objects.name: CSE_ASSETS_B
objects.description: Entity that holds all the physical attributes of the operational asset.

columns.name: ASSET_ID
columns.comments: Unique identifier and Primary Key for the asset. System Generated using the Fusion Global Unique ID generator

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ASSET_NUMBER
columns.comments: An user identifier for the asset object. This is the user primary key for the asset. If user does not enter a value then it is system generated using the Asset Document Number Sequence.

columns.name: ASSET_TAG
columns.comments: Asset Tag. This is an additional way of identifying the asset.

columns.name: ASSET_TRACKING_CODE
columns.comments: The tracking level of the asset. Whether the asset is tracked for full lifecycle, tracked as a customer asset only, or not tracked. This is a denormalized column from the item master.

columns.name: GENEALOGY_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating whether this asset is created from an item for which genealogy is enabled at the item master or not.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION_ASSET_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating whether the asset created is based just on the description and not an item or product. It is a free format way of defining an asset by not associating it to a product.

columns.name: VLD_ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.comments: The last validation organization used from the source application transaction.

columns.name: ITEM_ID
columns.comments: Product/Item reference as defined in the Fusion Item Master.

columns.name: ITEM_ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.comments: The organization id where this product instance is instantiated. This is usually the context organization when done from the workarea landing page. However transactional instantians will inherit the organization context of the transaction.

columns.name: ITEM_REVISION
columns.comments: The current revision of the product. As captured from the latest transaction.

columns.name: SERIAL_NUMBER
columns.comments: The Serial Number of the product. Which uniquely identifies the product instance that is either manufactured as an end assembly product or as components bought from the supplier.

columns.name: LOT_NUMBER
columns.comments: The unique lot number at the product instance level that tracks the batch of assemblies that are manufactured or procured from supplier.

columns.name: GEN_OBJECT_ID
columns.comments: Genealogy Object Identifier. The foreign key to the genealogy object.

columns.name: QUANTITY
columns.comments: Product Instance Quantity. It is always 1 for the serialized product instance. For the lot, it is the lot quantity at the tracked location.

columns.name: UOM_CODE
columns.comments: The primary unit of measure that tracks the product instance quantity.

columns.name: SECONDARY_QUANTITY
columns.comments: This is the secondary quantity captured when the item supports dual units of measure.

columns.name: SECONDARY_UOM_CODE
columns.comments: The unit of measure code for the secondary quantity. This is captured only when the item supports dual units of measure.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.comments: The status of the Asset. Product instance when tracked in the Inventory or WIP location may not have a status to be tracked.

columns.name: ACTIVE_END_DATE
columns.comments: The date when the asset is terminated.

columns.name: COMPETITOR_ASSET_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating that this asset is created in the repository just as a competitor asset to aid in the cross selling and up selling functional flows in CRM.

columns.name: CONNECTED_ASSET_FLAG
columns.comments: This flag indicates whether the asset is a connected asset. This enables the asset to integrate with any smart applications.

columns.name: IOT_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.comments: This flag indicates whether the asset is enabled to be synced to the IOT application. IOT enabled assets will be automatically synced to the IOT application when the SCM cloud env is wired to the native Oracle Asset Monitoring IOT app.

columns.name: CURRENT_LOCATION_CONTEXT
columns.comments: The current location context. This identifies the asset being located in the work center, inventory, wip job or in a customer location.

columns.name: CURRENT_LOCATION_ID
columns.comments: Current Location Identifier. The address location identifier.

columns.name: LOCATION_ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.comments: The organization id where the asset is located now. This works in conjunction with the other location columns like the work_center_id and the subinventory and locator.

columns.name: SUBINVENTORY_CODE
columns.comments: Subinventory Identifier. The inventory warehouse location.

columns.name: INVENTORY_LOCATOR_ID
columns.comments: The inventory item locator identifier.

columns.name: WORK_ORDER_ID
columns.comments: Work Order Reference when the component is issues to the work order.

columns.name: WORK_ORDER_OPERATION_ID
columns.comments: Work Order Operation Identifier.

columns.name: WORK_CENTER_ID
columns.comments: Work Center Identifier. The foreign key to the work center entity.

columns.name: PARENT_ASSET_ID
columns.comments: The immediate parent asset in the asset hierarchy. This is a denormalized column.

columns.name: ROOT_ASSET_ID
columns.comments: The root asset in the asset hierarchy. This is a denormalized column.

columns.name: LOGICAL_ROOT_ASSET_ID
columns.comments: The logical root asset in the as-sold logical hierarchy. This is a denormalized column.

columns.name: PROJECT_ID
columns.comments: The foreign key reference to the Project. Assets created from supply chain transactions that are performed in the context of a project will have this value populated.

columns.name: TASK_ID
columns.comments: The foreign key reference to the Project Task. Assets created from supply chain transactions that are performed in the context of a project task will have this value populated.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_LOCATION
columns.comments: An external location which is defined in the third party system and is not a defined location either in TCA or HR fusion system is captured in this column. A free format non translatable value is captured.

columns.name: PARTIALLY_FINISHED_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating whether the assembly serail is still a partially finished assembly.

columns.name: UNASSIGNED_FLAG
columns.comments: A flag that indicates whether the asset is assigned to the parent during the manufacturing process.

columns.name: SALES_ORDER_SOURCE_SYSTEM_TYPE
columns.comments: The type of the source sales order system.

columns.name: SALES_ORDER_SOURCE_SYSTEM
columns.comments: The source sales order system from which the order is captured.

columns.name: SALES_ORDER_NUMBER
columns.comments: The user key to the sales order business object

columns.name: SALES_ORDER_ID
columns.comments: Sales Order Identifier. Foreign key to the FOM Sales Order Entity.

columns.name: SALES_ORDER_LINE_NUMBER
columns.comments: The user key to the sales order lines entity.

columns.name: SALES_ORDER_LINE_ID
columns.comments: Sales Order Line Identifier. Foreign key to the FOM Sales Order Lines entity.

columns.name: INSTALLED_LOCATION_CONTEXT
columns.comments: The installed location context. The type of location where the asset is installed.

columns.name: INSTALLED_LOCATION_ID
columns.comments: Installed Location Identifier. Foreign key to either the hr location or hz location.

columns.name: SHIPMENT_DATE
columns.comments: Date when the asset is shipped to the customer.

columns.name: INSTALLED_DATE
columns.comments: Installation Date. Date when the equipment/asset is installed.

columns.name: IN_SERVICE_DATE
columns.comments: Date when the asset is placed in service.

columns.name: PURCHASE_DATE
columns.comments: Procurement Date. Date when the asset is procured from the Supplier.

columns.name: ORIGINATION_DATE
columns.comments: The original creation date of the Lot Number or Serial Number.

columns.name: SOLD_BY_BUSINESS_UNIT_ID
columns.comments: Sold By Business Unit Identifier

columns.name: REGISTERED_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag to indicate if the customer asset is registered or not.

columns.name: REGISTRATION_DATE
columns.comments: Date when the asset is registered as a customer asset.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_ASSET_START_DATE
columns.comments: The date when the customer asset was instantiated. Either during the creation of the asset when the item was set to track customer assets only or updated to the customer asset when the item is enabled for lifecycle tracking.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_ASSET_END_DATE
columns.comments: The date when the asset is no longer a customer asset. Either during the return of the asset back to the enterprise for good or when manually terminated from being a customer asset.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_ID
columns.comments: Customer Identifier. This is the sold to party id for which the asset is sold to. Sales order issue inventory transaction populates this value by reading this from the shipping details table.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_PARTY_TYPE
columns.comments: The party type of the customer. It could be an Organization Party or Person Party.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_SITE_PARTY_ID
columns.comments: The ship to party identifier captured at ths shiment transaction.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_SITE_ID
columns.comments: Customer Site Identifier. This is the ship to party site id of the customer that bought the customer asset.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_BILLING_PARTY_ID
columns.comments: The billing party that bought the asset.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_BILLING_PARTY_SITE_ID
columns.comments: The billing party site identifier. This is used in the derivation of the bill to location and there by the address of the billing party.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.comments: The billing customer account identifier.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_SITE_ID
columns.comments: The customer account site identifier.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_SITE_USE_ID
columns.comments: The identifier of the bill to account site use.

columns.name: CONTACT_ID
columns.comments: The contact of the asset. In the case of customer asset, the asset contact could be one of the party contacts that is defined in TCA for the customer that is associated with the asset. In the case of enterprise asset, it is simply an internal employee that is the custodian of the asset.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_ID
columns.comments: Supplier Identifier. The supplier from whom the asset was purchased.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_SITE_ID
columns.comments: Supplier Site Identifier. The primary key of the supplier site.

columns.name: COUNTRY_OF_ORIGIN_CODE
columns.comments: Code for the country of origin used to stripe the product genealogy data

columns.name: NEW_WO_ALLOWED_FLAG
columns.comments: This flag denotes whether the asset is maintainable or not. When the asset is not maintainable (New WO Allowed Flag = 'N'), a new work order cannot be created for the asset.

columns.name: DFLT_WO_TYPE
columns.comments: The work order type captured at the asset for the purpose of defaulting in the work order when created.

columns.name: DFLT_WO_SUB_TYPE
columns.comments: The work order sub type captured at the asset for the purpose of defaulting in the work order when created.

columns.name: MAINTAINABLE_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating whether the asset is used to drive maintenance management functions.

columns.name: OWNED_BY
columns.comments: Who is the owner of the asset. Values are 'E' for Enterprise and 'C' for Customer.

columns.name: USED_BY
columns.comments: Who is the user of the asset. Values are 'E' for Enterprise and 'C' for Customer.

columns.name: PARENT_ORDER_LINE_NUMBER
columns.comments: The order line number of the parent order line. When assets are created from om integration, the parent order line reference is provided, we capture that against the asset.

columns.name: PARENT_ORDER_LINE_ID
columns.comments: The order line identifier of the parent order line. When assets are created from om integration, the parent order line reference is provided, we capture that against the asset.

columns.name: FULFILL_LINE_ID
columns.comments: The distributed order orchestration fulfillment line reference.

columns.name: PARENT_FULFILL_LINE_ID
columns.comments: The parent fulfillment line reference in the context of the asset that was fulfilled by distributed order orchestration's fulfillment line.

columns.name: SALES_PRODUCT_TYPE
columns.comments: Attribute indicating classification of an item or product for sales processes

columns.name: LOGICAL_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag to indicate if this asset is for the purpose of logically grouping the tangible or software assets underneath the option class or model to project a sales view of the asset tree. More specifically to present the "As Sold" view.

columns.name: SPLIT_FROM_ASSET_ID
columns.comments: For non serial assets, when assets are split during partial return, the new asset created with the remaining quantity will have the split from asset reference.

columns.name: SHIPMENT_ID
columns.comments: From Outbound Shipments, the delivery_id is captured in this. From Inbound Receipts, the shipment_lind_id is captured here. This is an internal column used for processing.

columns.name: SHIPMENT_NUMBER
columns.comments: The shipment number that is used as the handle in the movement of products from one organization to another using an intransit stop.

columns.name: BOM_EXPLOSION_FLAG
columns.comments: This flag indicates whether this root asset is exploded to create the component assets using the primary item structure of the item at the root asset. This flag is only applicable at the root asset.

columns.name: COMPONENT_SEQUENCE_ID
columns.comments: The Bill Of Material Compenent Sequence Identifier. This will be populated when component assets are created using a bom explosion.

columns.name: QUANTITY_PER_ASSEMBLY
columns.comments: When this asset is created as a component asset as part of BOM explosion, the quantity per assembly from the item structure is captured here. Asset will be created with the extended quantity for the item structure component.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_SYSTEM_PACKING_UNIT
columns.comments: The capture of the packing unit (or license plate number) from the third party application that processes transactions in logistics.

columns.name: LICENSE_PLATE_NUMBER
columns.comments: This is the license plate number used to identify the packing unit.

columns.name: RETURN_ORDER_ID
columns.comments: The return order header identifier. Populated internally by the rma receiving transaction.

columns.name: RETURN_ORDER_LINE_ID
columns.comments: The return order line identifier. Populated internally by the rma receiving transaction.

columns.name: RETURN_ORDER_FULFILL_LINE_ID
columns.comments: The return order fulfillment line identifier. Populated internally by the rma receiving transaction.

columns.name: CONFIGURATOR_PATH
columns.comments: Configurator runtime representation of the Inventory Item Id path to the component. Path format is "." Separated inventory item id. For multi-instantiable components instances are denoted by [<instance number>].

columns.name: CONFIG_HEADER_ID
columns.comments: Header identifier of the configuration.

columns.name: CONFIG_REVISION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Revision number of the configuration.

columns.name: CRITICALITY_CODE
columns.comments: The criticality of the asset. Maintenance activities and performance metrics are defined based on the criticality of the asset.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY
columns.comments: Descriptive Flexfield: structure definition of the user descriptive flexfield.

objects.name: CSE_ASSETS_GT
objects.description: This is a global temporary table that is used in the processing for genealogy integration.

columns.name: GTT_ASSET_ID
columns.comments: The internal primay key to be used in the current session for the asset that is to be processed.

columns.name: PARENT_GTT_ASSET_ID
columns.comments: Reference to an in process asset that is also avaialble in this session.

columns.name: GTT_TXN_ID
columns.comments: The transaction reference of the asset that is being processed in this same session.

columns.name: GTT_REF_DOC_ID
columns.comments: A recerence document identifier associated to the Asset.

columns.name: GTT_SRC_DOC_ID
columns.comments: A source document identifier associated to the asset.

columns.name: GTT_GROUP_ID
columns.comments: The group id that groups the assets that is being processed in this session.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_QTY
columns.comments: The transaction quantity of the asset.

columns.name: QTY_PER_PARENT
columns.comments: The quantity per parent. This is used in the sales order fulfillment processing.

columns.name: ASSET_TRACKED_FLAG
columns.comments: The asset tracked flag from the item master, denormalized here for processing.

columns.name: ENABLE_GENEALOGY_TRACKING_FLAG
columns.comments: The genealogy tracking flag from the item master, denormalized here for processing.

columns.name: PRIMARY_UOM_CODE
columns.comments: The primary unit of measure code from the item master, denormalized here for processing.

columns.name: ASSET_ID
columns.comments: Unique identifier and Primary Key for the asset. System Generated using the Fusion Global Unique ID generator

columns.name: ASSET_OVN
columns.comments: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ASSET_NUMBER
columns.comments: An user identifier for the asset object. This is the user primary key for the asset. If user does not enter a value then it is system generated using the Asset Document Number Sequence.

columns.name: ASSET_TAG
columns.comments: Asset Tag. This is an additional way of identifying the asset.

columns.name: BOM_ITEM_TYPE
columns.comments: The bom item type as defined in the item master, denormalized here for processing.

columns.name: PICK_COMPONENTS_FLAG
columns.comments: The pick components flag as defined in the item master.

columns.name: REPLENISH_TO_ORDER_FLAG
columns.comments: The replenish to order flag as defined in the item master.

columns.name: ITEM_ID
columns.comments: Item identifier of the Asset that is being processed.

columns.name: ITEM_ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.comments: The organization id where this product instance is instantiated. This is usually the context organization when done from the workarea landing page. However transactional instantians will inherit the organization context of the transaction.

columns.name: ITEM_REVISION
columns.comments: The current revision of the product. As captured from the latest transaction.

columns.name: SERIAL_NUMBER
columns.comments: The Serial Number of the product. Which uniquely identifies the product instance that is either manufactured as an end assembly product or as components bought from the supplier.

columns.name: LOT_NUMBER
columns.comments: The unique lot number at the product instance level that tracks the batch of assemblies that are manufactured or procured from supplier.

columns.name: GEN_OBJECT_ID
columns.comments: Genealogy Object Identifier. The foreign key to the genealogy object.

columns.name: QUANTITY
columns.comments: Product Instance Quantity. It is always 1 for the serialized product instance. For the lot, it is the lot quantity at the tracked location.

columns.name: UOM_CODE
columns.comments: The primary unit of measure that tracks the product instance quantity.

columns.name: SECONDARY_QUANTITY
columns.comments: This is the secondary quantity captured when the item supports dual units of measure.

columns.name: SECONDARY_UOM_CODE
columns.comments: The unit of measure code for the secondary quantity. This is captured only when the item supports dual units of measure.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.comments: The status of the Asset. Product instance when tracked in the Inventory or WIP location may not have a status to be tracked.

columns.name: ACTIVE_END_DATE
columns.comments: The date when the asset is terminated.

columns.name: CURRENT_LOCATION_CONTEXT
columns.comments: The current location context. This identifies the asset being located in the work center, inventory, wip job or in a customer location.

columns.name: CURRENT_LOCATION_ID
columns.comments: Current Location Identifier. The address location identifier.

columns.name: LOCATION_ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.comments: The organization id where the asset is located now. This works in conjunction with the other location columns like the work_center_id and the subinventory and locator.

columns.name: SUBINVENTORY_CODE
columns.comments: Subinventory Identifier. The inventory warehouse location.

columns.name: INVENTORY_LOCATOR_ID
columns.comments: The inventory item locator identifier.

columns.name: WORK_ORDER_ID
columns.comments: Work Order Reference when the component is issues to the work order.

columns.name: WORK_ORDER_OPERATION_ID
columns.comments: Work Order Operation Identifier. When the processing involves a manufacturing Work Order.

columns.name: WORK_CENTER_ID
columns.comments: Work Center Identifier. The foreign key to the work center entity.

columns.name: PARTIALLY_FINISHED_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating whether the assembly serail is still a partially finished assembly.

columns.name: UNASSIGNED_FLAG
columns.comments: A flag that indicates whether the asset is assigned to the parent during the manufacturing process.

columns.name: SORDER_SOURCE_SYSTEM_TYPE
columns.comments: The sales order source system where the order is captured.

columns.name: SALES_ORDER_SOURCE_SYSTEM
columns.comments: The source sales order system from which the order is captured.

columns.name: SALES_ORDER_NUMBER
columns.comments: The user key to the sales order business object

columns.name: SALES_ORDER_ID
columns.comments: Sales Order Identifier. Foreign key to the FOM Sales Order Entity.

columns.name: SALES_ORDER_LINE_NUMBER
columns.comments: The user key to the sales order lines entity.

columns.name: SALES_ORDER_LINE_ID
columns.comments: Sales Order Line Identifier. Foreign key to the FOM Sales Order Lines entity.

columns.name: FULFILL_LINE_ID
columns.comments: The distributed order orchestration fulfillment line reference.

columns.name: OM_MAP_ID
columns.comments: The mapping identifier from the user configured service map for processing asset data from order fulfillments.

columns.name: PARENT_FULFILL_LINE_ID
columns.comments: The parent fulfillment line reference in the context of the asset that was fulfilled by distributed order orchestration's fulfillment line.

columns.name: ROOT_PAR_FULFILL_LINE_ID
columns.comments: The root parent fulfillment line identifier.

columns.name: PARENT_ORDER_LINE_NUMBER
columns.comments: The order line number of the parent order line. When assets are created from om integration, the parent order line reference is provided, we capture that against the asset.

columns.name: PARENT_ORDER_LINE_ID
columns.comments: The order line identifier of the parent order line. When assets are created from om integration, the parent order line reference is provided, we capture that against the asset.

columns.name: RMA_SOURCE_SYSTEM_TYPE
columns.comments: The return order source system type.

columns.name: RMA_ORDER_SOURCE_SYSTEM
columns.comments: The return order source system.

columns.name: RMA_ORDER_NUMBER
columns.comments: The return sales order number.

columns.name: RMA_ORDER_ID
columns.comments: The return sales order identifier.

columns.name: RMA_ORDER_LINE_NUMBER
columns.comments: The return sales order line number.

columns.name: RMA_ORDER_LINE_ID
columns.comments: The return sales order line identifier.

columns.name: RMA_FULFILL_LINE_ID
columns.comments: The return sales order fulfillment line identifier.

columns.name: RMA_PAR_FULFILL_LINE_ID
columns.comments: The return sales oder fulfillment line identifier's parent.

columns.name: RMA_ROOT_PAR_FULFILL_LINE_ID
columns.comments: The root parent fulfillment line identifier of the return sales order fulfillment line.

columns.name: RMA_PAR_ORDER_LINE_NUMBER
columns.comments: The parent line of the return sales order line.

columns.name: RMA_PAR_ORDER_LINE_ID
columns.comments: The parent line identifier of the return sales order line.

columns.name: INSTALLED_LOCATION_CONTEXT
columns.comments: The installed location context. The type of location where the asset is installed.

columns.name: INSTALLED_LOCATION_ID
columns.comments: Installed Location Identifier. Foreign key to either the hr location or hz location.

columns.name: SHIPMENT_DATE
columns.comments: Date when the asset is shipped to the customer.

columns.name: INSTALLED_DATE
columns.comments: Date when the asset is installed.

columns.name: IN_SERVICE_DATE
columns.comments: Date when the asset is placed in service.

columns.name: PURCHASE_DATE
columns.comments: Procurement Date. Date when the asset is procured from the Supplier.

columns.name: ORIGINATION_DATE
columns.comments: The original creation date of the Lot Number or Serial Number.

columns.name: SOLD_BY_BUSINESS_UNIT_ID
columns.comments: Sold By Business Unit Identifier

columns.name: REGISTERED_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag to indicate if the customer asset is registered or not.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_ASSET_START_DATE
columns.comments: The date when the customer asset was instantiated. Either during the creation of the asset when the item was set to track customer assets only or updated to the customer asset when the item is enabled for lifecycle tracking.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_ASSET_END_DATE
columns.comments: The date when the asset is no longer a customer asset. Either during the return of the asset back to the enterprise for good or when manually terminated from being a customer asset.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_ID
columns.comments: Customer Identifier. This is the sold to party id for which the asset is sold to. Sales order issue inventory transaction populates this value by reading this from the shipping details table.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_PARTY_TYPE
columns.comments: The party type of the customer. It could be an Organization Party or Person Party.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_SITE_PARTY_ID
columns.comments: The ship to party identifier captured at ths shiment transaction.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_SITE_ID
columns.comments: Customer Site Identifier. This is the ship to party site id of the customer that bought the customer asset.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_BILLING_PARTY_ID
columns.comments: The billing party that bought the asset.

columns.name: CUST_BILLING_PARTY_SITE_ID
columns.comments: Customer Billing Party Site Identifier captured for the Customer Asset.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.comments: The billing customer account identifier.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_SITE_ID
columns.comments: The customer account site identifier.

columns.name: CUST_ACCOUNT_SITE_USE_ID
columns.comments: Customer Account Site Use Identifier for the Customer Asset.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_ID
columns.comments: Supplier Identifier. The supplier from whom the asset was purchased.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_SITE_ID
columns.comments: Supplier Site Identifier. The primary key of the supplier site.

columns.name: NEW_WO_ALLOWED_FLAG
columns.comments: This flag denotes whether the asset is maintainable or not. When the asset is not maintainable (New WO Allowed Flag = 'N'), a new work order cannot be created for the asset.

columns.name: DFLT_WO_TYPE
columns.comments: The work order type captured at the asset for the purpose of defaulting in the work order when created.

columns.name: DFLT_WO_SUB_TYPE
columns.comments: The work order sub type captured at the asset for the purpose of defaulting in the work order when created.

columns.name: MAINTAINABLE_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating whether the asset is used to drive maintenance management functions.

columns.name: OWNED_BY
columns.comments: Who is the owner of the asset. Values are 'E' for Enterprise and 'C' for Customer.

columns.name: USED_BY
columns.comments: Who is the user of the asset. Values are 'E' for Enterprise and 'C' for Customer.

columns.name: LOGICAL_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag to indicate if this asset is for the purpose of logically grouping the tangible or software assets underneath the option class or model to project a sales view of the asset tree. More specifically to present the "As Sold" view.

columns.name: SALES_PRODUCT_TYPE
columns.comments: Attribute indicating classification of an item or product for sales processes

columns.name: REGISTRATION_DATE
columns.comments: Date when the asset is registered as a customer asset.

columns.name: SPLIT_FROM_ASSET_ID
columns.comments: For non serial assets, when assets are split during partial return, the new asset created with the remaining quantity will have the split from asset reference.

columns.name: MERGED_TO_ASSET_ID
columns.comments: Asset that this Transacted Asset is merging to.

columns.name: CASCADED_FROM_ASSET_ID
columns.comments: The parent asset from which the location information is cascaded from.

columns.name: RETURNED_FROM_PARENT_ASSET_ID
columns.comments: The parent asset refernce is captured and is stored here when the rma receipt happens for the component. This will be used to rebuild the configuration upon shipment of the replacement. This column is used only for staged transactions.

columns.name: ACTUAL_RETURNED_ASSET_ID
columns.comments: The actual asset that was returned for the staged inbound transaction. Used for component replacement functionality from service logistics.

columns.name: ACTUAL_SHIPPED_ASSET_ID
columns.comments: The actual asset that was shipped for the staged outbound transaction. Used for component replacement functionality from service logistics.

columns.name: SHIPMENT_ID
columns.comments: From Outbound Shipments, the delivery_id is captured in this. From Inbound Receipts, the shipment_lind_id is captured here. This is an internal column used for processing.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_LOCATION
columns.comments: An external location which is defined in the third party system and is not a defined location either in TCA or HR fusion system is captured in this column. A free format non translatable value is captured.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.comments: currency code for the extensibility

columns.name: CORP_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.comments: corporate currency code for extensibility

columns.name: CURCY_CONV_RATE_TYPE
columns.comments: currency conversion rate type for extensibility

columns.name: CONNECTED_ASSET_FLAG
columns.comments: This flag indicates whether the asset is a connected asset. This enables the asset to integrate with any smart applications.

columns.name: IOT_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.comments: This flag indicates whether the asset is enabled to be synced to the IOT application. IOT enabled assets will be automatically synced to the IOT application when the SCM cloud env is wired to the native Oracle Asset Monitoring IOT app.

columns.name: BOM_EXPLOSION_FLAG
columns.comments: This flag indicates whether this root asset is exploded to create the component assets using the primary item structure of the item at the root asset. This flag is only applicable at the root asset.

columns.name: COMPONENT_SEQUENCE_ID
columns.comments: The Bill Of Material Compenent Sequence Identifier. This will be populated when component assets are created using a bom explosion.

columns.name: QUANTITY_PER_ASSEMBLY
columns.comments: When this asset is created as a component asset as part of BOM explosion, the quantity per assembly from the item structure is captured here. Asset will be created with the extended quantity for the item structure component.

columns.name: EXT_SYSTEM_PACKING_UNIT
columns.comments: The external system packing unit.

columns.name: LICENSE_PLATE_NUMBER
columns.comments: This is the license plate number used to identify the packing unit.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION_ASSET_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating whether the asset created is based just on the description and not an item or product. It is a free format way of defining an asset by not associating it to a product.

columns.name: COMPETITOR_ASSET_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating that this asset is created in the repository just as a competitor asset to aid in the cross selling and up selling functional flows in CRM.

columns.name: RETURN_ORDER_ID
columns.comments: The return order header identifier. Populated internally by the rma receiving transaction.

columns.name: RETURN_ORDER_LINE_ID
columns.comments: The return order line identifier. Populated internally by the rma receiving transaction.

columns.name: RETURN_ORDER_FULFILL_LINE_ID
columns.comments: The return order fulfillment line identifier. Populated internally by the rma receiving transaction.

columns.name: ASSET_QTY
columns.comments: Asset Quantity. This is an interim column used in the processing logic.

columns.name: SPLIT_FROM_GTT_ASSET_ID
columns.comments: The split from asset id that is recorded in the interim session based processing.

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.comments: The action code as identified by the preprocessor.

columns.name: SERIAL_CONTROL_CODE
columns.comments: The serial control policy of the item, denormalized here for processing.

columns.name: LOT_CONTROL_CODE
columns.comments: The lot control policy of the item, denormalized here for processing.

columns.name: ITEM_SUB_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: The item sub type code as derived by the fulfillment engine.

columns.name: LINE_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: The sales order line type code to identify if the sales order is outbound or inbound.

columns.name: SRC_DEST_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: The flag indicating whether the temp asset is used as a source asset or destination asset.

columns.name: FOREIGNKEY_GTT_ASSET_ID
columns.comments: A reference to another asset that is being processed in this session.

columns.name: CONFIG_INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
columns.comments: Configured Item's identifier.

columns.name: MATCH_FOUND
columns.comments: This flag indicates whether a match is found already or not.

columns.name: INSTALLED_LOCATION_ID
columns.comments: Installed Location Identifier. Foreign key to either the hr location or hz location.

columns.name: SHIPMENT_DATE
columns.comments: Date when the asset is shipped to the customer.

columns.name: INSTALLED_DATE
columns.comments: Installation Date. Date when the equipment/asset is installed.

columns.name: IN_SERVICE_DATE
columns.comments: Date when the asset is placed in service.

columns.name: PURCHASE_DATE
columns.comments: Procurement Date. Date when the asset is procured from the Supplier.

columns.name: ORIGINATION_DATE
columns.comments: The original creation date of the Lot Number or Serial Number.

columns.name: SOLD_BY_BUSINESS_UNIT_ID
columns.comments: Sold By Business Unit Identifier

columns.name: CUSTOMER_ASSET_START_DATE
columns.comments: The date when the customer asset was instantiated. Either during the creation of the asset when the item was set to track customer assets only or updated to the customer asset when the item is enabled for lifecycle tracking.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_ASSET_END_DATE
columns.comments: The date when the asset is no longer a customer asset. Either during the return of the asset back to the enterprise for good or when manually terminated from being a customer asset.

columns.name: REGISTERED_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag to indicate if the customer asset is registered or not.

columns.name: REGISTRATION_DATE
columns.comments: Date when the asset is registered as a customer asset.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_ID
columns.comments: Customer Identifier. This is the sold to party id for which the asset is sold to. Sales order issue inventory transaction populates this value by reading this from the shipping details table.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_SITE_PARTY_ID
columns.comments: The ship to party identifier captured at ths shiment transaction.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_SITE_ID
columns.comments: Customer Site Identifier. This is the ship to party site id of the customer that bought the customer asset.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_BILLING_PARTY_ID
columns.comments: The billing party that bought the asset.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_BILLING_PARTY_SITE_ID
columns.comments: The billing party site identifier. This is used in the derivation of the bill to location and there by the address of the billing party.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.comments: The billing customer account identifier.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_SITE_ID
columns.comments: The customer account site identifier.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_SITE_USE_ID
columns.comments: The identifier of the bill to account site use.

columns.name: CONTACT_ID
columns.comments: The contact of the asset. In the case of customer asset, the asset contact could be one of the party contacts that is defined in TCA for the customer that is associated with the asset. In the case of enterprise asset, it is simply an internal employee that is the custodian of the asset.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_ID
columns.comments: Supplier Identifier. The supplier from whom the asset was purchased.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_SITE_ID
columns.comments: Supplier Site Identifier. The primary key of the supplier site.

columns.name: COUNTRY_OF_ORIGIN_CODE
columns.comments: Code for the country of origin used to stripe the product genealogy data

columns.name: NEW_WO_ALLOWED_FLAG
columns.comments: This flag denotes whether the asset is maintainable or not. When the asset is not maintainable (New WO Allowed Flag = 'N'), a new work order cannot be created for the asset.

columns.name: DFLT_WO_TYPE
columns.comments: The work order type captured at the asset for the purpose of defaulting in the work order when created.

columns.name: DFLT_WO_SUB_TYPE
columns.comments: The work order sub type captured at the asset for the purpose of defaulting in the work order when created.

columns.name: MAINTAINABLE_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating whether the asset is used to drive maintenance management functions.

columns.name: OWNED_BY
columns.comments: Who is the owner of the asset. Values are 'E' for Enterprise and 'C' for Customer.

columns.name: USED_BY
columns.comments: Who is the user of the asset. Values are 'E' for Enterprise and 'C' for Customer.

columns.name: PARENT_ORDER_LINE_NUMBER
columns.comments: The order line number of the parent order line. When assets are created from om integration, the parent order line reference is provided, we capture that against the asset.

columns.name: PARENT_ORDER_LINE_ID
columns.comments: The order line identifier of the parent order line. When assets are created from om integration, the parent order line reference is provided, we capture that against the asset.

columns.name: FULFILL_LINE_ID
columns.comments: The distributed order orchestration fulfillment line reference.

columns.name: PARENT_FULFILL_LINE_ID
columns.comments: The parent fulfillment line reference in the context of the asset that was fulfilled by distributed order orchestration's fulfillment line.

columns.name: SALES_PRODUCT_TYPE
columns.comments: Attribute indicating classification of an item or product for sales processes

columns.name: LOGICAL_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag to indicate if this asset is for the purpose of logically grouping the tangible or software assets underneath the option class or model to project a sales view of the asset tree. More specifically to present the "As Sold" view.

columns.name: SPLIT_FROM_ASSET_ID
columns.comments: For non serial assets, when assets are split during partial return, the new asset created with the remaining quantity will have the split from asset reference.

columns.name: SHIPMENT_ID
columns.comments: From Outbound Shipments, the delivery_id is captured in this. From Inbound Receipts, the shipment_lind_id is captured here. This is an internal column used for processing.

columns.name: SHIPMENT_NUMBER
columns.comments: The shipment number that is used as the handle in the movement of products from one organization to another using an intransit stop.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_SYSTEM_PACKING_UNIT
columns.comments: The external system packing unit that is gathered from the upstream logistics flows.

columns.name: LICENSE_PLATE_NUMBER
columns.comments: This is the license plate number used to identify the packing unit.

columns.name: BOM_EXPLOSION_FLAG
columns.comments: This flag indicates whether this root asset is exploded to create the component assets using the primary item structure of the item at the root asset. This flag is only applicable at the root asset.

columns.name: QUANTITY_PER_ASSEMBLY
columns.comments: When this asset is created as a component asset as part of BOM explosion, the quantity per assembly from the item structure is captured here. Asset will be created with the extended quantity for the item structure component.

columns.name: RETURN_ORDER_ID
columns.comments: The return order header identifier. Populated internally by the rma receiving transaction.

columns.name: RETURN_ORDER_LINE_ID
columns.comments: The return order line identifier. Populated internally by the rma receiving transaction.

columns.name: RETURN_ORDER_FULFILL_LINE_ID
columns.comments: The return order fulfillment line identifier. Populated internally by the rma receiving transaction.

columns.name: CONFIGURATOR_PATH
columns.comments: Configurator runtime representation of the Inventory Item Id path to the component. Path format is "." Separated inventory item id. For multi-instantiable components instances are denoted by [<instance number>].

columns.name: CONFIG_HEADER_ID
columns.comments: Header identifier of the configuration.

columns.name: CONFIG_REVISION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Revision number of the configuration.

columns.name: CRITICALITY_CODE
columns.comments: The criticality of the asset. Maintenance activities and performance metrics are defined based on the criticality of the asset.

objects.name: CSE_ASSETS_INT
objects.description: The staging entity that holds all the physical attributes of the operational asset.

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.comments: Interface Row Identifier. The primary key column of this table.

columns.name: INTERFACE_STATUS_CODE
columns.comments: The status of the interface row. The processor heavily relies on this column to persist interim status of the row upon processing data in bulk.

columns.name: INTERFACE_BATCH_ID
columns.comments: Interface Batch Identifier. This is the foreign key to the Interface Batch entity.

columns.name: INTERFACE_BATCH_CODE
columns.comments: The interface batch code. The user key to the interface batch entity.

columns.name: INTERFACE_RECORD_NUMBER
columns.comments: Interface Record Number. This is the user key to link the child interface entities together.

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.comments: The various actions that can be performed via the import functionality at the asset level.

columns.name: ASSET_ID
columns.comments: Unique identifier and Primary Key for the asset. System Generated using the Fusion Global Unique ID generator

columns.name: ASSET_NUMBER
columns.comments: An user identifier for the asset object. This is the user primary key for the asset. If user does not enter a value then it is system generated using the Asset Document Number Sequence.

columns.name: ASSET_DESCRIPTION
columns.comments: The detailed description of the asset.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION_ASSET_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating whether the asset created is based just on the description and not an item or product. It is a free format way of defining an asset by not associating it to a product.

columns.name: VLD_ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.comments: The last validation organization used from the source application transaction.

columns.name: ITEM_ID
columns.comments: Product/Item reference as defined in the Fusion Item Master.

columns.name: ITEM_NUMBER
columns.comments: Inventory Item Number. The user key to identify the product associated to the asset.

columns.name: ITEM_ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.comments: The organization id where this product instance is instantiated.

columns.name: ITEM_ORGANIZATION_CODE
columns.comments: The item organization user key. The organization where the asset was last located.

columns.name: ASSET_TRACKING_CODE
columns.comments: The tracking level of the asset. Whether the asset is tracked for full lifecycle, tracked as a customer asset only, or not tracked. This is a denormalized column from the item master.

columns.name: GENEALOGY_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating whether this asset is created from an item for which genealogy is enabled at the item master or not.

columns.name: ITEM_REVISION
columns.comments: The current revision of the product. As captured from the latest transaction.

columns.name: SERIAL_NUMBER
columns.comments: The Serial Number of the product. Which uniquely identifies the product instance that is either manufactured as an end assembly product or as components bought from the supplier.

columns.name: LOT_NUMBER
columns.comments: The unique lot number at the product instance level that tracks the batch of assemblies that are manufactured or procured from supplier.

columns.name: QUANTITY
columns.comments: Product Instance Quantity. It is always 1 for the serialized product instance. For the lot, it is the lot quantity at the tracked location.

columns.name: UOM_CODE
columns.comments: The primary unit of measure that tracks the product instance quantity.

columns.name: SECONDARY_QUANTITY
columns.comments: This is the secondary quantity captured when the item supports dual units of measure.

columns.name: SECONDARY_UOM_CODE
columns.comments: The unit of measure code for the secondary quantity. This is captured only when the item supports dual units of measure.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.comments: The status of the Asset. Product instance when tracked in the Inventory or WIP location may not have a status to be tracked.

columns.name: COMPETITOR_ASSET_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating that this asset is created in the repository just as a competitor asset to aid in the cross selling and up selling functional flows in CRM.

columns.name: CONNECTED_ASSET_FLAG
columns.comments: This flag indicates whether the asset is a connected asset. This enables the asset to integrate with any smart applications.

columns.name: IOT_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.comments: This flag indicates whether the asset is enabled to be synced to the IOT application. IOT enabled assets will be automatically synced to the IOT application when the SCM cloud env is wired to the native Oracle Asset Monitoring IOT app.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_PARTY_TYPE

columns.name: CUSTOMER_SITE_PARTY_NUMBER
columns.comments: The party number of the ship to party.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_SITE_PARTY_NAME
columns.comments: The party name of the ship-to party.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_SITE_PARTY_ID
columns.comments: The party identifier of the ship-to party. This is stored in the asset as a customer site's party id.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_SITE_NUMBER
columns.comments: The party site number of the shippped to party.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_SITE_NAME
columns.comments: The site name of the ship to party site.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_SITE_ID
columns.comments: The ship-to party site identifier. The foreign key to the hz_party_sites entity. This is where the asset is shipped to and assumed to be the customer site identifier..

columns.name: CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_NUMBER
columns.comments: The account number of the customer account.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_NAME
columns.comments: The account name of the customer account.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.comments: The billing customer account identifier.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_SITE_NUMBER
columns.comments: The site number of the customer account site.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_SITE_NAME
columns.comments: The account site name of the customer account.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_SITE_ID
columns.comments: The customer account site identifier.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_SITE_USE_CODE
columns.comments: The site use code of the customer account site.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_SITE_USE_ID
columns.comments: The identifier of the bill to account site use.

columns.name: CONTACT_ID
columns.comments: The contact of the asset. In the case of customer asset, the asset contact could be one of the party contacts that is defined in TCA for the customer that is associated with the asset. In the case of enterprise asset, it is simply an internal employee that is the custodian of the asset.

columns.name: CONTACT_NUMBER
columns.comments: The party number of the contact. This is the party_number from hz_parties for the contact_id.

columns.name: CONTACT_NAME
columns.comments: The party name of the contact. This is the party_name from hz_parties for the contact_id.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_ID
columns.comments: Supplier Identifier. The foreign key to the Suppliers business object.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_NAME
columns.comments: The user key to the supplier business object. The party name in hz_parties.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_SITE_ID
columns.comments: Supplier Site Identifier. The primary key of the supplier site.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_SITE_CODE
columns.comments: The user key to the supplier site business object.

columns.name: DFLT_WO_TYPE
columns.comments: The work order type captured at the asset for the purpose of defaulting in the work order when created.

columns.name: DFLT_WO_SUB_TYPE
columns.comments: The work order sub type captured at the asset for the purpose of defaulting in the work order when created.

columns.name: MAINTAINABLE_FLAG
columns.comments: The flag that indicates whether the asset is maintainable using the maintenance management functions.

columns.name: ACTIVE_END_DATE
columns.comments: The date when the asset is terminated.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_ASSET_START_DATE
columns.comments: The date when the customer asset was instantiated. Either during the creation of the asset when the item was set to track customer assets only or updated to the customer asset when the item is enabled for lifecycle tracking.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_ASSET_END_DATE
columns.comments: The date when the asset is no longer a customer asset. Either during the return of the asset back to the enterprise for good or when manually terminated from being a customer asset.

columns.name: NEW_WO_ALLOWED_FLAG
columns.comments: This flag denotes whether the asset is maintainable or not. When the asset is not maintainable (New WO Allowed Flag = 'N'), a new work order cannot be created for the asset.

columns.name: OKC_INTERFACE_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag to indicate whether service contract interface is required or not.

columns.name: EXPLODE_BOM_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating whether component assets are created as a result of exploding the bills of materials of the item for which the asset is created.

columns.name: NEW_ASSET_NUMBER
columns.comments: Populate a value in this field to change the asset number.

columns.name: GEN_OBJECT_ID
columns.comments: Genealogy object identifier. Foreign key to CSE_GENEALOGY_OBJECTS.

columns.name: ROOT_ASSET_ID
columns.comments: The root asset in the asset hierarchy. This is a denormalized column.

columns.name: LOGICAL_ROOT_ASSET_ID
columns.comments: The logical root asset in the as-sold logical hierarchy. This is a denormalized column.

columns.name: PARENT_INT_RECORD_NUMBER
columns.comments: When this asset that is being created or updated as a component of another parent asset, and the parent asset creation is inflight in the same batch that parent asset can be referenced here using its interface_record_number.

columns.name: PARENT_INT_RECORD_ID
columns.comments: The internal column to identify the parent asset's interface record number. Derived for parent_int_record_number.

columns.name: PARENT_ASSET_NUMBER
columns.comments: When a parent asset is referenced here, a component relationship is created between the parent asset and the asset that is being processed.

columns.name: PARENT_ASSET_ID
columns.comments: Internal identifier for the referenced parent asset number. Used for internal processing.

columns.name: RELATIONSHIP_ACTION_CODE
columns.comments: The actions that can be done when a parent asset is referenced. It could be either an add or remove. The lookup values are drawn from the lookup type ORA_CSE_ASSET_IMPORT_CFG_ACTION.

columns.name: RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: When a parent asset is referenced, the relationship that is created between the parent and its subject is established by this relationship type. This is defined as an internal column.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_LOCATION
columns.comments: An external location which is defined in the third party system and is not a defined location either in TCA or HR fusion system is captured in this column. A free format non translatable value is captured.

columns.name: IN_SERVICE_DATE
columns.comments: Date when the asset is placed in service.

columns.name: INSTALLED_DATE

columns.name: INVENTORY_LOCATOR_NAME

columns.name: PARENT_ITEM_NUMBER

columns.name: PARENT_SERIAL_NUMBER

columns.name: PARENT_LOT_NUMBER
columns.comments: The parent asset's lot number captured so that the asset can be resolved when the parent_asset_id is not passed.

columns.name: REGISTRATION_DATE

objects.description: This table stores the charges that are captured from order management for the asset sold to the customer. The price breakdown by charge element is captured in this table.

columns.name: ASSET_CHARGE_ID
columns.comments: The unique primary key identifier for the asset charges entity.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ASSET_ID
columns.comments: Foreign key to the customer asset entity. The order line charges specific to the instantiated asset.

columns.name: CHARGE_DEFINITION_CODE
columns.comments: The unique charge definition code

columns.name: PRICE_ELEMENT_CODE
columns.comments: The elemental breakdown of the charge. The type code that denotes that breakdown.

columns.name: PRICE_ELEMENT_USAGE_CODE
columns.comments: The usage of the price element where is charge is recorded.

columns.name: PRICED_QUANTITY_UOM_CODE
columns.comments: The unit of measure at which the order line quantity is priced. The priced quantity would be the asset quantity.

columns.name: UNIT_PRICE
columns.comments: The unit price of the item on the order line.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.comments: The currency code with which the order line was priced.

columns.name: PRIMARY_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating which of the price element is to be treated as the primary charge.

columns.name: PRICE_PERIODICITY_CODE
columns.comments: The price periodicity code when there is recurring billing involved.

columns.name: CHARGES_ROLLUP_FLAG
columns.comments: Rollup flag for the charges entity.

columns.name: CHARGE_COMPONENTS_ROLLUP_FLAG
columns.comments: The rollup flag at the charge comonents level.

columns.name: TAX_INCLUDED_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag that indicates whether tax is included in the charge or not.

columns.name: ACTIVE_START_DATE
columns.comments: The date when the asset charge became active.

columns.name: ACTIVE_END_DATE
columns.comments: The date when the asset charge was terminated.

columns.comments: The foreign key reference to the logical hierarchy.

columns.name: POSITION_NUMBER
columns.comments: The position number of the component or the node in the asset logical hierarchy.

columns.name: POTENTIAL_FLAG
columns.comments: There are use cases in the Manufacturing flow where a component of relationship is assumed based on the delayed birting point of the assembly serial number. In such cases the component takes on a Many-to-Many relationship with multiple parent serial numbers. These relationships are marked as potential relationships with this flag.

columns.name: MERGE_FLAG

columns.name: TRANSLATE_FLAG
columns.comments: This flag indicates a relationship between genealogy objects, mainly the lots that are translated to another. The relationship will be created with the relationship type as "component of", with the translate flag set.

objects.description: This table stores the batch information for grouping the asset interface records. A asset interface batch identifies the source system that the assets are interfaced from. It may also keep references of the user submitting the batch for processing and the time when the batch was created and how much time it took to process this batch. columns.name: SOURCE_TRANSACTION_TYPE_ID

columns.name: SOURCE_TRANSACTION_TYPE
columns.comments: Source Transaction type. The type of transaction performed in the source system.

columns.name: SOURCE_TRANSACTION_DATE
columns.comments: The transaction date from the source system captured at the batch level. The source transaction date captured at the batch level will be used in creating transactions for the asset.

columns.name: INTERNAL_BATCH_TYPE
columns.comments: This is an internal column to differentiate whether the batch is loaded for maintainable assets or customer assets. The valid values are MA and CA. MA for maintainable assets and CA for customer assets.

columns.name: METER_DEFINITION_ID
columns.comments: The foreign key to the Meter Definition entity. Multiple meters are instantiated for a meter definition.

columns.name: ORGANIZATION_ID

columns.name: OBJECT_TYPE_CODE

columns.name: OBJECT_ID

objects.name: CSE_METER_DEFINITIONS_B
objects.description: Entity that holds all the physical attributes of the meter template.

columns.name: METER_DEFINITION_ID
columns.comments: Unique identifier and Primary Key for the meter. System Generated using the Fusion Global Unique ID generator

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: TEMPLATE_USAGE_CODE
columns.comments: The meter template can be created either to instantiate meters for the assets or for subsctiptions. The lookup will be ORA_CSE_METER_TEMP_USAGE_CODE and the values passed will be ORA_ASSET or ORA_SUBSCRIPTION.

columns.name: METER_CODE
columns.comments: The unique user identifier for the meter. It is unique across the system.

columns.name: METER_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: The type of the meter. The various types are continuous or gauge.

columns.name: READING_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: The type of reading that this meter will capture. The various values are absolute or change.

columns.name: UOM_CODE
columns.comments: The unit of measure in which meter readings should be captured.

columns.name: READING_DIRECTION
columns.comments: The direction indicates whether the next value captured should be in the ascending form or descending form or both directions are allowed.

columns.name: INITIAL_READING_VALUE
columns.comments: When the meter is defined, the readings as found in the device could be recorded optionally as an initial value.

columns.name: READING_MIN_VALUE
columns.comments: The min value allowed to be captured in the meter reading.

columns.name: READING_MAX_VALUE
columns.comments: The max value allowed to be captured in the meter reading.

columns.name: RESET_ALLOWED_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating wheter the meter reading can be reset to the specified reset value.

columns.name: RESET_VALUE
columns.comments: The value to which the meter is reset to when the user resets the meter.

columns.name: ROLLOVER_ALLOWED_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating whether the meter reading automatically rolls over when it reaches its limit.

columns.name: ROLLOVER_MAX_VALUE
columns.comments: The value at which the meter automatically rolls over to the reset value when the meter is configured to rollover.

columns.name: ROLLOVER_RESET_VALUE
columns.comments: The value to which the meter resets when the max rollover value is reached for the meter that is configured to rollover.

columns.name: ACTIVE_START_DATE
columns.comments: The date when the meter template becomes active.

columns.name: ACTIVE_END_DATE
columns.comments: The date when the meter template is end dated.

columns.name: RECORD_AT_WO_COMPL_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates whether the reading capture at work order completion is a mandatory or optional requirement.

columns.name: ALLOW_IN_MAINT_PROGRAM_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating wheter any meter created from this template, can be included in the maintenance program to be able to specify a usage based forecast generation.

columns.name: DAILY_UTILIZATION_RATE
columns.comments: Daily utilization rate for the meter. Default value at the template level.

columns.name: UTILIZATION_RATE_COMPUTED_AT
columns.comments: The nth reading at which the utilization rate should be computed at.

columns.name: FORECAST_USING_DAILY_RATE_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating whether the forecast generation program can consider the daily utilization rate on the meter to compute the forecasts for the assets on the maintenance program.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.comments: Currency code for the extensibility

columns.name: CORP_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.comments: Corporate currency code for extensibility

columns.name: CURCY_CONV_RATE_TYPE
columns.comments: Currency conversion rate type for extensibility

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY
columns.comments: Descriptive Flexfield: structure definition of the user descriptive flexfield.

objects.description: Translation Entity for CSE_METER_DEFINITIONS_B.

columns.name: METER_DEFINITION_ID
columns.comments: Meter Definition Identifier. The primary key of the meter definition business object.

columns.name: LANGUAGE
columns.comments: Indicates the code of the language into which the contents of the translatable columns are translated.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SOURCE_LANG
columns.comments: Indicates the code of the language in which the contents of the translatable columns were originally created.

columns.name: METER_NAME
columns.comments: The name of the meter. Because this is a transalatable attribute, this cannot be used as an alternate key.

columns.name: METER_DESCRIPTION
columns.comments: The detailed description of the meter.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN

objects.name: CSE_METER_READINGS
objects.description: Entity that holds all the physical attributes of the meter readings.

columns.name: METER_READING_ID
columns.comments: Unique identifier and Primary Key for the meter. System Generated using the Fusion Global Unique ID generator

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: METER_ID
columns.comments: The foreign key to the instantiated meter.

columns.name: READING_DATE
columns.comments: The date when the reading is captured.

columns.name: READING_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: When reading is captured for the meter that has the meter reading type of both (absolute or change), at the capture time, user must say whether the value is absolute or change.

columns.name: READING_VALUE
columns.comments: The numeric reading value that is captured for the meter.

columns.name: READING_NET_CHANGE
columns.comments: Computed programatically. Typically it will be = new reading – net of last reading, but there are some different formulas involved.

columns.name: DISPLAYED_VALUE
columns.comments: The numeric reading value that is displayed in the user interface after computing the value that the user entered.

columns.name: NET_VALUE
columns.comments: Computed programmatically. Typically it will be = new reading + net of last reading, but there are some different formulas involved.

columns.name: INITIAL_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag to indicate if the reading entered is created automatically based on the initial reading value set at the meter instance or meter definition.

columns.name: RESET_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating wheter the reading was created as a result of a meter reset.

columns.name: MODIFIED_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating whether the meter reading was edited by the user or not.

columns.name: ROLLOVER_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating whether the reading was created as a result of the rollover settings in the meter instance or meter definition.

columns.name: DISABLED_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating whether the meter reading is disabled by a funcitonal user.

columns.name: CANCELED_FLAG
columns.comments: The flag indicating that the meter reading is canceled. A meter reading may be auto canceled when the user is trying to correct an earlier reading.

columns.name: REFERENCE_READING_ID
columns.comments: When readings are auto created by the system based on a reading that is auto cancelled, the auto cancelled reading id reference is persisted here.

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.comments: Free form comment field used to capture any notes, etc while the reading is being captured.

columns.name: WORK_ORDER_ID
columns.comments: The work order where this meter reading is captured upon completion of the work order.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.comments: Currency code for the extensibility

columns.name: CORP_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.comments: Corporate currency code for extensibility

columns.name: CURCY_CONV_RATE_TYPE
columns.comments: Currency conversion rate type for extensibility

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY
columns.comments: Descriptive Flexfield: structure definition of the user descriptive flexfield.

objects.description: The open interface entity that holds all the physical attributes of the meter readings.

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.comments: Interface Row Identifier. The primary key column of this table.

columns.name: INTERFACE_STATUS_CODE
columns.comments: The status of the interface row. The processor heavily relies on this column to persist interim status of the row upon processing data in bulk.

columns.comments: Interface Batch Identifier. This is the foreign key to the Interface Batch entity.

columns.name: INTERFACE_BATCH_CODE
columns.comments: The interface batch code. The user key to the interface batch entity.

columns.name: PARTITION_NUMBER
columns.comments: For parallel processing, the internal logic uses this column to stripe the bunch of meter readings in to a partition.

columns.name: INTERFACE_RECORD_NUMBER
columns.comments: Interface Record Number. This is the user key to link the child interface entities together.

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.comments: The various actions that can be performed via the import functionality at the meter reading level.

columns.name: METER_CODE
columns.comments: The unique user identifier for the meter. It is unique across the system.

columns.name: METER_ID
columns.comments: The foreign key to the instantiated meter.

columns.name: ASSET_NUMBER
columns.comments: An user identifier for the asset object. This is the user primary key for the asset.

columns.name: ASSET_ID
columns.comments: Unique identifier and Primary Key for the asset. System Generated using the Fusion Global Unique ID generator

columns.name: SUBSCRIPTION_PRODUCT_PUID
columns.comments: The subscription product public unique identifier.

columns.name: METER_READING_ID
columns.comments: Unique identifier and Primary Key for the meter reading entity.

columns.name: READING_DATE
columns.comments: The date when the reading is captured.

columns.name: READING_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: When reading is captured for the meter that has the meter reading type of both (absolute or change), at the capture time, user must say whether the value is absolute or change.

columns.name: RESET_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating wheter the reading was created as a result of a meter reset.

columns.name: ROLLOVER_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating whether the reading was created as a result of the rollover settings in the meter instance or meter definition.

columns.name: READING_VALUE
columns.comments: The numeric reading value that is captured for the meter.

columns.name: READING_NET_CHANGE
columns.comments: Computed programatically. Typically it will be = new reading – net of last reading, but there are some different formulas involved.

columns.name: NET_VALUE
columns.comments: Computed programmatically. Typically it will be = new reading + net of last reading, but there are some different formulas involved.

columns.name: DISPLAYED_VALUE
columns.comments: The numeric reading value that is displayed in the user interface after computing the value that the user entered.

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.comments: Free format comment field used to capture any notes, etc while the reading is being captured.

columns.name: WORK_ORDER_ID
columns.comments: The work order where this meter reading is captured upon completion of the work order.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.comments: Load Request Identifier. This is to support the loading of the interface records from the data files using the cloud framework.

columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

objects.name: CSE_W_CLAIMS_B
objects.description: The claim created for the warranty provider with all the collected entitlements.

columns.name: CLAIM_ID
columns.comments: Claim Identifier. This is the primary key of this entity.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CLAIM_NUMBER
columns.comments: The user identifiable unique number for the claim.

columns.name: CLAIM_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: The type of the claim. User defined in the lookup ORA_CSE_WTY_CLAIM_TYPE.

columns.name: MANUALLY_CREATED_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating whether this claim is autogenerated by the entitmenents engine or is manually created.

columns.name: OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: The type of object that is primarily associated to the claim. The primary use case involved the work order business object.

columns.name: OBJECT_ID
columns.comments: The object identifier that is primarily associated to the claim. It is the work order identifier when the object_type is a work order.

columns.name: ASSET_ID
columns.comments: The asset for which the claim is made. When the claim is done for a work order, it is usually the asset at the work order.

columns.name: WARRANTY_PROVIDER_ID
columns.comments: The actual provider of the warranty. It could be either the manufacturer, supplier, or a third party.

columns.name: CLAIM_DATE
columns.comments: The date the claim was put through for the warranty provider.

columns.name: CLAIM_STATUS_CODE
columns.comments: The various statuses that the claim can transition to.

columns.name: SUBMIT_BY_DATE
columns.comments: The date by which the claim must be submitted. This is driven by the default must submit by days parameter at the provider parameters setup.

columns.name: CLAIM_AMOUNT
columns.comments: The total claimable amount from the warranty provider.

columns.name: CLAIM_AMOUNT_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.comments: The currency in which the claim is made.

columns.name: CLAIM_NOTES
columns.comments: Notes documented for the claim processor.

columns.name: REIMBURSEMENT_REFERENCE
columns.comments: Reference information from a third party system.

columns.name: ASSIGNED_TO_PERSON_ID
columns.comments: The employee that is assigned to process this claim.

columns.name: REASON_FOR_REPAIR_CODE_ID
columns.comments: Represents the reason for which this repair operation is to be performed. Foreign key to cse_condition_event_codes_b table.

columns.name: PROVIDER_LABOR_RATE
columns.comments: The labor rate which the provider has agreed to pay for the repair work.

columns.name: MATCH_TO_TXN_CODE_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag to indicate that the transactions performed in this work order must be coded with predefined transaction codes.

columns.name: MATERIAL_AMOUNT_TOTAL
columns.comments: The total material cost collected from the entitlements. Summary column.

columns.name: EQUIPMENT_AMOUNT_TOTAL
columns.comments: The total equipment resource cost collected from the entitlements. Summary column.

columns.name: RESOURCE_AMOUNT_TOTAL
columns.comments: The total resource cost collected from the entitlements. Summary column.

columns.name: LABOR_AMOUNT_TOTAL
columns.comments: The total resource cost collected from the entitlements. Summary column.

columns.name: STANDARD_LABOR_AMOUNT
columns.comments: The standard labor repair amount computed for the standard repair work allowed for the provider.

columns.name: OTHER_AMOUNT
columns.comments: Any other miscellaneous cost incurred in the repair process.

columns.name: CLAIM_ADJUSTMENT_AMOUNT
columns.comments: The amount to be adjusted to the claimable amount.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CONVERSION_TYPE
columns.comments: The currency conversion type used to arrive at the conversion rate.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CONVERSION_RATE
columns.comments: The currency conversion rate used in converting the base amount to the claim curency code.

columns.name: REIMBURSEMENT_AMOUNT
columns.comments: The actual amount that is reimburded from the warranty provider.

columns.name: REIMBURSEMENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: The type of reimbursement. This is an user defined lookup.

columns.name: RESOLUTION_DATE
columns.comments: The date when the warranty claim was processed by the warranty provider.

columns.name: ACTIVE_END_DATE
columns.comments: The date when the claim is invalidated.

columns.name: CONTRACT_METER_ID
columns.comments: The contract meter identifier. This is the primary key of the entity.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CONTRACT_ID
columns.comments: The contract identifier. Foreign key to the contract entity.

columns.name: METER_ID

columns.name: METER_START_VALUE

columns.name: METER_INTERVAL_VALUE

columns.name: METER_END_VALUE

columns.name: CALCULATED_DUE_DATE
columns.comments: The calculated due date based on the latest meter readings.

columns.name: ACTIVE_END_DATE
columns.comments: The date when the meter based applicability becomes ineffective.

objects.name: CSE_W_COVERAGES_B
objects.description: A template that dictates terms and conditions that a supplier of the asset would provide in terms of warranty coverage for the asset either for a period of time or for a certain usage of the asset.

columns.name: COVERAGE_ID
columns.comments: Coverage Identifier. This is the primary key of this entity.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: COVERAGE_CODE
columns.comments: The user identifiable code for the coverage.

columns.name: COVERAGE_STATUS_CODE
columns.comments: The various statuses that a coverage can transition to. Examples are Draft and Ready.

columns.name: COVERAGE_START_DATE
columns.comments: The date when the coverage begins.

columns.name: COVERAGE_END_DATE
columns.comments: The date when the coverage would expire.

columns.name: COVERAGE_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: The type of coverage. This comes from an user defined lookup.

columns.name: MANUFACTURER_ID
columns.comments: The maufacturer of the part for which the coverage is defined..

columns.name: SUPPLIER_ID
columns.comments: The supplier of the part for which the coverage is defined.

columns.name: WARRANTY_PROVIDER_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: The warranty provider type code to identify if the provider is a supplier or manufacturer or a third party.

columns.name: WARRANTY_PROVIDER_ID
columns.comments: The actual provider of the warranty. It could be either the manufacturer, supplier, or a third party.

columns.name: WARRANTY_DURATION
columns.comments: The duration of the warranty. All warranties instantiated from this coverage will inherit this duration.

columns.name: WARRANTY_DURATION_UOM_CODE
columns.comments: The duration unit type for the duration of the warranty. This comes from a seeded lookup.

columns.name: TERMS_AND_CONDITIONS
columns.comments: Terms and condtions on the warranty coverage.

columns.name: REACTIONS_AND_RESOLUTIONS
columns.comments: Reactions and resolutions documented by the warranty provider.

columns.name: SERVICE_LEVEL_AGREEMENTS
columns.comments: Service level agreements with the warranty provider.

columns.name: INTERNAL_REPAIR_ALLOWED_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating that coverage allows work to be performed by the consumer.

columns.name: AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating whether an explicit authorization is to be sought before repair work is performed.

columns.name: PARTS_RETURN_REQUIRED_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating whether the original part must be returned to the provider.

columns.name: PARTS_REIMBURSEMENT_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating whether the replacement cost for parts can be reimbursed to the provider.

columns.name: LABOR_REIMBURSEMENT_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating whether the labor cost charged toward the repair work can be reimbursed to the provider.

columns.name: FILTER_BY_TXN_CODE_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating whether transactions that are not coded for the system are filtered out or not.
