objects.name: CSE_W_COVERAGES_INT
objects.description: A template that dictates terms and conditions that a supplier of the asset would provide in terms of warranty coverage for the asset either for a period of time or for a certain usage of the asset. This interface version of the table is used in the file based data import.

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.comments: Interface Row Identifier. The primary key column of this table.

columns.name: INTERFACE_STATUS_CODE
columns.comments: The status of the interface row. The processor heavily relies on this column to persist interim status of the row upon processing data in bulk.

columns.comments: Interface Batch Identifier. This is the foreign key to the Interface Batch entity.

columns.name: INTERFACE_BATCH_CODE
columns.comments: The interface batch code. The user key to the interface batch entity.

columns.name: HEADER_NUMBER
columns.comments: Interface Record Number. This is the user key to link the child interface entities together.

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.comments: The various actions that can be performed via the import functionality at the warranty coverage level.

columns.name: COVERAGE_ID
columns.comments: Coverage Identifier. This is the primary key of this entity.

columns.name: COVERAGE_CODE
columns.comments: The user identifiable code for the coverage.

columns.name: COVERAGE_NAME
columns.comments: The translatable name of the supplier warranty coverage.

columns.name: COVERAGE_DESCRIPTION
columns.comments: The detailed description of the supplier warranty coverage.

columns.name: WARRANTY_PROVIDER_NUMBER
columns.comments: The actual provider of the warranty. It could be either the manufacturer, supplier, or a third party.

columns.name: WARRANTY_PROVIDER_ID
columns.comments: The actual provider of the warranty. It could be either the manufacturer, supplier, or a third party.

columns.name: WARRANTY_PROVIDER_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: The warranty provider type code to identify if the provider is a supplier or manufacturer or a third party.

columns.name: COVERAGE_STATUS_CODE
columns.comments: The various statuses that a coverage can transition to. Examples are Draft and Ready.

columns.name: COVERAGE_START_DATE
columns.comments: The date when the coverage begins.

columns.name: COVERAGE_END_DATE
columns.comments: The date when the coverage would expire.

columns.name: COVERAGE_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: The type of coverage. This comes from an user defined lookup.

columns.name: WARRANTY_DURATION
columns.comments: The duration of the warranty. All warranties instantiated from this coverage will inherit this duration.

columns.name: WARRANTY_DURATION_UOM_CODE
columns.comments: The duration unit type for the duration of the warranty. This comes from a seeded lookup.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_NUMBER
columns.comments: The supplier of the part for which the coverage is defined.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_ID
columns.comments: The supplier of the part for which the coverage is defined.

columns.name: MANUFACTURER_NUMBER
columns.comments: The maufacturer of the part for which the coverage is defined..

columns.name: MANUFACTURER_ID
columns.comments: The maufacturer of the part for which the coverage is defined..

columns.name: LABOR_REIMBURSEMENT_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating whether the labor cost charged toward the repair work can be reimbursed to the provider.

columns.name: PARTS_REIMBURSEMENT_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating whether the replacement cost for parts can be reimbursed to the provider.

columns.name: PARTS_RETURN_REQUIRED_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating whether the original part must be returned to the provider.

columns.name: INTERNAL_REPAIR_ALLOWED_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating that coverage allows work to be performed by the consumer.

columns.name: AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating whether an explicit authorization is to be sought before repair work is performed.

columns.name: TERMS_AND_CONDITIONS
columns.comments: Terms and condtions on the warranty coverage.

columns.name: REACTIONS_AND_RESOLUTIONS
columns.comments: Reactions and resolutions documented by the warranty provider.

columns.name: SERVICE_LEVEL_AGREEMENTS
columns.comments: Service level agreements with the warranty provider.

columns.name: FILTER_BY_TXN_CODE_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating whether transactions that are not coded for the system are filtered out or not.

columns.name: PARTITION_NUMBER
columns.comments: For parallel processing, the internal logic uses this column to stripe the set of interface records into a partition.

objects.query:
SELECT cab.asset_id asset_id,
cab.asset_number asset_number,
cab.item_id item_id,
item.item_number item_number,
cab.item_organization_id oper_organization_id,
oper_org.organization_code oper_organization_code,
cab.serial_number serial_number,
cab.lot_number lot_number,
cab.quantity quantitiy,
cab.current_location_context current_location_context,
cab.current_location_id current_location_id,
cab.location_organization_id location_organization_id,
loc_org.organization_code location_organization_code,
cab.subinventory_code subinventory_code,
cab.inventory_locator_id inventory_locator_id,
cab.work_center_id work_center_id,
work_center.work_center_code work_center_code,
cab.work_order_id work_order_id,
cab.work_order_operation_id work_order_operation_id,
cab.sales_order_id sales_order_id,
cab.sales_order_number sales_order_number,
cab.sales_order_line_id sales_order_line_id,
cab.sales_order_line_number sales_order_line_number,
cab.customer_id customer_id,
cust.party_name customer_name,
cust.party_number customer_number,
cab.customer_site_party_id site_customer_id,
site_party.party_name site_customer_name,
site_party.party_number site_customer_number,
cab.customer_site_id customer_site_id,
cust_site.party_site_name customer_site_name,
cust_site.party_site_number customer_site_number,
cab.customer_billing_party_id bill_to_customer_id,
bill_party.party_name bill_to_customer_name,
bill_party.party_number bill_to_customer_number,
cab.customer_billing_party_site_id bill_to_customer_site_id,
bill_site.party_site_name bill_to_customer_site_name,
bill_site.party_site_number bill_to_customer_site_number,
cab.customer_account_id customer_account_id,
cust_acct.account_name customer_account_name,
cust_acct.account_number customer_account_number,
cab.customer_account_site_id customer_account_site_id,
cust_acct_site_ps.party_site_name customer_account_site_name,
cust_acct_site_ps.party_site_number customer_account_site_number,
int_loc.location_code internal_location_code,
cab.sold_by_business_unit_id sold_by_business_unit_id,
sold_by_bu.bu_name business_unit_name
FROM cse_assets_b cab,
egp_system_items_bv item,
inv_org_parameters oper_org,
inv_org_parameters loc_org,
wis_work_centers_b work_center,
hz_parties cust,
hz_parties site_party,
hz_party_sites cust_site,
hz_parties bill_party,
hz_party_sites bill_site,
hz_cust_accounts cust_acct,
hz_cust_acct_sites_all cust_acct_site,
hz_party_sites cust_acct_site_ps,
hr_locations int_loc,
fun_all_business_units_v sold_by_bu
WHERE item.inventory_item_id = cab.item_id
AND item.organization_id = cab.item_organization_id
AND oper_org.organization_id = cab.item_organization_id
AND loc_org.organization_id(+) = cab.location_organization_id
AND work_center.work_center_id(+) = cab.work_center_id
AND cust.party_id(+) = cab.customer_id
AND site_party.party_id(+) = cab.customer_site_party_id
AND cust_site.party_site_id(+) = cab.customer_site_id
AND bill_party.party_id(+) = cab.customer_billing_party_id
AND bill_site.party_site_id(+) = cab.customer_billing_party_site_id
AND cust_acct.cust_account_id(+) = cab.customer_account_id
AND cust_acct_site.cust_acct_site_id(+) = cab.customer_account_site_id
AND cust_acct_site_ps.party_site_id(+) = cust_acct_site.cust_acct_site_id
AND int_loc.location_id(+) = cab.current_location_id
AND sold_by_bu.bu_id(+) = cab.sold_by_business_unit_id

objects.name: CSE_ASSET_TXN_HIST_V
objects.query:
SELECT
transaction_id,
transacted_asset_id,
asset_id,
object_version_number,
request_id,
item_revision,
job_definition_name,
job_definition_package,
src_system_type,
fa_integration_status_code,
src_system_id,
CASE
WHEN src_system_type = 'ORA_INTERNAL' THEN (
SELECT
application_name
FROM
fnd_application_vl
WHERE
application_id = src_system_id
)
WHEN src_system_type = 'ORA_EXTERNAL' THEN (
SELECT
orig_system
FROM
hz_orig_systems_b
WHERE
orig_system_id = src_system_id
)
END AS src_system_name,
src_transaction_date,
src_transaction_id,
src_transaction_type_id,
CASE
WHEN src_system_type = 'ORA_INTERNAL'
AND src_system_id = 401 THEN (
SELECT
transaction_type_name
FROM
inv_transaction_types_vl
WHERE
transaction_type_id = src_transaction_type_id
)
WHEN src_system_type = 'ORA_INTERNAL'
AND src_system_id = 10008
THEN (
SELECT
meaning
FROM
fnd_lookups
WHERE
lookup_type = 'ORA_CSE_TRANSACTION_TYPE'
AND lookup_code = src_transaction_type_id
)
WHEN src_system_type = 'ORA_INTERNAL'
AND src_system_id = 10049
THEN (
SELECT
meaning
FROM
fnd_lookups
WHERE
lookup_type IN ('RCV_TRANSACTION_TYPE', 'ORA_CSE_TRANSACTION_TYPE')
AND lookup_code = src_transaction_type_id
)
WHEN src_system_type = 'ORA_INTERNAL'
AND ( src_system_id = 10493
OR src_system_id = 10531 ) THEN (
DECODE(src_transaction_type_id,
'PRODUCT_COMPLETION',
(SELECT
meaning
FROM
fnd_lookups
WHERE
lookup_type = 'ORA_CSE_TRANSACTION_TYPE'
AND lookup_code = 'ORA_CSE_TRNSFRM_PROD_COMP'),
'PRODUCT_RETURN',
(SELECT
meaning
FROM
fnd_lookups
WHERE
lookup_type = 'ORA_CSE_TRANSACTION_TYPE'
AND lookup_code = 'ORA_CSE_TRNSFRM_PROD_RTN'),
(SELECT
meaning
FROM
fnd_lookups
WHERE
lookup_type IN (
'ORA_WIE_OP_TRANSACTION_TYPE',
'ORA_WIE_MTL_TXN_TYPE',
'ORA_WIE_TRANSACTION_TYPES',
'ORA_CSE_TRANSACTION_TYPE'
)
AND lookup_code = src_transaction_type_id)
)
)
END AS src_transaction_type,
src_transaction_qty,
project_id,
task_id,
created_by,
creation_date,
last_updated_by,
last_update_date,
last_update_login,
quantity,
old_quantity,
secondary_quantity,
old_secondary_quantity,
asset_number,
old_asset_number,
current_location_context,
old_cur_location,
current_location_id,
old_cur_location_id,
serial_number,
old_serial_number,
location_organization_id,
old_location_org_id,
lot_number,
old_lot_number,
subinventory_code,
old_subinventory_code,
inventory_locator_id,
old_inventory_locator_id,
shipment_date,
old_shipment_date,
uom_code,
old_uom_code,
secondary_uom_code,
old_secondary_uom_code,
work_order_id,
old_work_order_id,
work_order_operation_id,
old_work_order_op_id,
work_center_id,
old_work_center_id,
iot_enabled_flag,
old_iot_enabled_flag,
competitor_asset_flag,
old_competitor_asset_flag,
item_organization_id,
old_item_organization_id,
item_id,
old_item_id,
contact_id,
old_contact_id,
active_end_date,
old_active_end_date,
maintainable_flag,
old_maintainable_flag,
new_wo_allowed_flag,
old_new_wo_flag,
dflt_wo_type,
old_dflt_wo_type,
dflt_wo_sub_type,
old_dflt_wo_sub_type,
customer_id,
old_customer_id,
customer_site_party_id,
old_cust_site_party_id,
customer_site_id,
old_cust_site_id,
customer_billing_party_id,
old_cust_billing_party_id,
customer_billing_party_site_id,
old_cust_billing_party_site_id,
customer_account_id,
old_cust_account_id,
customer_account_site_id,
old_cust_account_site_id,
customer_account_site_use_id,
old_cust_account_site_use_id,
shipment_id,
old_shipment_id,
customer_asset_start_date,
old_cust_asset_start_date,
customer_asset_end_date,
old_cust_asset_end_date,
split_from_asset_id,
old_split_from_asset_id,
installed_date,
old_installed_date,
CASE
WHEN ( nvl(quantity,-1) != nvl(old_quantity,-1)
OR nvl(secondary_quantity,-1) != nvl(old_secondary_quantity,-1)
OR nvl(serial_number,'X') != nvl(old_serial_number,'X')
OR nvl(asset_number,'X') != nvl(old_asset_number,'X')
OR nvl(iot_enabled_flag,'X') != nvl(old_iot_enabled_flag,'X')
OR nvl(competitor_asset_flag,'X') != nvl(old_competitor_asset_flag,'X')
OR nvl(item_organization_id,-1) != nvl(old_item_organization_id,-1)
OR nvl(item_id,-1) != nvl(old_item_id,-1)
OR nvl(contact_id,-1) != nvl(old_contact_id,-1)
OR nvl(active_end_date,SYSDATE) != nvl(old_active_end_date,SYSDATE)
OR nvl(maintainable_flag,'X') != nvl(old_maintainable_flag,'X')
OR nvl(new_wo_allowed_flag,'X') != nvl(old_new_wo_flag,'X')
OR nvl(dflt_wo_type,'X') != nvl(old_dflt_wo_type,'X')
OR nvl(dflt_wo_sub_type,'X') != nvl(old_dflt_wo_sub_type,'X')
OR nvl(customer_id,-1) != nvl(old_customer_id,-1)
OR nvl(customer_site_party_id,-1) != nvl(old_cust_site_party_id,-1)
OR nvl(customer_site_id,-1) != nvl(old_cust_site_id,-1)
OR nvl(customer_billing_party_id,-1) != nvl(old_cust_billing_party_id,-1)
OR nvl(customer_billing_party_site_id,-1) != nvl(old_cust_billing_party_site_id,-1)
OR nvl(customer_account_id,-1) != nvl(old_cust_account_id,-1)
OR nvl(customer_account_site_id,-1) != nvl(old_cust_account_site_id,-1)
OR nvl(customer_account_site_use_id,-1) != nvl(old_cust_account_site_use_id,-1)
OR nvl(shipment_id,-1) != nvl(old_shipment_id,-1)
OR nvl(customer_asset_start_date,SYSDATE) != nvl(old_cust_asset_start_date,SYSDATE)
OR nvl(customer_asset_end_date,SYSDATE) != nvl(old_cust_asset_end_date,SYSDATE)
OR nvl(installed_date,SYSDATE) != nvl(old_installed_date,SYSDATE)) THEN 'Y'
END AS asset_attribute_change,
CASE
WHEN ( nvl(current_location_context,'X') != nvl(old_cur_location,'X')
OR nvl(current_location_id,-1) != nvl(old_cur_location_id,-1)
OR nvl(work_center_id,-1) != nvl(old_work_center_id,-1)
OR nvl(work_order_id,-1) != nvl(old_work_order_id,-1)
OR nvl(work_order_operation_id,-1) != nvl(old_work_order_op_id,-1)
OR nvl(subinventory_code,'X') != nvl(old_subinventory_code,'X')
OR nvl(inventory_locator_id,-1) != nvl(old_inventory_locator_id,-1) ) THEN 'Y'
END AS asset_location_change,
CASE
WHEN src_system_id = 401 THEN 'Y'
END AS inventory_change,
CASE
WHEN ( src_system_id = 10008
OR src_system_id = 10049 ) THEN 'Y'
END AS sales_order_change,
CASE
WHEN ( ( src_system_id = 10493
OR src_system_id = 10531 )
AND ( work_order_id != nvl(old_work_order_id,-1) ) ) THEN 'Y'
END AS work_order_change,
CASE
WHEN ( EXISTS (
SELECT
1
FROM
cse_asset_relationships_hist cse_rel_hist,
cse_transacted_relationships cse_rel
WHERE
( cse_rel_hist.object_id = ASSET_TXN_OUTER.asset_id )
AND cse_rel_hist.transacted_relationship_id = cse_rel.transacted_relationship_id
AND cse_rel.transaction_id = ASSET_TXN_OUTER.transaction_id
) ) THEN 'Y'
WHEN ( EXISTS (
SELECT
1
FROM
cse_asset_relationships_hist cse_rel_hist,
cse_transacted_relationships cse_rel
WHERE
( cse_rel_hist.subject_id = ASSET_TXN_OUTER.asset_id )
AND cse_rel_hist.transacted_relationship_id = cse_rel.transacted_relationship_id
AND cse_rel.transaction_id = ASSET_TXN_OUTER.transaction_id
) ) THEN 'Y'
END AS asset_relationship_change
FROM
(
SELECT
cse_hist.transacted_asset_id,
cse_hist.asset_id,
cse_txn.object_version_number,
cse_txn.transaction_id,
cse_txn.request_id,
cse_txn.item_revision,
cse_txn.job_definition_name,
cse_txn.job_definition_package,
cse_txn.src_system_type,
cse_txn.fa_integration_status_code,
cse_txn.src_system_id,
cse_txn.src_transaction_date,
cse_txn.src_transaction_id,
cse_txn.src_transaction_type_id,
cse_txn.src_transaction_qty,
cse_txn.project_id,
cse_txn.task_id,
cse_txn.created_by,
cse_txn.creation_date,
cse_txn.last_updated_by,
cse_txn.last_update_date,
cse_txn.last_update_login,

LAG(cse_hist.quantity) OVER(
PARTITION BY cse_hist.asset_id
ORDER BY

ORDER BY

cse_tx_assets.asset_id,

cse_transacted_relationships cse_tx_rel,

cse_tx_assets.transaction_id = cse_txn.transaction_id
AND cse_tx_rel.transaction_id = cse_txn.transaction_id
AND cse_rel_hist.transacted_relationship_id = cse_tx_rel.transacted_relationship_id

OR (cse_rel_hist.subject_id = cse_tx_assets.asset_id AND cse_rel_hist.subject_type = 'A'))
AND cse_rel_hist.relationship_type_code = 'ORA_COMPONENT'
AND cse_rel_hist.potential_flag = 'N'
AND parent_asset.asset_id = cse_rel_hist.object_id
AND child_asset.asset_id = cse_rel_hist.subject_id

'ORA_CSE_CHG_REMOVED' AS change_type,

cse_txn.src_transaction_id,
work_order.work_order_id,
cse_tx_assets.asset_id,
cse_txn.src_transaction_type_id

cse_transactions cse_txn,
cse_transacted_assets cse_tx_assets,
cse_asset_relationships_hist cse_rel_hist,
inv_material_txns inv_mtl_txn,
wie_work_orders_b work_order,
inv_transaction_types_b inv_misc_receipt,
cse_assets_b parent_asset,
cse_assets_b child_asset

cse_tx_assets.transaction_id = cse_txn.transaction_id
AND ((cse_rel_hist.object_id = cse_tx_assets.asset_id AND cse_rel_hist.object_type = 'A')
OR (cse_rel_hist.subject_id = cse_tx_assets.asset_id AND cse_rel_hist.subject_type = 'A'))
AND cse_rel_hist.relationship_type_code = 'ORA_COMPONENT'
AND cse_rel_hist.potential_flag = 'N'

to_char(null) lot_expiration_action_desc,
to_date(null) lot_expiration_action_date,
to_char(null) lot_disable_flag,
to_char(null) lot_disable_flag_meaning
FROM inv_serial_numbers isn,
cse_genealogy_objects gen_obj,
fnd_lookups serial_status_lookup,
inv_material_statuses_vl serial_material_status
WHERE gen_obj.serial_number IS NOT NULL
AND gen_obj.item_id = isn.inventory_item_id
AND gen_obj.serial_number = isn.serial_number
AND serial_status_lookup.lookup_type = 'INV_SERIAL_NUM_STATUS'
AND serial_status_lookup.lookup_code = decode(isn.current_status,'6','1',isn.current_status)
AND serial_material_status.status_id = isn.status_id
UNION
SELECT 'L' serial_lot_indicator,
gen_obj.gen_object_id gen_object_id,
iln.inventory_item_id item_id,
iln.organization_id organization_id,
to_char(null) serial_number,
to_char(null) supplier_serial_number,
iln.lot_number lot_number,
iln.parent_lot_number parent_lot_number,
iln.description lot_description,
iln.supplier_lot_number supplier_lot_number,
iln.origination_date origination_date,
iln.vendor_id supplier_id,
to_char(null) serial_status_id,
to_char(null) serial_status,
to_char(null) serial_current_subinv_code,
cast(null as number(18)) serial_current_locator_id,
to_date(null) serial_shipment_date,
iln.status_id material_status_id,
lot_material_status.status_code material_status,
gen_obj.origination_quantity origination_quantity,
gen_obj.origination_document_type origination_document_type,
gen_obj.origination_document_number origination_document__number,
iln.grade_code lot_grade_code,
ig.description lot_grade_desc,
iln.expiration_date lot_expiration_date,
iln.maturity_date lot_maturity_date,
iln.retest_date lot_retest_date,
iln.hold_date lot_hold_date,
iln.expiration_action_code lot_expiration_action_code,
ia.description lot_expiration_action_desc,
iln.expiration_action_date lot_expiration_action_date,
nvl(iln.disable_flag,'2') lot_disable_flag,
LotDisableFlagLookup.meaning lot_disable_flag_meaning
FROM inv_lot_numbers iln,
cse_genealogy_objects gen_obj,
inv_material_statuses_vl lot_material_status,
inv_grades ig,
inv_actions_vl ia,
fnd_lookups LotDisableFlagLookup
WHERE gen_obj.lot_number IS NOT NULL
AND gen_obj.serial_number IS NULL
AND gen_obj.item_id = iln.inventory_item_id
AND gen_obj.organization_id = iln.organization_id
AND gen_obj.lot_number = iln.lot_number
AND lot_material_status.status_id = nvl(iln.status_id,1)
AND ig.grade_code(+) = iln.grade_code
AND ia.action_code(+) = iln.expiration_action_code
AND LotDisableFlagLookup.lookup_type(+)= 'INV_YES_NO_NUMERIC'
AND LotDisableFlagLookup.lookup_code(+)= nvl(iln.disable_flag,'2')

objects.name: CSE_GENEALOGY_RELATIONSHIPS_V
objects.query:
SELECT UNIQUE
CHILD.GEN_OBJECT_ID CHILD_GEN_OBJECT_ID,
RELATIONSHIP.RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_CODE RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_CODE,
PARENT.GEN_OBJECT_ID PARENT_GEN_OBJECT_ID,
RELATIONSHIP.OBJECT_TYPE,

NVL(RELATIONSHIP.MERGE_FLAG,'N') MERGE_FLAG,
NVL(RELATIONSHIP.TRANSLATE_FLAG,'N') TRANSLATE_FLAG
FROM
CSE_ASSETS_B PARENT,
CSE_ASSET_RELATIONSHIPS RELATIONSHIP,
CSE_ASSETS_B CHILD
WHERE
RELATIONSHIP.RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_CODE = 'ORA_COMPONENT' AND PARENT.ASSET_ID = RELATIONSHIP.OBJECT_ID AND CHILD.ASSET_ID = RELATIONSHIP.SUBJECT_ID AND SYSDATE BETWEEN NVL(RELATIONSHIP.ACTIVE_START_DATE, SYSDATE - 1) AND NVL(RELATIONSHIP.ACTIVE_END_DATE, SYSDATE + 1) AND relationship.object_type = 'A'
UNION
SELECT
CHILD.GEN_OBJECT_ID CHILD_GEN_OBJECT_ID,
RELATIONSHIP.RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_CODE RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_CODE,
PARENT.GEN_OBJECT_ID PARENT_GEN_OBJECT_ID,
RELATIONSHIP.OBJECT_TYPE,
RELATIONSHIP.SPLIT_FLAG,
RELATIONSHIP.MERGE_FLAG,
RELATIONSHIP.TRANSLATE_FLAG
FROM
CSE_GENEALOGY_OBJECTS PARENT,
CSE_ASSET_RELATIONSHIPS RELATIONSHIP,
CSE_GENEALOGY_OBJECTS CHILD
WHERE
RELATIONSHIP.RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_CODE = 'ORA_LOT_TXN'
AND PARENT.GEN_OBJECT_ID = RELATIONSHIP.OBJECT_ID
AND CHILD.GEN_OBJECT_ID = RELATIONSHIP.SUBJECT_ID
AND RELATIONSHIP.OBJECT_TYPE = 'G'

objects.name: CSE_TXN_ERRORS_V
objects.query:
SELECT wie_txns.transaction_source,
wie_txns.transaction_id,
wie_txns.worker_id,
wie_txns.transaction_date,
to_char(wie_txns.transaction_source_id) transaction_source_id,
wie_txns.transaction_source_line_id,
wie_txns.inventory_item_id,
wie_txns.interface_row_id,
wie_txns.status_code,
wie_errors.error_text,
wie_txns.SOURCE_SYSTEM_TYPE,
wie_txns.SOURCE_SYSTEM,
wie_txns.TRANSACTION_TYPE
FROM (SELECT 'WIE_INV_TXN' transaction_source,
wmti.inv_transaction_id transaction_id,
wmti.worker_id worker_id,
imt.transaction_date transaction_date,
wmti.work_order_id transaction_source_id,
wmti.wo_operation_id transaction_source_line_id,
wmti.inventory_item_id inventory_item_id,
wmti.interface_row_id interface_row_id,
wmti.interface_status_code status_code,
wmti.source_system_type SOURCE_SYSTEM_TYPE,
'Common Work Execution' SOURCE_SYSTEM,
(SELECT meaning from fnd_lookups lkps
WHERE wmti.TRANSACTION_TYPE_CODE = lkps.lookup_code
AND lkps.lookup_type = 'ORA_WIE_MTL_TXN_TYPE') TRANSACTION_TYPE
FROM wie_material_transactions_int wmti,
inv_material_txns imt
WHERE (wmti.interface_status_code = 'GENEALOGY_ERROR' OR wmti.interface_status_code = 'COMPLETED')
AND wmti.worker_id is not null
AND imt.transaction_id = inv_transaction_id
UNION
SELECT 'WIE_OPER_TXN' transaction_source,
woti.wo_operation_transaction_id transaction_id,
woti.worker_id worker_id,
wot.transaction_date transaction_date,
woti.work_order_id transaction_source_id,
woti.wo_operation_id transaction_source_line_id,
woti.inventory_item_id inventory_item_id,
woti.interface_row_id interface_row_id,
woti.interface_status_code status_code,
woti.source_system_type SOURCE_SYSTEM_TYPE,
'Common Work Execution' SOURCE_SYSTEM,
(SELECT meaning from fnd_lookups lkps
WHERE wot.TRANSACTION_TYPE_CODE = lkps.lookup_code
AND lkps.lookup_type = 'ORA_WIE_OP_TRANSACTION_TYPE') TRANSACTION_TYPE
FROM wie_operation_transactions_int woti,
wie_operation_transactions wot
WHERE (woti.interface_status_code = 'GENEALOGY_ERROR' OR woti.interface_status_code = 'COMPLETED')
AND woti.worker_id is not null
AND wot.wo_operation_transaction_id = woti.wo_operation_transaction_id) wie_txns,
wie_int_errors wie_errors
WHERE wie_errors.interface_row_id(+) = wie_txns.interface_row_id
UNION
SELECT 'INV_MTL_TXN',
imt.transaction_id,
null,
imt.transaction_date,
to_char(imt.transaction_source_id) transaction_source_id,
imt.trx_source_line_id,
imt.inventory_item_id,
null,
imt.alm_interface_status,
imt.alm_interface_error_code,
'Internal' SOURCE_SYSTEM_TYPE,
'Inventory Management' SOURCE_SYSTEM,
(SELECT TRANSACTION_TYPE_NAME
FROM INV_TRANSACTION_TYPES_VL
WHERE imt.TRANSACTION_TYPE_ID = TRANSACTION_TYPE_ID) TRANSACTION_TYPE
FROM inv_material_txns imt,
egp_system_items_vl egi
WHERE imt.alm_interface_status = 'ORA_P'
AND imt.inventory_item_id = egi.inventory_item_id
AND imt.organization_id = egi.organization_id
AND (egi.asset_tracked_flag in ('Y','C') or egi.enable_genealogy_tracking_flag ='Y')
UNION
SELECT 'RCV_TXN',
rt.transaction_id,
rt.parent_transaction_id,
rt.transaction_date,
to_char(nvl(rt.po_header_id,rt.transfer_order_header_id)) header_id,
nvl(rt.po_line_id, rt.transfer_order_line_id) line_id,
rsl.item_id,
null,
rt.alm_interface_status,
null,
'Internal' SOURCE_SYSTEM_TYPE,
'Receiving' SOURCE_SYSTEM,
(SELECT meaning
FROM fnd_lookups
WHERE lookup_type = 'RCV_TRANSACTION_TYPE' and lookup_code = rt.transaction_type) TRANSACTION_TYPE
from rcv_transactions rt,
rcv_shipment_lines rsl,
egp_system_items esi
where rt.alm_interface_status = 'ORA_P'
and rsl.shipment_line_id = rt.shipment_line_id
AND esi.inventory_item_id = rsl.item_id
AND esi.organization_id = rt.organization_id
AND (esi.asset_tracked_flag in ('Y','C') or esi.enable_genealogy_tracking_flag ='Y')
UNION
SELECT 'DOO_FULFILLMENT' transaction_source,
interface_row_id transaction_id,
orchestration_group_id worker_id,
transaction_date transaction_date,
source_order_number transaction_source_id,
header_id transaction_source_line_id,
null inventory_item_id,
interface_row_id interface_row_id,
interface_status_code status_code,
error_text error_text,
'Internal' source_system_type,
'Order Management' source_system,
transaction_type_code transaction_type
from cse_om_orders_int
where interface_status_code IN ('READY', 'ERROR')

Claim lines contain transaction details such as the product details, price, unit of measurement, and so on. For promotional claims, lines are used for associating programs with a specific claim. For Non-Promotional claims, claim lines may contain Credit Memo, Invoice or Order details.

objects.name: CJM_DOCUMENT_LINES_INT
objects.description: CJM_DOCUMENT_LINES_INT is an interface table for bulk import of document lines. Data in this table will be purged according to the setup in the import framework.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.comments: Batch identifier populated by the import framework for each job execution.

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.comments: Unique identifier for the record within a batch. Combination of BATCH_ID and INTERFACE_ROW_ID is unique in this interface table.

columns.name: FILE_RECORD_NUM
columns.comments: Used by the import wizard to relate a record in the interface table to the file row.

columns.name: FILE_NAME_SYSTASK_ID
columns.comments: Recommended optional column for multi-csv uptake, that saves the individual sys task id for each input csv file, corresponding to the value in the MKT_CM_SYSTASK table. This is populated by the import framework.

columns.name: IMPORT_STATUS_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates the status of a row in the interface table. File import wizard status: I - In Progress, O ? Obsolete (status of all the interface table records that were run previously), E - Error, S - Successful (internal use only).

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.comments: Optional column, used if consumers want any error message as the first error.

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.comments: Specifies the operations for a row. Possible values are NULL, INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE.

objects.name: CJM_DOCUMENT_LINES_STG
objects.description: This table is used as a staging table to store validated document line data from CJM_DOCUMENT_LINES_INT before it's transferred to CJM_DOCUMENT_LINES_ALL. This table is used as a temporary holding area during the data validation process.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_LINES_STG_ID
columns.comments: Unique identifier of the document lines stage record.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_BATCH_ID
columns.comments: Indicates the identifier of the document batch.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates the status code of the line. Values are from the lookup ORA_CJM_BATCH_LINE_STATUS.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.comments: Import batch identifier which was populated by Import Framework during data upload.

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.comments: Unique identifier for the record within a batch. The combination of BATCH_ID and INTERFACE_ROW_ID is a unique alternate key for the record.

columns.name: BATCH_NUMBER
columns.comments: Unique alternate key for the batch. Import Framework populates this value.

columns.name: BATCH_NAME
columns.comments: Indicates the batch name. Import Framework populates this value.

columns.name: BATCH_TRANSACTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates the batch transaction type code.

columns.name: BATCH_START_DATE
columns.comments: Indicates the start date of the batch.

columns.name: BATCH_END_DATE
columns.comments: Indicates the end date of the batch.

columns.name: BU_ID
columns.comments: Identifier of the business unit associated with the row.

columns.name: BU_NAME
columns.comments: Name of business unit associated with the row.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates the currency code of the channel batch transaction object.

columns.name: DISTRI_BILL_TO_CUST_ACCT_ID
columns.comments: Indicates the unique identifier of the distributor bill-to customer account.

columns.name: DISTRIBUTOR_NAME
columns.comments: Indicates the name of the distributor.

columns.name: DISTRI_BILL_TO_ACCT_NUMBER
columns.comments: Indicates the bill-to customer account number of the distributor.

columns.name: DISTRIBUTOR_REGISTRY_ID
columns.comments: Indicates the unique identification number of the distributor.

columns.name: DISTRIBUTOR_CLAIM_NUMBER
columns.comments: Indicates the claim number recorded in the distributor's system.

columns.name: HEADER_COMMENTS
columns.comments: Free-form text that can be used to capture any high-level information about the document.

columns.name: AGREEMENT_NUMBER
columns.comments: The unique number that identifies the special price agreement.

columns.name: AGREEMENT_NAME
columns.comments: The name of the special price agreement.

columns.name: AGREEMENT_ID
columns.comments: Unique identifier of the agreement number.

columns.name: AGREEMENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates the agreement type. Values are from the lookup code .

columns.name: ITEM_ID
columns.comments: Unique identifier of the inventory item.

columns.name: ITEM_NUMBER
columns.comments: Number associated with the inventory item.

columns.name: ITEM_DESCRIPTION
columns.comments: Indicates the description of the item.

columns.name: LINE_COMMENTS
columns.comments: Free-form text that can be used to capture any high-level information about the document lines.

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM_SOURCE
columns.comments: Source information of the originating system.

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE
columns.comments: Reference of the originating system.

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM_LINE_REFERENCE
columns.comments: Line reference of the originating system.

columns.name: BILL_TO_ACCOUNT_NUMBER
columns.comments: The account number of the bill-to customer.

columns.name: BILL_TO_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.comments: The unique identifier for the bill-to account.

columns.name: BILL_TO_CUSTOMER_REGISTRY_ID
columns.comments: Unique identification number of the bill-to party.

columns.name: BILL_TO_CUSTOMER_NAME
columns.comments: Indicates the name of the bill-to customer .

columns.name: BILL_TO_CUSTOMER_ID
columns.comments: Unique identifier of the bill to customer identifier. It is the PARTY_ID from HZ_PARTIES.

columns.name: WAYBILL_NUMBER
columns.comments: Indicates the non-negotiable document number that describes the contract for transporting cargo.

columns.name: REQUESTED_SHIP_DATE
columns.comments: Indicates the date on which the customer has requested the ordered item to be shipped.

columns.name: SALES_ORDER_NUMBER
columns.comments: The identifier for the sales order.

columns.name: SALES_ORDER_DATE
columns.comments: Date when the items where ordered.

columns.name: SALES_ORDER_LINE_NUMBER
columns.comments: The unique identifier of the sales order line.

columns.name: SHIPPED_DATE
columns.comments: The date the shipment was actually sent.

columns.name: SHIPPED_QUANTITY
columns.comments: The quantity of goods or services shipped by the supplier.

columns.name: SHIPPED_UOM
columns.comments: The unit of measure for the shipped quantity.

columns.name: CLAIMED_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Indicates the quantity claimed by the distributor for a special pricing agreement.

columns.name: SHIP_TO_CUSTOMER_NAME
columns.comments: The name of the ship-to customer.

columns.name: SHIP_TO_CUSTOMER_ID
columns.comments: The unique identifier of the ship-to customer.

columns.name: SHIP_TO_CUSTOMER_REGISTRY_ID
columns.comments: Unique identification number of the ship-to party.

columns.name: UNIT_PURCHASE_PRICE
columns.comments: The price per unit that a distributor paid for an item.

columns.name: UNIT_SELLING_PRICE
columns.comments: The price per unit that a buyer paid for an item.

columns.name: UNIT_CLAIMED_AMOUNT
columns.comments: The amount per unit that is claimed by the distributor.

columns.name: UNIT_DISCOUNT_AMOUNT
columns.comments: Indicates the discount amount per unit calculated by the system.

columns.name: CALCULATED_AMOUNT
columns.comments: Indicates the total calculated amount of the line that can be claimed.

columns.name: TOTAL_CALCULATED_AMOUNT
columns.comments: Indicates the total calculated amount of the line which can be claimed.

columns.name: ALLOWED_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Indicates the allowed quantity for the batch line.

columns.name: ALLOWED_AMOUNT
columns.comments: Indicates the allowed amount of the line per unit.

columns.name: TOTAL_ALLOWED_AMOUNT
columns.comments: Indicates the total allowed amount of the line which can be claimed.

columns.name: ACCEPTED_AMOUNT
columns.comments: Indicates the total accepted amount of the line that can be claimed.

columns.name: DISTRIBUTOR_CLAIM_AMOUNT
columns.comments: Indicates the line-level distributor claim amount. This is calculated as either the unit claimed amount multiplied by the claimed quantity, or the special price agreement unit allowed amount of the inventory item multiplied by the claimed quantity. If the claimed quantity isn't provided in the batch file, then the shipped quantity is used instead.

columns.name: DISPUTED_AMOUNT
columns.comments: Indicates the disputed amount. This is the difference between the amount claimed by the distributor and the calculated amount, or is equal to the amount claimed by the distributor if the line is rejected.

columns.name: TOTAL_ACCEPTED_AMOUNT
columns.comments: Indicates the total accepted amount of the line which can be claimed.

columns.name: ACCEPTANCE_MODE_CODE
columns.comments: A code indicating how the amount for the document line in the stage record is accepted. It distinguishes between automatically accepted amounts and manually accepted amounts. In automatically accepted amounts, the distributor's claimed amount matches the calculated amount, whereas, in manually accepted amounts, a user explicitly accepts the calculated amount.s

columns.name: DUP_DOCUMENT_LINES_STG_ID
columns.comments: Unique identifier for the duplicate document lines stage record. It is populated during the duplicate check of the lines within the same batch or across batches.

columns.name: PROCESS_ERROR_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates the error code for the document lines while processing the data in the staging table. This is an internal column used for validation.

columns.name: REJECT_REASON_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates the reason for rejecting the batch line. Values are from the lookup ORA_BATCH_LINE_REJECT_REASON.

columns.name: AGRMNT_STATUS_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates the status code of the agreement associated with the line.

columns.name: AGRMNT_ACCRUE_POS_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates whether the agreement accrual is based on the receipt of the point of sale data.

columns.name: AGRMNT_DIS_BILL_TO_ACCT_ID
columns.comments: Indicates the identifier of the distributor's bill to customer associated with the agreement.

columns.name: AGRMNT_BU_ID
columns.comments: Indicates the identifier of the business unit for the agreement.

columns.name: AGRMNT_PROGRAM_TYPE_ID
columns.comments: Indicates the identifier of the program type for the agreement.

columns.name: AGRMNT_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates the currency code for the agreement.

columns.name: AGRMNT_SPA_REQ_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates the request type code for the agreement.

columns.name: AGRMNT_END_CUST_PARTY_ID
columns.comments: Indicates the identifier of the end customer party associated with the agreement.

columns.name: AGRMNT_PRI_DATE_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates the date type code associated with the agreement.

columns.name: AGRMNT_PRI_DATE_FROM
columns.comments: Indicates the from date of the agreement based on the agreement's pricing date type code.

columns.name: AGRMNT_PRI_DATE_TO
columns.comments: Indicates the to date of the agreement based on the agreement's pricing date type code.

columns.name: AGRMNT_LN_UOM_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates the unit of measure of the item.

columns.name: AGRMNT_LN_PROGRAM_LINE_ID
columns.comments: Indicates the identifier of the program line associated with the agreement.

columns.name: AGRMNT_LN_DIS_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates the discount type code associated with the agreement line.

columns.name: AGRMNT_LN_DIS_AMOUNT
columns.comments: Indicates the discount amount for the agreement line.

columns.name: AGRMNT_LN_MAX_ALLOWED_QTY
columns.comments: Indicates the maximum allowed quantity in the agreement line.

columns.name: AGRMNT_LN_UNIT_DIS_AMOUNT
columns.comments: Indicates the discount amount per unit for the item in the agreement.

columns.name: AGRMNT_LN_ALREADY_ACCRUED_QTY
columns.comments: Indicates the quantity already accrued for the item in the agreement.

columns.comments: Bill to Business Unit derived from the Supplier Site Assignment where the Client Business Unit is the Order Business Unit.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.comments: Identifies the status of the manual adjustment record. Values are from the lookup ORA_CJM_MANUAL_ADJ_STATUS.

columns.name: ACCRUAL_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Identifies whether the accrual record is created for CUSTOMER or SUPPLIER. Values are from the lookup ORA_CJM_ACCRUAL_TYPE.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Identifies the type of adjustment, such as INCREASE_EARNED, DECREASE_EARNED, INCREASE_PAID, and DECREASE_PAID. Values are from the lookup ORA_CJM_ADJUSTMENT_TYPE.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_TYPE_ID
columns.comments: User created adjustment type identifier from CJM_ADJUSTMENT_TYPES_B table.

columns.name: BENEFICIARY_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Identifies the beneficiary type like CUSTOMER, BILL_TO, SHIP_TO and so on for which accruals are created. Values are validated using the lookup ORA_CJM_BENEFICIARY_TYPE.

columns.name: VENDOR_ID
columns.comments: Contains the vendor ID for vendor rebate program.

columns.name: VENDOR_SITE_ID
columns.comments: Contains the vendor site ID for vendor rebate program.

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.comments: Contains the party ID for CUSTOMER if a beneficiary is defined for a channel program for CUSTOMER, BILL_TO, SHIP_TO, and PARTY. If there is no beneficiary, this contains the party ID of the sales order customer.

columns.name: CUST_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.comments: Contains customer account ID if beneficiary is of type CUSTOMER, BILL_TO and is undefined for SHIP_TO, PARTY AND VENDOR. If there is no beneficiary, this contains the account ID of the sales order customer.

columns.name: BILL_TO_CUSTOMER_ID
columns.comments: Contains the CUST_ACCOUNT_ID of the sales order customer.

columns.name: BILL_TO_SITE_USE_ID
columns.comments: Contains the bill to site use ID if beneficiary is BILL_TO and is undefined for other beneficiary types. If there is no beneficiary, this contains the bill to site use ID of the sales order customer.

columns.name: SHIP_TO_PARTY_SITE_ID
columns.comments: Contains the ship to party site ID if beneficiary is SHIP_TO and is undefined for other beneficiary types. If there is no beneficiary, this contains the ship to party site ID of the sales order customer.

columns.name: PROGRAM_HEADER_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the program header ID for which accruals are created. This is a foreign key from the CJM_PROGRAMS_ALL_B table.

columns.name: PROGRAM_LINE_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the program line ID for which accruals are created. This is a foreign key from the CJM_PROGRAM_LINES table.

columns.name: ITEM_LEVEL_CODE
columns.comments: Identifies the product level code. Values are from the lookup ORA_CJM_ITEM_LEVEL.

columns.name: ITEM_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the unique identifier for the product level code, contains the inventory item ID in the case of ITEM.

columns.name: OBJECT_TYPE
columns.comments: Identifies the type of object for which accruals are created, such as Invoice, Third Party Order, Sales Order, and so on. Values are from the lookup ORA_CJM_DOCUMENT_TYPE.

columns.name: OBJECT_ID
columns.comments: Contains the unique identifier for the object type, for example, the resale header ID for third party orders, and order header ID for sales orders.

columns.name: OBJECT_LINE_ID
columns.comments: Contains the object line ID, such as fulfillment line ID in the case of a direct sales order and resale line in the case of a third party order. This will be used as the alternate key for FOM integration for charge and charge components tables.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_AMOUNT

columns.name: PROGRAM_HEADER_ID
columns.comments: Unique Identifier for a Channel Program.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: PROGRAM_CODE
columns.comments: Code for the Channel program, this can be either entered by the user or auto-generated from the system.

columns.name: PROGRAM_TYPE_ID
columns.comments: Referenced from CJM_PROGRAM_TYPES_B.PROGRAM_TYPE_ID. Values are from the program type template used to create the channel program.

columns.name: PROGRAM_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Contains seeded program type values. Values are from the lookup ORA_CJM_SEEDED_PROGRAM_TYPE.

columns.name: OWNER_ID
columns.comments: Owner of the Channel Program.(user_id)

columns.name: USER_STATUS_ID
columns.comments: User defined status for the Channel Program, Seed Data will be needed. Foreign key from CJM_USER_STATUSES_B table.

columns.name: VENDOR_ID
columns.comments: Contains the Vendor ID for Supplier Ship and Debit Program.

columns.name: VENDOR_SITE_ID
columns.comments: Contains the Vendor site ID for the Supplier Ship and Debit Program.

columns.name: INITIATED_BY_CODE
columns.comments: Program creation source code. Values are from the lookup ORA_CJM_INITIATED_BY.

columns.name: CONTACT_ID
columns.comments: Contact ID of the supplier for supplier ship and debit, supplier rebate, and supplier annual programs.

columns.name: AUTHORIZATION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Contains the Authorization Number by Vendor.

columns.name: QUOTE_NUMBER
columns.comments: Contains the Quote Number by vendor.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_PROGRAM
columns.comments: Enable override of auto selected programs in order management.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.comments: System Status Code for the user_status_id. Value will be populated from Look up code ORA_CJM_PROGRAM_SYSTEM_STATUS.

columns.name: STATUS_CHANGE_DATE
columns.comments: The date on which the status is assigned.

columns.name: DISCOUNT_APPLIED_TO_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates the level at which the Channel Program will be qualified. Value will be populated using the look up code ORA_CJM_DISCOUNT_APPLIED_TO.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.comments: The currency code used in budget request.

columns.name: COMMITTED_AMOUNT
columns.comments: Committed amount from the Budget.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_CLOSED_FLAG
columns.comments: Used for budgeting purposes, when channel program gets reconciled this Flag will be marked as Y.

columns.name: VOLUME_PROGRAM_TYPE
columns.comments: Type of Channnel volume program lines , if it is ACCRUAL or OFFINVOICE.

columns.name: RETROACTIVE
columns.comments: Applies only for programs of type Volume. Indicates if the discounts are retroactive.

columns.name: CALCULATION_METHOD_CODE
columns.comments: Tier calculation method supported by the program. Values are from the lookup ORA_CJM_TIER_CALC_METHOD.

columns.name: ENABLE_BENEFICIARY
columns.comments: Determines if the beneficiary is in the Channel Program UI.

columns.name: BENEFICIARY_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Stores beneficiary information. Possible values are like CUSTOM, BILL_TO, CUSTOMER, SHIPT_TO etc.

columns.name: BENEFICIARY_VALUE_CODE
columns.comments: This will store the value like customer account id in case of customer, bill to site use id in case of BILL_TO etc

columns.name: HEADER_DYNAMIC_MATRIX_ID
columns.comments: This column is mapped to the DYNAMIC_MATRIX_ID of QP_MATRICES table. Channel program qualifiers which are sourced from the order header are mapped to the Header Matrix Type. DYNAMIC_MATRIX_ID is further mapped to QP_MATRIX_INHERITED_DIMENSIONS and QP_MATRIX_RULES.

columns.name: COMMON_DYNAMIC_MATRIX_ID
columns.comments: This column is mapped to the DYNAMIC_MATRIX_ID of QP_MATRICES table. Channel Program Level 0 or Level1 qualifiers which are sourced from Order Headers or Order Lines will be mapped to the Common Matrix Type and this dynamic_matrix_id will further be mapped to the QP_MATRIX_INHERITED_DIMENSIONS and QP_MATRIX_RULES.

columns.name: HEADER_MATRIX_RULE_ID
columns.comments: This column is mapped to the DYNAMIC_MATRIX_RULE_ID from QP_MATRIX_RULES table. This matrix rule will be created for the Channel Program only when user enters the Level 0 Qualifiers sourced from order header and no Level 1 qualifiers are present.

columns.name: COMMON_MATRIX_RULE_ID
columns.comments: This column is mapped to the DYNAMIC_MATRIX_RULE_ID from QP_MATRIX_RULES table. This matrix rule will be created for the Channel Program only when user enters the Level 0 Qualifiers sourced from order header or order Line and no Level 1 qualifiers are present.

columns.name: SOLD_BY_SALES_METHOD_CODE
columns.comments: indicates if the channel program is for direct, indirect sales or both. Value will be populated from the lookup ORA_CJM_SALES_METHOD.

columns.name: BU_ID
columns.comments: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: PROGRAM_ACTIVATION_DATE
columns.comments: Activation date of the Channel Program.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.comments: The date from which the Channel program is Effective.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.comments: The date till which the Channel program is Effective.

columns.name: PRICING_DATE_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Pricing date type. This is the sales order date type used for evaluating channel program eligibility. This value can be the Order Date, Scheduled Shipment Date, or the Requested Ship Date and is populated using the lookup ORA_CJM_PRICING_APP_DATE_TYPE.

columns.name: PRICING_DATE_FROM
columns.comments: From Date based on pricing_date_type_code. If pricing_date_type_code is the Order Date, this is the From Order Date.

columns.name: PRICING_DATE_TO
columns.comments: To Date based on pricing_date_type_code. If pricing_date_type_code is the Order Date, this is the To Order Date.

columns.name: DISPLAY_ON_ORDER_FLAG
columns.comments: This Flag will decide if the channel program needs to be displayed in order Management screen or not.

columns.name: REQUEST_ONLY_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates whether the user must ask for the channel program, e.g. quote a promotion number, to get the benefits on the list. The pricing engine ignores any lists where 'Ask For = Y' if they have not been quoted on the pricing request.

columns.name: GRACE_PERIOD_IN_DAYS
columns.comments: Indicates the number of days that the ship and debit can extend beyond the 'to date', on a ship and debit request. This field determines the end date for the underlying program. The maximum value for this field is 9999 days.

columns.name: LAST_RUN_DATE
columns.comments: Last run date for the channel annual programs. Used to retrieve the invoice data to be processed in each run.

columns.name: LAST_PERIOD_END_DATE
columns.comments: Last accrual Processing peiod end date of the channel program.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates the code of the customer type for which the program is created. This column is applicable only for Lumpsum programs.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_ID
columns.comments: Indicates the identifier of the code for the customer type selected. This column is applicable only for Lumpsum programs.

columns.name: LUMPSUM_AMOUNT
columns.comments: Indicates the amount defined for the lumpsum program.

columns.name: LUMPSUM_DISTRIB_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates the distribution type of the Lumpsum program, for example, Even, Amount, and Percent. Values are from lookup ORA_CJM_DISTRIBUTION_TYPE.

columns.name: ESTIMATED_AMOUNT
columns.comments: Indicates the amount estimated for the program. This field is mandatory when the program is submitted.

columns.name: ACCOUNTED_ESTIMATED_AMOUNT
columns.comments: Indicates the amount estimated for the program in functional currency.

columns.name: ACCOUNTED_LUMPSUM_AMOUNT
columns.comments: Indicates the amount defined for the lumpsum program in functional currency.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_TYPE
columns.comments: Identifies the exchange rate type, for example CORPORATE.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_DATE
columns.comments: Indicates the date on which the exchange occurred. This is the date on which the program is submitted for approval.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.comments: Indicates the exchange rate between the program currency and the functional currency.

columns.name: COMMENTS_FOR_APPROVERS
columns.comments: Comments submitted to provide additional information to the approvers. Contains justification for the special pricing agreement.

columns.name: SUBMITTED_BY
columns.comments: Indicates the identifier for the user who has submitted the program for approval.

columns.name: SUBMITTED_DATE
columns.comments: Indicates the date on which the program is submitted for approval.

columns.name: APPROVED_DATE
columns.comments: Indicates the date on which the program was approved.

columns.name: REJECTED_DATE
columns.comments: Indicates the date on which the program was rejected

columns.name: OWNER_USER_ID
columns.comments: Indicates the value for the OWNER_ID before data migration. This indicates the identifier for the system user who created the program.

columns.name: ELIGIBLE_FOR_ALL_CUSTOMERS
columns.comments: Indicates whether the program is eligible for all customers.

columns.name: SHIP_FROM_DIST_INV_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates whether the special price agreement is applied to products that are shipped from the distributor's existing inventory.

columns.name: ACCRUE_BASED_ON_POS_FLAG

objects.name: CJM_PROGRAMS_MATRIX_MAP_ALL
objects.description: This table contains the mapping between the pricing dynamic matrix ID and the program for the combination of PROGRAM_TYPE_ID, BU_ID, and the PRICING_DATE_TYPE_CODE.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.comments: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.comments: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.comments: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: BU_ID

columns.name: PROGRAM_TYPE_ID
columns.comments: Referenced from CJM_PROGRAM_TYPES_B.PROGRAM_TYPE_ID. Values are from the program type template used to create the channel program.

columns.name: SEEDED_PROGRAM_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Predefined program type values. Values are from the lookup ORA_CJM_SEEDED_PROGRAM_TYPE.

columns.name: DYNAMIC_MATRIX_ID
columns.comments: This column is mapped to the DYNAMIC_MATRIX_ID of QP_MATRICES table. Channel program qualifiers which are sourced from the order header are mapped to the Header Matrix Type. DYNAMIC_MATRIX_ID is further mapped to QP_MATRIX_INHERITED_DIMENSIONS and QP_MATRIX_RULES.

columns.name: PRICING_DATE_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: This column stores the date type sourced from the header and is used to evaluate channel program eligibility. Contains Null if the program has data sourcing from the COMMON_DYNAMIC_MATRIX_ID. This code is populated from the lookup ORA_CJM_PRICING_APP_DATE_TYPE.

objects.name: CJM_PROGRAMS_UTILIZED_ALL_B
objects.description: CJM_PROGRAMS_UTILIZED_ALL_B contains all Accrual records generated via both the Channel Program Accrual Engine ESS Job as well as the Manual Adjustment process. This table contains all accrual records created for a Direct Sales Order, Indirect Sales Order, Increased Earned, Decrease Earned, Increase Paid and Decrease Paid Adjustment records. Accruals with gl_posted_flag set to Y are calculated as the Earned Amount, while the sum of all accruals for a given Program and Budget Combination is considered the Utilized amount.

columns.name: UTILIZATION_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the unique identifier for the CJM_PROGRAMS_UTILIZED_ALL_B table

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.comments: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.comments: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.comments: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: BU_ID
columns.comments: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: BILL_TO_BU_ID
columns.comments: Bill to Business Unit derived from the Supplier Site Assignment where the Client Business Unit is the Order Business Unit.

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.comments: Unique identifier for the legal entity. If an identifier is not specified, the default legal entity of the business unit is assigned by the system.

columns.name: PROGRAM_HEADER_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the Program Header ID for which accruals are created. This is a Foreign Key from the CJM_PROGRAMS_ALL_B table.

columns.name: PROGRAM_LINE_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the program_line_id, for which accruals are created. This is a Foreign Key from the CJM_PROGRAM_LINES table.

columns.name: BUDGET_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the Budget against which the Accruals are created.

columns.name: UTILIZATION_TYPE
columns.comments: Identifies the type of utilization, such as Accrual, Utilized, or Adjustment record. Values are from Lookup ORA_CJM_UTILIZATION_TYPE.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_TYPE
columns.comments: Identifies the Type of Adjustment, such as INCREASE_EARNED, DECREASE_EARNED, INCREASE_PAID , DECREASE_PAID. Values are from the Lookup ORA_CJM_ADJUSTMENT_TYPE.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_TYPE_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the Adjustment type ID for the different Adjustment Types.

columns.name: OBJECT_TYPE
columns.comments: Identifies the type of object for which Accruals are created, such as INVOICE, Third Party Order, Sales Order, and so on. Values are from Lookup ORA_CJM_DOCUMENT_TYPE.

columns.name: OBJECT_ID
columns.comments: Contains the Unique identifier for the Object Type, the Invoice ID in the case of INVOICE, the resale header ID in the case of Third Party Orders, and Order Header ID in the case of Sales Order.

columns.name: OBJECT_LINE_ID
columns.comments: Contains the Object Line ID, such as Fulfillment Line ID in the case of a direct Sales Order and Resale Line in the case of a Third Party Order. This will be used as the alternate key for FOM integration for charge and Charge Components table.

columns.name: CHARGE_DEFINITION_CODE
columns.comments: This code is created in the Pricing module and it represents the unique combination of Charge Type, Charge Sub Type, and Price Type Code. This will be used as the alternate key for FOM integration for charge and Charge Components table.

columns.name: PRICE_PERIODICITY_CODE
columns.comments: This code is populated when the price type code is Recurring. It contains values, such as Weeks, Months , Hours, and so on. This will be used as the alternate key for FOM integration for charge and Charge Components table.

columns.name: PRICE_ELEMENT_CODE
columns.comments: The price element code for which Channel Charges are created. This will be used as the alternate key for FOM integration for charge and Charge Components table. This will be used as the alternate key for FOM integration for charge and Charge Components table.

columns.name: PRICING_SOURCE_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: For Channel Charges, this contains the value as 'PRICING_TERM'. This will be used as the alternate key for FOM integration for charge and Charge Components table.

columns.name: PRICING_SOURCE_ID
columns.comments: The pricing source ID contains the pricing term ID applied to a sales order for which charge components are generated in Fusion Order Management. This will be used as the alternate key for FOM integration for charge and Charge Components table.

columns.name: ITEM_LEVEL_CODE
columns.comments: Identifies the Product Level Code for which Exclusion is created (example: ITEM or ALL_ITEMS). Value will be populated in this column using the look up code ORA_CJM_ITEM_LEVEL.

columns.name: ITEM_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the unique identifier for the Product level code, contains the Inventory Item ID in the case of PRODUCT, and the category ID in the case of PRODUCT_FAMILY.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_CURR_AMOUNT
columns.comments: Identifies the Accrual Amount in the Transaction currency, for example the accrual amount is the Sales Order Currency in the case of a Direct Sales Order.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_CURR_AMOUNT_REM
columns.comments: Identifies the Accrual remaining Amount in the Transaction currency, for example it contains the accrual remaining amount not yet claimed.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.comments: Identifies the Transaction Currency Code, for example order currency code in the case of a Direct Sales Order.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_TYPE
columns.comments: Identifies the Exchange Rate Type for which Accruals are created (example: CORPORATE).

columns.name: GL_DATE
columns.comments: Identifies the General Ledger Posting Date. This contains the Actual Shipment date or the Invoice date in the case of a Direct Sales order (Based on GL posting profile) and Invoiced date in the case of RMA orders.

columns.name: REQUESTED_GL_DATE
columns.comments: General Ledger posting date.Contains the actual shipment date or the invoice date in the case of a direct sales orders (based on GL posting profile) and invoiced date in case of RMA orders. For manual adjustments,this is a user entered field and can be a past date or system date. While posting the records to GL, as per sweep fix, if the period is closed, the records gets posted this is a user entered field and can be a past date or system date. While posting the records to GL, as per sweep fix, if the period is closed, the records gets posted in the next open GL period and this column is updated with the actual GL posted date.

columns.name: MANUAL_ADJUSTMENT_ID
columns.comments: Foreign key reference from CJM_MANUAL_ADJUSTMENTS_ALL_B table for manual adjustment records. One set of user Input for Manual Adjustment record can create multiple records in CJM_PROGRAM_UTILIZED_ALL_B table in case of Decreased_Earned Adjustments if First In First Out Logic will gets executed.

columns.name: INVOICE_SOURCE_CODE
columns.comments: Alternate key for the invoice ID, along with the invoice number.

columns.name: GL_POSTED_FLAG
columns.comments: Identifies if the Accrual Record was posted in GL. This column is set to Y if the record posted successfully, F if the GL posting failed due to any errors with the Accrual record and the record will then be reprocessed in the next run, and N if the Accrual Record is not yet posted to GL.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_DATE
columns.comments: Identifies the creation date of the Charge components in the case of a Direct Sales Order and the Program Accrual Engine start date in the case of backdated Adjustment Records.

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.comments: If a Beneficiary is defined for a channel program, this contains the party ID for CUSTOMER in the case of CUSTOMER, BILL To, SHIP TO, PARTY. Otherwise, it contains the party_id for the Sales Order customer.

columns.name: CUST_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.comments: Contains the cust_account_id in the case Beneficiary is of type CUSTOMER, BILL_TO and Null in the case of SHIP_TO, PARTY AND VENDOR. If there is no Beneficiary, it contains the account identifier of the sales order customer.

columns.name: BILL_TO_CUSTOMER_ID
columns.comments: This will always contain the cust_account_id for Sales Order Customer.

columns.name: BILL_TO_SITE_USE_ID
columns.comments: Contains the Bill To site use ID if BENEFICIARY is BILL_TO, or this contains NULL for other Beneficiary types. If there is no Beneficiary, it contains the Bill To site use ID of the sales order customer.

columns.name: SHIP_TO_PARTY_SITE_ID
columns.comments: Contains the ship to party site ID if BENEFICIARY is SHIP_TO or this contains NULL for other Beneficiary types. If there is no Beneficiary, it contains the ship to party site ID of sales order customer.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME

objects.name: CJM_PROGRAM_CONDITIONS
objects.description: CJM_PROGRAM_CONDITIONS contains the additional conditions for Level 1 qualifiers for a Channel Program. PROGRAM_QUALIFIER_ID will be the Foreign Key from CJM_PROGRAM_QUALIFIERS.PROGRAM_QUALIFIER_ID. All the rows present in this table will be the AND conditions for the corresponding Level 1 conditions present in CJM_PROGRAM_QUALIFIERS table.

columns.name: QUALIFIER_CONDITION_ID
columns.comments: Unique identifier of the Program Qualifier Condition.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: PROGRAM_QUALIFIER_ID
columns.comments: Unique identifier for the Program Qualifiers Table. Foreign Key from CJM_PROGRAM_QUALIFIERS.PROGRAM_QUALIFIER_ID

columns.name: QUALIFIER_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: The value from the Source Code Name of the Conditions Column, in the Matrix Class. Values are from lookup ORA_CJM_QUALIFIER_TYPE.

columns.name: COMPARISON_OPERATOR_CODE
columns.comments: The relational operator code used to define how the pricing engine should evaluate the qualifier attributes, based on lookup ORA_CJM_MKT_COND_OPERATOR.

columns.name: QUALIFIER_VALUE_CODE
columns.comments: Values, such as customer account identifier in the case of a customer, bill-to site identifier in the case of BILL_TO, and so on.

columns.name: QUALIFIER_VALUE_CODE_TO
columns.comments: The high value for the QUALIFIER_ATTRIBUTE, if the COMPARISON_OPERATOR_CODE is BETWEEN.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.comments: Date the qualifier becomes effective

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.comments: Date the qualifier becomes ineffective.

columns.name: QUALIFIER_DATATYPE
columns.comments: Identifies the datatype of the QUALIFIER_ATTR_VALUE and QUALIFIER_ATTR_VALUE_TO.

objects.name: CJM_PROGRAM_LINES
objects.description: CJM_PROGRAM_LINES_ALL contains channel program line level information. For example, Item Context details, Discount details like Type and Value.

columns.name: PROGRAM_LINE_ID
columns.comments: Unique identifier for Program lines.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.comments: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.comments: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.comments: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: PROGRAM_HEADER_ID
columns.comments: Unique Identifier for a Channel Program. This is the Foreign key from CJM_PROGRAMS_ALL_B.PROGRAM_HEADER_ID. Unique identifer for a Special Price Agreement.

columns.name: PROGRAM_TIER_HEADER_ID
columns.comments: Foreign Key from cjm_program_tier_headers table, Channel Rebate Program Simple Tier will not have any row in cjm_program_tier_all_b and will store the Discount and Item information in Lines_All table. This will contain multiple rows for Different Items in one discount table in case of Volume program and PROGRAM_TIER_ID will be a Foreign Key in that case.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.comments: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the beginning of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.comments: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the end of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: MAX_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Maximum allowed quantity in a channel program line.

columns.name: ITEM_LEVEL_CODE
columns.comments: This Column will store the values like ALL_ITEMS, ITEM_CATEGORY or ITEM, for custom product qualifier we might need the seed data. Value will be populated in this column using the look up code ORA_CJM_ITEM_TYPE.

columns.name: ITEM_ID
columns.comments: Product attribute value like inventory_item_id, Null in case of ALL_ITEMS.

columns.name: UOM_CODE
columns.comments: Unit of Measure code like 'Ea'.

columns.name: DISCOUNT_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Discount type for program lines. Values are from the lookup code ORA_CJM_LINE_DISCOUNT_TYPE.

columns.name: DISCOUNT_AMOUNT
columns.comments: Discount Amount for the program line.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_BASIS_ID
columns.comments: QP Adjustment Bases for ListPrice, Inv Price, Ceiling Price, Base List price etc, this can be used to implement the Bucket Functionality.

columns.name: ACCRUAL_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates if it is an accrual line or off invoice. Yes indicates accrual lines.

columns.name: INCOMPATIBILITY_GRP_CODE
columns.comments: Incompatibility group Code will decide the application of Channel Program on the Same Order , like Exclusive. This is to Support for the Advance options of Channel Program.

columns.name: PRODUCT_PRECEDENCE
columns.comments: Needed for Advance options support. This field will decide the application of Channel program on Sales order.

columns.name: APPLY_DISCOUNT_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates if discount is applicable to this product.

columns.name: LINE_DYNAMIC_MATRIX_ID
columns.comments: This column is mapped to the DYNAMIC_MATRIX_ID of QP_MATRICES table. Channel program Lines like Item or UoM will be mapped to the Line Matrix Type and this dynamic_matrix_id will further be mapped to the QP_MATRIX_INHERITED_DIMENSIONS and QP_MATRIX_RULES.

columns.name: LINE_MATRIX_RULE_ID
columns.comments: This column is mapped to the DYNAMIC_MATRIX_RULE_ID from QP_MATRIX_RULES table. This matrix rule will be created for the Channel Program Lines.

columns.name: PRICING_TERM_ID
columns.comments: This column refers to the pricing_term_id of qp_pricing_terms_b table. Channel Program lines will be mapped as pricing terms in Pricing upon activation of Channel Program.

columns.name: TP_ITEM_ID
columns.comments: Unique identifier for the supplier item.

columns.name: INCLUDE_VOL_EXCLUDE_DIS_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates if volume must be considered and discount excluded for volume programs.

columns.name: PROGRAM_LINE_NUMBER
columns.comments: User friendly alternate key for the program line number to be displayed in the UI.

columns.name: REVISION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Indicates the number of revisions for a product rule.

columns.name: CATEGORY_SET_ID
columns.comments: Indicates the catalog information of the category selected for the product rule.

columns.name: ORIG_UNIT_SELLING_PRICE
columns.comments: Indicates the original selling price per unit for an item.

columns.name: QUANTITY
columns.comments: Contains the item quantity for which special pricing discount is applicable.

columns.name: AMOUNT
columns.comments: Indicates the calculated amount for the program line.

columns.name: UNIT_DISCOUNT_AMOUNT
columns.comments: Indicates the calculated amount per unit for the program line.

columns.name: IS_VALID_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates if the current program line is valid or not. Contains 'N' for the invalid lines and Null for the valid records.

columns.name: COMPETITOR_ITEM
columns.comments: Descriptive text for a competitor's item.

columns.name: COMPETITOR_ITEM_PRICE
columns.comments: Indicates the price per unit for a competitor's item.

columns.name: RULE_NUMBER
columns.comments: Number that identifies the leading component in the Display Line Number. The rule number must be an integer greater than 0. The Display Line Number is a unique number and is the concatenation of the rule number and the child rule number separated by a period. For example, if the display line number is 3.1, then the rule number is 3 and the child rule number is 1.

columns.name: CHILD_RULE_NUMBER
columns.comments: Number that identifies the trailing component in the Display Line Number. The child rule number must be blank for the first rule number and must be an integer greater than 0. The Display Line Number is a unique number and is the concatenation of the rule number and the child rule number separated by a period. For example, if the display line number is 5.2, then the rule number is 5 and the child rule number is 2.

objects.name: CJM_ADJUSTMENT_TYPES_VL
objects.query:
SELECT
B.ADJUSTMENT_TYPE_ID,
B.ADJUSTMENT_TYPE_UNIQUE_CODE,
TL.ADJUSTMENT_TYPE_NAME,
B.ADJUSTMENT_TYPE_GUID,
TL.DESCRIPTION,
B.SET_ID,
B.ADJUSTMENT_TYPE_CODE,
B.BUY_SIDE_FLAG,
B.SELL_SIDE_FLAG,
B.SEEDED_FLAG,
B.ENABLED_FLAG,
B.START_DATE,
B.END_DATE,
B.OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER,
B.CREATED_BY,
B.CREATION_DATE,
B.LAST_UPDATED_BY,
B.LAST_UPDATE_DATE,
B.LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN,
B.REQUEST_ID,
B.JOB_DEFINITION_NAME,
B.JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE,
B.ADJUSTMENT_NUMBER_PREFIX
FROM
CJM_ADJUSTMENT_TYPES_B B,
CJM_ADJUSTMENT_TYPES_TL TL
WHERE
B.ADJUSTMENT_TYPE_ID = TL.ADJUSTMENT_TYPE_ID
AND
TL.LANGUAGE = USERENV('LANG')

objects.name: CJM_ADJ_TYPE_REASONS_VL
objects.query:
SELECT
B.ADJUSTMENT_REASON_ID,
B.REASON_CODE,
B.ENABLED_FLAG,
B.DEFAULT_FLAG,
B.ADJUSTMENT_TYPE_ID,
B.OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER,
B.CREATED_BY,
B.CREATION_DATE,
B.LAST_UPDATED_BY,
B.LAST_UPDATE_DATE,
B.LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN,
B.REQUEST_ID,
B.JOB_DEFINITION_NAME,
B.JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE,
TL.ADJUSTMENT_REASON_NAME,
TL.DESCRIPTION
FROM
CJM_ADJ_TYPE_REASONS_B B,

AND UTIL.ITEM_ID = EGPSYSTEMITEMVL.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
AND UTIL.TP_ITEM_ID = EGPTPITEMS.TP_ITEM_ID(+)
AND EGPSYSTEMITEMVL.ORGANIZATION_ID = CJM_UTILITY_PKG.GET_INV_ORG_FROM_BU_ID(UTIL.BU_ID)

AND DOOLINESALL.HEADER_ID = DOOFULFILLLINESALL.HEADER_ID
AND UTIL.OBJECT_ID = DOOHEADERSALL.HEADER_ID

AND UTIL.MANUAL_ADJUSTMENT_ID = MANUALADJ.MANUAL_ADJUSTMENT_ID(+)
AND UTIL.ACCRUAL_TYPE = 'SUPPLIER'
AND UTIL.gl_posted_flag = 'Y'
AND FndLookUp1.lookup_type = 'ORA_CJM_TRANSACTION_TYPE'
AND FndLookUp1.lookup_code=UTIL.UTILIZATION_TYPE
AND CjmAdjustmentTypesVL.ADJUSTMENT_TYPE_ID(+) = UTIL.adjustment_type_id

objects.name: CJM_PROGRAM_CLAIMS_VL
objects.query:
SELECT
futb.program_header_id,
cca.claim_id,
cca.status_code claim_status_code,
userstatus.user_status_name,
cca.claim_date,
cca.claim_number,
cca.currency_code claim_currency_code,
futb.in_progress + futb.paid claim_amount,
futb.in_progress in_progress,
futb.paid paid,
claim_details.settlement_date settlement_date,
claim_details.settlement_type settlement_type,
claim_details.settlement_number settlement_number,
claim_details.instrument_number instrument_number,
claim_details.instrument_type instrument_type,
claim_details.instrument_date instrument_date,
claim_details.instrument_amount instrument_amount,
(
SELECT
COUNT(1)
FROM
cjm_settlement_docs_all cs
WHERE
cs.claim_id = cca.claim_id
AND
cs.settlement_doc_type_code = 'INSTRUMENT'
) instrument_count,
cca.creation_date,
cca.created_by,
cca.last_update_date,
cca.last_updated_by
FROM
cjm_claims_all cca,
cjm_user_statuses_vl userstatus,
(
SELECT
util.program_header_id,
casso.claim_id,
CASE
WHEN
cca2.status_code <> 'SETTLED'
THEN SUM(cclu.amount)
ELSE 0
END
in_progress,
CASE
WHEN
cca2.status_code = 'SETTLED'
THEN SUM(cclu.amount)
ELSE 0
END
paid
FROM
cjm_claim_lines_util_all cclu,
cjm_programs_utilized_all_b util,
cjm_claim_associations_all casso,
cjm_claims_all cca2
WHERE
cclu.utilization_id = util.utilization_id
AND
casso.association_id = cclu.association_id
AND
cca2.claim_id = casso.claim_id
AND
util.gl_posted_flag = 'Y'
GROUP BY
util.program_header_id,
casso.claim_id,
cca2.status_code
) futb,
(
SELECT
nvl(
csda_transaction.claim_id,
csda_instrument.claim_id
) claim_id,
csda_transaction.settlement_date,
csda_transaction.settlement_type,
csda_transaction.settlement_number,
csda_instrument.instrument_number,
csda_instrument.instrument_type,
csda_instrument.instrument_date,
csda_instrument.instrument_amount
FROM
(
SELECT
cca.claim_id,
csda_trans.settlement_date settlement_date,
csda_trans.settlement_type settlement_type,
csda_trans.settlement_number settlement_number
FROM
cjm_claims_all cca,
cjm_settlement_docs_all csda_trans,
(
SELECT
csda_in_trans.claim_id,
MIN(csda_in_trans.creation_date) creation_date
FROM
cjm_settlement_docs_all csda_in_trans
WHERE
csda_in_trans.settlement_doc_type_code = 'TRANSACTION'
AND
nvl(
csda_in_trans.purge_flag,
'N'
) = 'N'
AND
(
CASE
WHEN csda_in_trans.payment_method_code <> 'CHECK' THEN 1
WHEN
csda_in_trans.payment_method_code = 'CHECK'
AND
csda_in_trans.status_code IN (
'ISSUED','NEGOTIABLE','STOP INITIATED','CLEARED','RECONCILED'
)
THEN 1
WHEN csda_in_trans.payment_method_code IS NULL THEN 1
ELSE 0
END
) = 1
GROUP BY
csda_in_trans.claim_id
) csda_in_transaction
WHERE
cca.claim_id = csda_trans.claim_id
AND
csda_trans.settlement_doc_type_code = 'TRANSACTION'
AND
csda_trans.claim_id = csda_in_transaction.claim_id
AND
csda_trans.creation_date = csda_in_transaction.creation_date
) csda_transaction
FULL OUTER JOIN (
SELECT
cca.claim_id,
csda_instr.settlement_number instrument_number,
csda_instr.settlement_type instrument_type,
csda_instr.settlement_date instrument_date,
csda_instr.settlement_amount instrument_amount
FROM
cjm_claims_all cca,
cjm_settlement_docs_all csda_instr,
(
SELECT
csda_in_instr.claim_id,
MIN(csda_in_instr.creation_date) creation_date
FROM
cjm_settlement_docs_all csda_in_instr
WHERE
csda_in_instr.settlement_doc_type_code = 'INSTRUMENT'
AND
nvl(
csda_in_instr.purge_flag,
'N'
) = 'N'
AND
(
CASE
WHEN csda_in_instr.payment_method_code <> 'CHECK' THEN 1
WHEN
csda_in_instr.payment_method_code = 'CHECK'
AND
csda_in_instr.status_code IN (
'ISSUED','NEGOTIABLE','STOP INITIATED','CLEARED','RECONCILED'
)
THEN 1
WHEN csda_in_instr.payment_method_code IS NULL THEN 1
ELSE 0
END
) = 1
GROUP BY
csda_in_instr.claim_id
) csda_in_instrument
WHERE
cca.claim_id = csda_instr.claim_id
AND
csda_instr.settlement_doc_type_code = 'INSTRUMENT'
AND
csda_instr.claim_id = csda_in_instrument.claim_id
AND
csda_instr.creation_date = csda_in_instrument.creation_date
) csda_instrument ON csda_instrument.claim_id = csda_transaction.claim_id
) claim_details
WHERE
cca.claim_id = futb.claim_id
AND
cca.claim_id = claim_details.claim_id (+)
AND
cca.user_status_id = userstatus.user_status_id

objects.name: CMK_ACCOUNT_NUMBERS
objects.description: This table contains account numbers used in B2B message processing. Each account number must have an associated service provider, trading partner, supplier, a ship-to location and optionally a purchasing site and business unit and pay site and pay site business unit. The account number is included in the payload of the outbound purchase sent to your suppliers. The information in this table is also used during processing of invoices you receive to derive a pay site for your invoices that don't have a purchase order or to specify a pay site for your invoice that is different than the site on your purchase order.

columns.comments: This is the identifier of the account number.

columns.comments: This is the unique identifier of the service provider.

columns.comments: This is the unique identifier of the supplier site.

columns.name: BILL_TO_BU
columns.comments: This is the business unit that is used to create the invoice during message processing.

columns.name: PAY_SITE_ID
columns.comments: This is the site that is used to create the invoice during message processing.
