columns.comments: The unique identifier of a work order details interface record. Its value is an application generated unique id.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: INTERFACE_BATCH_ID
columns.comments: Represents the internal interface batch identifier. This is used to group a batch of interface records for processing. When interface records are brought in via services or the UI, the system will internally generate this value.

columns.name: INTERFACE_BATCH_CODE
columns.comments: Represents the user identified code for the interface batch.

columns.name: INTERFACE_STATUS_CODE
columns.comments: Represents the progress of the interface processing with statuses such as ready for processing or currently in process as well as the various flavors of completion statuses. Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = ORA_WIE_INTERFACE_STATUS.

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.comments: A code used to indicate what action the system should perform on the detail entity. Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = ORA_WIE_WO_IMP_DETAIL_ACTION.

columns.name: LOAD_TYPE
columns.comments: A code used to indicate the type of data this detail record contains. This indicates if the data being loaded represents the work order operation, work order operation material, work order operation resource, work order serials, etc. Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = ORA_WIE_WO_IMP_LOAD_TYPE.

columns.name: HEADER_NUMBER
columns.comments: The attributes WORK_ORDER_NUMBER + ORGANIZATION_CODE uniquely identify a work order. However, when the work order number is auto generated at the time of creation, the user will not have the work order number to pass via the open interface. This attribute allows the user to connect the header records with the details in the WIE_WORK_ORDER_DETAILS_INT table. The value of this column is user managed. This is not carried forward to the production tables.

columns.name: WORK_ORDER_NUMBER
columns.comments: Represents the user-facing identifier of the work order.

columns.name: WORK_ORDER_ID
columns.comments: Represents the internal identifier of the work order.

columns.name: ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.comments: The organization identifier that represents the manufacturing plant to which this work order belongs.

columns.name: WO_OPERATION_SEQ_NUMBER
columns.comments: Represents the user key in defining the order of operations within the work order.

columns.name: STANDARD_OPERATION_CODE
columns.comments: Reference to the standard operation code. If populated will be used to pull the standard definition for constructing the work order operation and its children.

columns.name: STANDARD_OPERATION_ID
columns.comments: Reference to the standard operation identifier. If populated will be used to pull the standard definition for constructing the operation and its children.

columns.name: OPERATION_NAME
columns.comments: Name of the operation. It is a short description of the operation.

columns.name: OPERATION_DESCRIPTION
columns.comments: Description of the operation. It is a long description of the operation.

columns.name: OPERATION_LONG_DESCRIPTION
columns.comments: Long description of the operation. It is a long description of the operation.

columns.name: OPERATION_TYPE
columns.comments: Specifies the type of the operation. Valid values are contained within the ORA_WIS_OPERATION_TYPE lookup.

columns.name: WO_OPERATION_ID
columns.comments: The internal work order operation identifier.

columns.name: WORK_CENTER_CODE
columns.comments: The user key to the work center entity.

columns.name: WORK_CENTER_ID
columns.comments: The internal identifier to the work center entity.

columns.name: COUNT_POINT_OPERATION_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag used to indicate if this is a count point operation. If an operation is a count point operation, then you have to manually complete it. Any operations in between the count points are automatically completed (i.e. backflushed, etc.).

columns.name: AUTO_TRANSACT_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates whether both resources and materials are automatically charged based on the Supply Type or the Charge Type setups upon completion of the operation.

columns.name: OPER_PLANNED_START_DATE
columns.comments: Planned start date of this operation.

columns.name: OPER_PLANNED_COMPL_DATE
columns.comments: Planned completion date of this operation.

columns.name: READY_QUANTITY
columns.comments: The quantity that is sitting in the inbound queue of each of the operation. This is an internal field and is not exposed in the XLSM template for import.

columns.name: SHIPPING_DOCUMENTS_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag used to determine whether shipping documents need to be generated for a supplier operation. Valid Values: 'Y' and 'N'.

columns.name: OSP_ITEM_ID
columns.comments: Item that represents the value added service in a supplier operation. This is also commonly known as a partially finished assembly.

columns.name: OSP_ITEM_NUMBER
columns.comments: Item that represents the value added service in a supplier operation. This is also commonly known as a partially finished assembly. This is the user key for the supplier operation item.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_ID
columns.comments: Represents the identifier of the suggested supplier for a supplier operation.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_NAME
columns.comments: Represents the name of the suggested supplier for a supplier operation. This is the user key for the supplier.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_SITE_ID
columns.comments: Represents the identifier of the suggested supplier site for a supplier operation.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_SITE_CODE
columns.comments: Represents the code of the suggested supplier site for a supplier operation. This is the user key for the supplier site.

columns.name: LEAD_TIME_UOM
columns.comments: Represents the unit of measure code for the fixed and/or variable lead time values on the supplier operation.

columns.name: LEAD_TIME_UNIT_OF_MEASURE
columns.comments: Represents the unit of measure for the fixed and/or variable lead time values on the supplier operation.

columns.name: FIXED_LEAD_TIME
columns.comments: Represents the fixed lead time used to calculate the operation's start and end date for the supplier operation.

columns.name: VARIABLE_LEAD_TIME
columns.comments: Represents the variable lead time used to calculate the operation's start and end date based on the operation quantity for the supplier operation.

columns.name: ADDL_MTL_AT_MANUAL_ISSUE
columns.comments: Indicates whether or not this operation allows additional materials to be added at manual issue. Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = ORA_WIS_ADDL_MANUAL_ISSUE_OPTS.

columns.name: OP_COMPL_WITH_UNDER_ISSUE
columns.comments: Indicates whether or not to allow operation completions with under issued material. Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = ORA_WIS_OP_COMPLETION_VAL_OPTS.

columns.name: OP_COMPL_WITH_OPEN_EXCEPTIONS
columns.comments: Indicates whether or not to allow operation completions with open exceptions. Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = ORA_WIS_OP_COMPLETION_VAL_OPTS.

columns.name: MATERIAL_SEQ_NUMBER
columns.comments: A sequence number that represents the order of consumption of material at a given operation.

columns.name: WO_OPERATION_MATERIAL_ID
columns.comments: The internal work order operation material identifier. System generated primary key.

columns.name: MATERIAL_TYPE
columns.comments: Type of material consumed by the operation. Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = ORA_WIS_WD_INPUT_MATERIAL.

columns.name: MATERIAL_ITEM_NUMBER
columns.comments: User key to the item to be specified as material in the work order operation material entity.

columns.name: MATERIAL_ITEM_ID
columns.comments: Internal identifier to the item to be specified as material in the work order operation material entity.

columns.name: MATERIAL_ITEM_REVISION
columns.comments: Revision of the item when the item is revision controlled.

columns.name: MATERIAL_QTY_PER_PRODUCT
columns.comments: The quantity per assembly of the component material.

columns.name: MATERIAL_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Quantity of the material either consumed in the operation or produced from the operation.

columns.name: MATERIAL_INVERSE_QUANTITY
columns.comments: The inverse of material quantity.

columns.name: MATERIAL_UOM_CODE
columns.comments: Represents the unit of measure code of the specified material quantity.

columns.name: MATERIAL_UNIT_OF_MEASURE
columns.comments: Represents the unit of measure of the specified material quantity.

columns.name: MATERIAL_BASIS_TYPE
columns.comments: Indicates whether the material quantity is fixed (i.e. quantity per lot produced) or variable (i.e. quantity per item produced). Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = EGP_BOM_BASIS_TYPE.

columns.name: MATERIAL_REQUIRED_DATE
columns.comments: Date when the material is required in the operation.

columns.name: MATERIAL_YIELD_FACTOR
columns.comments: Represents the yield factor of the component.

columns.name: MATERIAL_INCL_IN_PLANNING
columns.comments: Flag used to identify if the item should be included in planning. Valid Values: 'Y' and 'N'.

columns.name: PREFERRED_GRADE_CODE
columns.comments: Preferred grade code for grade-controlled items used to record product completions or select item issues for a recipe, work definition or work order.

columns.name: SUBSTITUTE_MATERIAL_ITEM_ID
columns.comments: Internal identifier to the substitute item.

columns.name: SUBSTITUTE_QTY_PER_PRODUCT
columns.comments: Quantity per assembly of the substitute item.

columns.name: SUPPLY_TYPE
columns.comments: The various supply types are "Assembly Pull", "Operation Pull", "Push", and "Phantom". Assembly Pull - Material will be backflushed at the completion of the assembly. Operation Pull - Material will be backflushed at the completion of the operation. Push - Material will have to manually issued. Phantom - For materials having lower level components, the components will be considered as inputs to this work order. Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup_type = EGP_WIP_SUP_TYPE + lookup_type = ORA_WIE_WO_SUPPLY_TYPE.

columns.name: SUPPLY_SUBINVENTORY
columns.comments: The subinventory that supplies material to the operation.

columns.name: SUPPLY_LOCATOR_ID
columns.comments: The locator within the supply subinventory that feed material in to the work order operations.

columns.name: RESOURCE_SEQ_NUMBER
columns.comments: This value is used to define the sequence in which resources work together in finishing the operation. For parallel work the same sequence number is used.

columns.name: WO_OPERATION_RESOURCE_ID
columns.comments: This is the internal work order operation resource identifier. System generated primary key.

columns.name: RESOURCE_CODE
columns.comments: Represents the user key to the resource.

columns.name: RESOURCE_ID
columns.comments: Represents the internal identifier to the resource which is a foreign key to the WIS_RESOURCES_B table.

columns.name: RESOURCE_PRINCIPAL_FLAG
columns.comments: When two or more resources are running in parallel (i.e. simultaneous resources which have the same sequence number), one and only one of them must be marked as the principal/primary resource. Planning will identify bottlenecks if the principal resource is not available when checking for capacity.

columns.name: RESOURCE_USAGE_RATE
columns.comments: Represents the resource usage rate per unit of the primary product produced.

columns.name: RESOURCE_REQUIRED_USAGE
columns.comments: Represents the total required usage for the resource based on the basis type, usage rate, and work order quantity. It is the usage per assembly unit (variable basis) or the usage per work order (fixed basis). For example, assuming usage rate = 1 hour and work order quantity = 10: If Basis = Variable, then required usage = 1 * 10 = 10 hours If Basis = Fixed, then required usage = 1 hour

columns.name: RESOURCE_INVERSE_REQD_USAGE
columns.comments: The inverse of the required usage.

columns.name: RESOURCE_BASIS_TYPE
columns.comments: Indicates whether the resource quantity is fixed (i.e. usage per lot produced) or variable (i.e. usage per item produced). Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = EGP_BOM_BASIS_TYPE.

columns.name: CHARGE_TYPE
columns.comments: Indicates whether resource transactions are automatically generated and at what stage. Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = ORA_WIS_CHARGE_TYPE.

columns.name: RESOURCE_ASSIGNED_UNITS
columns.comments: Number of resource units assigned to perform the operation.

columns.name: RESOURCE_PLANNED_START_DATE
columns.comments: Date when the resource is planned to start within the operation to which it is assigned.

columns.name: RESOURCE_PLANNED_COMPL_DATE
columns.comments: Date when the resource is planned to complete within the operation to which it is assigned.

columns.name: RESOURCE_ACTIVITY_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates the activity this production resource is going to perform at this operation. Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = ORA_WIS_RESOURCE_ACTIVITY.

columns.name: RESOURCE_SCHEDULED_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag used to indicate if this resource is scheduled or not. Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = ORA_WIS_RESOURCE_SCHEDULE.

columns.name: WD_OP_ALT_RESOURCE_ID
columns.comments: Foreign key to WIS_WD_OP_ALT_RESOURCES.WD_OP_ALT_RESOURCE_ID.

columns.name: WO_OP_MATERIAL_SERIAL_ID
columns.comments: Represents the unique identifier of the operation material serial.

columns.name: SERIAL_NUMBER
columns.comments: Serial Number that is attached to the primary product in the case of serialized manufacturing.

columns.name: SERIAL_NUMBER_NEW
columns.comments: This column is currently not being used.

columns.name: WO_OP_MATERIAL_LOT_ID
columns.comments: Represents the unique identifier of the operation material lot.

columns.name: PARENT_LOT_NUMBER
columns.comments: Used to capture the parent lot number in manufacturing and is then passed on to Inventory.The value eventually resides in the PARENT_LOT_NUMBER column in INV_LOT_NUMBERS table.

columns.name: LOT_NUMBER
columns.comments: Lot Number reference. Foreign key to INV_LOT_NUMBERS table.

columns.name: LOT_ASSOCIATED_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Represents the quantity associated to the particular lot number.

columns.name: LOT_EXPIRATION_DATE
columns.comments: The date on which the inventory in the lot expires.

columns.name: ASSET_ID
columns.comments: Represents the unique identifier of the asset on a maintenance work order.

columns.name: ASSET_NUMBER
columns.comments: Represents the user-key that uniquely identifies the asset on a maintenance work order.

columns.name: WARRANTY_REPAIR_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag to indicate that the work performed in this work order is covered by a supplier warranty.

columns.name: MATCH_TO_TXN_CODE_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag to indicate that the transactions performed in this work order must be coded with predefined transaction codes.

columns.name: REASON_FOR_REPAIR_CODE_ID
columns.comments: Represents the unique identifier of the specific reason for repair for which the work order is created. Foreign key to cse_condition_event_codes_b table.

columns.name: REASON_FOR_REPAIR_CODE
columns.comments: Represents the user-key identifier of the specific reason for repair for which the work order is created. Foreign key to cse_condition_event_codes_b table.

columns.name: REPAIR_TXN_CODE_ID
columns.comments: Represents the unique identifier of the reason to which this repair transaction is applicable. Foreign key to cse_condition_event_codes_b table.

columns.name: REPAIR_TXN_CODE
columns.comments: Represents the unique code that identifies of the reason to which this repair transaction is applicable. Foreign key to cse_condition_event_codes_b table.

columns.name: WORK_ACCOMPLISHED_CODE_ID
columns.comments: Represents the unique identifier of the accomplishment code recorded at resource transaction. Foreign key to cse_condition_event_codes_b table.

columns.name: WORK_ACCOMPLISHED_CODE
columns.comments: Represents the unique code that identifies the accomplishment code recorded at resource transaction. Foreign key to cse_condition_event_codes_b table.

columns.name: ROUTE_ASSET_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating whether the asset included in this table is a normal work order asset or an asset designated as part of the asset route.

columns.name: ROUTE_COMPLETE_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating whether the asset included as part of the asset route is completed during the execution of the work order.

columns.name: ROUTE_SKIPPED_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating whether the asset included as part of the asset route is skipped during the execution of the work order.

columns.name: WO_OP_RESOURCE_INSTANCE_ID
columns.comments: Represents the unique identifier of the work order operation resource instance.

columns.name: LABOR_INSTANCE_CODE

columns.name: LABOR_INSTANCE_ID
columns.comments: Represents the foreign key to the labor resource instance record.

columns.name: PERSON_NUMBER
columns.comments: The unique user identifier of the worker that is assigned at the work order operation resource requirement.

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.comments: The person identifier of the worker that is assigned at the work order operation resource requirement.

columns.name: EQUIPMENT_INSTANCE_CODE
columns.comments: A code used to identify the equipment resource instance. This code uniquely identifies the equipment resource instance within a manufacturing plant.

columns.name: EQUIPMENT_INSTANCE_ID
columns.comments: Represents the foreign key to the equipment resource instance record.

columns.name: RESOURCE_TYPE
columns.comments: Indicates the type of this resource. Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = ORA_WIS_RESOURCE_TYPE.

columns.name: WO_OPERATION_OUTPUT_ID
columns.comments: Represents the unique identifier of a work order operation output.

columns.name: OUTPUT_SEQ_NUMBER

columns.name: OUTPUT_TYPE

columns.name: COMPLETION_TYPE
columns.comments: Indicates the completion type code. Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = ORA_WIS_OUTPUT_COMPL_TYPE.

columns.name: OP_YIELD_FACTOR
columns.comments: Indicates the yield factor which represents the percentage of the starting quantity that is actually yielded at the completion of the operation. The default value is 1 (100%).

columns.name: ENFORCE_INT_REQUIREMENTS
columns.comments: Enforce integer requirement for component's calculated quantity or inverse quantity. Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = EGP_SUB_COMP_ENFORCE_INT_REQ. Valid values include: 0 - None - Do not convert to an integer. 1 - Round down - Round it down to the nearest lower integer. 2 - Round up - Round it up to the nearest higher integer.

columns.name: EXTENDED_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Quantity of the material calculated based on the enforce integer policy specified in the ENFORCE_INT_REQUIREMENTS column.

columns.name: CONTRIBUTE_TO_YIELD_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag used to indicate if this component should contribute to yield calculation in the manufacturing process.

columns.name: PRODUCT_YIELD
columns.comments: Product yield equals quantity times yield factor for products in the product formula.

columns.name: EXECUTION_RUN_NUMBER
columns.comments: A number that uniquely identifies an execution run within a work order. When a work order is split into execution runs, each run is assigned this unique number, which is used to track the materials, resources, and products transacted for that specific run.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.comments: A value that indicates the current status of an execution run. The values for this attribute come from lookup ORA_WIE_EXEC_RUN_STATUSES.

columns.name: PLANNED_RUN_QUANTITY
columns.comments: The quantity of primary product that is planned to be produced in this execution run.

columns.name: WO_EXECUTION_RUN_ID

columns.name: FIND_NUMBER

columns.name: PARTITION_NUMBER

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.comments: This column is used when loading data from the csv file to the interface table using the central ESS program. This is the request id for the job that did the move from UCM to the interface table.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.comments: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.comments: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.comments: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: GRADE_CODE
columns.comments: This indicates the grade of the lot when the item is enabled for grade control. Represents the foreign key to the INV_GRADES_B table.

columns.name: DISPENSE_RULE_ID
columns.comments: Indicates the unique identifier of a dispensing rule. Its value is a foreign key reference to dispense rule for the item in the WIS_DISPENSE_RULES table.

objects.name: WIE_WORK_ORDER_DETAILS_INT_GT
objects.description: This is a global temporary table that is to capture shadow records from the work order detail interface table.

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.comments: The unique identifier of a work order details interface record. Its value is an application generated unique id.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: INTERFACE_BATCH_ID
columns.comments: Represents the internal interface batch identifier. This is used to group a batch of interface records for processing. When interface records are brought in via services or the UI, the system will internally generate this value.

columns.name: INTERFACE_BATCH_CODE
columns.comments: Represents the user identified code for the interface batch.

columns.name: INTERFACE_STATUS_CODE
columns.comments: Represents the progress of the interface processing with statuses such as ready for processing or currently in process as well as the various flavors of completion statuses. Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = ORA_WIE_INTERFACE_STATUS.

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.comments: A code used to indicate what action the system should perform on the detail entity. Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = ORA_WIE_WO_IMP_DETAIL_ACTION.

columns.name: LOAD_TYPE
columns.comments: A code used to indicate the type of data this detail record contains. This indicates if the data being loaded represents the work order operation, work order operation material, work order operation resource, work order serials, etc. Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = ORA_WIE_WO_IMP_LOAD_TYPE.

columns.name: HEADER_NUMBER
columns.comments: The attributes WORK_ORDER_NUMBER + ORGANIZATION_CODE uniquely identify a work order. However, when the work order number is auto generated at the time of creation, the user will not have the work order number to pass via the open interface. This attribute allows the user to connect the header records with the details in the WIE_WORK_ORDER_DETAILS_INT table. The value of this column is user managed. This is not carried forward to the production tables.

columns.name: WORK_ORDER_NUMBER
columns.comments: Represents the user-facing identifier of the work order.

columns.name: WORK_ORDER_ID
columns.comments: Represents the internal identifier of the work order.

columns.name: ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.comments: The organization identifier that represents the manufacturing plant to which this work order belongs.

columns.name: WO_OPERATION_SEQ_NUMBER
columns.comments: Represents the user key in defining the order of operations within the work order.

columns.name: STANDARD_OPERATION_CODE
columns.comments: Reference to the standard operation code. If populated will be used to pull the standard definition for constructing the work order operation and its children.

columns.name: STANDARD_OPERATION_ID
columns.comments: Reference to the standard operation identifier. If populated will be used to pull the standard definition for constructing the operation and its children.

columns.name: OPERATION_NAME
columns.comments: Name of the operation. It is a short description of the operation.

columns.name: OPERATION_DESCRIPTION
columns.comments: Description of the operation. It is a long description of the operation.

columns.name: OPERATION_LONG_DESCRIPTION
columns.comments: Long description of the operation. It is a long description of the operation.

columns.name: OPERATION_TYPE
columns.comments: Specifies the type of the operation. Valid values are contained within the ORA_WIS_OPERATION_TYPE lookup.

columns.name: WO_OPERATION_ID
columns.comments: The internal work order operation identifier.

columns.name: WORK_CENTER_CODE
columns.comments: The user key to the work center entity.

columns.name: WORK_CENTER_ID
columns.comments: The internal identifier to the work center entity.

columns.name: COUNT_POINT_OPERATION_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag used to indicate if this is a count point operation. If an operation is a count point operation, then you have to manually complete it. Any operations in between the count points are automatically completed (i.e. backflushed, etc.).

columns.name: AUTO_TRANSACT_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates whether both resources and materials are automatically charged based on the Supply Type or the Charge Type setups upon completion of the operation.

columns.name: OPER_PLANNED_START_DATE
columns.comments: Planned start date of this operation.

columns.name: OPER_PLANNED_COMPL_DATE
columns.comments: Planned completion date of this operation.

columns.name: READY_QUANTITY
columns.comments: The quantity that is sitting in the inbound queue of each of the operation. This is an internal field and is not exposed in the XLSM template for import.

columns.name: SHIPPING_DOCUMENTS_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag used to determine whether shipping documents need to be generated for a supplier operation. Valid Values: 'Y' and 'N'.

columns.name: OSP_ITEM_ID
columns.comments: Item that represents the value added service in a supplier operation. This is also commonly known as a partially finished assembly.

columns.name: OSP_ITEM_NUMBER
columns.comments: Item that represents the value added service in a supplier operation. This is also commonly known as a partially finished assembly. This is the user key for the supplier operation item.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_ID
columns.comments: Represents the identifier of the suggested supplier for a supplier operation.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_NAME
columns.comments: Represents the name of the suggested supplier for a supplier operation. This is the user key for the supplier.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_SITE_ID
columns.comments: Represents the identifier of the suggested supplier site for a supplier operation.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_SITE_CODE
columns.comments: Represents the code of the suggested supplier site for a supplier operation. This is the user key for the supplier site.

columns.name: LEAD_TIME_UOM
columns.comments: Represents the unit of measure code for the fixed and/or variable lead time values on the supplier operation.

columns.name: LEAD_TIME_UNIT_OF_MEASURE
columns.comments: Represents the unit of measure for the fixed and/or variable lead time values on the supplier operation.

columns.name: FIXED_LEAD_TIME
columns.comments: Represents the fixed lead time used to calculate the operation's start and end date for the supplier operation.

columns.name: VARIABLE_LEAD_TIME
columns.comments: Represents the variable lead time used to calculate the operation's start and end date based on the operation quantity for the supplier operation.

columns.name: ADDL_MTL_AT_MANUAL_ISSUE
columns.comments: Indicates whether or not this operation allows additional materials to be added at manual issue. Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = ORA_WIS_ADDL_MANUAL_ISSUE_OPTS.

columns.name: OP_COMPL_WITH_UNDER_ISSUE
columns.comments: Indicates whether or not to allow operation completions with under issued material. Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = ORA_WIS_OP_COMPLETION_VAL_OPTS.

columns.name: OP_COMPL_WITH_OPEN_EXCEPTIONS
columns.comments: Indicates whether or not to allow operation completions with open exceptions. Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = ORA_WIS_OP_COMPLETION_VAL_OPTS.

columns.name: MATERIAL_SEQ_NUMBER
columns.comments: A sequence number that represents the order of consumption of material at a given operation.

columns.name: WO_OPERATION_MATERIAL_ID
columns.comments: The internal work order operation material identifier. System generated primary key.

columns.name: MATERIAL_TYPE
columns.comments: Type of material consumed by the operation. Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = ORA_WIS_WD_INPUT_MATERIAL.

columns.name: MATERIAL_ITEM_NUMBER
columns.comments: User key to the item to be specified as material in the work order operation material entity.

columns.name: MATERIAL_ITEM_ID

columns.name: MATERIAL_ITEM_REVISION
columns.comments: Revision of the item when the item is revision controlled.

columns.name: MATERIAL_QTY_PER_PRODUCT
columns.comments: The quantity per assembly of the component material.

columns.name: MATERIAL_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Quantity of the material either consumed in the operation or produced from the operation.

columns.name: MATERIAL_INVERSE_QUANTITY
columns.comments: The inverse of material quantity.

columns.name: MATERIAL_UOM_CODE
columns.comments: Represents the unit of measure code of the specified material quantity.

columns.name: MATERIAL_UNIT_OF_MEASURE
columns.comments: Represents the unit of measure of the specified material quantity.

columns.name: MATERIAL_BASIS_TYPE
columns.comments: Indicates whether the material quantity is fixed (i.e. quantity per lot produced) or variable (i.e. quantity per item produced). Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = EGP_BOM_BASIS_TYPE.

columns.name: MATERIAL_REQUIRED_DATE
columns.comments: Date when the material is required in the operation.

columns.name: MATERIAL_YIELD_FACTOR
columns.comments: Represents the yield factor of the component.

columns.name: MATERIAL_INCL_IN_PLANNING
columns.comments: Flag used to identify if the item should be included in planning. Valid Values: 'Y' and 'N'.

columns.name: PREFERRED_GRADE_CODE
columns.comments: Preferred grade code for grade-controlled items used to record product completions or select item issues for a recipe, work definition or work order.

columns.name: SUBSTITUTE_MATERIAL_ITEM_ID
columns.comments: Internal identifier to the substitute item.

columns.name: SUBSTITUTE_QTY_PER_PRODUCT
columns.comments: Quantity per assembly of the substitute item.

columns.name: SUPPLY_TYPE
columns.comments: The various supply types are "Assembly Pull", "Operation Pull", "Push", and "Phantom". Assembly Pull - Material will be backflushed at the completion of the assembly. Operation Pull - Material will be backflushed at the completion of the operation. Push - Material will have to manually issued. Phantom - For materials having lower level components, the components will be considered as inputs to this work order. Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup_type = EGP_WIP_SUP_TYPE + lookup_type = ORA_WIE_WO_SUPPLY_TYPE.

columns.name: SUPPLY_SUBINVENTORY
columns.comments: The subinventory that supplies material to the operation.

columns.name: SUPPLY_LOCATOR_ID

columns.name: RESOURCE_SEQ_NUMBER
columns.comments: This value is used to define the sequence in which resources work together in finishing the operation. For parallel work the same sequence number is used.

columns.name: WO_OPERATION_RESOURCE_ID
columns.comments: This is the internal work order operation resource identifier. System generated primary key.

columns.name: RESOURCE_CODE
columns.comments: Represents the user key to the resource.

columns.name: RESOURCE_ID
columns.comments: Represents the internal identifier to the resource which is a foreign key to the WIS_RESOURCES_B table.

columns.name: RESOURCE_PRINCIPAL_FLAG
columns.comments: When two or more resources are running in parallel (i.e. simultaneous resources which have the same sequence number), one and only one of them must be marked as the principal/primary resource. Planning will identify bottlenecks if the principal resource is not available when checking for capacity.

columns.name: RESOURCE_USAGE_RATE
columns.comments: Represents the resource usage rate per unit of the primary product produced.

columns.name: RESOURCE_REQUIRED_USAGE
columns.comments: Represents the total required usage for the resource based on the basis type, usage rate, and work order quantity. It is the usage per assembly unit (variable basis) or the usage per work order (fixed basis). For example, assuming usage rate = 1 hour and work order quantity = 10: If Basis = Variable, then required usage = 1 * 10 = 10 hours If Basis = Fixed, then required usage = 1 hour

columns.name: RESOURCE_INVERSE_REQD_USAGE
columns.comments: The inverse of the required usage.

columns.name: RESOURCE_BASIS_TYPE
columns.comments: Indicates whether the resource quantity is fixed (i.e. usage per lot produced) or variable (i.e. usage per item produced). Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = EGP_BOM_BASIS_TYPE.

columns.name: CHARGE_TYPE
columns.comments: Indicates whether resource transactions are automatically generated and at what stage. Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = ORA_WIS_CHARGE_TYPE.

columns.name: RESOURCE_ASSIGNED_UNITS
columns.comments: Number of resource units assigned to perform the operation.

columns.name: RESOURCE_PLANNED_START_DATE
columns.comments: Date when the resource is planned to start within the operation to which it is assigned.

columns.name: RESOURCE_PLANNED_COMPL_DATE
columns.comments: Date when the resource is planned to complete within the operation to which it is assigned.

columns.name: RESOURCE_ACTIVITY_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates the activity this production resource is going to perform at this operation. Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = ORA_WIS_RESOURCE_ACTIVITY.

columns.name: RESOURCE_SCHEDULED_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag used to indicate if this resource is scheduled or not. Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = ORA_WIS_RESOURCE_SCHEDULE.

columns.name: WO_OP_MATERIAL_SERIAL_ID

columns.name: SERIAL_NUMBER
columns.comments: Serial Number that is attached to the primary product in the case of serialized manufacturing.

columns.name: SERIAL_NUMBER_NEW

columns.name: WO_OP_MATERIAL_LOT_ID
columns.comments: Represents the unique identifier of the operation material lot.

columns.name: PARENT_LOT_NUMBER
columns.comments: Used to capture the parent lot number in manufacturing and is then passed on to Inventory.The value eventually resides in the PARENT_LOT_NUMBER column in INV_LOT_NUMBERS table.

columns.name: LOT_NUMBER
columns.comments: Lot Number reference. Foreign key to INV_LOT_NUMBERS table.

columns.name: LOT_ASSOCIATED_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Represents the quantity associated to the particular lot number.

columns.name: LOT_EXPIRATION_DATE
columns.comments: The date on which the inventory in the lot expires.

columns.name: ASSET_ID
columns.comments: Represents the unique identifier of the asset on a maintenance work order.

columns.name: ASSET_NUMBER
columns.comments: Represents the user-key that uniquely identifies the asset on a maintenance work order.

columns.name: WARRANTY_REPAIR_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag to indicate that the work performed in this work order is covered by a supplier warranty.

columns.name: MATCH_TO_TXN_CODE_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag to indicate that the transactions performed in this work order must be coded with predefined transaction codes.

columns.name: REASON_FOR_REPAIR_CODE_ID
columns.comments: Represents the unique identifier of the specific reason for repair for which the work order is created. Foreign key to cse_condition_event_codes_b table.

columns.name: REASON_FOR_REPAIR_CODE
columns.comments: Represents the user-key identifier of the specific reason for repair for which the work order is created. Foreign key to cse_condition_event_codes_b table.

columns.name: REPAIR_TXN_CODE_ID
columns.comments: Represents the unique identifier of the reason to which this repair transaction is applicable. Foreign key to cse_condition_event_codes_b table.

columns.name: REPAIR_TXN_CODE

columns.name: WORK_ACCOMPLISHED_CODE_ID

columns.name: WORK_ACCOMPLISHED_CODE
columns.comments: Represents the unique code that identifies the accomplishment code recorded at resource transaction. Foreign key to cse_condition_event_codes_b table.

columns.name: ROUTE_ASSET_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating whether the asset included in this table is a normal work order asset or an asset designated as part of the asset route.

columns.name: ROUTE_COMPLETE_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating whether the asset included as part of the asset route is completed during the execution of the work order.

columns.name: ROUTE_SKIPPED_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating whether the asset included as part of the asset route is skipped during the execution of the work order.

columns.name: WO_OP_RESOURCE_INSTANCE_ID
columns.comments: Represents the unique identifier of the work order operation resource instance.

columns.name: LABOR_INSTANCE_CODE

columns.name: LABOR_INSTANCE_ID
columns.comments: Represents the foreign key to the labor resource instance record.

columns.name: PERSON_NUMBER
columns.comments: The unique user identifier of the worker that is assigned at the work order operation resource requirement.

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.comments: The person identifier of the worker that is assigned at the work order operation resource requirement.

columns.name: EQUIPMENT_INSTANCE_CODE
columns.comments: A code used to identify the equipment resource instance. This code uniquely identifies the equipment resource instance within a manufacturing plant.

columns.name: EQUIPMENT_INSTANCE_ID
columns.comments: Represents the foreign key to the equipment resource instance record.

columns.name: RESOURCE_TYPE

columns.name: WO_OPERATION_OUTPUT_ID
columns.comments: Represents the unique identifier of a work order operation output.

columns.name: OUTPUT_SEQ_NUMBER

columns.name: OUTPUT_TYPE

columns.name: COMPLETION_TYPE

columns.name: PRIMARY_FLAG

columns.comments: Flag used to indicate if the operation can be re-sequenced while executing the operation. Valid values are Y or N.

columns.name: OP_YIELD_FACTOR
columns.comments: Indicates the yield factor which represents the percentage of the starting quantity that is actually yielded at the completion of the operation. The default value is 1 (100%).

columns.name: ENFORCE_INT_REQUIREMENTS
columns.comments: Enforce integer requirement for component's calculated quantity or inverse quantity. Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = EGP_SUB_COMP_ENFORCE_INT_REQ. Valid values include: 0 - None - Do not convert to an integer. 1 - Round down - Round it down to the nearest lower integer. 2 - Round up - Round it up to the nearest higher integer.

columns.name: EXTENDED_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Quantity of the material calculated based on the enforce integer policy specified in the ENFORCE_INT_REQUIREMENTS column.

columns.name: CONTRIBUTE_TO_YIELD_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag used to indicate if this component should contribute to yield calculation in the manufacturing process.

columns.name: PRODUCT_YIELD
columns.comments: Product yield equals quantity times yield factor for products in the product formula.

columns.name: EXECUTION_RUN_NUMBER
columns.comments: A number that uniquely identifies an execution run within a work order. When a work order is split into execution runs, each run is assigned this unique number, which is used to track the materials, resources, and products transacted for that specific run.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.comments: A value that indicates the current status of an execution run. The values for this attribute come from lookup ORA_WIE_EXEC_RUN_STATUSES.

columns.name: PLANNED_RUN_QUANTITY
columns.comments: The quantity of primary product that is planned to be produced in this execution run.

columns.name: WO_EXECUTION_RUN_ID
columns.comments: The unique identifier of an execution run record. Foreign key to WIE_WO_EXECUTION_RUNS.

columns.name: FIND_NUMBER
columns.comments: A unique number used to identify each instance of the same component occurring multiple times at the same level in an item structure.

columns.name: PARTITION_NUMBER

objects.name: WIE_WO_EXECUTION_RUNS
objects.description: This table stores execution runs created for manufacturing work orders that are split for execution due to capacity constraints. The split can be performed based on either the number of runs, multiples of product quantity or manually. This reference is then carried across all related transactions to ensure traceability.

columns.name: WO_EXECUTION_RUN_ID
columns.comments: The unique identifier of execution run record. Its value is an application generated unique id.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: EXECUTION_RUN_NUMBER
columns.comments: A number that uniquely identifies an execution run within a work order. When a work order is split into execution runs, each run is assigned this unique number, which is used to track the materials, resources, and products transacted for that specific run.

columns.name: WORK_ORDER_ID
columns.comments: Represents the internal identifier of the work order. Foreign key to WIE_WORK_ORDERS_B.

columns.name: LAST_COMPL_OP_SEQUENCE
columns.comments: This is the operation sequence of the last operation in chronological order where a completion transaction is reported.

columns.name: LAST_COMPL_WO_OPERATION_ID
columns.comments: This is the internal identifier of the last operation in chronological order where a completion transaction is reported. Foreign key to WIE_WO_OPERATIONS_B.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.comments: A value that indicates the current status of an execution run. The values for this attribute come from lookup ORA_WIE_EXEC_RUN_STATUSES.

columns.name: PLANNED_RUN_QUANTITY
columns.comments: The quantity of primary product that is planned to be produced in this execution run.

columns.name: PLANNED_BATCH_QUANTITY
columns.comments: The batch quantity that is planned to be executed as part of this execution run.

columns.name: UNDER_COMPLETED_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag to indicate that the execution run is marked as under-completed.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.comments: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.comments: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.comments: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

objects.description: This table is used to track execution-related quantities for each operation within an execution run. This table maintains these quantities individually for each execution run and operation to ensure accurate tracking.

columns.comments: The quantity that is completed in this operation as part of this execution run.

columns.name: SCRAPPED_QUANTITY
columns.comments: The quantity that is scrapped in this operation as part of this execution run.

columns.name: REJECTED_QUANTITY
columns.comments: The quantity that is rejected in this operation as part of this execution run.

columns.name: VARIANCE_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Batch variance quantity reported at the current operation as part of this execution run.

objects.name: WIE_WO_OPERATIONS_B
objects.description: This table stores information about the various execution steps required for a given work order. These steps include the processes that are necessary to produce a given product.

columns.name: WO_OPERATION_ID
columns.comments: The unique identifier of work order operation record. Its value is an application generated unique id.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.comments: The organization identifier that represents the manufacturing plant to which this operation belongs.

columns.name: WORK_ORDER_ID
columns.comments: Represents the internal identifier of the work order.

columns.name: OPERATION_TYPE
columns.comments: Specifies the type of the operation. Valid values are contained within the ORA_WIS_OPERATION_TYPE lookup.

columns.name: OPERATION_SEQ_NUMBER
columns.comments: This is the user key in defining the order of the operations within the work order.

columns.name: STANDARD_OPERATION_ID
columns.comments: Reference to the standard operation. If an operation in the work order is created by referencing the standard operation, this column value will be populated.

columns.name: WORK_CENTER_ID
columns.comments: Represents the internal work center identifier for which this operation belongs.

columns.name: COUNT_POINT_OPERATION_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag used to indicate if this is a count point operation. If an operation is a count point operation, then you have to manually complete it. Any operations in between the count points are automatically completed (i.e. backflushed, etc.).

columns.name: AUTO_TRANSACT_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates whether both resources and materials are automatically charged based on the Supply Type or the Charge Type setups upon completion of the operation.

columns.name: READY_QUANTITY
columns.comments: The quantity that is sitting in the inbound queue of the operation.

columns.name: COMPLETED_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Primary product quantity completed so far in the work order. This is a summary column.

columns.name: SCRAPPED_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Primary product quantity that is scrapped in the work order. This is a summary column.

columns.name: REJECTED_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Primary product quantity that is rejected in the work order. This is a summary column.

columns.name: PLANNED_START_DATE
columns.comments: Planned start date of this operation.

columns.name: PLANNED_COMPLETION_DATE
columns.comments: Planned completion date of this operation.

columns.name: ACTUAL_START_DATE
columns.comments: Actual start date of the operation. Currently, this column is not used.

columns.name: ACTUAL_COMPLETION_DATE
columns.comments: Actual completion date of the operation. Currently, this column is not used.

columns.name: SERIAL_TRACKING_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag used to indicate that this is the first operation where the end item begins to be tracked by serial numbers. Valid values: 'Y' and 'N'.

columns.name: PREVIOUS_CP_OP_SEQ_NUM
columns.comments: The previous count point operation sequence number. This is de-normalized to derive defaults upon execution of the operation. This is an internal column.

columns.name: NEXT_CP_OP_SEQ_NUM
columns.comments: The next count point operation sequence number. This is de-normalized to derive defaults upon execution of the operation. This is an internal column.

columns.name: WD_OPERATION_ID
columns.comments: Represents the work order operation identifier from the work definition.

columns.name: SHIPPING_DOCUMENTS_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag used to determine whether shipping documents need to be generated for a supplier operation. Valid Values: 'Y' and 'N'.

columns.name: OSP_ITEM_ID
columns.comments: Item that represents the value added service in a supplier operation. This is also commonly known as a partially finished assembly.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_ID
columns.comments: Represents the identifier of the suggested supplier for a supplier operation.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_SITE_ID
columns.comments: Represents the identifier of the suggested supplier site for a supplier operation.

columns.name: LEAD_TIME_UOM
columns.comments: Represents the unit of measure for the fixed and/or variable lead time values on the supplier operation.

columns.name: FIXED_LEAD_TIME
columns.comments: Represents the fixed lead time used to calculate the operation's start and end date for the supplier operation.

columns.name: VARIABLE_LEAD_TIME
columns.comments: Represents the variable lead time used to calculate the operation's start and end date based on the operation quantity for the supplier operation.

columns.name: IN_PROCESS_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Quantity in supplier operation that has been completed in the previous count point operation but hasn't been received yet in this operation.

columns.name: PO_REQUESTED_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Quantity for which a supply request has been raised with SCO for this supplier operation.

columns.name: PO_APPROVED_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Quantity for which an approved PO exists for this supplier operation.

columns.name: SHIPPED_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Quantity which has been shipped to the supplier.

columns.name: RECEIVED_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Quantity of the partially finished assembly (PFA) that has been delivered to the shopfloor from the supplier.

columns.name: OVER_RECEIPT_QUANTITY
columns.comments: The quantity received in excess of the expected quantity for a supplier operation.

columns.name: CUMULATIVE_SCRAP_QUANTITY
columns.comments: The total cumulative scrapped quantity up to the current operation, excluding the current operation.

columns.name: ADDL_MTL_AT_MANUAL_ISSUE
columns.comments: Indicates whether or not this operation allows additional materials to be added at manual issue. Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = ORA_WIS_ADDL_MANUAL_ISSUE_OPTS.

columns.name: OP_COMPL_WITH_UNDER_ISSUE
columns.comments: Indicates whether or not to allow operation completions with under issued material. Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = ORA_WIS_OP_COMPLETION_VAL_OPTS.

columns.name: OP_COMPL_WITH_OPEN_EXCEPTIONS
columns.comments: Indicates whether or not to allow operation completions with open exceptions. Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = ORA_WIS_OP_COMPLETION_VAL_OPTS.

columns.name: RESEQUENCE_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag used to indicate if the operation can be re-sequenced while executing the operation. Valid values are Y or N.

columns.name: EXECUTION_SEQUENCE
columns.comments: Indicates the execution sequence of the operation if the work order has re-sequence operations.

columns.name: TOLLGATE_OP_SEQ_NUM
columns.comments: Used to identify the set of re-sequence operations between two operations. This field is used to help dispatch list pull records efficiently.

columns.name: REASON_FOR_REPAIR_CODE_ID
columns.comments: Represents the reason for which this repair operation is to be performed. Foreign key to cse_condition_event_codes_b table.

columns.name: REPAIR_TXN_CODE_ID
columns.comments: Represents the code to which this repair transaction is applicable. Foreign key to cse_condition_event_codes_b table.

columns.name: WORK_ACCOMPLISHED_CODE_ID
columns.comments: Represents the accomplishment code to record when the operation is completed. Foreign key to cse_condition_event_codes_b table.

columns.name: OP_YIELD_FACTOR
columns.comments: Indicates the yield factor which represents the percentage of the starting quantity that is actually yielded at the completion of the operation. The default value is 1 (100%).

columns.name: MNT_COMPLETE_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating whether the operation is soft completed by the maintenance technician.

columns.name: VARIANCE_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Batch variance quantity reported at the current operation.

columns.name: CUMULATIVE_VARIANCE_QUANTITY
columns.comments: The total cumulative variance quantity up to the current operation, excluding the current operation.

columns.name: OP_COMPL_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates whether the current operation has been marked complete. Valid values are: N (default) - operation is not marked complete Y - operation is marked complete and no more forward transactions are allowed

columns.name: TO_MOVE_QUANTITY
columns.comments: The quantity completed at an operation and moved to a staging location and not available for the next operation to execute.

columns.name: PENDING_INSPECTION_QUANTITY
columns.comments: The quantity completed at an operation and pending inspection and not available for the next operation to execute.

columns.name: REWORK_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag used to indicate if this operation is a rework operation. Valid values: 'Y' and 'N'.

columns.name: REWORK_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Primary product quantity that is reworked at this operation.

columns.name: LINE_OP_SEQ_NUMBER
columns.comments: Represents the line operation sequence for the production line that is associated with the work order.

columns.name: WORKSTATION_ID
columns.comments: Indicates the workstation where this operation is executed. It is a foreign key to the WIS_WORKSTATIONS_B table.

columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.comments: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

objects.name: WIE_WO_OPERATIONS_B_GT
objects.description: This is a global temporary table that is to capture shadow records of work order operation

columns.name: TEMPORARY_ROW_ID
columns.comments: Unique id of work order operation shadow record

columns.name: WO_OPERATION_ID
columns.comments: This is the internal Work Order Operation identifier

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.comments: The manufacturing plant identifier.

columns.name: WORK_ORDER_ID
columns.comments: Foreign Key reference to the work order header table.

columns.name: OPERATION_TYPE
columns.comments: Specifies the type of the operation. Valid values are contained within the ORA_WIS_OPERATION_TYPE lookup.

columns.name: OPERATION_SEQ_NUMBER
columns.comments: Operation Sequence Number. This is the user key in defining the order of the operations within the work order.

columns.name: STANDARD_OPERATION_ID
columns.comments: Reference to the Standard Operation. If an operation in the work order is created by referencing the standard operation, this column value will be populated.

columns.name: WORK_CENTER_ID
columns.comments: Execution Work Center Identifier.

columns.name: COUNT_POINT_OPERATION_FLAG
columns.comments: Count Point operations are operations that are needing user intervention. The quantity of the assembly must move in and out of the operation that is defined as a count point operation

columns.name: AUTO_TRANSACT_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates whether both resources and material are automatically charged based on the Supply Type or the Charge Type setups for the operation. If the supply type is Operation Pull, the component level issue transactions will happen when the operation is completed. If the supply type is Assembly Pull, the component level issue transactions will happen at the Assembly Completion event. Resource Transaction are automatically done when the Quantity is moved outside the Operation. Valid values are 'Y' and 'N'.

columns.name: READY_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Ready Quantity. The qantity that is sitting in the inbound queue of each of the operation.

columns.name: COMPLETED_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Primary Product Quantity completed so far in the work order. This is a summary column.

columns.name: SCRAPPED_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Primary Product Quantity that is scrapped in the work order. This is a summary column.

columns.name: REJECTED_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Primary Product Quantity that is rejected in the work order. This is a summary column.

columns.name: PLANNED_START_DATE
columns.comments: Planned start date of this operation.

columns.name: PLANNED_COMPLETION_DATE
columns.comments: Planned completion date of this operation.

columns.name: ACTUAL_START_DATE
columns.comments: Actual start date of the operation. Currently, this column is not used.

columns.name: ACTUAL_COMPLETION_DATE
columns.comments: Actual completion date of the operation. Currently, this column is not used.

columns.name: SERIAL_TRACKING_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates that this is the first operation where the end item begins to be tracked by serial numbers. Valid Values: 'Y' and 'N'.

columns.name: PREVIOUS_CP_OP_SEQ_NUM
columns.comments: The previous count point operation sequence number. This is de-normalized to derive defaults upon execution of the operation. Internal Column

columns.name: NEXT_CP_OP_SEQ_NUM
columns.comments: The next count point operation sequence number. This is de-normalized to derive defaults upon execution of the operation. Internal Column

columns.name: WD_OPERATION_ID
columns.comments: Work Definition Operation reference.

columns.name: SHIPPING_DOCUMENTS_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag used to determine whether shipping documents need to be generated for a supplier operation. Valid Values: 'Y' and 'N'.

columns.name: OSP_ITEM_ID
columns.comments: Item that represents the value added service in a supplier operation. This is also commonly known as a partially finished assembly.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_ID
columns.comments: Represents the identifier of the suggested supplier for a supplier operation.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_SITE_ID
columns.comments: Represents the identifier of the suggested supplier site for a supplier operation.

columns.name: LEAD_TIME_UOM
columns.comments: Represents the unit of measure for the fixed and/or variable lead time values on the supplier operation.

columns.name: FIXED_LEAD_TIME
columns.comments: Represents the fixed lead time used to calculate the operation’s start and end date for the supplier operation.

columns.name: VARIABLE_LEAD_TIME
columns.comments: Represents the variable lead time used to calculate the operation’s start and end date based on the operation quantity for the supplier operation.

columns.name: IN_PROCESS_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Quantity in supplier operation that has been completed in the previous count point operation but hasn't been received yet in this operation.

columns.name: PO_REQUESTED_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Quantity for which a supply request has been raised with SCO for this supplier operation.

columns.name: PO_APPROVED_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Quantity for which an approved PO exists for this supplier operation.

columns.name: SHIPPED_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Quantity which has been shipped to the supplier.

columns.name: RECEIVED_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Quantity of the partially finished assembly (PFA) that has been delivered to the shopfloor from the supplier.

columns.name: OVER_RECEIPT_QUANTITY
columns.comments: The quantity received in excess of the expected quantity for a supplier operation.

columns.name: CUMULATIVE_SCRAP_QUANTITY
columns.comments: The total cumulative scrapped quantity up to the current operation, excluding the current operation.

columns.name: ADDL_MTL_AT_MANUAL_ISSUE
columns.comments: Indicates whether or not this operation allows additional materials to be added at manual issue. Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = ORA_WIS_ADDL_MANUAL_ISSUE_OPTS.

columns.name: OP_COMPL_WITH_UNDER_ISSUE
columns.comments: Indicates whether or not to allow operation completions with under issued material. Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = ORA_WIS_OP_COMPLETION_VAL_OPTS.

columns.name: OP_COMPL_WITH_OPEN_EXCEPTIONS
columns.comments: Indicates whether or not to allow operation completions with open exceptions. Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = ORA_WIS_OP_COMPLETION_VAL_OPTS.

columns.name: RESEQUENCE_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag used to indicate if the operation can be re-sequenced while executing the operation. Valid values are Y or N.

columns.name: EXECUTION_SEQUENCE
columns.comments: Indicates the execution sequence of the operation if the work order has re-sequence operations.

columns.name: TOLLGATE_OP_SEQ_NUM
columns.comments: Used to identify the set of re-sequence operations between two operations. This field is used to help dispatch list pull records efficiently.

columns.name: REASON_FOR_REPAIR_CODE_ID
columns.comments: Represents the reason for which this repair operation is to be performed. Foreign key to cse_condition_event_codes_b table.

columns.name: REPAIR_TXN_CODE_ID
columns.comments: Represents the code to which this repair transaction is applicable. Foreign key to cse_condition_event_codes_b table.

columns.name: WORK_ACCOMPLISHED_CODE_ID
columns.comments: Represents the accomplishment code to record when the operation is completed. Foreign key to cse_condition_event_codes_b table.

columns.name: OP_YIELD_FACTOR
columns.comments: Indicates the yield factor which represents the percentage of the starting quantity that is actually yielded at the completion of the operation. The default value is 1 (100%).

columns.name: MNT_COMPLETE_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating whether the operation is soft completed by the maintenance technician.

columns.name: VARIANCE_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Batch variance quantity reported at the current operation.

columns.name: CUMULATIVE_VARIANCE_QUANTITY
columns.comments: The total cumulative variance quantity up to the current operation, excluding the current operation.

columns.name: OP_COMPL_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates whether the current operation has been marked complete. Valid values are: N (default) - operation is not marked complete Y - operation is marked complete and no more forward transactions are allowed

columns.name: TO_MOVE_QUANTITY
columns.comments: The quantity completed at an operation and moved to a staging location and not available for the next operation to execute.

columns.name: PENDING_INSPECTION_QUANTITY
columns.comments: The quantity completed at an operation and pending inspection and not available for the next operation to execute.

columns.name: REWORK_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag used to indicate if this operation is a rework operation. Valid values: 'Y' and 'N'.

columns.name: REWORK_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Primary product quantity that is reworked at this operation.

columns.name: LINE_OP_SEQ_NUMBER
columns.comments: Represents the line operation sequence for the production line that is associated with the work order.

columns.name: WORKSTATION_ID
columns.comments: Indicates the workstation where this operation is executed. It is a foreign key to the WIS_WORKSTATIONS_B table.

objects.name: WIE_WO_OPERATION_MATERIALS
objects.description: This table stores the material requirements for the work order at the operation level. The various types of materials required are recorded in this table.

columns.name: WO_OPERATION_MATERIAL_ID
columns.comments: The unique identifier of work order operation material record. Its value is an application generated unique id.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.comments: The organization identifier that represents the manufacturing plant to which this operation material belongs.

columns.name: WO_OPERATION_ID
columns.comments: Represents the foreign key reference to the WIE_WO_OPERATIONS_B table. For the primary product, this table is directly a child of WIE_WORK_ORDERS.

columns.name: WORK_ORDER_ID
columns.comments: Represents the internal identifier of the work order.

columns.name: MATERIAL_SEQ_NUMBER
columns.comments: Represents the order of consumption of material for a given operation.

columns.name: MATERIAL_TYPE
columns.comments: Type of material consumed by the operation. Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = ORA_WIS_WD_INPUT_MATERIAL.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
columns.comments: The primary item identifier defined in the work order.

columns.name: ITEM_REVISION
columns.comments: If the primary product is revision controlled, this will have a value.

columns.name: QUANTITY_PER_PRODUCT
columns.comments: Represents the quantity per assembly. This is the MATERIAL_QUANTITY from the work definition operation material.

columns.name: BASIS_TYPE
columns.comments: Indicates whether the material quantity is fixed (i.e. quantity per lot produced) or variable (i.e. quantity per item produced). Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = EGP_BOM_BASIS_TYPE.

columns.name: QUANTITY
columns.comments: Quantity of the material either consumed in the operation or produced from the operation. This is usually the work order quantity times the QUANTITY_PER_ASSEMBLY when the basis type is VARIABLE.

columns.name: INVERSE_QUANTITY
columns.comments: The inverse of material quantity.

columns.name: UOM_CODE
columns.comments: Represents the unit of measure code of the specified quantity.

columns.name: REQUIRED_DATE
columns.comments: Date when the material is required in the operation.

columns.name: YIELD_FACTOR
columns.comments: This is the percentage of material quantity actually incorporated into the finished good.

columns.name: INCLUDE_IN_PLANNING_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag used to indicate whether this material requirement should be seen by the planning process or not.

columns.name: SUBSTITUTE_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag used indicate whether this component is a substitute or not. Valid values: Y - Substitute N or null - Primary component

columns.name: SUBSTITUTE_PRIORITY_RANKING
columns.comments: Internal column to store the priority ranking of the substitute when swapped with primary.

columns.name: SUPPLY_TYPE
columns.comments: Reference of the supply type used for the work order operation material. Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = EGP_WIP_SUP_TYPE + lookup_type = ORA_WIE_WO_SUPPLY_TYPE.

columns.name: SUPPLY_SUBINVENTORY
columns.comments: The subinventory that supplies material to the operation.

columns.name: SUPPLY_LOCATOR_ID
columns.comments: The locator within the supply subinventory that feeds material into the work order operations.

columns.name: ISSUED_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Represents the quantity issued so far, since partial issues are possible. This is mostly kept for runtime calculations.

columns.name: PRODUCED_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Represents the quantity produced so far, since partial completions are possible. This is mostly kept for runtime calculations.

columns.name: PICKED_QUANTITY
columns.comments: The actual pick confirmed quantity which gets updated when inventory does pick confirm for move orders.

columns.name: ALLOCATED_QUANTITY
columns.comments: The total allocated quantity displayed as part of component pick processing. The value is incremented for the pick release quantity and adjusted for the quantity that is pick confirmed from inventory.

columns.name: REMAINING_ALLOCATED_QUANTITY
columns.comments: The total remaining allocated quantity maintained as part of component pick processing. The value represents the total allocated quantity (ALLOCATED_QUANTITY) minus the quantity issued to the work order post allocation.

columns.name: TIA_REF_LINE_ID
columns.comments: The transaction item attrbute reference identifier. This could be either the value of the CTO_MATCH_LINES.LINE_ID or FOM_ORDER_LINES.LINE_ID. The differentiator will be persisted in TIA_REF_ENTITY.

columns.name: TIA_REF_ENTITY
columns.comments: This column specifies whether the TIA_REF_LINE_ID is from CTO Match Lines or OM Order Lines.

columns.name: WD_OPERATION_MATERIAL_ID
columns.comments: Represents the work order operation material identifier from the work definition.

columns.name: REPAIR_TXN_CODE_ID
columns.comments: Represents the code to which this repair transaction is applicable. Foreign key to cse_condition_event_codes_b table.

columns.name: ENFORCE_INT_REQUIREMENTS
columns.comments: Enforce integer requirement for component's calculated quantity or inverse quantity. Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = EGP_SUB_COMP_ENFORCE_INT_REQ. Valid values include: 0 - None - Do not convert to an integer. 1 - Round down - Round it down to the nearest lower integer. 2 - Round up - Round it up to the nearest higher integer.

columns.name: EXTENDED_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Quantity of the material calculated based on the enforce integer policy specified in the ENFORCE_INT_REQUIREMENTS column.

columns.name: CONTRIBUTE_TO_YIELD_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag used to indicate if this component should contribute to yield calculation in the manufacturing process.

columns.name: BATCH_UOM_CONVERSION_RATE
columns.comments: Represents conversion factor by which the UOM is equivalent to the Batch UOM at the time of work order release.

columns.name: FIND_NUMBER
columns.comments: A unique number used to identify each instance of the same component occurring multiple times at the same level in an item structure.

columns.name: SCRAPPED_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Material quantity that is scrapped in the work order operation. This is a summary column.

columns.name: REWORK_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Material quantity that is used for rework in the work order operation. This is a summary column.

columns.name: REFERENCE_DESIGNATOR_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag used to indicate if a reference designator exists for the component. Valid values: Y, N, or NULL (treated as N).

columns.name: PREFERRED_GRADE_CODE
columns.comments: Preferred grade code for grade-controlled items used to record product completions or select item issues for a recipe, work definition or work order.

columns.comments: Quantity of the material either consumed in the operation or produced from the operation. This is usually the work order quantity times the QUANTITY_PER_ASSEMBLY when the basis type is VARIABLE.

columns.name: INVERSE_QUANTITY
columns.comments: The inverse of material quantity.

columns.name: UOM_CODE
columns.comments: Represents the unit of measure code of the specified quantity.

columns.name: REQUIRED_DATE
columns.comments: Date when the material is required in the operation.

columns.name: YIELD_FACTOR
columns.comments: This is the percentage of material quantity actually incorporated into the finished good.

columns.name: INCLUDE_IN_PLANNING_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag used to indicate whether this material requirement should be seen by the planning process or not.

columns.name: SUBSTITUTE_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag used indicate whether this component is a substitute or not. Valid values: Y - Substitute N or null - Primary component

columns.name: SUBSTITUTE_PRIORITY_RANKING
columns.comments: Internal column to store the priority ranking of the substitute when swapped with primary.

columns.name: SUPPLY_TYPE
columns.comments: Reference of the supply type used for the work order operation material. Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = EGP_WIP_SUP_TYPE + lookup_type = ORA_WIE_WO_SUPPLY_TYPE.

columns.name: SUPPLY_SUBINVENTORY
columns.comments: The subinventory that supplies material to the operation.

columns.name: SUPPLY_LOCATOR_ID
columns.comments: The locator within the supply subinventory that feeds material into the work order operations.

columns.name: ISSUED_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Represents the quantity issued so far, since partial issues are possible. This is mostly kept for runtime calculations.

columns.name: PRODUCED_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Represents the quantity produced so far, since partial completions are possible. This is mostly kept for runtime calculations.

columns.name: PICKED_QUANTITY
columns.comments: The actual pick confirmed quantity which gets updated when inventory does pick confirm for move orders.

columns.name: ALLOCATED_QUANTITY
columns.comments: The total allocated quantity displayed as part of component pick processing. The value is incremented for the pick release quantity and adjusted for the quantity that is pick confirmed from inventory.

columns.name: REMAINING_ALLOCATED_QUANTITY
columns.comments: The total remaining allocated quantity maintained as part of component pick processing. The value represents the total allocated quantity (ALLOCATED_QUANTITY) minus the quantity issued to the work order post allocation.

columns.name: TIA_REF_LINE_ID
columns.comments: The transaction item attrbute reference identifier. This could be either the value of the CTO_MATCH_LINES.LINE_ID or FOM_ORDER_LINES.LINE_ID. The differentiator will be persisted in TIA_REF_ENTITY.

columns.name: TIA_REF_ENTITY
columns.comments: This column specifies whether the TIA_REF_LINE_ID is from CTO Match Lines or OM Order Lines.

columns.name: WD_OPERATION_MATERIAL_ID
columns.comments: Represents the work order operation material identifier from the work definition.

columns.name: REPAIR_TXN_CODE_ID
columns.comments: Represents the code to which this repair transaction is applicable. Foreign key to cse_condition_event_codes_b table.

columns.name: ENFORCE_INT_REQUIREMENTS
columns.comments: Enforce integer requirement for component's calculated quantity or inverse quantity. Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = EGP_SUB_COMP_ENFORCE_INT_REQ. Valid values include: 0 - None - Do not convert to an integer. 1 - Round down - Round it down to the nearest lower integer. 2 - Round up - Round it up to the nearest higher integer.

columns.name: EXTENDED_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Quantity of the material calculated based on the enforce integer policy specified in the ENFORCE_INT_REQUIREMENTS column.

columns.name: CONTRIBUTE_TO_YIELD_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag used to indicate if this component should contribute to yield calculation in the manufacturing process.

columns.name: BATCH_UOM_CONVERSION_RATE
columns.comments: Represents conversion factor by which the UOM is equivalent to the Batch UOM at the time of work order release.

columns.name: FIND_NUMBER
columns.comments: A unique number used to identify each instance of the same component occurring multiple times at the same level in an item structure.

columns.name: SCRAPPED_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Material quantity that is scrapped in the work order operation. This is a summary column.

columns.name: REWORK_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Material quantity that is used for rework in the work order operation. This is a summary column.

columns.name: REFERENCE_DESIGNATOR_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag used to indicate if a reference designator exists for the component. Valid values: Y, N, or NULL (treated as N).

columns.name: PREFERRED_GRADE_CODE
columns.comments: Preferred grade code for grade-controlled items used to record product completions or select item issues for a recipe, work definition or work order.
