objects.name: WIE_WO_OPERATION_RESOURCES
objects.description: This table stores the labor and equipment resource requirements for the work order.

columns.name: WO_OPERATION_RESOURCE_ID
columns.comments: The unique identifier of work order operation resource record. Its value is an application generated unique id.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.comments: The organization identifier that represents the manufacturing plant to which this operation resource belongs.

columns.name: WO_OPERATION_ID
columns.comments: Represents the foreign key reference to the WIE_WO_OPERATIONS_B table.

columns.name: RESOURCE_SEQ_NUMBER
columns.comments: Resource sequence number value is used to define the sequence in which resources work together in finishing the operation. For parallel work the same sequence number is used.

columns.name: WORK_CENTER_ID
columns.comments: Represents the internal work center identifier for which this resource belongs.

columns.name: RESOURCE_ID
columns.comments: Represents the internal identifier to the resource which is a foreign key to the WIS_RESOURCES_B table.

columns.name: PRINCIPAL_FLAG
columns.comments: When two or more resources are running in parallel (i.e. simultaneous resources which have the same sequence number), one and only one of them must be marked as the principal/primary resource. Planning will identify bottlenecks if the principal resource is not available when checking for capacity.

columns.name: USAGE_RATE
columns.comments: The predefined resource rate that is required to perform operation/activity for one unit of the assembly. For example: Number of hours it take to spray paint one pedestal.

columns.name: BASIS_TYPE
columns.comments: Indicates whether the resource quantity is fixed (i.e. usage per lot produced) or variable (i.e. usage per item produced). Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = EGP_BOM_BASIS_TYPE.

columns.name: REQUIRED_USAGE
columns.comments: Represents the total required usage for the resource based on the basis type, usage rate, and work order quantity. It is the usage per assembly unit (variable basis) or the usage per work order (fixed basis). For example, assuming usage rate = 1 hour and work order quantity = 10: If Basis = Variable, then required usage = 1 * 10 = 10 hours If Basis = Fixed, then required usage = 1 hour

columns.name: INVERSE_REQUIRED_USAGE
columns.comments: The inverse of the required usage.

columns.name: UOM_CODE
columns.comments: Represents the unit of measure code of the specified resource usage.

columns.name: CHARGE_TYPE
columns.comments: Indicates whether resource transactions are automatically generated and at what stage. Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = ORA_WIS_CHARGE_TYPE.

columns.name: ASSIGNED_UNITS
columns.comments: Number of resource units assigned to perform the operation.

columns.name: PLANNED_START_DATE
columns.comments: Date when the resource is planned to start within the operation to which it is assigned.

columns.name: PLANNED_COMPLETION_DATE
columns.comments: Date when the resource is planned to complete within the operation to which it is assigned.

columns.name: RESOURCE_ACTIVITY_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates the activity this production resource is going to perform at this operation. Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = ORA_WIS_RESOURCE_ACTIVITY.

columns.name: SCHEDULED_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag used to indicate if this resource is scheduled or not. Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = ORA_WIS_RESOURCE_SCHEDULE.

columns.name: PHANTOM_FLAG
columns.comments: This flag denotes that the resource that is associated to this operation was pulled in as part of a phantom explosion that pulled in the resources from the work definition of a phantom material tied to the operation.

columns.name: ACTUAL_RESOURCE_USAGE
columns.comments: Represents the actual resource usage recorded for the assigned resource. This is a calculated column.

columns.name: WD_OPERATION_RESOURCE_ID
columns.comments: Represents the work order operation resource identifier from the work definition.

columns.name: PROFILE_ID
columns.comments: Foreign key reference to HCM model profiles.

columns.name: EQP_QUAL_PROFILE_ID
columns.comments: Foreign key reference to equipment qualification profiles.

columns.name: REASON_FOR_REPAIR_CODE_ID
columns.comments: Represents the reason for which this repair operation is to be performed. Foreign key to cse_condition_event_codes_b table.

columns.name: REPAIR_TXN_CODE_ID
columns.comments: Represents the code to which this repair transaction is applicable. Foreign key to cse_condition_event_codes_b table.

columns.name: WORK_ACCOMPLISHED_CODE_ID
columns.comments: Represents the accomplishment code to record when the operation is completed. Foreign key to cse_condition_event_codes_b table.

columns.name: MNT_COMPLETE_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating whether the operation resource requirements are fulfilled by the maintenance technician.

columns.name: REWORK_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Resource quantity that is used for rework in the work order operation. This is a summary column.

columns.comments: Indicates the dependency type between previous and next work operations in the operation dependency setup. Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = ORA_WIS_DEPENDENCY_TYPE.

objects.description: This table is used to store substitute materials associated to a work order operation material.

columns.name: WO_OP_SUB_MATERIAL_ID
columns.comments: The unique identifier of the work order operation substitute material record. Its value is an application generated unique id.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: WO_OPERATION_MATERIAL_ID
columns.comments: Represents the work order operation material for which the substitute material/component is defined. This is a foreign key to the WIE_WO_OPERATION_MATERIALS table.

columns.name: ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.comments: The manufacturing plant identifier for which the operation material substitute is defined.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
columns.comments: Represents the identifier of the substitute material/component. This is a foreign key to the EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B table.

columns.name: SUBSTITUTE_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag used indicate whether this component is a substitute or not. Valid values: Y - Substitute N - Primary component

columns.name: QUANTITY_PER_PRODUCT
columns.comments: Represents the item quantity per assembly for the substitute material/component.

columns.name: REQUIRED_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Represents the total item quantity for the substitute material/component.

columns.name: INVERSE_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Represents the inverse item quantity for the substitute material/component.

columns.name: UOM_CODE
columns.comments: Represents the unit of measure code of the specified quantity.

columns.name: PRIORITY_RANKING
columns.comments: Indicates the order of preference.

columns.name: ENFORCE_INT_REQUIREMENTS
columns.comments: Enforce integer requirement for component's calculated quantity or inverse quantity. Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = EGP_SUB_COMP_ENFORCE_INT_REQ. Valid values include: 0 - None - Do not convert to an integer. 1 - Round down - Round it down to the nearest lower integer. 2 - Round up - Round it up to the nearest higher integer.

columns.name: EXTENDED_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Quantity of the material calculated based on the enforce integer policy specified in the ENFORCE_INT_REQUIREMENTS column.

columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

objects.name: WIE_WO_OSP_ACTION_DETAILS
objects.description: This table stores the details related to outside processing and corresponding purchasing, shipping, and receiving details.

columns.name: WO_OSP_ACTION_DETAIL_ID
columns.comments: This is the internal outside processing action detail identifier.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: WO_OPERATION_ID
columns.comments: Foreign key reference to the work order operation against which this action is being recorded.

columns.name: ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.comments: Identifier of the organization on the associated work order operation.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.comments: Status of the supplier operation action.

columns.name: QUANTITY
columns.comments: Quantity for which the action is being triggered.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_TYPE
columns.comments: Type of document for which this action is being triggered.

columns.name: DOC_REF1
columns.comments: First level identifier of the document represented by the document type and status. If the document type is "PO", this field will be empty when the status is "REQUESTED", otherwise it contains the reference to po_headers_all.po_header_id when the status is "APPROVED". If the document type is "SHIPMENT", this field will contain a reference to po_headers_all.po_header_id when the status is "REQUESTED", otherwise it contains the reference to wsh_new_deliveries.delivery_id when the status is "CONFIRMED". If the document type is "RECEIPT", this field will contain a reference to rcv_transactions.transaction_id when the status is either "DELIVERED" or "RETURNED".

columns.name: DOC_REF2
columns.comments: Second level identifier of the document represented by the document type and status. If the document type is "PO", this field will be empty when the status is "REQUESTED", otherwise it contains the reference to po_lines_all.po_line_id when the status is "APPROVED". If the document type is "SHIPMENT", this field will contain a reference to po_lines_all.po_line_id when the status is "REQUESTED", otherwise it contains the reference to wsh_delivery_details.delivery_detail_id when the status is "CONFIRMED". If the document type is "RECEIPT", this field will be empty when the status is "DELIVERED", otherwise it contains the reference to rcv_transactions.parent_transaction_id when the status is "RETURNED".

columns.name: DOC_REF3
columns.comments: Third level identifier of the document represented by the document type and status. If the document type has a value of "PO", this field will be empty when the status is "REQUESTED", otherwise it contains the reference to po_line_locations_all.line_location_id when the status is "APPROVED". If the document type has a value of "SHIPMENT", this field will contain a reference to po_line_locations_all.line_location_id when the status is "REQUESTED", otherwise it contains the reference to po_lines_all.po_line_id when the status is "CONFIRMED". If the document type has a value of "RECEIPT", this field will contain a reference to po_lines_all.po_line_id when the status is either "DELIVERED" or "RETURNED".

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: WS_WI_EXEC_ACTIVITY_ID
columns.comments: Represents the foreign key to the WIE_WS_WI_EXEC_ACTIVITIES table.

columns.name: WORK_INSTR_STEP_ID
columns.comments: Represents the foreign key to the WIS_WORK_INSTRUCTION_STEPS_B table. It maps to the STEP_ID attribute in the WIS_WORK_INSTRUCTION_STEPS_B table.

columns.name: STEP_REQUIRED_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag used to indicate whether the work instruction step is mandatory. Valid values are Y or N.

columns.name: COMPLETION_TIME
columns.comments: Represents completion time when the work instruction step was completed.

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.comments: Represents the internal identifier of the person who performed the work instruction step.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

objects.name: WIE_CURRENT_SHIFTS_V
objects.query:
SELECT WPS.organization_id ORGANIZATION_ID,
'NEXT_SHIFT' SHIFT_AFFINITY,
WPS.shift_id SHIFT_ID,
WPS.start_date_time START_DATE_TIME,
WPS.END_DATE_TIME END_DATE_TIME
FROM WIE_PLANT_SHIFTS_V WPS,
(
SELECT WPS_B.organization_id,MIN(start_date_time) start_date_time
FROM WIE_PLANT_SHIFTS_V WPS_B, WIE_PLANT_TIMEZONE_V PARAMS
WHERE WPS_B.ORGANIZATION_ID = PARAMS.ORGANIZATION_ID
AND PARAMS.PLANT_TIME < WPS_B.START_DATE_TIME
GROUP BY WPS_B.ORGANIZATION_ID
)NEXT_SHIFT_PER_ORG
where NEXT_SHIFT_PER_ORG.ORGANIZATION_ID = WPS.ORGANIZATION_ID
and NEXT_SHIFT_PER_ORG.START_DATE_TIME = WPS.START_DATE_TIME
union
select WPS.ORGANIZATION_ID ORGANIZATION_ID,
'PREVIOUS_SHIFT' SHIFT_AFFINITY,
WPS.shift_id SHIFT_ID,
WPS.start_date_time START_DATE_TIME,
WPS.END_DATE_TIME END_DATE_TIME
FROM WIE_PLANT_SHIFTS_V WPS,
(
SELECT WPS_B.organization_id,MAX(start_date_time) start_date_time
from WIE_PLANT_SHIFTS_V WPS_B, WIE_PLANT_TIMEZONE_V PARAMS
WHERE WPS_B.ORGANIZATION_ID = PARAMS.ORGANIZATION_ID
AND PARAMS.PLANT_TIME > WPS_B.END_DATE_TIME
group by WPS_B.ORGANIZATION_ID
)PREVIOUS_SHIFT_PER_ORG
where PREVIOUS_SHIFT_PER_ORG.ORGANIZATION_ID = WPS.ORGANIZATION_ID
and PREVIOUS_SHIFT_PER_ORG.START_DATE_TIME = WPS.START_DATE_TIME
union
SELECT WPS.organization_id ORGANIZATION_ID,
'CURRENT_SHIFT' SHIFT_AFFINITY,
WPS.shift_id SHIFT_ID,
WPS.start_date_time START_DATE_TIME,
WPS.end_date_time END_DATE_TIME
FROM WIE_PLANT_SHIFTS_V WPS, WIE_PLANT_TIMEZONE_V PARAMS
where WPS.ORGANIZATION_ID = PARAMS.ORGANIZATION_ID
AND PARAMS.PLANT_TIME between WPS.START_DATE_TIME and WPS.END_DATE_TIME
UNION
SELECT WPS.organization_id ORGANIZATION_ID,
'PAST_DUE_AND_CURRENT_SHIFT' SHIFT_AFFINITY,
to_number(0) SHIFT_ID,
to_date(null) START_DATE_TIME,
WPS.end_date_time END_DATE_TIME
from WIE_PLANT_SHIFTS_V WPS, WIE_PLANT_TIMEZONE_V PARAMS
WHERE WPS.ORGANIZATION_ID = PARAMS.ORGANIZATION_ID
AND PARAMS.PLANT_TIME between WPS.start_date_time and WPS.end_date_time

objects.name: WIE_DETAIL_COMPLETE_ERRORS_V

material.inventory_item_number ,
errors.error_text ,
material.inv_transaction_header_id ,
null interface_row_id,

items.item_number ,
errors.error_text ,
null ,
optxnintf.interface_row_id,
errors.table_name

wie_operation_transactions_int optxnintf ,
egp_system_items items
where errors.interface_row_id = optxnintf.interface_row_id
and items.inventory_item_id = optxnintf.inventory_item_id
and items.organization_id = optxnintf.organization_id

objects.name: WIE_OVR_CAL_CURRENT_SHIFTS_V
objects.query:
SELECT
wps.organization_id organization_id,
wps.schedule_id schedule_id,
'NEXT_SHIFT' shift_affinity,
wps.shift_id shift_id,
wps.start_date_time start_date_time,
wps.end_date_time end_date_time
FROM
wie_ovr_cal_extend_shifts_v wps,
(
SELECT
wps_b.organization_id,
wps_b.schedule_id,
MIN(start_date_time) start_date_time
FROM
wie_ovr_cal_extend_shifts_v wps_b,
wie_plant_timezone_v params
WHERE
wps_b.organization_id = params.organization_id
AND params.plant_time < wps_b.start_date_time
GROUP BY
wps_b.organization_id,
wps_b.schedule_id
) next_shift_per_org
WHERE
next_shift_per_org.organization_id = wps.organization_id
AND next_shift_per_org.schedule_id = wps.schedule_id
AND next_shift_per_org.start_date_time = wps.start_date_time
UNION
SELECT
wps.organization_id organization_id,
wps.schedule_id schedule_id,
'PREVIOUS_SHIFT' shift_affinity,
wps.shift_id shift_id,
wps.start_date_time start_date_time,
wps.end_date_time end_date_time
FROM
wie_ovr_cal_extend_shifts_v wps,
(
SELECT
wps_b.organization_id,
wps_b.schedule_id,
MAX(start_date_time) start_date_time
FROM
wie_ovr_cal_extend_shifts_v wps_b,
wie_plant_timezone_v params
WHERE
wps_b.organization_id = params.organization_id
AND params.plant_time > wps_b.end_date_time
GROUP BY
wps_b.organization_id,
wps_b.schedule_id
) previous_shift_per_org
WHERE
previous_shift_per_org.organization_id = wps.organization_id
AND previous_shift_per_org.schedule_id = wps.schedule_id
AND previous_shift_per_org.start_date_time = wps.start_date_time
UNION
SELECT
wps.organization_id organization_id,
wps.schedule_id schedule_id,
'CURRENT_SHIFT' shift_affinity,
wps.shift_id shift_id,
wps.start_date_time start_date_time,
wps.end_date_time end_date_time
FROM
wie_ovr_cal_extend_shifts_v wps,
wie_plant_timezone_v params
WHERE
wps.organization_id = params.organization_id
AND params.plant_time BETWEEN wps.start_date_time AND wps.end_date_time
UNION
SELECT
wps.organization_id organization_id,
wps.schedule_id schedule_id,
'PAST_DUE_AND_CURRENT_SHIFT' shift_affinity,
to_number(0) shift_id,
to_date(NULL) start_date_time,
wps.end_date_time end_date_time
FROM
wie_ovr_cal_extend_shifts_v wps,
wie_plant_timezone_v params
WHERE
wps.organization_id = params.organization_id
AND params.plant_time BETWEEN wps.start_date_time AND wps.end_date_time

objects.name: WIE_OVR_CAL_EXTEND_SHIFTS_V
objects.query:
SELECT
shifts.organization_id,
shifts.schedule_id,
shifts.schedule_detail_id,
shifts.shift_id,
shifts.start_date_time,
shifts.end_date_time
FROM
wie_half_year_ovr_cal_shifts_v shifts
WHERE
NOT EXISTS (
SELECT
1
FROM
rcs_plant_shift_exc_vl exceptions
WHERE
exceptions.organization_id = shifts.organization_id
AND exceptions.schedule_id = shifts.schedule_id
AND exceptions.associated_shift_id = shifts.shift_id
AND exceptions.exception_type IN ( 'RemoveShift', 'ChangeShift' )
AND trunc(start_date_time) BETWEEN start_date AND end_date
)
UNION
SELECT
shifts.organization_id,
shifts.schedule_id,
shifts.schedule_detail_id,
shifts.shift_id,
CAST(trunc(start_date_time) +(1 / 24) *(exc_start_time / 3600000) AS DATE),
CAST(trunc(end_date_time) +(1 / 24) *(exc_end_time / 3600000) AS DATE)
FROM
wie_half_year_ovr_cal_shifts_v shifts,
rcs_plant_shift_exc_vl excption
WHERE
excption.organization_id = shifts.organization_id
AND excption.schedule_id = shifts.schedule_id
AND excption.associated_shift_id = shifts.shift_id
AND excption.exception_type = 'ChangeShift'
AND trunc(start_date_time) BETWEEN start_date AND end_date
UNION
SELECT
organization_id,
schedule_id,
plant_shift_exc_id,
associated_shift_id shift_id,
CAST(trunc(start_date + level - 1) +(1 / 24) *(exc_start_time / 3600000) AS DATE) start_date_time,
CAST(trunc(start_date + level - 1) +(1 / 24) *(exc_end_time / 3600000) AS DATE) end_date_time
FROM
(
SELECT
recur_add_shift_exceps.plant_shift_exc_id,
recur_add_shift_exceps.organization_id,
recur_add_shift_exceps.schedule_id,
recur_add_shift_exceps.associated_shift_id,
recur_add_shift_exceps.start_date,
recur_add_shift_exceps.exc_start_time,
recur_add_shift_exceps.end_date,
recur_add_shift_exceps.exc_end_time
FROM
rcs_plant_shift_exc_vl recur_add_shift_exceps
WHERE
recur_add_shift_exceps.exception_type = 'AddShift'
) added_shifts
CONNECT BY level <= ( added_shifts.end_date - added_shifts.start_date + 1 )
AND PRIOR added_shifts.plant_shift_exc_id = added_shifts.plant_shift_exc_id
AND PRIOR sys_guid() IS NOT NULL

objects.name: WIE_PLANT_CALENDAR_SHIFTS_V

FROM zmm_sr_schedule_dtls sd,

and shift_id is not null

objects.name: WIE_PLANT_SHIFTS_V
objects.query:
SELECT shifts.organization_id,
shifts.schedule_detail_id,
shifts.SHIFT_ID,
shifts.START_DATE_TIME,
shifts.END_DATE_TIME
FROM WIE_HALF_YEAR_CAL_SHIFTS_V SHIFTS
WHERE NOT EXISTS
(SELECT 1
FROM rcs_plant_shift_exc_vl EXCEPTIONS
WHERE EXCEPTIONS.ORGANIZATION_ID = SHIFTS.ORGANIZATION_ID
AND EXCEPTIONS.SCHEDULE_ID = SHIFTS.SCHEDULE_ID
AND EXCEPTIONS.ASSOCIATED_SHIFT_ID = SHIFTS.SHIFT_ID
AND EXCEPTIONS.EXCEPTION_TYPE IN ('RemoveShift','ChangeShift')
AND TRUNC(START_DATE_TIME) BETWEEN start_date AND end_date
)
UNION
SELECT SHIFTS.ORGANIZATION_ID,
shifts.schedule_detail_id,
shifts.SHIFT_ID,
CAST(TRUNC(START_DATE_TIME)+(1/24)*(exc_start_time/3600000) AS DATE),
CAST(TRUNC(END_DATE_TIME) +(1/24)*(exc_end_time/3600000) AS DATE)
FROM WIE_HALF_YEAR_CAL_SHIFTS_V SHIFTS,
rcs_plant_shift_exc_vl EXCPTION
WHERE EXCPTION.ORGANIZATION_ID = SHIFTS.ORGANIZATION_ID
AND EXCPTION.SCHEDULE_ID = SHIFTS.SCHEDULE_ID
AND EXCPTION.ASSOCIATED_SHIFT_ID = SHIFTS.SHIFT_ID
AND EXCPTION.EXCEPTION_TYPE = 'ChangeShift'
AND TRUNC(START_DATE_TIME) BETWEEN start_date AND end_date
UNION
SELECT ORGANIZATION_ID,
PLANT_SHIFT_EXC_ID,
ASSOCIATED_SHIFT_ID AS SHIFT_ID,
CAST(TRUNC(START_DATE+LEVEL-1)+(1/24)*(EXC_START_TIME/3600000) AS DATE)START_DATE_TIME,
CAST(TRUNC(START_DATE+LEVEL-1)+(1/24)*(EXC_END_TIME/3600000) AS DATE)END_DATE_TIME
FROM
(SELECT RECUR_ADD_SHIFT_EXCEPS.PLANT_SHIFT_EXC_ID,
RECUR_ADD_SHIFT_EXCEPS.ORGANIZATION_ID,
RECUR_ADD_SHIFT_EXCEPS.ASSOCIATED_SHIFT_ID,
RECUR_ADD_SHIFT_EXCEPS.START_DATE,
RECUR_ADD_SHIFT_EXCEPS.EXC_START_TIME,
RECUR_ADD_SHIFT_EXCEPS.END_DATE,
RECUR_ADD_SHIFT_EXCEPS.EXC_END_TIME
FROM RCS_PLANT_SHIFT_EXC_VL RECUR_ADD_SHIFT_EXCEPS
WHERE RECUR_ADD_SHIFT_EXCEPS.EXCEPTION_TYPE = 'AddShift'
) ADDED_SHIFTS
CONNECT BY LEVEL <= (ADDED_SHIFTS.END_DATE - ADDED_SHIFTS.START_DATE+1)
AND PRIOR ADDED_SHIFTS.PLANT_SHIFT_EXC_ID = ADDED_SHIFTS.PLANT_SHIFT_EXC_ID
AND prior SYS_GUID() IS NOT NULL

objects.name: WIE_PROD_EXECUTION_PARAMS_V
objects.query:
SELECT wcb.organization_id AS organization_id,
wcb.work_center_id AS work_center_id,
CASE
WHEN NVL(wpe.override_uom_flag, 'N') = 'Y'
THEN COALESCE(wce.quantity_uom_code, wpe.quantity_uom_code)
ELSE wpe.quantity_uom_code
END AS quantity_uom_code,
NVL(wpe.plan_adherence_target_percent,100) AS plan_adherence_target_percent,
NVL(wpe.oee_target_percent,100) AS oee_target_percent,
NVL(wpe.availability_target_percent,100) AS availability_target_percent,
NVL(wpe.performance_target_percent,100) AS performance_target_percent,
NVL(wpe.quality_target_percent,100) AS quality_target_percent,
NVL(wpe.perf_loss_threshold_limit,120) AS perf_loss_threshold_limit,
NVL(wpe.operator_assignment_code,'NOT_ENFORCED') AS operator_assignment_code,
NVL(wpe.wo_operation_assignment_code ,'NOT_ENFORCED') AS wo_operation_assignment_code,
NVL(wpe.operator_checkin_config_code ,'NO_CONCURRENT_SESSIONS') AS operator_checkin_config_code,
NVL(wpe.check_in_other_operators_code, 'ALLOWED') AS check_in_other_operators_code,
NVL(wpe.labor_res_charging_scope_code, 'ALL_CHKED_IN_AND_UNMATCH_OP') AS labor_res_charging_scope_code,
NVL(wpe.equip_res_charging_scope_code, 'WS_EQ_MATCH_AND_OPR_UNMATCH') AS equip_res_charging_scope_code,
NVL(wpe.res_txn_submission_config_code ,'AUTO_SUBMIT_TXN') AS res_txn_submission_config_code,
NVL(wpe.resource_activity_config_code , 'DISABLE') AS resource_activity_config_code
FROM wis_work_centers_b wcb
LEFT JOIN wie_prod_execution_params wpe
ON wcb.organization_id = wpe.organization_id
LEFT JOIN wie_prod_exec_prm_wc_overrides wce
ON (wcb.work_center_id = wce.work_center_id

objects.name: WIE_SOURCE_SYSTEMS_V
objects.query:
select 'INTERNAL' source_system_type,
fa.application_id source_system_id,
fa.product_code source_system_code,
fa.application_name source_system_name,
fa.description source_system_description
from fnd_application_vl fa
union
select 'EXTERNAL' source_system_type,
hos.orig_system_id source_system_id,
hos.orig_system source_system_code,
hos.orig_system_name source_system_name,
hos.description source_system_description
from hz_orig_systems_vl hos
where hos.status = 'A'
and hos.start_date_active <= TRUNC(sysdate)
and (hos.end_date_active IS NULL
or hos.end_date_active >= TRUNC(sysdate))
order by 1, 3

objects.name: WIE_WORK_ORDERS_ON_HOLD_V
objects.query:
SELECT wo.work_order_id,
wo.work_order_status_id,
wo.planned_completion_date,
wo.organization_id,
wm.work_method_code
FROM wie_work_orders_b wo,
wis_work_methods_b wm
WHERE wo.work_order_status_id IN
(SELECT wosts.wo_status_id
FROM wie_wo_statuses_b wosts
WHERE wosts.wo_system_status_code = 'ON_HOLD')
AND wo.order_less_flag = 'N'
AND wo.work_method_id = wm.work_method_id

objects.name: WIE_WORK_ORDERS_PAST_DUE_V

objects.name: WIE_WO_DISPATCH_LISTS_V
objects.query:
SELECT wo.work_order_id WORK_ORDER_ID,
wo.object_version_number WO_OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER,
wo.work_order_number WORK_ORDER_NUMBER,
wo.work_order_priority WORK_ORDER_PRIORITY,
wo.released_date RELEASED_DATE,
wo.organization_id ORGANIZATION_ID,
uoms.unit_of_measure UOM,
wo.uom_code UOM_CODE,
wo.planned_start_quantity PLANNED_START_QUANTITY,
esi.item_number ITEM_NUMBER,
esi.inventory_item_id INVENTORY_ITEM_ID,
esi.description ITEM_DESCRIPTION,
wc.work_center_name WORK_CENTER_NAME,
wc.work_center_id WORK_CENTER_ID,
wc.work_area_id WORK_AREA_ID,
woop.wo_operation_id WO_OPERATION_ID,
woop.operation_name WO_OPERATION_NAME,
woop.operation_seq_number OPERATION_SEQ_NUMBER,
woop.completed_quantity COMPLETED_QUANTITY,
woop.scrapped_quantity SCRAPPED_QUANTITY,
woop.rejected_quantity REJECTED_QUANTITY,
woop.ready_quantity READY_QUANTITY,
fl.meaning DISPATCH_STATE,
fl.lookup_code DISPATCH_LOOKUP_CODE,
CASE
WHEN fl.lookup_code = 'READY'
THEN NVL(woop.ready_quantity,0)
WHEN fl.lookup_code = 'COMPLETE'
THEN woop.completed_quantity
WHEN fl.lookup_code = 'REJECT'
THEN woop.rejected_quantity
WHEN fl.lookup_code = 'SCRAP'
THEN woop.scrapped_quantity
WHEN fl.lookup_code = 'IN_PROCESS'
THEN woop.in_process_quantity
WHEN fl.lookup_code = 'OPTIONAL'
THEN NULL
END QUANTITY,
woop.previous_cp_op_seq_num PREVIOUS_CP_OP_SEQ_NUM,
woop.next_cp_op_seq_num NEXT_CP_OP_SEQ_NUM,
woop.planned_start_date OPERATION_START_DATE,
woop.planned_completion_date OPERATION_COMPLETION_DATE,
NVL(woop.serial_tracking_flag,'N') SERIAL_TRACKING_FLAG,
CASE COUNT_POINT_OPERATION_FLAG
WHEN 'Y'
THEN NVL(
(SELECT SUM(DECODE(SIGN(NVL(opmat.issued_quantity,0)-opmat.quantity),-1,1,0))
FROM wie_wo_operation_materials opmat
WHERE opmat.wo_operation_id = woop.wo_operation_id
AND opmat.work_order_id = woop.work_order_id
AND opmat.supply_type = '1'),-1)
ELSE -1
END material_icon_ind,
CASE COUNT_POINT_OPERATION_FLAG
WHEN 'Y'
THEN NVL(
(SELECT SUM(DECODE(SIGN(NVL(opresource.actual_resource_usage,0)-opresource.required_usage),-1,1,0))
FROM wie_wo_operation_resources opresource
WHERE opresource.wo_operation_id = woop.wo_operation_id
AND opresource.charge_type = 'MANUAL'),-1)
ELSE -1
END resource_icon_ind,
wo.cm_po_header_id PO_HEADER_ID,
wo.cm_po_line_id PO_LINE_ID,
poh.segment1 PO_HEADER_NUMBER,
pol.line_num PO_LINE_NUMBER,
woop.operation_type OPERATION_TYPE,
oss.operation_start_time OPERATION_START_TIME,
woop.standard_operation_id,
wo.item_revision,
doo.header_id source_fulfill_header_id,
doo.fulfill_line_id source_fulfill_line_id,
wwm.work_method_name WORK_METHOD,
wwm.work_method_code WORK_METHOD_CODE,
CASE
WHEN (wwm.work_method_code='PROCESS_MANUFACTURING') OR ((wo.work_order_type IN ('STANDARD', 'NON_STANDARD')) AND ((NVL(woop.count_point_operation_flag,'N') = 'Y') OR (NVL(woop.count_point_operation_flag,'N') = 'N' AND NVL(woop.auto_transact_flag,'N') = 'N')))
THEN
(SELECT
CASE
WHEN ((MAX(NVL(wwoo.output_quantity,0)-NVL(wwoo.completed_quantity,0)) = 0) or (SIGN(MAX(NVL(wwoo.output_quantity,0)-NVL(wwoo.completed_quantity,0)))=-1))
THEN 'CHECKMARK'
WHEN MAX(1) IS NULL
THEN 'CIRCLE'
ELSE 'CHECKLIST'
END
FROM wie_wo_operation_outputs wwoo
WHERE wwoo.wo_operation_id = woop.wo_operation_id
AND wwoo.completion_type = 'MANUAL')
ELSE 'NONE'
END output_icon_ind,
NVL(woop.op_compl_with_under_issue,'ALLOW') op_compl_with_under_issue,
NVL(woop.op_compl_with_open_exceptions,'ALLOW') op_compl_with_open_exceptions,
NVL(woop.cumulative_scrap_quantity,0) cumulative_scrap_quantity,
wo.pjc_project_id PROJECT_ID,
wo.pjc_project_number PROJECT_NUMBER,
wo.pjc_task_id TASK_ID,
wo.pjc_task_number TASK_NUMBER,
wo.work_order_type WORK_ORDER_TYPE,
wo.preassign_lot_flag PREASSIGN_LOT_FLAG,
woop.resequence_flag RESEQUENCE_FLAG,
woop.execution_sequence EXECUTION_SEQUENCE,
woop.tollgate_op_seq_num TOLL_GATE_OP_SEQ_NUM,
wo.under_completed_flag UNDER_COMPLETED_FLAG,
CASE
WHEN (wwm.work_method_code='PROCESS_MANUFACTURING') AND (wo.work_definition_id is not null)
THEN
(SELECT NVL(PROCESS_BATCH_TYPE, 'USER_DEFINED')
FROM wis_work_definitions wwd
WHERE wo.work_definition_id = wwd.work_definition_id AND wo.organization_id = wwd.organization_id)
ELSE 'USER_DEFINED'
END PROCESS_BATCH_TYPE,
wo.enable_execution_run_flag ENABLE_EXECUTION_RUN_FLAG,
wo.enable_parallel_ops_flag ENABLE_PARALLEL_OPS_FLAG
FROM wie_wo_operations_vl woop,
wie_work_orders_b wo,
wis_work_centers_vl wc,
egp_system_items_vl esi,
fnd_lookups fl,
inv_units_of_measure_vl uoms,
po_headers_all poh,
po_lines_all pol,
dos_supply_tracking_lines dos,
doo_fulfill_lines_all doo,
wis_work_methods_vl wwm,
(SELECT wwoss.operation_start_time, wwoss.wo_operation_id
FROM wie_wo_operation_start_stop wwoss
WHERE wwoss.operation_stop_time IS NULL
AND (wwoss.wo_product_serial_id IS NULL
OR wwoss.wo_product_serial_id =
(SELECT inner_wwoss.wo_product_serial_id
FROM wie_wo_operation_start_stop inner_wwoss
WHERE inner_wwoss.operation_stop_time IS NULL
AND inner_wwoss.wo_operation_id = wwoss.wo_operation_id
AND rownum = 1))) oss
WHERE wo.work_order_id = woop.work_order_id
AND wo.organization_id = woop.organization_id
AND woop.work_center_id = wc.work_center_id
AND wo.inventory_item_id = esi.inventory_item_id
AND wo.organization_id = esi.organization_id
AND uoms.uom_code = wo.uom_code
AND wo.cm_po_header_id = pol.po_header_id (+)
AND wo.cm_po_line_id = pol.po_line_id (+)
AND wo.cm_po_header_id = poh.po_header_id (+)
AND wo.source_line_ref_id = dos.tracking_line_id (+)
AND dos.supply_order_reference_line_id = doo.fulfill_line_id (+)
AND fl.lookup_type = 'ORA_WIE_DISPATCH_STATE'
AND wo.work_method_id = wwm.work_method_id
AND wwm.work_method_code IN ('DISCRETE_MANUFACTURING','PROCESS_MANUFACTURING')
AND wo.work_order_status_id IN (SELECT wost.wo_status_id FROM wie_wo_statuses_b wost
WHERE wost.wo_system_status_code IN ('RELEASED','COMPLETED'))
AND wo.order_less_flag = 'N'
AND NVL(woop.auto_transact_flag,'N') = 'N'
AND((fl.lookup_code = 'READY'
AND (woop.ready_quantity > 0
OR ((NVL(woop.ready_quantity,0) = 0 AND NVL(woop.completed_quantity,0) = 0 AND NVL(woop.rejected_quantity,0) = 0 AND NVL(woop.scrapped_quantity,0) = 0)
AND woop.resequence_flag = 'Y'
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wie_wo_operations_b opexists WHERE opexists.work_order_id = woop.work_order_id
AND opexists.tollgate_op_seq_num = woop.tollgate_op_seq_num
AND opexists.ready_quantity > 0 AND NVL(opexists.completed_quantity,0) = 0 AND NVL(opexists.rejected_quantity,0) = 0 AND NVL(opexists.scrapped_quantity,0) = 0))))
OR(woop.completed_quantity > 0 AND fl.lookup_code = 'COMPLETE')
OR(woop.rejected_quantity > 0 AND fl.lookup_code = 'REJECT')
OR(woop.scrapped_quantity > 0 AND fl.lookup_code = 'SCRAP')
OR (woop.IN_PROCESS_QUANTITY > 0 AND fl.lookup_code = 'IN_PROCESS')
OR(NVL(woop.count_point_operation_flag,'N') = 'N' AND fl.lookup_code = 'OPTIONAL'))
AND woop.wo_operation_id = oss.wo_operation_id (+)

objects.name: WIE_WO_OPERATIONS_COMPLETE_V
objects.query:
SELECT WO.WORK_ORDER_ID WORK_ORDER_ID,
OPER.WO_OPERATION_ID WO_OPERATION_ID,
WO.WORK_ORDER_STATUS_ID WORK_ORDER_STATUS_ID,
OPER.PLANNED_COMPLETION_DATE PLANNED_COMPLETION_DATE,
OPER.ORGANIZATION_ID ORGANIZATION_ID,
OPER.WORK_CENTER_ID WORK_CENTER_ID,
OPER.COMPLETED_QUANTITY COMPLETED_QUANTITY,
WC.WORK_AREA_ID WORK_AREA_ID,
SHIF.SHIFT_AFFINITY SHIFT_AFFINITY,
SHIF.START_DATE_TIME START_DATE_TIME,
SHIF.END_DATE_TIME END_DATE_TIME,
MT.WORK_METHOD_CODE WORK_METHOD_CODE
FROM WIE_WORK_ORDERS_B WO,
WIE_WO_OPERATIONS_B OPER,
WIS_WORK_CENTERS_B WC,
WIE_CURRENT_SHIFTS_V SHIF,
WIS_WORK_METHODS_B MT
WHERE OPER.WORK_ORDER_ID = WO.WORK_ORDER_ID
AND WO.ORDER_LESS_FLAG = 'N'
AND WO.WORK_ORDER_STATUS_ID IN
(SELECT WOSTS.WO_STATUS_ID
FROM WIE_WO_STATUSES_B WOSTS
WHERE WOSTS.WO_SYSTEM_STATUS_CODE IN('RELEASED', 'COMPLETED'))
AND WC.WORK_CENTER_ID = OPER.WORK_CENTER_ID
AND SHIF.ORGANIZATION_ID = OPER.ORGANIZATION_ID
AND OPER.PLANNED_COMPLETION_DATE IS NOT NULL
AND OPER.AUTO_TRANSACT_FLAG = 'N'
AND OPER.COMPLETED_QUANTITY > 0
AND SHIF.SHIFT_AFFINITY IN ('PREVIOUS_SHIFT','CURRENT_SHIFT','NEXT_SHIFT')
AND OPER.PLANNED_COMPLETION_DATE >= FND_TIMEZONE_PUB.ADJUST_DATETIME(SHIF.START_DATE_TIME, FND_TIMEZONES.GET_CLIENT_TIMEZONE_CODE, FND_TIMEZONES.GET_SERVER_TIMEZONE_CODE)
AND OPER.PLANNED_COMPLETION_DATE <= FND_TIMEZONE_PUB.ADJUST_DATETIME(SHIF.END_DATE_TIME, FND_TIMEZONES.GET_CLIENT_TIMEZONE_CODE, FND_TIMEZONES.GET_SERVER_TIMEZONE_CODE)
AND WO.WORK_METHOD_ID = MT.WORK_METHOD_ID

objects.name: WIE_WO_OPERATIONS_PAST_DUE_V
objects.query:
SELECT WO.WORK_ORDER_ID WORK_ORDER_ID,
OPER.WO_OPERATION_ID WO_OPERATION_ID,
WO.WORK_ORDER_STATUS_ID WORK_ORDER_STATUS_ID,
OPER.PLANNED_COMPLETION_DATE PLANNED_COMPLETION_DATE,
OPER.ORGANIZATION_ID ORGANIZATION_ID,
OPER.WORK_CENTER_ID WORK_CENTER_ID,
OPER.READY_QUANTITY READY_QUANTITY,
OPER.REJECTED_QUANTITY REJECTED_QUANTITY,
OPER.OPERATION_TYPE,
WC.WORK_AREA_ID,
MT.WORK_METHOD_CODE WORK_METHOD_CODE
FROM WIE_WORK_ORDERS_B WO,
WIE_WO_OPERATIONS_B OPER,
WIS_WORK_CENTERS_B WC,
WIS_WORK_METHODS_B MT
WHERE OPER.WORK_ORDER_ID = WO.WORK_ORDER_ID
AND WO.ORDER_LESS_FLAG = 'N'
AND OPER.COUNT_POINT_OPERATION_FLAG ='Y'
AND WO.WORK_ORDER_STATUS_ID IN
(SELECT WOSTS.WO_STATUS_ID
FROM WIE_WO_STATUSES_B WOSTS
WHERE WOSTS.WO_SYSTEM_STATUS_CODE IN('RELEASED', 'COMPLETED')

WIS_WORK_METHODS_B MT
WHERE OPER.WORK_ORDER_ID = WO.WORK_ORDER_ID
AND WO.ORDER_LESS_FLAG = 'N'
AND WO.WORK_ORDER_STATUS_ID IN

FROM WIE_WO_STATUSES_B WOSTS
WHERE WOSTS.WO_SYSTEM_STATUS_CODE IN('RELEASED', 'COMPLETED'))

AND OPER.PLANNED_COMPLETION_DATE IS NOT NULL
AND OPER.AUTO_TRANSACT_FLAG = 'N'
AND OPER.READY_QUANTITY > 0
AND SHIF.SHIFT_AFFINITY IN ('PREVIOUS_SHIFT','CURRENT_SHIFT','NEXT_SHIFT')
AND OPER.PLANNED_COMPLETION_DATE >= FND_TIMEZONE_PUB.ADJUST_DATETIME(SHIF.START_DATE_TIME, FND_TIMEZONES.GET_CLIENT_TIMEZONE_CODE, FND_TIMEZONES.GET_SERVER_TIMEZONE_CODE)

objects.name: WIE_WO_OPERATION_YIELDS_V
objects.query:
WITH operation_inputs AS (
SELECT /*+ QB_NAME(qb_op_inputs) */ wo_operation_id, SUM(nvl(issued_quantity/nvl(batch_uom_conversion_rate,1),0)) AS material_in_qty,
SUM(nvl(quantity/nvl(batch_uom_conversion_rate,1),0)) AS material_in_req_qty
FROM WIE_WO_OPERATION_MATERIALS
WHERE supply_type='1' and nvl(contribute_to_yield_flag,'N')='Y'
GROUP BY wo_operation_id
),
operation_outputs AS (
SELECT /*+ QB_NAME(qb_op_outputs) */ wo_operation_id, SUM(nvl(completed_quantity/nvl(batch_uom_conversion_rate,1),0)) AS material_out_qty,
SUM(nvl(output_quantity/nvl(batch_uom_conversion_rate,1),0)) AS material_out_req_qty
FROM WIE_WO_OPERATION_OUTPUTS
where completion_type='MANUAL'
GROUP BY wo_operation_id
),
operation_details AS (
SELECT /*+ QB_NAME(qb_op_details) */
op.work_order_id,
op.wo_operation_id,
op.op_yield_factor AS planned_yield,
nvl(op.completed_quantity, 0) as intermediate_out_qty,
op.operation_seq_number,
op.previous_cp_op_seq_num,
nvl(i.material_in_qty, 0) material_in_qty,
nvl(i.material_in_req_qty, 0) material_in_req_qty,
nvl(ot.material_out_qty, 0) material_out_qty,
nvl(ot.material_out_req_qty, 0) material_out_req_qty
FROM WIE_WO_OPERATIONS_B op
LEFT JOIN operation_inputs i ON op.wo_operation_id = i.wo_operation_id
LEFT JOIN operation_outputs ot ON op.wo_operation_id = ot.wo_operation_id
),
recursive_yields (work_order_id, wo_operation_id, operation_seq_number, planned_yield, intermediate_out_qty, previous_cp_op_seq_num, material_in_qty, material_in_req_qty, material_out_qty, material_out_req_qty, intermediate_in_qty, yield_loss, actual_yield, actual_cum_yield, planned_cum_yield) AS (
SELECT /*+ QB_NAME(qb_ry_anchor) */
work_order_id,
wo_operation_id,
operation_seq_number,
planned_yield,
intermediate_out_qty,
previous_cp_op_seq_num,
material_in_qty,
material_in_req_qty,
material_out_qty,
material_out_req_qty,
0 AS intermediate_in_qty,
material_in_qty - (material_out_qty + intermediate_out_qty) AS yield_loss,
(material_out_qty + intermediate_out_qty) / NULLIF(material_in_qty,0) AS actual_yield,
(material_out_qty + intermediate_out_qty) / NULLIF(material_in_qty,0) AS actual_cum_yield,
planned_yield as planned_cum_yield
FROM operation_details
WHERE previous_cp_op_seq_num IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT /*+ QB_NAME(qb_ry_recursive) */
od.work_order_id,
od.wo_operation_id,
od.operation_seq_number,
od.planned_yield,
od.intermediate_out_qty,
od.previous_cp_op_seq_num,
od.material_in_qty,
od.material_in_req_qty,
od.material_out_qty,
od.material_out_req_qty,
ry.intermediate_out_qty intermediate_in_qty,
(ry.intermediate_out_qty + od.material_in_qty) - (od.material_out_qty + od.intermediate_out_qty) AS yield_loss,
(od.material_out_qty + od.intermediate_out_qty) / NULLIF((ry.intermediate_out_qty + od.material_in_qty),0) AS actual_yield,
(od.material_out_qty + od.intermediate_out_qty) / NULLIF(((ry.intermediate_out_qty / NULLIF(ry.actual_cum_yield, 0)) + od.material_in_qty),0) AS actual_cum_yield,
(((ry.intermediate_out_qty * (ry.planned_cum_yield / NULLIF(ry.actual_cum_yield,0) )) + od.material_in_qty) * od.planned_yield)/
NULLIF(((ry.intermediate_out_qty / NULLIF(ry.planned_cum_yield, 0) ) + (od.material_in_qty)),0) AS planned_cum_yield
FROM operation_details od
JOIN recursive_yields ry ON od.previous_cp_op_seq_num = ry.operation_seq_number and od.work_order_id = ry.work_order_id
)
SELECT /*+ QB_NAME(qb_final) */
wo_operation_id,
work_order_id,
material_in_qty material_issued_qty,
material_in_req_qty material_required_qty,
material_out_qty output_completed_qty,
material_out_req_qty output_expected_qty,
intermediate_in_qty,
intermediate_out_qty,
yield_loss,
round(planned_yield, fnd_profile.value('INV_QUANTITY_DECIMAL_PRECISION')) planned_yield,
round(planned_cum_yield,fnd_profile.value('INV_QUANTITY_DECIMAL_PRECISION')) planned_cum_yield,
round(actual_yield, fnd_profile.value('INV_QUANTITY_DECIMAL_PRECISION')) actual_yield,
round(actual_cum_yield, fnd_profile.value('INV_QUANTITY_DECIMAL_PRECISION')) actual_cum_yield
FROM recursive_yields

objects.name: WIE_WO_OP_MATERIALS_RSV_V
objects.query:
SELECT
mat.organization_id,
mat.work_order_id,
mat.wo_operation_id,
mat.inventory_item_id,
mat.item_revision,
MIN(mat.required_date) required_date,
SUM(mat.quantity) quantity,
SUM(mat.issued_quantity) issued_quantity,
mat.uom_code,
mat.enforce_int_requirements,
SUM(mat.extended_quantity) extended_quantity,
sign(quantity) quantity_sign
FROM
wie_wo_operation_materials mat
WHERE
material_type IN ( 'COMPONENT', 'ASSEMBLY_COMPONENT' )
AND supply_type IN ( '1', '2', '3' )
GROUP BY
mat.organization_id,
mat.work_order_id,
mat.wo_operation_id,
mat.inventory_item_id,
mat.item_revision,
mat.uom_code,
sign(quantity),
mat.enforce_int_requirements

objects.name: WIE_WO_RESERVABLE_COMPS_V
objects.query:
SELECT /*+ leading(wo) no_merge(woom) */
WO.WORK_ORDER_NUMBER,
WO.WORK_ORDER_ID,
WO.ORGANIZATION_ID,
WOOP.OPERATION_SEQ_NUMBER,
WOOP.WO_OPERATION_ID,
EGP1.ITEM_NUMBER "ASSEMBLY_ITEM",
WO.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID "ASSEMBLY_ITEM_ID",
EGP2.ITEM_NUMBER "COMPONENT_ITEM",
WOOM.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID "COMPONENT_ITEM_ID",
WOOM.REQUIRED_DATE,
WO.PJC_PROJECT_NUMBER "DEMAND_PROJECT_NUMBER",
WO.PJC_PROJECT_ID "DEMAND_PROJECT_ID",
WO.PJC_TASK_NUMBER "DEMAND_TASK_NUMBER",
WO.PJC_TASK_ID "DEMAND_TASK_ID",
CASE
WHEN WOOM.QUANTITY-NVL(WOOM.ISSUED_QUANTITY,0) > 0 THEN
INV_CONVERT.INV_UM_CONVERT( WOOM.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID, NULL, WOOM.ORGANIZATION_ID,NULL,(WOOM.QUANTITY-NVL(WOOM.ISSUED_QUANTITY,0)), WOOM.UOM_CODE, EGP2.PRIMARY_UOM_CODE, NULL, NULL )
ELSE 0
END AS "REQUESTED_QUANTITY",
EGP2.PRIMARY_UOM_CODE "DEMAND_UOM",
ST.WO_SYSTEM_STATUS_CODE,
DECODE (ENFORCE_INT_REQUIREMENTS, '0', 'N', '1', 'Y', '2', 'Y', 'N') "ENFORCE_INTEGER_FLAG" ,
WOOM.EXTENDED_QUANTITY "EXTENDED_QUANTITY",
WOOM.UOM_CODE "COMPONENT_TRANSACTION_UOM"
FROM
WIE_WORK_ORDERS_B WO,
WIE_WO_OPERATIONS_B WOOP,
WIE_WO_OP_MATERIALS_RSV_V WOOM,
EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_BV EGP1,
EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_BV EGP2,

WO.WORK_ORDER_ID = WOOP.WORK_ORDER_ID AND
WO.WORK_ORDER_ID = WOOM.WORK_ORDER_ID AND
WOOP.WO_OPERATION_ID = WOOM.WO_OPERATION_ID AND
EGP1.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = WO.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID AND
EGP1.ORGANIZATION_ID = WO.ORGANIZATION_ID AND
EGP2.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = WOOM.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID AND
EGP2.ORGANIZATION_ID = WOOM.ORGANIZATION_ID AND
WO.WORK_ORDER_STATUS_ID = ST.WO_STATUS_ID AND
ST.WO_SYSTEM_STATUS_CODE IN ('UNRELEASED','RELEASED') AND
WO.ORDER_LESS_FLAG = 'N' AND
WO.CONTRACT_MFG_FLAG = 'N' AND
WOOM.QUANTITY_SIGN > 0

objects.name: WIE_WO_RESERVATIONS_V
objects.query:
SELECT
InventoryReservationPEO.reservation_id,
InventoryReservationPEO.organization_id,
InventoryReservationPEO.inventory_item_id,
InventoryReservationPEO.demand_source_type_id,
TO_CHAR(InventoryReservationPEO.demand_source_type_id) as demand_source_type_id_derived,
InventoryReservationPEO.demand_source_header_id,
DECODE(InventoryReservationPEO.demand_source_type_id,
2,NVL(SalesOrderPEO.sales_order_number,InventoryReservationPEO.demand_source_header_id),
8,NVL(SalesOrderPEO.sales_order_number,InventoryReservationPEO.demand_source_header_id),
18,NVL(SalesOrderPEO.sales_order_number,InventoryReservationPEO.demand_source_header_id),
3,(SELECT MAX( fnd_flex_ext.get_segs('GL','GL#',CodeCombinationPEO.chart_of_accounts_id,InventoryReservationPEO.demand_source_header_id)) accountsegments
FROM gl_code_combinations CodeCombinationPEO
WHERE code_combination_id = InventoryReservationPEO.demand_source_header_id
),
6,(SELECT MAX( fnd_flex_ext.get_segs('INV','MDSP',AccountAliasPEO.structure_instance_number,InventoryReservationPEO.demand_source_header_id,InventoryReservationPEO.organization_id)) accountaliassegs
FROM inv_generic_dispositions AccountAliasPEO
WHERE disposition_id = InventoryReservationPEO.demand_source_header_id
AND organization_id = InventoryReservationPEO.organization_id
),
13,InventoryReservationPEO.demand_source_name, NULL) AS demand_source_header_number,
InventoryReservationPEO.demand_source_line_id,
DECODE(sales_order_shipment_number,NULL,DECODE(sales_order_line_number,NULL,TO_CHAR(demand_source_line_id),sales_order_line_number), sales_order_line_number
||DECODE(sales_order_line_number,NULL,NULL,'-')
||sales_order_shipment_number) AS demand_source_line_number,
InventoryReservationPEO.demand_source_name,
InventoryReservationPEO.reservation_quantity,
InventoryReservationPEO.primary_reservation_quantity,
InventoryReservationPEO.reservation_uom_code,
InventoryReservationPEO.primary_uom_code,
(SELECT SUM(InventoryReservationPEO1.primary_reservation_quantity)
FROM inv_reservations InventoryReservationPEO1
WHERE InventoryReservationPEO1.demand_source_header_id=InventoryReservationPEO.demand_source_header_id
AND InventoryReservationPEO1.demand_source_line_id =InventoryReservationPEO.demand_source_line_id
) AS demand_quantity,
InventoryReservationPEO.primary_uom_code AS demand_uom,
DECODE(InventoryReservationPEO.demand_source_type_id,2,InventoryReservationPEO.requirement_date,8,InventoryReservationPEO.requirement_date,18,InventoryReservationPEO.requirement_date,NULL) AS due_date,
DECODE(InventoryReservationPEO.demand_source_type_id,2,PartyPEO1.party_number,8,PartyPEO1.party_number,18,PartyPEO1.party_number,NULL) AS customer_number,
DECODE(InventoryReservationPEO.demand_source_type_id,2,PartyPEO1.party_name,8,PartyPEO1.party_name,18,PartyPEO1.party_name,NULL) AS customer_name,
PartyPEO1.party_type AS customer_type,
InventoryReservationPEO.supply_source_header_id,
InventoryReservationPEO.source_fulfillment_line_id AS src_fulfill_line_id,
'DOO_HEADERS_ALL' AS attachment_entity_name,
'DOO_FULFILL_LINES_ALL' AS line_entity_name
FROM inv_reservations InventoryReservationPEO,
inv_sales_orders SalesOrderPEO,
hz_parties PartyPEO1
WHERE InventoryReservationPEO.supply_source_type_id = 5
AND SalesOrderPEO.sales_order_id (+) = InventoryReservationPEO.demand_source_header_id
AND PartyPEO1.party_id (+) = SalesOrderPEO.sold_to_party_id
AND (NOT EXISTS
(SELECT 1
FROM wsh_delivery_details DeliveryLinePEO
WHERE DeliveryLinePEO.source_header_id = InventoryReservationPEO.demand_source_header_id
AND DeliveryLinePEO.source_line_id = InventoryReservationPEO.demand_source_line_id
AND DeliveryLinePEO.released_status NOT IN ('X','D')
) )
UNION ALL
SELECT DISTINCT InventoryReservationPEO.reservation_id,
DeliveryLinePEO.organization_id,
DeliveryLinePEO.inventory_item_id,
InventoryReservationPEO.demand_source_type_id,
TO_CHAR(InventoryReservationPEO.demand_source_type_id) as demand_source_type_id_derived,
DeliveryLinePEO.source_header_id AS demand_source_header_id,
DeliveryLinePEO.sales_order_number AS demand_source_header_number,
DeliveryLinePEO.source_line_id AS demand_source_line_id,
DECODE(DeliveryLinePEO.sales_order_shipment_number,NULL,DECODE(DeliveryLinePEO.sales_order_line_number,NULL,TO_CHAR(DeliveryLinePEO.source_line_id), DeliveryLinePEO.sales_order_line_number), DeliveryLinePEO.sales_order_line_number
||DECODE(DeliveryLinePEO.sales_order_line_number,NULL,NULL,'-')
||DeliveryLinePEO.sales_order_shipment_number) AS demand_source_line_number,
InventoryReservationPEO.demand_source_name,
InventoryReservationPEO.reservation_quantity,
InventoryReservationPEO.primary_reservation_quantity,
InventoryReservationPEO.reservation_uom_code,
InventoryReservationPEO.primary_uom_code,
src_requested_quantity AS demand_quantity,
src_requested_quantity_uom AS demand_uom,
DeliveryLinePEO.date_scheduled AS due_date,
PartyPEO1.party_number AS customer_number,
PartyPEO1.party_name AS customer_name,
PartyPEO1.party_type AS customer_type,
InventoryReservationPEO.supply_source_header_id,
InventoryReservationPEO.source_fulfillment_line_id AS src_fulfill_line_id,
'DOO_HEADERS_ALL' AS attachment_entity_name,
'DOO_FULFILL_LINES_ALL' AS line_entity_name
FROM inv_reservations InventoryReservationPEO,
wsh_delivery_details_v DeliveryLinePEO,
hz_parties PartyPEO1
WHERE InventoryReservationPEO.supply_source_type_id = 5
AND InventoryReservationPEO.organization_id = DeliveryLinePEO.organization_id
AND InventoryReservationPEO.demand_source_header_id = DeliveryLinePEO.source_header_id
AND InventoryReservationPEO.demand_source_line_id = DeliveryLinePEO.source_line_id
AND DeliveryLinePEO.released_status NOT IN ('X','D')
AND PartyPEO1.party_id (+) = DeliveryLinePEO.sold_to_party_id

objects.name: WIE_WO_SUPPLIER_OPERATIONS_V
objects.query:
SELECT wo.work_order_id WORK_ORDER_ID,
wo.object_version_number WO_OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER,
wo.work_order_number WORK_ORDER_NUMBER,
wo.work_order_priority WORK_ORDER_PRIORITY,
wo.released_date RELEASED_DATE,
wo.organization_id ORGANIZATION_ID,
(SELECT uom.unit_of_measure
FROM inv_units_of_measure_vl uom
WHERE uom.uom_code = wo.uom_code
) UOM,
wo.uom_code UOM_CODE,
wo.planned_start_quantity PLANNED_START_QUANTITY,
(SELECT pitem.item_number
FROM egp_system_items_vl pitem
WHERE pitem.inventory_item_id = wo.inventory_item_id
AND pitem.organization_id = wo.organization_id
) ITEM_NUMBER,
wo.inventory_item_id INVENTORY_ITEM_ID,
(SELECT itemvl.description
FROM egp_system_items_vl itemvl
WHERE itemvl.inventory_item_id = wo.inventory_item_id
AND itemvl.organization_id = wo.organization_id
) ITEM_DESCRIPTION,
woop.wo_operation_id WO_OPERATION_ID,
woop.operation_seq_number OPERATION_SEQ_NUMBER,
NVL(woop.ready_quantity,0) READY_QUANTITY,
NVL(woop.completed_quantity,0) COMPLETED_QUANTITY,
NVL(woop.scrapped_quantity,0) SCRAPPED_QUANTITY,
NVL(woop.rejected_quantity,0) REJECTED_QUANTITY,
NVL(woop.po_requested_quantity,0) PO_REQUESTED_QUANTITY,
NVL(woop.po_approved_quantity,0) PO_APPROVED_QUANTITY,
NVL(woop.shipped_quantity,0) SHIPPED_QUANTITY,
NVL(woop.received_quantity,0) RECEIVED_QUANTITY,
NVL(woop.over_receipt_quantity,0) OVER_RECEIPT_QUANTITY,
NVL(woop.in_process_quantity,0) IN_PROCESS_QUANTITY,
woop.operation_type OPERATION_TYPE,
woop.osp_item_id OSP_ITEM_ID,
(SELECT oitem.item_number
FROM egp_system_items_vl oitem
WHERE oitem.inventory_item_id = woop.osp_item_id
AND oitem.organization_id = woop.organization_id
) OSP_ITEM_NUMBER,
woop.shipping_documents_flag SHIPPING_DOCUMENTS_FLAG,
fl.meaning DISPATCH_STATE,
fl.lookup_code DISPATCH_LOOKUP_CODE,
CASE
WHEN fl.lookup_code = 'READY'
THEN NVL(woop.ready_quantity,0)
WHEN fl.lookup_code = 'COMPLETE'
THEN NVL(woop.completed_quantity,0)
WHEN fl.lookup_code = 'REJECT'
THEN NVL(woop.rejected_quantity,0)
WHEN fl.lookup_code = 'SCRAP'
THEN NVL(woop.scrapped_quantity,0)
WHEN fl.lookup_code = 'IN_PROCESS'
THEN NVL(woop.in_process_quantity,0)
END QUANTITY,
woop.previous_cp_op_seq_num PREVIOUS_CP_OP_SEQ_NUM,
woop.next_cp_op_seq_num NEXT_CP_OP_SEQ_NUM,
woop.planned_start_date OPERATION_START_DATE,
woop.planned_completion_date OPERATION_COMPLETION_DATE,
NVL(woop.serial_tracking_flag,'N') SERIAL_TRACKING_FLAG,
NVL(
(SELECT SUM(DECODE(SIGN(NVL(issued_quantity,0)-quantity),-1,1,0))
FROM wie_wo_operation_materials opmat
WHERE opmat.wo_operation_id= woop.wo_operation_id
AND opmat.work_order_id = woop.work_order_id
AND supply_type ='1'
) ,-1) MATERIAL_ICON_IND,
CASE DECODE(
(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT supplier_id) FROM wie_wo_osp_action_details WHERE document_type = 'PO'
AND status ='APPROVED'
AND wo_operation_id = woop.wo_operation_id
) ,0,'DEFAULT',1,'SINGLE','MULTIPLE')
WHEN 'DEFAULT'
THEN NULL
WHEN 'SINGLE'
THEN
(SELECT parties.party_name
FROM wie_wo_osp_action_details osp,
poz_suppliers supplier,
hz_parties parties
WHERE osp.wo_operation_id = woop.wo_operation_id
AND osp.document_type = 'PO'
AND osp.status ='APPROVED'
AND supplier.vendor_id = osp.supplier_id
AND parties.party_id = supplier.party_id
AND ROWNUM = 1
)
ELSE 'MULTIPLE'
END SUPPLIER,
CASE DECODE(
(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT supplier_site_id) FROM wie_wo_osp_action_details WHERE document_type = 'PO'
AND status ='APPROVED'
AND wo_operation_id = woop.wo_operation_id
) ,0,'DEFAULT',1,'SINGLE','MULTIPLE')
WHEN 'DEFAULT'
THEN NULL
WHEN 'SINGLE'
THEN
(SELECT site.vendor_site_code
FROM wie_wo_osp_action_details osp,
poz_supplier_sites_all_m site
WHERE osp.wo_operation_id = woop.wo_operation_id
AND osp.document_type = 'PO'
AND osp.status ='APPROVED'
AND site.vendor_site_id = osp.supplier_site_id
AND ROWNUM = 1
)
WHEN 'MULTIPLE'
THEN 'MULTIPLE'
END SUPPLIER_SITE,
CASE DECODE(
(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT supplier_site_id) FROM wie_wo_osp_action_details WHERE document_type = 'PO'
AND status ='APPROVED'
AND wo_operation_id = woop.wo_operation_id
) ,0,'DEFAULT',1,'SINGLE','MULTIPLE')
WHEN 'DEFAULT'
THEN NULL
WHEN 'SINGLE'
THEN
(SELECT DISTINCT osp.supplier_site_id
FROM wie_wo_osp_action_details osp
WHERE osp.wo_operation_id = woop.wo_operation_id
AND osp.document_type = 'PO'
AND osp.status ='APPROVED'
AND ROWNUM = 1
)
WHEN 'MULTIPLE'
THEN NULL
END VENDOR_SITE_ID,
wc.work_center_id WORK_CENTER_ID,
wc.work_area_id WORK_AREA_ID,
doo.header_id source_fulfill_header_id,
doo.fulfill_line_id source_fulfill_line_id,
woop.operation_name,
wwm.work_method_code,
wwm.work_method_name,
CASE
WHEN fl.lookup_code ='OPTIONAL'
THEN 'NONE'
WHEN (wwm.work_method_code='PROCESS_MANUFACTURING') OR ((wo.work_order_type = 'STANDARD' OR wo.work_order_type = 'NON_STANDARD') AND NVL(woop.count_point_operation_flag,'N') = 'Y')
THEN
(SELECT
CASE
WHEN ((MAX(NVL(output_quantity,0)-NVL(completed_quantity,0)) = 0) or (SIGN(MAX(NVL(output_quantity,0)-NVL(completed_quantity,0)))=-1))
THEN 'CHECKMARK'
WHEN MAX(1) IS NULL
THEN 'CIRCLE'
ELSE 'CHECKLIST'
END
FROM WIE_WO_OPERATION_OUTPUTS wwoo
WHERE wwoo.wo_operation_id=woop.wo_operation_id
AND completion_type ='MANUAL')
ELSE 'NONE'
END output_icon_ind,
NVL(woop.op_compl_with_under_issue,'ALLOW') op_compl_with_under_issue,
NVL(woop.op_compl_with_open_exceptions,'ALLOW') op_compl_with_open_exceptions,
NVL(woop.cumulative_scrap_quantity,0) cumulative_scrap_quantity,
wo.pjc_project_id PROJECT_ID,
wo.pjc_project_number PROJECT_NUMBER,
wo.pjc_task_id TASK_ID,
wo.pjc_task_number TASK_NUMBER,
wo.work_order_type WORK_ORDER_TYPE,
wo.preassign_lot_flag PREASSIGN_LOT_FLAG,
woop.execution_sequence EXECUTION_SEQUENCE,
woop.tollgate_op_seq_num TOLL_GATE_OP_SEQ_NUM,
wo.under_completed_flag UNDER_COMPLETED_FLAG
FROM wie_work_orders_b wo,
wie_wo_operations_vl woop,
wis_work_centers_b wc,
fnd_lookups fl,
dos_supply_tracking_lines dos,
doo_fulfill_lines_all doo,
wis_work_methods_vl wwm
WHERE wo.order_less_flag ='N'
AND wwm.work_method_code IN ('DISCRETE_MANUFACTURING','PROCESS_MANUFACTURING')
AND wo.work_order_status_id IN
(SELECT wost.wo_status_id
FROM wie_wo_statuses_b wost
WHERE wost.wo_system_status_code IN ('RELEASED', 'COMPLETED')
)
AND woop.work_order_id = wo.work_order_id
AND wo.work_method_id = wwm.work_method_id
AND woop.organization_id = wo.organization_id
AND woop.operation_type ='SUPPLIER'
AND wc.work_center_id = woop.work_center_id
AND wo.source_line_ref_id = dos.tracking_line_id (+)
AND dos.supply_order_reference_line_id = doo.fulfill_line_id (+)
AND fl.lookup_type = 'ORA_WIE_DISPATCH_STATE'
AND ( (woop.ready_quantity > 0
AND fl.lookup_code = 'READY')
OR(woop.completed_quantity > 0
AND fl.lookup_code = 'COMPLETE')
OR(woop.rejected_quantity > 0
AND fl.lookup_code = 'REJECT')
OR(woop.scrapped_quantity > 0
AND fl.lookup_code = 'SCRAP')
OR(fl.lookup_code = 'IN_PROCESS'
AND ( (NVL(woop.in_process_quantity,0) = 0
AND NVL(woop.po_requested_quantity,0) > NVL(woop.received_quantity,0))
OR (NVL(woop.in_process_quantity,0) > 0)
OR (NVL(woop.over_receipt_quantity,0) > 0)) ))

WWO.RELEASED_DATE RELEASED_DATE,

WWO.NETTABLE_SUPPLY_QTY_OVERRIDE NETTABLE_SUPPLY_QTY_OVERRIDE,
WWO.COMPLETED_QUANTITY COMPLETED_QUANTITY,
WWO.SCRAPPED_QUANTITY SCRAPPED_QUANTITY,

(SELECT MAX(OPERATION_SEQ_NUMBER) FROM WIE_WO_OPERATIONS_B OP WHERE OP.WORK_ORDER_ID=WWO.WORK_ORDER_ID) OPERATION_SEQ_NUMBER,
WWO.PLANNED_START_QUANTITY BATCH_QUANTITY,
WWO.UOM_CODE BATCH_UOM_CODE,
WWO.MNT_COMPLETE_TO_INV_FLAG MNT_COMPLETE_TO_INV_FLAG,
WWO.MNT_INCLUDE_IN_PLANNING_FLAG MNT_INCLUDE_IN_PLANNING_FLAG,
WWO.MNT_TRANSFORM_TO_ITEM_ID MNT_TRANSFORM_TO_ITEM_ID
FROM WIE_WORK_ORDERS_VL WWO,
WIE_WO_STATUSES_B WWS,
WIS_WORK_METHODS_B WWM
WHERE WWS.WO_STATUS_ID = WWO.WORK_ORDER_STATUS_ID
AND WWM.WORK_METHOD_ID = WWO.WORK_METHOD_ID
AND WWM.WORK_METHOD_CODE IN ('DISCRETE_MANUFACTURING','FLOW_MANUFACTURING')

WWO.WORK_ORDER_ID WORK_ORDER_ID,
WWO.WORK_ORDER_NUMBER WORK_ORDER_NUMBER,
WWO.WORK_ORDER_DESCRIPTION WORK_ORDER_DESCRIPTION,

WWM.WORK_METHOD_CODE WORK_METHOD_CODE,

WWO.WORK_ORDER_STATUS_ID WORK_ORDER_STATUS_ID,

WWS.WO_SYSTEM_STATUS_CODE SYSTEM_STATUS_CODE,
WWO.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID INVENTORY_ITEM_ID,
WWO.ITEM_REVISION ITEM_REVISION,
WWO.UOM_CODE UOM_CODE,
WWO.PLANNED_START_DATE PLANNED_START_DATE,
WWO.PLANNED_COMPLETION_DATE PLANNED_COMPLETION_DATE,
WWO.RELEASED_DATE RELEASED_DATE,
WWO.ACTUAL_START_DATE ACTUAL_START_DATE,
WWO.ACTUAL_COMPLETION_DATE ACTUAL_COMPLETION_DATE,
WWO.PLANNED_START_QUANTITY PLANNED_START_QUANTITY,
WWO.NETTABLE_SUPPLY_QTY_OVERRIDE NETTABLE_SUPPLY_QTY_OVERRIDE,
WWO.COMPLETED_QUANTITY COMPLETED_QUANTITY,
WWO.SCRAPPED_QUANTITY SCRAPPED_QUANTITY,
WWO.REJECTED_QUANTITY REJECTED_QUANTITY,
DECODE(WWS.WO_SYSTEM_STATUS_CODE, 'CANCELED', 0, 'CLOSED', 0, WWO.PLANNED_START_QUANTITY - (NVL(WWO.COMPLETED_QUANTITY,0) + NVL(WWO.SCRAPPED_QUANTITY,0))) SUPPLY_QUANTITY,
'Y' PRIMARY_FLAG,
(SELECT MAX(OPERATION_SEQ_NUMBER) FROM WIE_WO_OPERATIONS_B OP WHERE OP.WORK_ORDER_ID=WWO.WORK_ORDER_ID) OPERATION_SEQ_NUMBER,
WWO.PLANNED_START_QUANTITY BATCH_QUANTITY,
WWO.UOM_CODE BATCH_UOM_CODE,
WWO.MNT_COMPLETE_TO_INV_FLAG MNT_COMPLETE_TO_INV_FLAG,

WWO.MNT_TRANSFORM_TO_ITEM_ID MNT_TRANSFORM_TO_ITEM_ID
FROM WIE_WORK_ORDERS_VL WWO,
WIE_WO_STATUSES_B WWS,
WIS_WORK_METHODS_B WWM
WHERE WWS.WO_STATUS_ID = WWO.WORK_ORDER_STATUS_ID
AND WWM.WORK_METHOD_ID = WWO.WORK_METHOD_ID
AND WWM.WORK_METHOD_CODE = 'MAINTENANCE'
AND NVL(WWO.MNT_COMPLETE_TO_INV_FLAG,'N') = 'Y'
UNION ALL
SELECT WWO.ORGANIZATION_ID ORGANIZATION_ID,
WWO.WORK_ORDER_ID WORK_ORDER_ID,
WWO.WORK_ORDER_NUMBER WORK_ORDER_NUMBER,
WWO.WORK_ORDER_DESCRIPTION WORK_ORDER_DESCRIPTION,
WWO.WORK_METHOD_ID WORK_METHOD_ID,
WWM.WORK_METHOD_CODE WORK_METHOD_CODE,
WWO.WORK_ORDER_TYPE WORK_ORDER_TYPE,
WWO.WORK_ORDER_SUB_TYPE WORK_ORDER_SUB_TYPE,
WWO.WORK_ORDER_STATUS_ID WORK_ORDER_STATUS_ID,
WWS.WO_STATUS_CODE USER_STATUS_CODE,
WWS.WO_SYSTEM_STATUS_CODE SYSTEM_STATUS_CODE,
OUTPUTS.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID INVENTORY_ITEM_ID,
NULL ITEM_REVISION,
ITEM.PRIMARY_UOM_CODE UOM_CODE,
WOOP.PLANNED_START_DATE PLANNED_START_DATE,
WOOP.PLANNED_COMPLETION_DATE PLANNED_COMPLETION_DATE,
WWO.RELEASED_DATE RELEASED_DATE,

NULL NETTABLE_SUPPLY_QTY_OVERRIDE,
OUTPUTS.COMPLETED_QUANTITY COMPLETED_QUANTITY,
WOOP.SCRAPPED_QUANTITY SCRAPPED_QUANTITY,
NULL REJECTED_QUANTITY,
INV_CONVERT.INV_UM_CONVERT(OUTPUTS.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID,NULL,(OUTPUTS.OUTPUT_QUANTITY - (((NVL(WOOP.SCRAPPED_QUANTITY,0) + NVL(WOOP.CUMULATIVE_SCRAP_QUANTITY,0))/WWO.PLANNED_START_QUANTITY)*OUTPUTS.OUTPUT_QUANTITY + NVL(OUTPUTS.COMPLETED_QUANTITY,0))),OUTPUTS.UOM_CODE,ITEM.PRIMARY_UOM_CODE,NULL,NULL) SUPPLY_QUANTITY,

WWO.MNT_COMPLETE_TO_INV_FLAG MNT_COMPLETE_TO_INV_FLAG,

WWO.MNT_TRANSFORM_TO_ITEM_ID MNT_TRANSFORM_TO_ITEM_ID

columns.name: CONFORMANCE_PARAMETER_ID

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

objects.name: WIS_DISPENSE_RULES
objects.description: This table stores dispense rules definitions that determine when an item requires controlled dispensing for a manufacturing plant. Dispensing rules are evaluated using a hierarchy and can be defined at different levels: by item, by item and plant, or by item, plant, and work definition. Each dispensing rule includes the item, manufacturing plant (optional), work definition (optional), tolerance, dispensing UOM, and the associated dispense area.

columns.name: DISPENSE_RULE_ID
columns.comments: The unique identifier of a dispense rule. Its value is an application generated unique id.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.comments: Indicates the organization that represents the manufacturing plant for which this dispense rule is defined.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
columns.comments: Indicates the item for which this dispense rule is defined.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_FROM_DATE
columns.comments: Indicates the effective date from which the dispense rule applies.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_TO_DATE
columns.comments: Indicates the date until which the dispense rule remains effective.

columns.name: DISPENSE_REQUIRED_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates whether dispensing is required for the item or not. Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = YES_NO

columns.name: DISPENSE_AREA_ID
columns.comments: Indicates the dispense area from which dispensing is to be performed for this dispense rule.

columns.name: DISPENSE_UOM_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates the unit of measure code used for dispensing the material. This unit of measure has an existing conversion factor available to the primary unit of measure of the item.

columns.name: TOLERANCE_TYPE
columns.comments: Indicates the tolerance type used to evaluate completion of dispensing. Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = ORA_WIS_DS_TOLERANCE_TYPE.

columns.name: UPPER_TOLERANCE_LIMIT
columns.comments: Indicates the upper limit for dispense completion evaluation based on the tolerance type.

columns.name: LOWER_TOLERANCE_LIMIT
columns.comments: Indicates the lower limit for dispense completion evaluation based on the tolerance type.

columns.name: MATERIAL_ISSUE_TYPE
columns.comments: Indicates the material issue used to evaluate completion of dispensing. Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = ORA_WIS_DS_MATERIAL_ISSUE_TYPE.

columns.name: INSTRUCTION_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.comments: Identifier of the dispense instruction template associated with the dispense rule. Represents foreign key to PER_CHECKLISTS_B.

columns.name: RETURN_INSTRUCTION_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.comments: Identifier of the return dispense instruction template associated with the dispense rule. Represents foreign key to PER_CHECKLISTS_B.

columns.name: DEFAULT_BOOTH_ID
columns.comments: Indicates the default dispense booth identifier for the dispense rule.

columns.name: APPROVAL_STATUS_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates the approval status of the dispense rule. Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = ORA_WIS_ERES_APPROVAL_STATUS. Default value is APPROVED(E-Signature is not enabled).

objects.name: WIS_ITEM_LEADTIMES_GT
objects.description: This is a global temporary table that stores calculated lead times used as part of the calculate manufacturing and cumulative lead time process.

columns.name: JOB_REQUEST_ID
columns.comments: Represents the request ID of the job that created the row.

columns.name: ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.comments: The organization identifier that represents the manufacturing plant to which this item belongs.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
columns.comments: Represents the top level, final assembly, subassembly, or model item which belongs to the given organization.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ITEM_NUMBER
columns.comments: Represents the user key to the top level, final assembly, subassembly, or model item which belongs to the given organization.

columns.name: ITEM_RANGE_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag to indicate if the item is part of a range given in the calculate lead time job parameters.

columns.name: MAKE_BUY_CODE
columns.comments: Code to indicate if the item is usually manufactured or bought.

columns.name: WORK_DEFINITION_ID
columns.comments: The unique identifier of a work definition.

columns.name: WORK_DEF_NAME
columns.comments: Indicates the name of the work definition.

columns.name: WORK_DEFINITION_HEADER_NAME
columns.comments: Indicates the unique name for the work definition. In the case of process manufacturing, this represents the process name.

columns.name: VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Indicates the version of the work definition.

columns.name: PREPROCESSING_LEAD_TIME
columns.comments: Represents the days which must be added to purchasing or manufacturing lead time to place an order.

columns.name: PROCESSING_LEAD_TIME
columns.comments: Represents the days required to procure or manufacture an item.

columns.name: POSTPROCESSING_LEAD_TIME
columns.comments: Represents the days required to receive a purchased item into inventory from the initial supplier receipt.

columns.name: FIXED_LEAD_TIME
columns.comments: Represents the days required to make an assembly independent of order quantity, such as setup or tear down time.

columns.name: VARIABLE_LEAD_TIME
columns.comments: Represents the days required to produce one additional unit of an assembly.

columns.name: CUMULATIVE_MFG_LEAD_TIME
columns.comments: Represents manufacturing lead time of an assembly (in days) plus the largest adjusted cumulative manufacturing lead time of its components, where each is adjusted by subtracting the operation lead time offset.

columns.name: CUMULATIVE_TOTAL_LEAD_TIME
columns.comments: Represents total lead time of the assembly plus the largest adjusted cumulative total lead time of its components, where each is adjusted by subtracting the operation lead time offset.

columns.name: LEAD_TIME_LOT_SIZE
columns.comments: Represents quantity used to compute processing lead time.

columns.name: UNIT_OF_MEASURE
columns.comments: Represents the unit of measure of the lead time lot size.

columns.name: ERROR_TEXT
columns.comments: Represents the translated error text for a failure that occurred during lead time calculation.

objects.name: WIS_ITEM_STRUCTURE_EVENTS
objects.description: This table stores the item structure change events that are raised by the product information management (PIM) application when an item structure is modified.

columns.name: ITEM_STRUCTURE_EVENT_ID
columns.comments: The unique identifier of the item structure event. Its value is an application generated unique id.

columns.name: EVENT_DATE
columns.comments: Indicates the date when the event was raised from within the product information management (PIM) application.

columns.name: EVENT_ENTITY
columns.comments: Indicates the product information management (PIM) entity that triggered this event (i.e. structure header, components, substitutes, or reference designator).

columns.name: EVENT_TYPE
columns.comments: Indicates the action that triggered this event (i.e. Add, Modify, or Delete).

columns.name: PROCESSED_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates whether this event has been processed or not.

columns.name: BILL_SEQUENCE_ID
columns.comments: Represents the unique identifier of the item structure record for which this event has been raised.

columns.name: COMPONENT_SEQUENCE_ID
columns.comments: Represents the unique identifier of the item structure component for which this event has been raised.

columns.name: ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.comments: Represents the organization of the item structure for which this event has been raised.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
columns.comments: Represents the unique identifier of the item for which the event has been raised.

columns.name: SYNCHRONIZATION_REQUEST_ID
columns.comments: Indicates the request identifier of the work definition synchronization ESS job that processes this item structure event record.

columns.name: WORK_DEFINITION_ID
columns.comments: Represents the unique identifier of the work definition for which this event has been raised.

columns.name: ORIG_ITEM_STRUCTURE_EVENT_ID
columns.comments: Represents the original item structure event identifier from which this event was raised.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ITEM_ID

columns.name: SUBINVENTORY_CODE

columns.name: LOCATOR_ID
columns.comments: Represents the identifier of the item locator.

columns.comments: Indicates the type of kanban card. Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = ORA_WIS_KANBAN_CARD_TYPE.

columns.name: SOURCE_ORGANIZATION_ID

columns.name: SOURCE_SUBINVENTORY_CODE

columns.name: SOURCE_LOCATOR_ID

columns.name: SUPPLIER_ID

columns.name: SUPPLIER_SITE_ID

columns.name: KANBAN_SIZE

columns.name: CURRENT_REPLENISHMENT_CYCLE_ID

columns.name: PRODUCTION_LINE_ID

columns.name: MAX_REPLENISHMENTS

columns.name: INACTIVE_DATE

columns.name: EXPECTED_DELIVERY_DATE
columns.comments: Calculated expected delivery date and time for the Kanban card. Calculated when the card moves to In Process. The date portion can be used for PO/TO need-by date.

objects.name: WIS_KANBAN_PULL_SEQUENCES
objects.description: This table stores Kanban information indicating how items should be replenished by a given replenishment type.

columns.name: PULL_SEQUENCE_ID
columns.comments: The unique identifier of the Kanban pull sequence. Its value is an application-generated unique ID.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.comments: The organization identifier represents the manufacturing plant to which this Kanban pull sequence belongs.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
columns.comments: Represents the unique identifier of the item to be replenished using this defined Kanban pull sequence.

columns.name: SUBINVENTORY_CODE
columns.comments: Represents the name of the subinventory.

columns.name: LOCATOR_ID
columns.comments: Represents the identifier of the item locator.

columns.name: SOURCE_TYPE
columns.comments: Represents the source from where the item should be replenished. Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = ORA_WIS_KANBAN_SOURCE_TYPE.

columns.name: SOURCE_ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.comments: Represents the identifier of the organization from which the replenishment is sourced according to the specified source type value.

columns.name: SOURCE_SUBINVENTORY_CODE
columns.comments: Represents the name of the subinventory from which the replenishment is sourced according to the specified source type value.

columns.name: SOURCE_LOCATOR_ID
columns.comments: Represents the identifier of the item locator from which the replenishment is sourced according to the specified source type value.

columns.name: KANBAN_SIZE
columns.comments: Indicates the quantity of the Kanban.

columns.name: NUMBER_OF_CARDS
columns.comments: Indicates the number of Kanban cards.

columns.name: REPLENISHMENT_LEAD_TIME
columns.comments: Indicates the amount of time required to replenish Kanban.

columns.name: PRODUCTION_LINE_ID
columns.comments: Represents the identifier of a production line. It is a foreign key to the WIS_PRODUCTION_LINES_B table.

columns.name: CONSOLIDATION_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag used to indicate consolidation option for cards of pull sequence. Valid values are Y or N.

columns.name: CONSOLIDATION_GROUP_CODE
columns.comments: Represents the consolidation group used to consolidate Kanban cards.

columns.name: KANBAN_CALCULATION_METHOD
columns.comments: Represents what is to be calculated, such as Kanban size or number of cards. Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = ORA_WIS_KANBAN_CALC_METHOD.

columns.name: KANBAN_PLAN_ID
columns.comments: A unique identifier for the Kanban plan associated to the pull sequences.

columns.name: LAST_IMPLEMENTED_PLAN_ID
columns.comments: Represents the unique identifier of the Kanban plan that is implemented on the pull sequence.

columns.name: PLAN_EFFECTIVITY_DATE
columns.comments: Represents the date on which the plan is implemented or published.

columns.name: PLAN_START_DATE
columns.comments: Represents the start date chosen while running the plan.

columns.name: PLAN_END_DATE
columns.comments: Represents the demand cutoff date chosen while running the plan.

columns.name: SAFETY_STOCK_DAYS
columns.comments: Number of days of safety stock maintained to avoid inventory shortages.

columns.name: ALLOCATION_PERCENT
columns.comments: Allocation percentage of average daily demand that needs to be associated to the pull sequences.

columns.name: AVG_DAILY_DEMAND
columns.comments: Average daily demand calculated based on the Kanban plan run.

columns.name: ENABLE_DELIVERY_SCHEDULES_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating whether delivery schedule logic should be used for this pull sequence. Valid values are Y/N. Defaulted to N for backward compatibility.

columns.name: DELIVERY_SCHEDULE_ID
columns.comments: Represents the optional identifier of the delivery schedule used for the pull sequence. It is a foreign key to the WIS_KBN_DELIVERY_SCHEDULES_B table. If null and schedules are enabled, use the organization default schedule.

objects.name: WIS_KBN_PLAN_LOWLEVEL_CODES_GT
objects.description: This is a global temporary table that stores the low level codes for each item/location combination that is planned. The column LEVELS_BELOW stores the number of levels in the bill of material that exist beneath a given item. The column LOW_LEVEL_CODE is populated based on where an item or item/location combination occurs in the bill of material/ kanban replenishment chain. This table is then used by the Kanban planning engine to determine the demand flow from an item/location combination to the component item/location combination(s).

columns.name: TEMPORARY_ROW_ID
columns.comments: The unique identifier of the Kanban plan low level codes record.

columns.name: KANBAN_PLAN_ID
columns.comments: The unique identifier assigned to each Kanban plan within the system. It's a foreign key to the WIS_KANBAN_PLANS_B table.

columns.name: ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.comments: The organization identifier represents the manufacturing plant to which this Kanban demand belongs.

columns.name: COMPONENT_ITEM_ID
columns.comments: Represents the unique identifier of the component item.

columns.name: ASSEMBLY_ITEM_ID
columns.comments: Represents the unique identifier of the parent item of the component.

columns.name: COMPONENT_SUBINVENTORY_CODE
columns.comments: Represents the name of the subinventory where the component item is stored or managed.

columns.name: COMPONENT_LOCATOR_ID
columns.comments: Represents the identifier of the locator of the component item.

columns.name: FROM_SUBINVENTORY_CODE
columns.comments: Represents the name of the source subinventory in an intra-organization replenishment chain.

columns.name: FROM_LOCATOR_ID
columns.comments: Represents the identifier of the source locator in an intra-organization replenishment chain.

columns.name: LOW_LEVEL_CODE
columns.comments: Arbitrary number associated to the component in the BOM by level in the BOM hierarchy.

columns.name: LEVELS_BELOW
columns.comments: Represents the levels beneath this component in the BOM.

columns.name: COMPONENT_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Represents the quantity of component in bill of material.

columns.name: COMPONENT_YIELD_FACTOR
columns.comments: Represents the yield of component in bill of material.

columns.name: PLANNING_FACTOR
columns.comments: Represents the planning percentage of component in bill of material.

columns.name: KANBAN_ITEM_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag to indicate if this item is replenished using Kanbans. Valid values are Y/N.

columns.name: OPERATION_YIELD
columns.comments: Represents the operation yield of the operation to which this item is associated in the work definition.

columns.name: WIP_SUPPLY_TYPE
columns.comments: Indicates the supply type code of the item. Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = EGP_WIP_SUP_TYPE.

columns.name: BASIS_TYPE
columns.comments: Indicates whether the item quantity is fixed (i.e. quantity per lot produced) or variable (i.e. quantity per item produced). Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = EGP_BOM_BASIS_TYPE.

columns.name: ASSEMBLY_WORK_DEFINITION_ID
columns.comments: Reference to the work definition to which this item is associated.

columns.name: COMPONENT_SEQUENCE_ID
columns.comments: Reference to the item structure component (EGP_COMPONENTS_B).

objects.name: WIS_RULE_EXPRESSION_NODES
objects.description: This table stores the operation applicability rule in the form of an expression tree. This is an internal representation of the rule to allow the conditions to be evaluated efficiently.

columns.name: RULE_ID
columns.comments: The unique identifier of the rule to which this expression node belongs.

columns.name: SEQUENCE_NUMBER
columns.comments: Indicates the evaluation order of this node in the expression tree.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: PARENT_SEQUENCE_NUMBER
columns.comments: Indicates the parent sequence number of this expression node. If the expression node is the root node, then this column will be null.

columns.name: NODE_TYPE
columns.comments: Indicates the type of the node. Valid values are: - OPERATOR - TIA - KEYWORD - ITEM - VALUE

columns.name: TIA_NAME
columns.comments: If this node is of type TIA, this indicates the internal name of the transaction item attribute (TIA).

columns.name: DATA_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates the data type of the constant. Valid values are: - N (Numeric) - S (String)

columns.name: VALUE
columns.comments: If this node is of type VALUE, this indicates the alphanumeric representation of the value of the node.

columns.name: VALUE_NUMBER
columns.comments: If this node is of type VALUE and the data type of the constant value is numeric, this indicates the numeric representation of the value of the node.

columns.name: OPERATOR_CODE
columns.comments: If this node is of type OPERATOR, this indicates the operator code.

columns.name: KEYWORD_CODE
columns.comments: If this node is of type KEYWORD, this indicates the keyword code.

columns.name: COMPONENT_ITEM_HIERARCHY
columns.comments: If this node refers to an item or to a transaction item attribute (TIA), then this column holds the concatenated inventory item ids of this component's ancestors. The last element in the path represents the referenced item. If this is a root node, this column holds the inventory item id of the top-level item node.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
columns.comments: Indicates the id of the item if this node refers to an item or to a transaction item attribute (TIA).

columns.name: ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.comments: Indicates the organization id. This is part of the foreign key to the item if this node refers to an item or to a transaction item attribute (TIA).

objects.description: This table stores the default values for the simplified setups for common work setup business objects. The defaults for the following business objects are contained in this table. 1. Work Area 2. Work Center 3. Equipment Resource 4. Labor Resource Using the quick setup functionality, an application implementation consultant will be able to create setup business objects when a new plant is configured.

columns.name: SETUP_OBJECT_ID
columns.comments: The unique identifier of a setup object default. Its value is an application generated unique id.

columns.name: SETUP_OBJECT_NAME
