columns.name: SERVICE_WIP_FLAG
columns.comments: This column is stamped only for transactions associated to maintenance work orders. This indicates if this transaction is to be costed as Service WIP in place of maintenance expense.

columns.name: DEBRIEF_LINE_ID
columns.comments: This column is stamped only for transactions associated to maintenance work orders from RCL (Service Logistics). This identifies the debrief line id.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.comments: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.comments: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.comments: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: TRADE_AGREEMENT_FTR_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the financial trade relationship of the trade event linked to this transaction.

columns.name: TRADE_AGREEMENT_TYPE
columns.comments: To be used by the accounting template instead of transaction_flow_type. Populate this for all SFO related physical transactions (even when we do not explicitly call SFO).

columns.name: TRADE_AGREEMENT_NUMBER
columns.comments: Required for interorganization shipment, SO Issue, RMA receipt to identify that it is SFO related. All these cases call SFO to figure it out.

columns.name: SUCCESSOR_INVENTORY_ORG_ID
columns.comments: Required for SO issue, interorganization shipment, TO shipment to provide as a source in SLA because accounting of this hits trade in-transit.

columns.name: SUCCESSOR_BUSINESS_UNIT_ID
columns.comments: Required for SO Issue, interorganization shipment, TO shipment to provide as a source in SLA because accounting of this hits trade in-transit.

columns.name: PRIOR_INVENTORY_ORG_ID
columns.comments: Required for direct interorganization receipt to provide as a source in SLA because accounting of this hits trade intransit (as there is no receiving involved here).

columns.name: PRIOR_BUSINESS_UNIT_ID
columns.comments: Required for direct interorganization receipt to provide as a source in SLA because accounting of this hits trade intransit (as there is no receiving involved here).

columns.name: TRANSFER_ORDER_LINE_ID
columns.comments: Required for all transfer order transactions.

columns.name: TRANSFER_ORDER_DISTRIBUTION_ID
columns.comments: Required for transfer order related receipts. Where it does not come from the interface, qty preprocessor will derive it based on ascending order of distribution identifier (to keep it in sync with how Inventory derives it).

columns.name: TRANSACTION_GROUP_ID
columns.comments: Used to group related transactions together.

columns.name: TRANSFER_TRANSACTION_GROUP_ID
columns.comments: The transaction group whose average cost is required to process this transaction.

columns.name: PRICING_OPTION
columns.comments: Pricing Option identifier. It signifies whether the option is to use the PO price (1), transfer price (2) or the cost + markup (3) as the transfer cost.

columns.name: PARENT_TRANSACTION_ID
columns.comments: The parent transaction identifier if this is a logical transaction.

columns.name: TRANSFER_PERCENTAGE
columns.comments: Percentage of value to attribute to transfer costs in an interorganization transfer.

columns.name: CONSIGNED_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates whether the transaction is consigned or owned.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_RECEIPT_TXN_ID
columns.comments: Reference of the original receipt transaction ID (Deliver transaction ID) on the inter org receipt transactions. This is required to find the purchase order delivery to which the inter org receipt is linked to.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_RECEIPT_NUMBER
columns.comments: This column is used for valuation unit generation and is the combination of receipt number and the inventory org code.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_RECEIPT_INV_ORG_ID
columns.comments: The Inventory organization where the original receipt of consigned goods was received.

columns.name: CUSTODY_INVENTORY_ORG_ID
columns.comments: Inventory org where the goods are physically present. This attribute would have a value for scenarios when purchased goods are transferred without ownership change and ownership change happens in transferee org. Stamped on Inter org issue transactions.

columns.name: CONTINGENT_OWNER_TYPE
columns.comments: Represents the party type who bears the risk for the goods in custody. This is the party type who will be the owner on ownership change. Values: SUPPLIER, INVENTORY_ORG.

columns.name: CONTINGENT_OWNER_ID
columns.comments: Represents the party who bears the risk for the goods in custody. This is the party who will be the owner on ownership change. Party Type = SUPPLIER, represents the supplier site ID; Party Type = INVENTORY_ORG, represents the inventory org ID.

columns.name: OWNER_TYPE
columns.comments: This is the party that transfers the ownership to the org where the ownership change happens. Values: 1 is SUPPLIER, 2 is INVENTORY_ORG, null is for non-consigned scenario.

columns.name: OWNING_ENTITY_ID
columns.comments: This is the party that transfers the ownership to the org where the ownership change happens. Owner Type = SUPPLIER, represents the supplier site ID; Owner type = INVENTORY_ORG, represents the inventory org id.

columns.name: OWNER_NAME
columns.comments: The owner code that is used in the valuation unit generation.

columns.name: TRANSFER_TO_REGULAR_TXN_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the transfer to regular transaction that is being returned. This is only populated for transfer to consigned transactions.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CONVERSION_RATE
columns.comments: The conversion rate from the entered currency on the purchase order to the functional currency of the Bill to business unit on the purchase order.

columns.name: CALLBACK_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates if SFO api needs to be called to send the cost to SFO so that next node cost be sent back to costing. Values are N - call back not done yet, Y - call back done, NULL - not applicable.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_INTERFACE_LINE_NUM
columns.comments: Identifies the inventory transaction when entered via the interface.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.comments: Used by Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_INTERFACE_ID
columns.comments: Transaction Identifier from INV_TRANSACTIONS_INTERFACE.

columns.name: SOURCE_SALES_ORDER_NUMBER
columns.comments: Sales order number from shipping.

columns.name: SOURCE_SALES_ORDER_LINE_NUMBER
columns.comments: Sales order line number from shipping.

columns.name: SOURCE_SO_SHIPMENT_NUMBER
columns.comments: Sales order shipment number from shipping.

columns.name: SALES_ORDER_SOURCE_SYSTEM
columns.comments: This column stores source of the sales order document.

columns.name: RECEIPT_ADVICE_NUMBER
columns.comments: This is used has identifier for Sales order RMA transaction.

columns.name: RECEIPT_ADVICE_LINE_NUMBER
columns.comments: This is used has line identifier for Sales order RMA transaction.

columns.name: REFERENCED_SO_NUMBER
columns.comments: This column stores the Referenced sales order number for Sales order RMA transaction.

columns.name: REFERENCED_SO_LINE_NUMBER
columns.comments: Referenced sales order line number.

columns.name: CST_TRANSFER_ORDER_LINE_ID
columns.comments: Transfer order line identifier (FK to CST_TRANSFER_ORDER_LINES).

columns.name: CST_TRANSFER_ORDER_DIST_ID
columns.comments: Transfer Order distribution identifier (FK to CST_TRANSFER_ORDER_DISTS).

columns.name: INV_TRANSFER_ORDER_HEADER_ID
columns.comments: Transfer order header unique identifier.

columns.name: INV_TRANSFER_ORDER_LINE_ID
columns.comments: Transfer order line identifier and every transfer order related transaction must have this.

columns.name: INV_TRANSFER_ORDER_DIST_ID
columns.comments: Transfer Order distribution identifier.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_TO_SHIPMENT_TXN_ID
columns.comments: For return shipment transactions, this references the original forward flow transaction id.

columns.name: MANUAL_RECEIPT_REQD_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag to denote Manual receipt is created or not for transfer to expense destination.

columns.name: REFERENCE_DOO_FULLFILL_LINE_ID
columns.comments: Referenced fulfillment line identifier.

columns.name: SHIPPING_INV_ORG_ID
columns.comments: Original Shipping Inventory Org. Only populated for forward and return IDS and CDS flows.

columns.name: SHIPPING_BU_ID
columns.comments: Profit Center Business Unit of Original Shipping Inventory Org. Only populated for forward and return IDS and CDS flows.

columns.name: RETURN_INV_ORG_ID
columns.comments: Inventory org of return receipt.

columns.name: RETURN_BU_ID
columns.comments: Profit Center Business Unit of Inventory Org where the return receipt.

columns.name: REFERENCED_RETURN_FLAG
columns.comments: Possible values Y/N/NULL. Mainly used in R13 for referenced RMA. May be used for more flows later. Y means return is a referenced return. N means it is unreferenced. NULL means that it is a pre-R13 return flow or this column is not applicable for the flow.

columns.name: TXN_CHAINED_FLAG
columns.comments: Possible values Y/N/NULL. Y/NULL means that chaining is completed. N means chaining not yet done.

columns.name: QPP_TXN_GROUPS_UPDATED_FLAG
columns.comments: Processing flag to support the update of the TRANSACTION_GROUP_ID and TRANSFER_TRANSACTION_GROUP_ID columns. Values are Y - Yes, N - No.

columns.name: SIMPLE_PROC_FLAG
columns.comments: Whether the Dropship Delivery is for Simple Procurement (Y) or for Global Procurement flow (N).

columns.name: CONSUMPTION_UNIT_PRICE
columns.comments: Transfer to owned transaction unit price.

columns.name: WO_OUTPUT_TYPE
columns.comments: Type of output produced on a process manufacturing work order. Valid values exist in the lookup ORA_WIS_WD_OUTPUT_MATERIAL.

columns.name: PRIMARY_PRODUCT_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates whether this is the primary output for the work order. Valid values are Y or N.

columns.name: WO_COST_ALLOCATION_BASIS
columns.comments: The basis for cost allocation for output items in a process manufacturing work order. It can be either percentage or fixed value. Valid values exist in lookup ORA_WIS_COST_ALLOC_BASIS.

columns.name: INV_STRIPING_CATEGORY
columns.comments: Segment used to identify the descriptive flexfield application context for Inventory striping attributes.

columns.name: PROJECT_ID
columns.comments: Identifier of the project used to stripe Inventory transactions.

columns.name: TASK_ID
columns.comments: Identifier of the task used to stripe Inventory transactions.

columns.name: COUNTRY_OF_ORIGIN_CODE
columns.comments: Code for the country of manufacture used to stripe Inventory transactions.

columns.name: WMS_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates whether the transaction is WMS reconciliation.

columns.name: TRANSFER_PROJECT_ID
columns.comments: Transfer Project identifier used in project transfer transactions.

columns.name: TRANSFER_TASK_ID
columns.comments: Transfer Task identifier used in project transfer transactions.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_RETURN_HEADER_ID
columns.comments: Unique identifier for supplier return header.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_RETURN_LINE_ID
columns.comments: Unique identifier for supplier return line.

columns.name: RECALL_HEADER_ID
columns.comments: Unique identifier for recall header.

columns.name: RECALL_LINE_ID
columns.comments: Unique identifier for recall line.

columns.name: PARENT_ID
columns.comments: This column identifies source and resultant transaction group for lot merge, translate and split flows.

columns.name: SOURCE_LOT_FLAG
columns.comments: To identify source transactions for lot merge, translate and split flows. Values: (Y) for Source transaction, (N) for resultant transaction and null in case of other flows.

columns.name: REF_RCV_TRANSACTION_ID
columns.comments: This column identifies the receiving transaction identifier for Shipment and Receipt transactions in the Internal Material Transfers forward and return flows.

columns.name: ASSEMBLY_ASSET_ID
columns.comments: The work order asset for which the material transactions are performed.

columns.name: PO_LINE_LOCATION_ID
columns.comments: Purchase order shipment schedule identifier.

columns.name: CONTRIBUTE_TO_YIELD_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag used to indicate if this component should contribute to yield calculation in the manufacturing process.

columns.name: BATCH_UOM_CONVERSION_RATE
columns.comments: Represents the conversion factor used to translate the quantity in transaction UOM into the batch UOM for calculated batch work orders.

columns.name: MATERIAL_SEQ_NUMBER
columns.comments: Represents the order of consumption of material for a given operation.

columns.name: BASIS_TYPE
columns.comments: Indicates whether the item quantity is fixed (i.e. quantity per lot produced) or variable (i.e. quantity per item produced). Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = EGP_BOM_BASIS_TYPE.

columns.name: QUANTITY_TRACKED
columns.comments: Indicates whether onhand item quantity is tracked for cost calculations. Valid values are Yes = NULL, No = 'N'.

columns.name: ITEM_GRADE_CODE
columns.comments: This indicates the material grade for the item.

columns.name: ITEM_EXPIRATION_DATE
columns.comments: This is the date of expiration for the item.

columns.name: FISCAL_DOC_HEADER_ID

columns.name: FISCAL_DOC_ACCESS_KNUM
columns.comments: This column stores the access key number corresponding to the fiscal document.

columns.name: FISCAL_DOC_LINE_ID
columns.comments: This column stores the unique identifier for the fiscal document line.

columns.name: REF_FISCAL_DOC_HEADER_ID
columns.comments: This column stores the unique identifier for the reference fiscal document header.

columns.name: REF_FISCAL_DOC_LINE_ID
columns.comments: This column stores the unique identifier for the reference fiscal document line.

columns.name: REF_FISCAL_DOC_ACCESS_KNUM
columns.comments: This column stores the access key number corresponding to the reference fiscal document.

columns.name: FISCAL_DOC_SCHEDULE_ID
columns.comments: This column stores the unique identifier for the fiscal document schedule.

columns.name: REF_FISCAL_DOC_SCHEDULE_ID
columns.comments: This column stores the unique identifier for the reference fiscal document schedule.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_SYSTEM_REFERENCE
columns.comments: Identifies the external source system. In case of inventory transfers it is CST with parent transaction identifier relating to original row.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_SYSTEM_REF_ID
columns.comments: Stores a value that uniquely identifies a certain instance of an object within the external system.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ORG_ID
columns.comments: Indicates The Inventory Org To Which The Item Belongs.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
columns.comments: Surrogate key that identifies Inventory Item.

columns.name: BASE_TXN_TYPE_ID
columns.comments: Inventory transaction type identifier. For origin as INV the value comes from INV_TRANSACTION_TYPES_TL table.

columns.name: BASE_TXN_SOURCE_TYPE_ID
columns.comments: Inventory transaction source type identifier. For origin as INV the value comes from INV_TXN_SOURCE_TYPES_TL table, but a custom source type is treated as INVENTORY (value>100 is brought in as 13), and for CST it comes from Lookup type CST_BASE_TXN_SOURCE_TYPES.

columns.name: INV_TXN_SOURCE_TYPE_ID
columns.comments: Transaction source type identifier including custom source types.

columns.name: BASE_TXN_ACTION_ID
columns.comments: Inventory transaction action identifier. For Origin as INV, the value comes from lookup INV_TRANSACTION_ACTIONS and for Origin as CST the value is from lookup type CST_BASE_TXN_ACTIONS.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_DATE
columns.comments: The date when this transaction happened.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_CREATION_DATE
columns.comments: Date when the Transaction was created.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_TIMEZONE_CODE
columns.comments: Timezone code based on transaction date.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_QTY
columns.comments: Transaction Quantity in transaction unit of measure.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_UOM_CODE
columns.comments: The unit of measure code in which transaction quantity is specified

columns.name: PRIMARY_QTY
columns.comments: Transaction Quantity in Primary unit of measure.

columns.name: PRIMARY_UOM_CODE
columns.comments: The unit of measure code in which primary transaction quantity is specified.

columns.name: SECONDARY_TRANSACTION_QTY
columns.comments: Transaction Quantity in Secondary unit of measure.

columns.name: SECONDARY_TRANSACTION_UOM_CODE
columns.comments: The unit of measure code in which secondary transaction quantity is specified.

columns.name: SUBINVENTORY_CODE
columns.comments: The subinventory code where the item is stored.

columns.name: LOCATOR_ID
columns.comments: Surrogate key that identifies Inventory locator.

columns.name: INTRANSIT_FLAG
columns.comments: Identifies whether or not this is an intransit logical transaction created by Cost Preprocessor.

columns.name: TXN_GROUP_ID
columns.comments: Stamped to identify the set of transactions that are being processed.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_REASON_ID
columns.comments: Surrogate key that identifies Transaction Reason.

columns.name: TRANSFER_TRANSACTION_ID
columns.comments: Transaction id of the opposing transfer transaction.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_TRANSACTION_TEMP_ID
columns.comments: Transaction Temp Id that was generated when the Inventory transaction was saved.

columns.name: TRANSFER_INVENTORY_ORG_ID
columns.comments: Transfer opposing inventory organization id.

columns.name: TRANSFER_SUBINVENTORY_CODE
columns.comments: Subinventory name for the other leg of transfer transaction.

columns.name: TRANSFER_LOCATOR_ID
columns.comments: Inventory location identifier for the other leg of transfer transaction.

columns.name: ORIG_TRANSFER_INVENTORY_ORG_ID
columns.comments: The transfer transaction identifier as stamped on the transaction.

columns.name: EXPENSE_TRANSACTION_FLAG
columns.comments: Identifies whether a transaction is an asset or expense transaction.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_TEMP_ID
columns.comments: Transaction Temp Id generated before Transaction Manager processes this record.

columns.name: FOB_POINT
columns.comments: Indicates the Free on-board point and determines the point of transfer of liability/ownership. It is 1 for SHIPMENT and 2 for RECEIPT.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_FLOW_TYPE
columns.comments: Transaction Flow Identifier, 1 - Internal Drop Shipment, 2 - Global Procurement, 3 - Customer Drop Shipment, 4 - Intransit Interorg Transfer, 5 - Direct Interorg Transfer, 6 - Intraorg Transfer, 7 - Transfer Order Intransit Interorg Transfer, 8 - Transfer Order Direct Interorg Transfer, 9 - Transfer Order Intraorg Transfer, 10 - TIR/TIRR at ownership change in procuring org for consigned PO, 11 - TIRR of TO Return with Scrap or null for others.

columns.name: INTERNAL_PROFIT_TRACKING
columns.comments: This column is used by Costing and the values it can hold are 'Y' and 'N'. It indicates whether or not to track profit in inventory.

columns.name: INTERCOMPANY_INVOICING_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates whether the transaction is eligible for intercompany invoicing or not.

columns.name: INTERFACE_BATCH_NUMBER
columns.comments: Batch Number of External Systems interface run. Added to facilitate source system to identify which transactions were sent in which run on the source system.

columns.name: INTERFACE_BATCH_NAME
columns.comments: Batch Name of External Systems interface run.

columns.name: BUSINESS_UNIT_ID
columns.comments: Business Unit Id of the Inventory Organization.

columns.name: TRANSFER_CST_INV_TXN_ID
columns.comments: Source inventory transaction identifying the other leg of transfer transaction.

columns.name: ADDN_TXN_CREATED_FLAG
columns.comments: The flag specifies whether the intransit transactions has been created by the parent transaction. Valid values for the flag are (U)nprocessed, (N)ot yet created, Null : Child transaction has been created or the flag is not applicable to this transaction.

columns.name: TRANSFER_LINKED_FLAG
columns.comments: Specifies whether this transfer transaction has been chained to the other leg of transfer. Values are (U)nprocessed, (N)ot yet, Null : linked or column not applicable for this transaction.

columns.name: RCV_TRANSACTION_ID
columns.comments: Surrogate key that identifies Receiving transaction.

columns.name: PO_DISTRIBUTION_ID
columns.comments: Surrogate key that identifies Purchasing distribution.

columns.name: WSH_DELIVERY_DETAIL_ID
columns.comments: Surrogate key that identifies Shipping delivery detail.

columns.name: DOO_FULLFILL_LINE_ID

columns.name: CODE_COMBINATION_ID

columns.name: CST_WORK_ORDER_OPERATION_ID
columns.comments: Surrogate ID identifying a work order operation in costing.

columns.name: CST_WO_OPERATION_TXN_ID
columns.comments: Surrogate ID identifying the manufacturing operation transaction creating the material transaction.

columns.name: REWORK_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating whether the material transaction needs to be considered for rework as part of the operation where it is being reported. Valid values: Y, N, or NULL (treated as N).

columns.name: WORK_ORDER_ID
columns.comments: Surrogate ID identifying a work order in manufacturing.

columns.name: SUPPLY_TYPE
columns.comments: The various supply types are Assembly Pull, Operation Pull, Push, and Phantom. This list will have to be seeded as lookups with the type EGP_WIP_SUP_TYPE.

columns.name: WORK_ORDER_OPERATION_ID
columns.comments: Surrogate ID identifying an operation within a work order.

columns.name: WORK_CENTER_ID
columns.comments: Surrogate ID identifying Work Center where the operation is executed.

columns.name: WO_OPERATION_TRANSACTION_ID
columns.comments: Surrogate ID identifying a work order operation transaction that generated this material transaction.

columns.comments: Transactions Source Document Type.

columns.name: TXN_SOURCE_DOC_NUMBER
columns.comments: Transactions Source Document Number.

columns.comments: Transactions Source Documents Reference Document Type.

columns.name: TXN_SOURCE_REF_DOC_NUMBER
columns.comments: Transactions Source Documents Reference Document Number.

columns.name: TO_GRADE_CODE

columns.name: SERVICE_WIP_FLAG
columns.comments: This column is stamped only for transactions associated to maintenance work orders. This indicates if this transaction is to be costed as Service WIP in place of maintenance expense.

columns.name: DEBRIEF_LINE_ID
columns.comments: This column is stamped only for transactions associated to maintenance work orders from RCL (Service Logistics). This identifies the debrief line id.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.comments: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.comments: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.comments: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: TRADE_AGREEMENT_FTR_ID
columns.comments: Financial agreement identifier defined on a document flow in financial orchestration system.

columns.name: TRADE_AGREEMENT_TYPE
columns.comments: To be used by the accounting template instead of transaction_flow_type. Populate this for all SFO related physical transactions (even when we do not explicitly call SFO).

columns.name: TRADE_AGREEMENT_NUMBER
columns.comments: Required for interorg shipment, SO Issue, RMA receipt to identify that it is SFO related. All these cases call SFO to figure it out.

columns.name: SUCCESSOR_INVENTORY_ORG_ID
columns.comments: Required for SO Issue, interorg shipment, TO shipment to provide as a source in SLA because accounting of this hits Trade Intransit.

columns.name: SUCCESSOR_BUSINESS_UNIT_ID
columns.comments: Required for SO Issue, interorg shipment, TO shipment to provide as a source in SLA because accounting of this hits Trade Intransit.

columns.name: PRIOR_INVENTORY_ORG_ID
columns.comments: Required for direct interorg receipt to provide as a source in SLA because accounting of this hits Trade Intransit (as there is no receiving involved here).

columns.name: PRIOR_BUSINESS_UNIT_ID
columns.comments: Required for direct interorg receipt to provide as a source in SLA because accounting of this hits Trade Intransit (as there is no receiving involved here).

columns.name: TRANSFER_ORDER_LINE_ID
columns.comments: Required for all transfer order transactions.

columns.name: TRANSFER_ORDER_DISTRIBUTION_ID
columns.comments: Required for transfer order related receipts. Where it does not come from the interface, quantity preprocessor will derive it based on ascending order of distribution id (to keep it in sync with how Inventory derives it).

columns.name: TRANSACTION_GROUP_ID
columns.comments: Used to group related transactions together.

columns.name: TRANSFER_TRANSACTION_GROUP_ID
columns.comments: The transaction group whose average cost is required to process this transaction.

columns.name: PRICING_OPTION
columns.comments: Pricing Option identifier. It signifies whether the option is to use the PO price (1), transfer price (2) or the cost+markup (3) as the transfer cost.

columns.name: PARENT_TRANSACTION_ID
columns.comments: The parent transaction identifier if this is a logical transaction.

columns.name: TRANSFER_PERCENTAGE
columns.comments: Percentage of value to attribute to transfer costs in an Inter-Org transfer.

columns.name: CONSIGNED_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates whether the transaction is consigned or owned.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_RECEIPT_TXN_ID
columns.comments: Reference of the original receipt transaction ID (Deliver transaction ID) on the inter org receipt transactions. This is required to find the purchase order delivery to which the inter org receipt is linked to.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_RECEIPT_NUMBER
columns.comments: This column is used for valuation unit generation and is the combination of receipt number and the inventory org code.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_RECEIPT_INV_ORG_ID
columns.comments: The Inventory organization where the original receipt of consigned goods was received.

columns.name: CUSTODY_INVENTORY_ORG_ID
columns.comments: Inventory org where the goods are physically present. This attribute would have a value for scenarios when purchased goods are transferred without ownership change and ownership change happens in transferee org. Stamped on Inter org issue transactions.

columns.name: CONTINGENT_OWNER_TYPE
columns.comments: Represents the party type who bears the risk for the goods in custody. This is the party type who will be the owner on ownership change. Values: SUPPLIER, INVENTORY_ORG.

columns.name: CONTINGENT_OWNER_ID
columns.comments: Represents the party who bears the risk for the goods in custody. This is the party who will be the owner on ownership change. Party Type = SUPPLIER, represents the supplier site ID; Party Type = INVENTORY_ORG, represents the inventory org ID.

columns.name: OWNER_TYPE
columns.comments: This is the party that transfers the ownership to the org where the ownership change happens. Values: 1 is SUPPLIER, 2 is INVENTORY_ORG, null is for non-consigned scenario.

columns.name: OWNING_ENTITY_ID
columns.comments: This is the party that transfers the ownership to the org where the ownership change happens. Owner Type = SUPPLIER, represents the supplier site ID; Owner type = INVENTORY_ORG, represents the inventory org id.

columns.name: OWNER_NAME
columns.comments: The owner code that is used in the valuation unit generation.

columns.name: TRANSFER_TO_REGULAR_TXN_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the transfer to regular transaction that is being returned. This is only populated for transfer to consigned transactions.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CONVERSION_RATE
columns.comments: The conversion rate from the entered currency on the purchase order to the functional currency of the Bill to business unit on the purchase order.

columns.name: CALLBACK_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates if SFO api needs to be called to send the cost to SFO so that next node cost be sent back to costing. Values are N - call back not done yet, Y - call back done, NULL - not applicable.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_INTERFACE_LINE_NUM
columns.comments: Identifies the inventory transaction when entered via the interface.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.comments: Used by Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_INTERFACE_ID
columns.comments: Transaction Identifier from INV_TRANSACTIONS_INTERFACE.

columns.name: SOURCE_SALES_ORDER_NUMBER
columns.comments: Sales order number from shipping.

columns.name: SOURCE_SALES_ORDER_LINE_NUMBER
columns.comments: Sales order line number from shipping.

columns.name: SOURCE_SO_SHIPMENT_NUMBER
columns.comments: Sales order shipment number from shipping.

columns.name: SALES_ORDER_SOURCE_SYSTEM
columns.comments: This columns stores source of the sales order document.

columns.name: RECEIPT_ADVICE_NUMBER
columns.comments: This is used has identifier for Sales order RMA transaction.

columns.name: RECEIPT_ADVICE_LINE_NUMBER
columns.comments: This is used has line identifier for Sales order RMA transaction.

columns.name: REFERENCED_SO_NUMBER
columns.comments: This column stores the Referenced sales order number for Sales order RMA transaction.

columns.name: REFERENCED_SO_LINE_NUMBER
columns.comments: Referenced sales order line number.

columns.name: CST_TRANSFER_ORDER_LINE_ID
columns.comments: Transfer order line identifier (FK to CST_TRANSFER_ORDER_LINES).

columns.name: CST_TRANSFER_ORDER_DIST_ID
columns.comments: Transfer Order distribution identifier (FK to CST_TRANSFER_ORDER_DISTS).

columns.name: INV_TRANSFER_ORDER_HEADER_ID
columns.comments: Surrogate key that identifies The transfer order header.

columns.name: INV_TRANSFER_ORDER_LINE_ID
columns.comments: Transfer order line identifier and every transfer order related transaction must have this.

columns.name: INV_TRANSFER_ORDER_DIST_ID
columns.comments: Surrogate key that identifies Transfer Order distribution.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_TO_SHIPMENT_TXN_ID
columns.comments: For return shipment transactions, this references the original forward flow transaction id.

columns.name: MANUAL_RECEIPT_REQD_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag to denote Manual receipt is created or not for transfer to expense destination.

columns.name: REFERENCE_DOO_FULLFILL_LINE_ID
columns.comments: Surrogate key that identifies Referenced fulfilment line.

columns.name: SHIPPING_INV_ORG_ID
columns.comments: Original Shipping Inventory Org. Only populated for forward and return IDS and CDS flows.

columns.name: SHIPPING_BU_ID
columns.comments: Profit Center Business Unit of Original Shipping Inventory Org. Only populated for forward and return IDS and CDS flows.

columns.name: RETURN_INV_ORG_ID
columns.comments: Inventory org of return receipt.

columns.name: RETURN_BU_ID
columns.comments: Profit Center Business Unit of Inventory Org where the return receipt.

columns.name: REFERENCED_RETURN_FLAG
columns.comments: Possible values Y/N/NULL. Mainly used in R13 for referenced RMA. May be used for more flows later. Y means return is a referenced return N means it is unreferenced NULL means that it is a pre-R13 return flow or this column is not applicable for the flow.

columns.name: TXN_CHAINED_FLAG
columns.comments: Possible values Y/N/NULL. Y/NULL means that chaining is completed N means chaining not yet done.

columns.name: QPP_TXN_GROUPS_UPDATED_FLAG
columns.comments: Processing flag to support the update of the TRANSACTION_GROUP_ID and TRANSFER_TRANSACTION_GROUP_ID columns. Values are Y - Yes, N - No.

columns.name: SIMPLE_PROC_FLAG
columns.comments: Whether the Dropship Delivery is for Simple Procurement (Y) or for Global Procurement flow (N).

columns.name: CONSUMPTION_UNIT_PRICE
columns.comments: Transfer to owned transaction unit price.

columns.name: WO_OUTPUT_TYPE
columns.comments: Type of output produced on a process manufacturing work order. Valid values exist in the lookup ORA_WIS_WD_OUTPUT_MATERIAL.

columns.name: PRIMARY_PRODUCT_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates whether this is the primary output for the work order. Valid values are Y or N.

columns.name: WO_COST_ALLOCATION_BASIS
columns.comments: The basis for cost allocation for output items in a process manufacturing work order. It can be either percentage or fixed value. Valid values exist in lookup ORA_WIS_COST_ALLOC_BASIS.

columns.name: INV_STRIPING_CATEGORY
columns.comments: Segment used to identify the descriptive flexfield application context for Inventory striping attributes.

columns.name: PROJECT_ID
columns.comments: Identifier of the project used to stripe Inventory transactions.

columns.name: TASK_ID
columns.comments: Identifier of the task used to stripe Inventory transactions.

columns.name: COUNTRY_OF_ORIGIN_CODE
columns.comments: Code for the country of manufacture used to stripe Inventory transactions.

columns.name: WMS_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates whether the transaction is WMS reconciliation.

columns.name: COST_ORG_ID
columns.comments: Surrogate ID identifying the cost organization.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_RETURN_HEADER_ID
columns.comments: Unique identifier for supplier return header.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_RETURN_LINE_ID
columns.comments: Unique identifier for supplier return line.

columns.name: RECALL_HEADER_ID
columns.comments: Unique identifier for recall header.

columns.name: RECALL_LINE_ID
columns.comments: Unique identifier for recall line.

columns.name: PARENT_ID
columns.comments: This column identifies source and resultant transaction group for lot merge, translate and split flows.

columns.name: SOURCE_LOT_FLAG
columns.comments: To identify source transactions for lot merge, translate and split flows. Values: (Y) for Source transaction, (N) for resultant transaction and null in case of other flows.

columns.name: TCST_INV_ID_REQ_FLAG
columns.comments: Determines if the record should be updated with transfer_cst_inv_txn_id. Possible values are Y, N.

columns.name: REF_RCV_TRANSACTION_ID

columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.comments: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.comments: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.comments: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: TRADE_AGREEMENT_FTR_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the financial trade relationship of the trade event linked to this transaction.

columns.name: TRADE_AGREEMENT_TYPE
columns.comments: To be used by the accounting template instead of transaction_flow_type. Populate this for all SFO related physical transactions (even when we do not explicitly call SFO)

columns.name: TRADE_AGREEMENT_NUMBER
columns.comments: Required for interorganization shipment, SO Issue, RMA receipt to identify that it is SFO related. All these cases call SFO to figure it out.

columns.name: SUCCESSOR_INVENTORY_ORG_ID
columns.comments: Required for SO issue, interorganization shipment, TO shipment to provide as a source in SLA because accounting of this hits trade in-transit.

columns.name: SUCCESSOR_BUSINESS_UNIT_ID
columns.comments: Required for SO Issue, interorganization shipment, TO shipment to provide as a source in SLA because accounting of this hits trade in-transit.

columns.name: PRIOR_INVENTORY_ORG_ID
columns.comments: Required for direct interorganization receipt to provide as a source in SLA because accounting of this hits trade intransit (as there is no receiving involved here).

columns.name: PRIOR_BUSINESS_UNIT_ID
columns.comments: Required for direct interorganization receipt to provide as a source in SLA because accounting of this hits trade intransit (as there is no receiving involved here).

columns.name: TRANSFER_ORDER_LINE_ID
columns.comments: Required for all transfer order transactions.

columns.name: TRANSFER_ORDER_DISTRIBUTION_ID
columns.comments: Required for transfer order related receipts. Where it does not come from the interface, qty preprocessor will derive it based on ascending order of distribution identifier (to keep it in sync with how Inventory derives it).

columns.name: TRANSACTION_GROUP_ID
columns.comments: Used to group related transactions together.

columns.name: TRANSFER_TRANSACTION_GROUP_ID
columns.comments: The transaction group whose average cost is required to process this transaction.

columns.name: PRICING_OPTION
columns.comments: Pricing Option identifier. It signifies whether the option is to use the PO price (1), transfer price (2) or the cost + markup (3) as the transfer cost.

columns.name: PARENT_TRANSACTION_ID
columns.comments: The parent transaction identifier if this is a logical transaction

columns.name: TRANSFER_PERCENTAGE
columns.comments: Percentage of value to attribute to transfer costs in an interorganization transfer.

columns.name: CONSIGNED_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates whether the transaction is consigned or owned.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_RECEIPT_TXN_ID
columns.comments: Reference of the original receipt transaction ID (Deliver transaction ID) on the inter org receipt transactions. This is required to find the purchase order delivery to which the inter org receipt is linked to.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_RECEIPT_NUMBER
columns.comments: This column is used for valuation unit generation and is the combination of receipt number and the inventory org code.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_RECEIPT_INV_ORG_ID
columns.comments: The Inventory organization where the original receipt of consigned goods was received.

columns.name: CUSTODY_INVENTORY_ORG_ID
columns.comments: Inventory org where the goods are physically present. This attribute would have a value for scenarios when purchased goods are transferred without ownership change and ownership change happens in transferee org. Stamped on Inter org issue transactions.

columns.name: CONTINGENT_OWNER_TYPE
columns.comments: Represents the party type who bears the risk for the goods in custody. This is the party type who will be the owner on ownership change. Values: SUPPLIER, INVENTORY_ORG

columns.name: CONTINGENT_OWNER_ID
columns.comments: Represents the party who bears the risk for the goods in custody. This is the party who will be the owner on ownership change. Party Type = SUPPLIER, represents the supplier site ID; Party Type = INVENTORY_ORG, represents the inventory org ID

columns.name: OWNER_TYPE
columns.comments: This is the party that transfers the ownership to the org where the ownership change happens. Values: 1 is SUPPLIER, 2 is INVENTORY_ORG, null is for non-consigned scenario

columns.name: OWNING_ENTITY_ID
columns.comments: This is the party that transfers the ownership to the org where the ownership change happens. Owner Type = SUPPLIER, represents the supplier site ID; Owner type = INVENTORY_ORG, represents the inventory org id

columns.name: OWNER_NAME
columns.comments: The owner code that is used in the valuation unit generation.

columns.name: TRANSFER_TO_REGULAR_TXN_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the transfer to regular transaction that is being returned. This is only populated for transfer to consigned transactions.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CONVERSION_RATE
columns.comments: The conversion rate from the entered currency on the purchase order to the functional currency of the Bill to business unit on the purchase order.

columns.name: CALLBACK_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates if SFO api needs to be called to send the cost to SFO so that next node cost be sent back to costing. Values are N - call back not done yet, Y - call back done, NULL - not applicable.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_INTERFACE_LINE_NUM
columns.comments: Identifies the inventory transaction when entered via the interface.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.comments: Used by Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_INTERFACE_ID
columns.comments: Transaction Identifier from INV_TRANSACTIONS_INTERFACE

columns.name: SOURCE_SALES_ORDER_LINE_NUMBER
columns.comments: Sales order line number from shipping

columns.name: SOURCE_SO_SHIPMENT_NUMBER
columns.comments: Sales order shipment number from shipping

columns.name: SALES_ORDER_SOURCE_SYSTEM

columns.name: REFERENCED_SO_NUMBER
columns.comments: This column stores the Referenced sales order number for Sales order RMA transaction

columns.name: REFERENCED_SO_LINE_NUMBER
columns.comments: Referenced sales order line number

columns.name: CST_TRANSFER_ORDER_LINE_ID
columns.comments: Transfer order line identifier (FK to CST_TRANSFER_ORDER_LINES).

columns.name: CST_TRANSFER_ORDER_DIST_ID
columns.comments: Transfer Order distribution identifier (FK to CST_TRANSFER_ORDER_DISTS).

columns.name: INV_TRANSFER_ORDER_HEADER_ID
columns.comments: Transfer order header unique identifier.

columns.name: INV_TRANSFER_ORDER_LINE_ID
columns.comments: Transfer order line identifier and every transfer order related transaction must have this.

columns.name: INV_TRANSFER_ORDER_DIST_ID
columns.comments: Transfer Order distribution identifier.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_TO_SHIPMENT_TXN_ID
columns.comments: For return shipment transactions, this references the original forward flow transaction id.

columns.name: MANUAL_RECEIPT_REQD_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag to denote Manual receipt is created or not for transfer to expense destination

columns.name: REFERENCE_DOO_FULLFILL_LINE_ID
columns.comments: Referenced fulfillment line identifier

columns.name: SHIPPING_INV_ORG_ID
columns.comments: Original Shipping Inventory Org. Only populated for forward and return IDS and CDS flows.

columns.name: SHIPPING_BU_ID
columns.comments: Profit Center Business Unit of Original Shipping Inventory Org. Only populated for forward and return IDS and CDS flows.

columns.name: RETURN_INV_ORG_ID
columns.comments: Inventory org of return receipt.

columns.name: RETURN_BU_ID
columns.comments: Profit Center Business Unit of Inventory Org where the return receipt.

columns.name: REFERENCED_RETURN_FLAG
columns.comments: Possible values Y/N/NULL. Mainly used in R13 for referenced RMA. May be used for more flows later. Y means return is a referenced return. N means it is unreferenced. NULL means that it is a pre-R13 return flow or this column is not applicable for the flow.

columns.name: TXN_CHAINED_FLAG
columns.comments: Possible values Y/N/NULL. Y/NULL means that chaining is completed. N means chaining not yet done.

columns.name: QPP_TXN_GROUPS_UPDATED_FLAG
columns.comments: Processing flag to support the update of the TRANSACTION_GROUP_ID and TRANSFER_TRANSACTION_GROUP_ID columns. Values are Y - Yes, N - No

columns.name: SIMPLE_PROC_FLAG
columns.comments: Whether the Dropship Delivery is for Simple Procurement (Y) or for Global Procurement flow (N).

columns.name: CONSUMPTION_UNIT_PRICE
columns.comments: Transfer to owned transaction unit price

columns.name: WO_OUTPUT_TYPE

columns.name: INTRANSIT_FLAG
columns.comments: Identifies whether or not this is an intransit logical transaction created by Cost PreProcessor. If created by PreProcessor then its value is Y else it is null.

columns.name: SECONDARY_TXN_QTY

objects.name: CST_INV_VALUATION_BUILD_DATES
objects.description: This table is used for determining the delta records which need to be picked up for the inventory valuation logic. At the start of the inv val run, the current build date is stamped with current date time. At the end of the inv run, the last build date is stamped with the current build date. columns.comments: Transactional primary product quantity that is moved.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_UOM_CODE
columns.comments: Transactional unit of measure of the primary product quantity that is moved.

columns.name: CST_WORK_ORDER_OPERATION_ID
columns.comments: Surrogate ID identifying the work order operation at which this operation was performed.

columns.name: PARENT_CST_WO_OPERATION_ID

columns.name: TO_DISPATCH_STATE
columns.comments: The end resulting status where the transaction quantity moves to. Lookup type WIE_DISPATCH_STATE.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_DATE
columns.comments: Identifies the date and time when the transaction was performed.

columns.comments: Costing internal date derived for sequencing of transactions for processing.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.comments: Period in which the transaction is processed. This value is populated for the transactions in periodic average cost method.

columns.name: LE_TIMEZONE_CODE
columns.comments: Legal Entity timezone. If NULL, then LE timezone is not enabled for the data in the row and the dates are assumed to be in database timezone.

columns.name: PROVISIONAL_COMPLETION_TYPE
columns.comments: Indicates how to process partial completions. Possible Values: Value at standard cost Value at last actual cost Value at perpetual average cost.

columns.comments: Indicates how to handle scrap costs. Can take the following values: Include in Inventory - remaining quantity absorbs the full work order costs. Expense Out - scrap cost is expensed out.

columns.comments: Status of the transaction which denotes, whether a transaction has been pre-processed, processed by cost processors, distributions have been created or processed by sub-ledger accounting etc. C Fully costed E Error N Not processed P Partially costed X Excluded W Pending.

columns.comments: Current accounting status of the transaction for display: D Draft accounted E Error F Final accounted N Not accounted X Excluded from accounting Z Not applicable.

columns.name: ERROR_CODE

columns.comments: Surrogate ID identifying the operation transaction in costing.

columns.name: OPERATION_ADJ_TXN_ID
columns.comments: Surrogate ID indicating the adjustment transaction which is triggered on work order close.

columns.name: COST_ORG_ID
columns.comments: Surrogate ID identifying the cost organization associated to the plant where the work order is executed.

columns.name: COST_BOOK_ID
columns.comments: Surrogate ID identifying the cost book associated to the cost organization.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.comments: Period in which the transaction is processed. This value is populated for the transactions in periodic average cost method.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
columns.comments: Surrogate ID identifying the primary product associated to the work order where the resource was consumed.

columns.name: COST_PROFILE_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the Asset/Expense Cost Profile linked to the item cost profile. This cost profile is used to get the valuation options for the transaction.

columns.name: DEFAULT_COST_ELEMENT_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the default cost element to be used when a input cost is not available.

columns.name: COST_TRANSACTION_TYPE
columns.comments: Cost transaction type for the transaction. E.g RECEIPT/ISSUE.

columns.name: BASE_TXN_TYPE_ID
columns.comments: Transaction type identifier. For operation transactions this value comes from CST_INTERNAL_TXN_TYPES_VL.

columns.name: BASE_TXN_SOURCE_TYPE_ID
columns.comments: Transaction source type identifier. For operation transactions this value will come from CST_INTERNAL_TXN_TYPES_VL. This value will always be 0.

columns.name: BASE_TXN_ACTION_ID
columns.comments: Transaction action identifier. For operation transactions this value will come from CST_INTERNAL_TXN_TYPES_VL.

columns.comments: Transaction quantity in primary unit of measure.

columns.name: PRIMARY_UOM_CODE
columns.comments: Primary unit of measure for the item.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Transactional primary product quantity that is moved.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_UOM_CODE
columns.comments: Transactional unit of measure of the primary product quantity that is moved.

columns.name: TOTAL_SCRAP_QTY
columns.comments: Net total of scrap quantity reported at the work order operation linked to this operation transaction.

columns.name: CST_WORK_ORDER_ID
columns.comments: Surrogate ID identifying the work order for which operation transaction was performed.

columns.name: CST_WORK_ORDER_OPERATION_ID
columns.comments: Surrogate ID identifying the work order operation at which this operation was performed.

columns.name: OPERATION_SEQ_NUMBER
columns.comments: Number identifying the operation sequence within a work order. This is the sequence in which operation will be performed in the work order.

columns.name: EXECUTION_SEQUENCE
columns.comments: Indicates the execution sequence of the operation if the work order has re-sequence operations.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_DATE
columns.comments: Identifies the date and time when the transaction was performed.

columns.name: COST_DATE
columns.comments: Costing internal date derived for sequencing of transactions for processing.

columns.name: OPERATION_SCRAP_COST_TYPE
columns.comments: Indicates how to handle scrap costs. Can take the following values: Include in Inventory - remaining quantity absorbs the full work order costs. Expense Out - scrap cost is expensed out.

columns.name: OPERATION_SCRAP_VALUATION_TYPE
columns.comments: Indicates when to calculate the value of scrap transactions. Can take the following values: -Value at WO close -Value immediately and at WO close -Value at cost cutoff date and WO close.

columns.name: WO_UPDATE_EVENT_TXN_ID
columns.comments: Surrogate ID identifying the work order close transaction. This reference is used to track if the scrap transaction was available in the system during work order close.

columns.name: POSTED_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates if the transaction has been processed and costs created in CST_OPERATION_TXN_COSTS.

columns.name: COSTING_STATUS
columns.comments: Status of the transaction which denotes, whether a transaction has been pre-processed, processed by cost processors, distributions have been created or processed by sub-ledger accounting etc. C Fully costed E Error N Not processed P Partially costed X Excluded W Pending.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_STATUS
columns.comments: Current accounting status of the transaction for display: D Draft accounted E Error F Final accounted N Not accounted X Excluded from accounting Z Not applicable.

columns.name: PAC_TXN_GROUP_ID_2

columns.name: PAC_TXN_GROUP_ID_3
columns.comments: Unique identifier for the set of transactions for incremental processing.

columns.name: ENABLE_PARALLEL_OPS_FLAG
columns.comments: A flag that indicates whether parallel operations are enabled for this work order. Valid values for the flag are: N or null - denotes parallel operations are not enabled, Y - denotes parallel operations are enabled.

columns.name: REWORK_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag used to indicate if this operation is a rework operation. Valid values: Y, N, or NULL (treated as N).

columns.comments: Po line location identifier in receipt accounting.

columns.name: NET_TRADE_RECEIPT_QTY
columns.comments: The net trade instransit receipt quantity (including the instransit returns) against this PO schedule. The quantity is in the primary UOM of the item.

columns.name: NET_PO_SCHEDULE_ORDERED_QTY
columns.comments: The net ordered quantity (ordered quantity - canceled quantity) of this PO schedule. The quantity is in the primary UOM of the item.

columns.name: NET_INVOICED_QTY
columns.comments: The net invoiced quantity against this PO Schedule. The quantity is in the primary UOM of the item.

columns.name: MATCH_OPTION
columns.comments: Indicates the match option of the PO schedule. Valid values are 'P' - PO Match and 'R' - Receipt Match.

columns.name: INVOICE_QTY
columns.comments: Quantity being invoiced in unit of measure code.

columns.name: TRADE_RECEIPT_QTY
columns.comments: The net trade instransit receipt quantity (including the instransit returns) against this PO schedule. The quantity is in the source doc uom.

columns.name: PRIMARY_NET_DEL_QTY
columns.comments: Indicates the net delivered quantity in primary UOM.

columns.name: SECONDARY_NET_DEL_QTY
columns.comments: Indicates the net delivered quantity in secondary UOM.

columns.name: PROCESS_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates if PO schedule is accrual cleared or not when net quantity is zero.

objects.name: CST_QTY_RCPT_PO_DIST_GT
objects.description: Global temporary table used in the cost preprocessor. It holds the quantity information (net delivered quantity, invoiced quantity) for PO distribution receipt combinations that have match to receipt invoices.

columns.name: CMR_PO_DISTRIBUTION_ID
columns.comments: Single column FK: Identifies the PO distribution whose acquisition cost is being computed.

columns.name: CMR_RCV_TRANSACTION_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the root receipt transaction whose acquisition cost is being computed

columns.name: NET_DELIVERED_QTY
columns.comments: The net delivered quantity (including all the quantity adjustments and returns) against this PO distribution. The quantity is in the primary UOM of the item.

columns.name: TOTAL_INVOICED_QTY
columns.comments: The total invoiced quantity against this PO distribution and receipt combination. The quantity is in the primary UOM of the item.

columns.name: PRIMARY_UOM_CODE
columns.comments: Primary unit of measure of the item.

columns.name: ROOT_RCPT_CURR_CONV_RATE
columns.comments: Currency conversion rate specified on the root receive transaction associated with this delivery. This rate is used for currency conversion for deliveries against POs whose invoices are matched to receipts.

columns.name: PO_NET_DEL_QTY
columns.comments: The net delivered quantity (including all the quantity adjustments and returns) against this PO distribution and receipt. The quantity is in the Purchase Order unit of measure.

columns.name: NET_INVOICED_QTY
columns.comments: The total invoiced quantity against this PO distribution and receipt combination in the Purchase Order UOM.

columns.name: SECONDARY_NET_DEL_QTY
columns.comments: The net delivered quantity (including all the quantity adjustments and returns) against this PO distribution and receipt. The quantity is in the item secondary unit of measure.

columns.name: PO_UOM_CODE
columns.comments: Purchase order pricing unit of measure.

columns.name: SECONDARY_UOM_CODE
columns.comments: Secondary unit of measure of the item.

columns.comments: Stores the source transaction identifier against which the service cost recognition or service cost recognition reversal transaction is created.

columns.comments: Identifies the table name of the source transaction against which the service cost recognition or service cost recognition reversal transaction is created. Possible values are: cst_transactions, cst_resource_transactions.

columns.comments: The unique identifier for the cost organization.

columns.name: COST_BOOK_ID
columns.comments: The unique identifier for the cost book.

columns.name: REV_REC_TXN_ID
columns.comments: The unique identifier for the service revenue transaction.

columns.comments: Period in which the transaction is processed. This value is populated for the transactions in periodic average cost method.

columns.comments: Indicates the charge posting date for the service cost line against which the service cost recognition or service cost recognition reversal transaction is created.

columns.name: COST_PERCENTAGE
columns.comments: Indicates the service cost recognition percentage.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ORG_ID
columns.comments: The unique identifier for the inventory organization.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
columns.comments: The unique identifier for the inventory item.

columns.name: RESOURCE_ID
columns.comments: The unique identifier for the resource.

columns.name: CST_WORK_ORDER_ID
columns.comments: The unique identifier for the work order in Costing.

columns.name: CST_WORK_ORDER_OPERATION_ID
columns.comments: The unique identifier for the work order operation associated with the transaction.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_TYPE_ID
columns.comments: Transaction type identifier. Possible values are: 48 : Service Cost Recognition 49 : Service Cost Recognition Reversal

columns.name: TRANSACTION_SOURCE_TYPE_ID
columns.comments: Transaction source type identifier. This will always be zero for both service cost recognition and service cost recognition reversal transactions.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_ACTION_ID
columns.comments: Transaction action identifier. Possible values are: 48 : Service Cost Recognition 49 : Service Cost Recognition Reversal

columns.name: DEBRIEF_LINE_ID
columns.comments: The unique identifier for the debrief line.

columns.name: POSTED_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates if the cost row is created for the service cost recognition or service cost recognition reversal transaction. Possible values are: N-Not Processed, Y-Cost row is created, E-Error.

columns.name: VARIANCE_POSTED_FLAG
columns.comments: A flag that indicates whether variance cost is created for the service cost recognition or service cost recognition reversal transaction. Possible values are: NULL or X: Variance cost is not expected, N : Variance cost is expected and is yet to be created by the distribution processor, Y : Variance cost is created by the distribution processor, E : Variance cost is expected. The flag is updated to E (error) so that the transaction is picked up again for processing by the distribution processor in subsequent execution.

columns.name: COST_STATUS
columns.comments: Indicates the cost status of the transaction. Possible values are: N-Not Processed, P-Partially Processed, C-Fully Costed, E-Error, X-Excluded from Costing.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_STATUS
columns.comments: Indicates the accounting status of the transaction. Possible values are: N-Not Processed, D-Draft Accounted, F-Final Accounted, E-Error, X-Excluded from Accounting.

columns.name: LE_TIMEZONE_CODE
columns.comments: Value that identifies the legal entity time zone. If NULL, then legal entity time zone is not enabled for the data in the row and the dates are assumed to be in database time zone.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.comments: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.comments: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.comments: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

objects.name: CST_RESOURCE_TRANSACTIONS
objects.description: This table will contain the manufacturing resource transactions that are staged for cost processor. The transactions are staged for each cost book within the cost organization associated to the plant where the resource was consumed. In addition to the resource transactions from manufacturing, this entity will also contain the logical transaction for the WIP revaluation corresponding to the resource rate changes.

columns.name: RESOURCE_TRANSACTION_ID
columns.comments: Primary Key that identifies a resource transaction. It shares the same sequence as the one used for Transaction ID in the Cost Transaction entity. This ensures that the transaction_id is unique across all transactions tables.

columns.name: LE_TIMEZONE_CODE
columns.comments: Legal entity timezone. If NULL, then LE timezone is not enabled for the data in the row and the dates are assumed to be in database timezone.

columns.name: COST_ORG_ID
columns.comments: Surrogate ID identifying the cost organization which is associated to the plant/inventory organization of the resource transaction.

columns.name: COST_BOOK_ID
columns.comments: Surrogate ID identifying the cost book to which this transaction belongs.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.comments: The plant where the resource was consumed.

columns.name: RESOURCE_ID
columns.comments: Surrogate ID identifying the resource which was consumed. This attribute along with the plant, cost organization and cost book combination is used to derive the resource rate.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
columns.comments: Surrogate ID identifying the primary product associated to the work order where the resource was consumed.

columns.name: ITEM_COST_PROFILE_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the item cost profile of the primary product of the Work Order associated to the resource transaction.

columns.name: COST_PROFILE_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the Asset Cost Profile linked to the item cost profile. This cost profile is used to get the cost component mapping, which is needed to map the resource rate cost components to the cost elements.

columns.name: CST_WO_RESOURCE_TXN_ID
columns.comments: Surrogate ID identifying the resource transaction interfaced to costing from manufacturing.

columns.name: CST_WORK_ORDER_ID
columns.comments: Surrogate ID identifying the work order where the resource was consumed.

columns.name: CST_WORK_ORDER_OPERATION_ID
columns.comments: Surrogate ID identifying the work order operation where the resource was consumed.

columns.name: WORK_CENTER_ID
columns.comments: Surrogate ID identifying the work center where the resource was consumed.

columns.name: WO_OPERATION_RESOURCE_ID
columns.comments: Surrogate ID identifying the resource association to a work order operation. This association can be used to derive resource sequence etc.

columns.name: RESOURCE_ACTIVITY_CODE
columns.comments: The Activity associated to this resource transaction. This attribute will be used to derive resource rates post R11. Activity in the first release of fusion will be used to define any intra operation steps + any other custom run steps that the customer would like to track at the resource level.

columns.name: COST_TRANSACTION_TYPE
columns.comments: Identifies the cost transaction type such as RECEIPT or ISSUE.

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_PROCESSING_CODE
columns.comments: Additional Processing Code is an optional further definition of the Cost Transaction Type. It is used on adjustment transactions (Cost Transaction Type is set to 'ADJUST') and is set to 'WIP_STD_RESOURCE' when the adjustment was triggered by cost change; otherwise, it is set to null.

columns.name: TXN_SOURCE_DOC_TYPE
columns.comments: Document Type of the transaction. E.g. "WO" indicating a Work Order.

columns.name: TXN_SOURCE_DOC_NUMBER
columns.comments: Document Number of the transaction. This is the Work Order Number.

columns.name: TXN_SOURCE_REF_DOC_TYPE
columns.comments: For R11, this is the same as the Transaction Source Doc Type. In later release this can be a FPO linked to a WO.

columns.name: TXN_SOURCE_REF_DOC_NUMBER
columns.comments: For R11, this is the same as the Transaction Source Doc Number. In later release this can be a FPO Number linked to a WO.

columns.name: BASE_TXN_TYPE_ID
columns.comments: Transaction type identifier. For resource transactions this value comes from CST_INTERNAL_TXN_TYPES_VL.

columns.name: BASE_TXN_SOURCE_TYPE_ID
columns.comments: Transaction source type identifier. For resource transactions this value will come from CST_INTERNAL_TXN_TYPES_VL. This value will always be 0.

columns.name: BASE_TXN_ACTION_ID
columns.comments: Transaction action identifier. For resource transactions this value will come from CST_INTERNAL_TXN_TYPES_VL.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_DATE
columns.comments: Identifies the date and time when the resource consumption happened.

columns.name: COST_DATE
columns.comments: This is the date at which the resource transaction is costed. This date will be used to derive the applicable rate for the transaction?? Resource rate on the resource transactions is derived based on the cost date. This date can be different from the transaction date if the resource transaction is back dated. Cost date rules similar to inventory transaction needs to be followed for resource transactions also i.e cost date is equal to the last date on which the resource transactions were processed for a cost organization - cost book combination.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.comments: Period in which the transaction is processed. This value is populated for the transactions in periodic average cost method.

columns.name: COST_METHOD_CODE
columns.comments: Cost method associated with the asset cost profile of the primary item. This will be useful when performing standard cost updates to WIP costs for resource transactions.

columns.name: COMPONENT_GROUP_ID
columns.comments: Cost component group derived from the asset cost profile.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Resource usage in transaction UOM.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_UOM_CODE
columns.comments: Identifies the unit of measure in which the transaction was performed.

columns.name: PRIMARY_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Resource usage in primary unit of measure.

columns.name: PRIMARY_UOM_CODE
columns.comments: Identifies the primary UOM of the resource.

columns.name: POSTED_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates whether resource costs have been created for this resource transaction. Y-yes, N-no and E-error.

columns.name: PREPROCESSING_STATUS
columns.comments: Preprocessing status of the transaction. SUCCESS - success ERROR- error.

columns.name: ERROR_CODE
columns.comments: FND error code identifying the error message in case the transaction is in error.

columns.name: COSTING_STATUS
columns.comments: Status of the transaction which denotes, whether a transaction has been pre-processed, processed by cost processors, distributions have been created or processed by sub-ledger accounting etc. C Fully costed E Error N Not processed P Partially costed X Excluded.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_STATUS
columns.comments: Current accounting status of the transaction for display: D Draft accounted E Error F Final accounted N Not accounted X Excluded from accounting Z Not applicable.

columns.name: SERVICE_WIP_FLAG
columns.comments: This column is stamped only for transactions associated to maintenance work orders. This indicates if this transaction is to be costed as Service WIP in place of maintenance expense.

columns.name: SERVICE_COST_POSTED_FLAG
columns.comments: A flag that indicates whether service cost recognition or service cost recognition reversal transaction has been created for the Costing transaction. Possible values are: NULL: Transaction not eligible for service cost recognition or service cost recognition reversal. N: New. Transaction yet to be processed by the service cost recognition processor. H: Hold. Transaction moved to hold status by the service cost recognition processor due to unavailability of cost line from the Service Logistics application. R: Reprocess. Transaction with hold status will be marked for reprocess by the service cost recognition processor upon availability of cost line the from Service Logistics application. Y: Service cost recognition or Service cost recognition reversal transaction has been created. X: Excluded from service cost recognition and service cost recognition reversal, for Projects related transactions.

columns.name: REWORK_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating whether the resource transaction needs to be considered for rework as part of the operation where it is being reported. Valid values: Y, N, or NULL (treated as N).

columns.name: DEBRIEF_LINE_ID
columns.comments: This column is stamped only for transactions associated to maintenance work orders from RCL (Service Logistics). This identifies the debrief line id.

columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.comments: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.comments: OBSOLETE: Identifies the planning cost organization for which the cost planning scenario is created.

columns.comments: OBSOLETE: Identifies the inventory organization / plant for which the cost planning scenario is entered. It is a required value if the scenario type is manufacturing.

columns.name: SCENARIO_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comments: OBSOLETE: Indicates the user identifiable number of the scenario version. Within a scenario, the version number would be a single running number for both standard scenario versions and CTO scenario versions.

columns.name: SCENARIO_HEADER_ID
columns.comments: OBSOLETE: Indicates the scenario header identifier. For every new version created, the scenario header identifier would be inherited from the base version of the scenario.

columns.name: PURPOSE_CODE
columns.comments: OBSOLETE: Indicates the purpose for which the scenario is being defined.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.comments: OBSOLETE: Indicates the currency code in which the costs are maintained in the cost planning scenario.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CONVERSION_TYPE
columns.comments: OBSOLETE: Indicates the currency conversion type to be used to convert the item cost and resource rates from their respective currencies to the cost planning scenario currency.

columns.name: PUBLISH_TO_ACCOUNTING_FLAG
columns.comments: OBSOLETE: Specifies if the scenario is enabled to publish costs for Cost Accounting.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
columns.comments: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the end of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: SCENARIO_VERSION_TYPE
columns.comments: OBSOLETE: Indicates the version type of the scenario version. The LOOKUP_TYPE for these values is ORA_CST_SCENARIO_VERSION_TYPES.

columns.name: CONFIGURED_ENABLED
columns.comments: OBSOLETE: Indicates whether the scenario is enabled for configured item processing. Valid values are Y and N. Only if the value is Y, the option to invoke build and rollup of CTO items would be possible from the scenario.

columns.name: CONFIGURED_FROM_DATE
columns.comments: OBSOLETE: Indicates the cut-off date of the work orders which would be processed by the scenario build and roll up processes. It is be a mandatory attribute, if the configured enabled flag is set to Y. By default this date would be populated from the effective start date of the scenario and the user has the option of overriding it.

columns.name: PLANNING_MODE
columns.comments: OBSOLETE: The planning mode of the scenario to allow making changes to existing Published costs for New Items only. The LOOKUP_TYPE for these values is ORA_CST_SCENARIO_PLANNING_MODE.

columns.name: PREVIOUS_SCENARIO_ID
columns.comments: OBSOLETE: Previous Scenario Identifier. This will be populated with the value of the previous scenario. Applicable only when the NEW_ITEMS option is chosen, otherwise column is null.

columns.name: SUPPLY_CHAIN_ROLLUP_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates whether the scenario is enabled for Supply Chain Cost Rollup.

columns.name: ROLLUP_GROUP_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the supply chain rollup group for which the cost planning scenario is created.

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_SET_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the assignment set associated to the cost planning scenario.

columns.name: TRANSFER_COST_RULE_SET_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the transfer cost rule set associated to the cost planning scenario.

columns.name: ORGANIZATION_CONTEXT
columns.comments: Indicates the organization context for which the cost planning scenario is created. The LOOKUP_TYPE for this column is ORA_CST_ORGANIZATION_CONTEXT with the values ORA_CST_ORG_CONTEXT_SINGLE or ORA_CST_ORG_CONTEXT_GROUP.

columns.name: ROLLUP_RESULTS_CACHED_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates whether the rollup results have been cached in the rollup costs table. Valid values are N - Not cached, L - Legacy caching mode, E - Enhanced caching mode, X - XML caching mode.

columns.name: ROLLUP_RESULTS
columns.comments: Used to store the cached results of the rollup process either in plain text or in XML.

columns.comments: Identifies the planning cost organization for which the cost planning scenario is created.

columns.name: SCENARIO_TYPE
columns.comments: Indicates the type of scenario. It can be either for manufacturing which indicates that a rollup would be performed from the cost planning scenario or it can be non-manufacturing which indicates the cost planning scenario is used for publishing item cost plans and resource rates plans to cost accounting and is not used for cost rollup purposes. The LOOKUP_TYPE for these values is CST_SCENARIO_TYPES.

columns.name: CONFIGURED_ENABLED

columns.name: CONFIGURED_FROM_DATE
columns.comments: Indicates the cut-off date of the work orders which would be processed by the scenario build and roll up processes. It is be a mandatory attribute, if the configured enabled flag is set t o Y. By default this date would be populated from the effective start date of teh scenario and the user has the option of overriding it.

columns.name: PURPOSE_CODE

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE

columns.name: CURRENCY_CONVERSION_TYPE
columns.comments: Indicates the currency conversion type to be used to convert the item cost and resource rates from their respective currencies to the cost planning scenario currency.

columns.name: PUBLISH_TO_ACCOUNTING_FLAG
columns.comments: Specifies if the scenario is enabled to publish costs for Cost Accounting.

columns.name: COST_ORG_ID
columns.comments: Indicates the accounting cost organization to which the results of the cost rollup would be published for manufacturing type cost planning scenarios or the accounting cost organization to which the item cost plan and resource rate plan would be.

columns.comments: Captures the cumulative unit cost for the operation. It is equal to the total unit cost of the input components and input resources and the unallocated unit cost from the previous operations.

columns.name: CUMULATIVE_EXTENDED_COST
columns.comments: Captures the cumulative extended cost for the operation. It is equal to the total extended cost of the input components and input resources and the unallocated extended cost from the previous operations.

columns.name: ALLOCATED_UNIT_COST
columns.comments: Captures the unit cost allocated for a particular output item based on the cost allocation percentage. It is calculated by applying the cost allocation percentage on the sum of current operation unit cost and previous unit unallocated costs.

columns.name: ALLOCATED_EXTENDED_COST
columns.comments: Captures the extended cost allocated for a particular output item based on the cost allocation percentage. It is calculated by applying the cost allocation percentage on the sum of current operation extended cost and previous unallocated extended costs.

columns.name: UNALLOCATED_UNIT_COST
columns.comments: Captures the unallocated unit cost left after all the allocations for output items for a particular operation are completed. It is calculated as the difference between cumulative unit cost and allocated unit cost.

columns.name: UNALLOCATED_EXTENDED_COST
columns.comments: Captures the unallocated extended cost left after all the allocations for output items for a particular operation are completed. It is calculated as the difference between cumulative extended cost and allocated extended cost.
