objects.name: CST_STD_ITEM_COSTS_GT
objects.description: This tables stores the item cost information being published to cost accounting temporarily during the process of publishing.

columns.name: COST_ESTIMATE_ASSIGN_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the item cost plan's control attribute assignment.

columns.name: COST_ORG_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the cost organization to which the cost is being published to.

columns.name: COST_BOOK_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the cost book to which the cost is being published to.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the item for which the cost is being published.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ORG_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the inventory organization of the item for which the cost is being published.

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_LEVEL
columns.comments: Indicates the level to which the cost is being published. Valid values as inventory control attributes, valuation unit and valuation structure.

columns.name: STRUCTURE_INSTANCE_NUMBER
columns.comments: Identifies the structure of the control attributes for which the item costs are being published.

columns.name: CODE_COMBINATION_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the inventory control attributes for which the costs are being published.

columns.name: VAL_STRUCTURE_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates the type of item cost. Valid values are asset (ASSET) and expense (EXPENSE).

columns.name: VAL_STRUCTURE_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the valuation structure to which the cost is being published to.

columns.name: COST_PROFILE_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the cost profile to which the cost is being published to.

columns.name: VAL_UNIT_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the valuation unit to which the cost is being published to.

columns.name: ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.comments: Indicates the manufacturing plant for the rolled-up costs.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_START_DATE
columns.comments: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the beginning of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
columns.comments: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the end of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: FROM_PERIOD_NAME
columns.comments: Indicates the period from which the standard cost is effective for periodic average books.

columns.name: TO_PERIOD_NAME
columns.comments: Indicates the period till which the standard cost is effective for periodic average books.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates the status of the item cost being published. Successfully validated records would have a status of success. Records that have failed the validation would have the error code which was generated based on the validations.

columns.name: TOTAL_COST
columns.comments: Indicates the total cost of the item for which costs are being published.

columns.name: FROM_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates the from currency code for which the conversion rates are calculated.

columns.name: TO_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates the to currency for which the conversion rates are calculated.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CONVERSION_TYPE
columns.comments: Indicates the currency conversion type for which the conversion rates are calculated.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CONVERSION_DATE
columns.comments: Indicates the currency conversion date based on which the conversion rates are calculated.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CONVERSION_RATE
columns.comments: Indicates the calculated currency conversion rate. Default value is 1, when the from and to currency codes are the same.

columns.name: FROM_UOM_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates the from UOM code used for the UOM conversion factor calculations.

columns.name: TO_UOM_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates the to UOM code used for the UOM conversion factor calculations.

columns.name: UOM_CONVERSION_FACTOR
columns.comments: Indicates the calculated UOM conversion factor. Default value is 1, when the from and to UOM codes are the same.

columns.name: PREVIOUS_STD_COST_ID
columns.comments: Indicates the previous standard cost identifier which is currently valid in cost accounting prior to the current cost being published.

columns.name: PREVIOUS_EFFECTIVE_START_DATE
columns.comments: Indicates the previous standard cost start date which is currently valid in cost accounting prior to the current cost being published.

columns.name: PREVIOUS_EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
columns.comments: Indicates the previous standard cost end date which is currently valid in cost accounting prior to the current cost being published.

columns.name: PREVIOUS_LAST_USED_DATE
columns.comments: Indicates the last date when the previous standard cost which is currently valid was used in cost accounting prior to the current cost being published.

columns.name: PREVIOUS_TOTAL_COST
columns.comments: Indicates the total standard cost of the previous standard cost record if any, which this standard cost record replaces.

columns.name: FUTURE_STD_COST_ID
columns.comments: Indicates the future standard cost identifier which is currently valid in cost accounting prior to the current cost being published.

columns.name: FUTURE_EFFECTIVE_START_DATE
columns.comments: Indicates the future standard cost start date which is currently valid in cost accounting prior to the current cost being published.

columns.name: FUTURE_EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
columns.comments: Indicates the future standard cost end date which is currently valid in cost accounting prior to the current cost being published.

columns.name: SCENARIO_PUBLISH_HEADER_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the publish header based on which the current item cost is being published.

columns.name: SCENARIO_EVENT_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the scenario event which was invoked using which the current item cost is being published.

columns.name: COMPONENT_GROUP_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the cost component mapping, which would be used for translating the cost component information to cost elements.

columns.name: SCENARIO_ROLLUP_HEADER_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the scenario rollup header reference for the item cost being published. This value is populated for components which are used in rollup as well as the rolled-up item costs being published.

columns.name: STD_COST_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the standard cost identifier for the item cost being published.

columns.name: COST_ESTIMATE_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the cost estimate identifier based on which the item cost is being published. This value is populated for components which are used in rollup and for items which are part of the cost estimate but are not part of the rollup process.

columns.name: COST_ESTIMATE_LINE_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the cost estimate line identifier based on which the item cost is being published. This value is populated for components which are used in rollup and for items which are part of the cost estimate but are not part of the rollup process.

columns.name: REF_STD_COST_ID
columns.comments: Indicates the buy cost type reference record from which this standard cost type record was created.

columns.name: LAST_USED_DATE
columns.comments: Indicates the last date when the standard cost was used in cost accounting.

columns.name: SCENARIO_ID
columns.comments: Indicates the surrogate key reference of the cost planning scenario.

columns.name: ROLLUP_ITEM_TYPE
columns.comments: Indicates whether the item being rolled up is (1) Standard (2) Purchased CTO (3) Manufactured CTO.

columns.name: SCCR_SOURCE_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates the supply chain cost rollup source types of buy, make, and transfer. Valid values are: NULL, B, BM, BMT, BT, M, MT, T.

objects.name: CST_STD_ITEM_COST_DETAILS_GT
objects.description: This table contains the temporary data pertaining to standard item cost details populated as part of the publish process.

columns.name: COST_COMPONENT_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the cost component of the item cost detail being published.

columns.name: EXPENSE_POOL_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the expense pool of the item cost detail being published. This value is populated for cost components of type overhead.

columns.name: COST_LEVEL_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates the level from which the cost detail is applied to an item cost. Valis values are this level and lower level.

columns.name: COST_ELEMENT_ID
columns.comments: Indicates the cost element derived based on the cost component and the component group mapping based on the item for the item cost detail being published.

columns.name: ENTERED_UNIT_COST

columns.comments: A flag that indicates whether service cost recognition or service cost recognition reversal transaction has been created for the Costing transaction. Possible values are: NULL: Transaction not eligible for service cost recognition or service cost recognition reversal. N: New. Transaction yet to be processed by the service cost recognition processor. H: Hold. Transaction moved to hold status by the service cost recognition processor due to unavailability of cost line from the Service Logistics application. R: Reprocess. Transaction with hold status will be marked for reprocess by the service cost recognition processor upon availability of cost line the from Service Logistics application. Y: Service cost recognition or Service cost recognition reversal transaction has been created. X: Excluded from service cost recognition and service cost recognition reversal, for Projects related transactions.

columns.comments: The unit of measure code in which transaction quantity is specified.

columns.name: PROCESS_DATE
columns.comments: Date at which the average cost processor processed this transaction. It gives the sequence of transaction processing.

columns.name: COGS_POSTED_FLAG
columns.comments: A flag that indicates whether COGS or RMA Recognition transaction has been created for the costing transaction. Possible values are: NULL: Transaction not eligible for COGS or RMA Recognition. N: New. Transaction yet to be processed by COGS Processor. H: Hold. Transaction moved to hold status by COGS Processor due to unavailability of revenue line and ship-bill reference. R: Reprocess. There are 2 scenarios where a transaction will be marked for reprocessing by COGS Processor. 1. Upon availability of revenue line and ship-bill reference, transaction status will change from H to R for reprocessing. 2. In case of partial revenue recognition, transaction status will change from Y to R for reprocessing the next partial revenue lines. Y: COGS or RMA Recognition transaction has been created. X: Excluded from COGS or RMA Recognition. For Projects related transactions.

columns.name: STAGED_FOR_TXFR_COST_FLAG

columns.name: COST_STATUS

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_STATUS
columns.comments: Current accounting status of the transaction for display: N-Not Processed, D-Draft Accounted, F-Final Accounted, E-Error, X-Excluded from Accounting.

objects.name: CST_TRANSACTION_COSTS
objects.description: This table holds the actual cost of receipts and issues for transactions in parent table CST_TRANSACTIONS. It holds the entire history of what each actual cost was after every adjustment, and the cost is stored in its entirety on each adjustment instead of being stored in incremental costs. Receipt costs can come in externally from the incoming acquisition costs flow or internally from the costing engine (transfers at cost and transactions that use current item cost). Issue costs can come from RTV transactions, miscellaneous issue transactions, transfer credits and freight charges, and negative PO quantity adjustments.

For Acquisition Cost Adjustments, this value defaults to the EFF_DATE if a specific currency conversion date override was not provided. columns.name: COSTING_STATUS
columns.comments: Status whether the transaction has been processed by preprocessor, processed by cost processor, distributions have been created or transactions have been processed by sub-ledger accounting. N-Not Processed: no distribution lines are created for this transaction at the current time - lines are expected. Staged by QPP P-Partially Costed: some distribution lines are created, but not all. More lines are expected. C-Fully Costed: All distributions have been created - more lines are not expected. E-ERROR: TRANSACTION IS IN ERROR, NO LINES CAN BE GENERATED AS THE CURRENT TIME. STAGED BY QPP X-Excluded from Costing: No distribution lines will be created for this transaction.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_STATUS
columns.comments: Status of sub-ledger accounting process: N-Not accounted - SLA/GL Accounting is expected/pending. Z-Not Applicable - Distributions are NOT created, and the accounting is not sent to GL. D-Draft accounted - SLA Accounting in draft mode completed. Final Accounting expected. F-Final accounted - SLA Accounting in final mode completed. No further accounting is expected. E-ERROR - AN ERROR IN CREATE ACCOUNTING WAS ENCOUNTERED. FURTHER ACCOUNTING IS EXPECTED AFTER ERROR IS RESOLVED. X-Excluded from accounting. Distributions are created, but no accounting is expected.

columns.name: TXN_CURRENCY_CONVERSION_DATE
columns.comments: Identifies the date that was used for currency conversion. For Acquisition Cost Adjustments, this value defaults to the EFF_DATE if a specific currency conversion date override was not provided. An Acquisition Cost Adjustment could be a result of a combination of multiple retroprice adjustments and invoices, and each of these could have their own corresponding accounting dates and as such we cannot pick a specific price change or invoice to decide on the currency conversion date. So instead of having a complicated set of rules to pick the currency conversion date, we keep it simple and use the date of computation of the acquisition cost for the currency conversion.

columns.name: COSTING_STATUS
columns.comments: Status whether the transaction has been processed by preprocessor, processed by cost processor, distributions have been created or transactions have been processed by sub-ledger accounting. N-Not Processed: no distribution lines are created for this transaction at the current time - lines are expected. Staged by QPP P-Partially Costed: some distribution lines are created, but not all. More lines are expected. C-Fully Costed: All distributions have been created - more lines are not expected. E-ERROR: TRANSACTION IS IN ERROR, NO LINES CAN BE GENERATED AS THE CURRENT TIME. STAGED BY QPP X-Excluded from Costing: No distribution lines will be created for this transaction.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_STATUS
columns.comments: Status of sub-ledger accounting process: N-Not accounted - SLA/GL Accounting is expected/pending Z-Not Applicable - Distributions are NOT created, and the accounting is not sent to GL. D-Draft accounted - SLA Accounting in draft mode completed. Final Accounting expected F-Final accounted - SLA Accounting in final mode completed. No further accounting is expected E-ERROR - AN ERROR IN CREATE ACCOUNTING WAS ENCOUNTERED. FURTHER ACCOUNTING IS EXPECTED AFTER ERROR IS RESOLVED. X-Excluded from accounting. Distributions are created, but no accounting is expected.

objects.name: CST_TRANSFER_SRC_COSTS_GT
objects.description: Global temp table that contains the transfer transaction cost details generated internally by the costing engine. The cost is in terms of the shipping cost organization and contains a reference to the destination cost transaction identifier. The costs are converted by mapping cost elements and converting currencies from the source to the destination.

columns.name: DEST_TRANSACTION_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the destination cost transaction.

columns.name: SOURCE_TRANSACTION_ID
columns.comments: Identifies Source Transaction layer

columns.name: SOURCE_REC_TRXN_ID
columns.comments: Identifies Source Transaction layer

columns.name: SOURCE_DEP_TRXN_ID
columns.comments: Identifies Source Transaction layer

columns.name: SOURCE_COST_ELEMENT_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the source cost element. Holds the transfer cost in terms of the shipping cost organization's cost elements.

columns.name: SOURCE_EXPENSE_POOL_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the source expense pool.

columns.name: SOURCE_ABSORPTION_TYPE
columns.comments: Identifies the absorption type for which this cost is created.

columns.name: SOURCE_TXFR_COST_DATE
columns.comments: Identifies the maximum transfer transaction cost date.

columns.name: ORIG_SOURCE_TXFR_COST_DATE
columns.comments: Identifies the original transfer transaction cost date if the cost date had to be bumped up because of adjustments.

columns.name: SOURCE_UNIT_COST
columns.comments: Identifies the source unit cost of the transfer transaction cost element.

columns.name: SOURCE_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Quantity of the source transaction.

columns.name: TOTAL_SOURCE_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Total Quantity of the source transactions.

columns.name: DEST_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Identifies the destination quantity this source transaction affects. Typically equal to the total source transaction.

columns.name: UOM_CONVERSION_FACTOR
columns.comments: UOM_CONVERSION_FACTOR

columns.name: SOURCE_DEST_CONV_FACTOR
columns.comments: The conversion factor between the primary unit of measure (uom) of source (issue) transfer transaction and the primary uom of the destination receipt transaction.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_FLAG
columns.comments: Identifies if the row represents an adjustment cost being propagated. 'N' - No 'Y' - Yes

columns.name: SOURCE_COST_ORG_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the source cost organization.

columns.name: SOURCE_COST_BOOK_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the source cost book.

columns.name: SOURCE_SET_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the set identifier of the source cost organization.

columns.name: SOURCE_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.comments: Identifies the source currency code.

columns.name: SOURCE_INV_ORG_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the source inventory organization. It is used to retrieve the profit in inventory cost element.

columns.name: COST_ELEMENT_TYPE
columns.comments: Identifies the cost element type. When the source cost element ID is set to 0, this column specifies what type or category the cost is. For example, if this row is profit in inventory, this column value becomes PROFIT_IN_INVENTORY, specifying it as such. Note that this column has no correlation with the column of the same name (COST_ELEMENT_TYPE) on table CST_COST_ELEMENTS_B. There is no LOOKUP_TYPE for these codes.

columns.name: MAPPING_REQUIRED_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates whether cost element to cost element mapping is required on transfers that have multiple legs consisting of physical and logical transfer issues and receipts. The flag helps to avoid unnecessary mapping of cost elements. N - No, Y - Yes. There is no LOOKUP_TYPE for these codes.

Note that this column has no correlation with the column of the same name (COST_ELEMENT_TYPE) on table CST_COST_ELEMENTS_B. There is no LOOKUP_TYPE for these codes.

objects.description: This table is used to temporarily store a subset of data from cst_transactions table to support internal processing within the Cost Processor.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_ID
columns.comments: Transaction identifier which uniquely identifies a transaction in costing.

columns.name: UNREFERENCED_RMA_COST_CODE
columns.comments: Cost option to value sales returns without any reference to the original sales order, which can be the existing item cost or the price on RMA order.

columns.name: DS_SOURCE_LINE_ID
columns.comments: Based on Flow Type(ASN OR INVOICE) either Shipment Line Id or Transaction Event Id will be stored.

columns.name: LE_TIMEZONE_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates Legal Entity time zone for the costing transaction.

columns.name: COST_ORG_ID
columns.comments: Single column FK: Identifies the Cost Organization associated with the inventory organization.

columns.name: COST_BOOK_ID
columns.comments: Single column FK: Identifies the Cost Book assigned to the Cost Organization.

columns.name: VAL_STRUCTURE_ID
columns.comments: Single column FK: Identifies the Valuation Structure.

columns.name: STRUCTURE_INSTANCE_NUMBER
columns.comments: Identifies the Structure instance number for transaction.

columns.name: VAL_UNIT_ID
columns.comments: Identifies Valuation unit for the transaction.

columns.name: VAL_UNIT_COMBINATION_ID
columns.comments: Identifies Valuation Unit Code Combination for the transaction.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
columns.comments: Inventory Item Identifier for Costing Transaction.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ORG_ID
columns.comments: Indicates The Inventory organization to which the item belongs.

columns.name: COST_TRANSACTION_TYPE
columns.comments: Costing transaction type ISSUE or RECEIPT.

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_PROCESSING_CODE
columns.comments: Code specifying what kind of processing needs to be done. The value is defined in CST_INTERNAL_TXN_TYPE for the transaction type and is used by Cost Processors for additional processing.

columns.name: LOGICAL_FLAG
columns.comments: This indicates whether this transaction type is logical. Such transactions have no on-hand quantity impact and do not trigger re-averaging. These transaction show the financial flow.

columns.name: INTRANSIT_FLAG
columns.comments: To identify whether the transaction is a issue or receipt into intransit.

columns.name: BASE_TXN_TYPE_ID
columns.comments: Inventory transaction type identifier. For origin as INV the value comes from INV_TRANSACTION_TYPES_TL table.

columns.name: BASE_TXN_SOURCE_TYPE_ID
columns.comments: Inventory transaction source type identifier. For origin as INV the value comes from INV_TXN_SOURCE_TYPES_TL table, but a custom source type is treated as INVENTORY (value>100 is brought in as 13), and for CST it comes from Lookup_type CST_BASE_TXN_SOURCE_TYPES.

columns.name: INV_TXN_SOURCE_TYPE_ID
columns.comments: Transaction source type identifier including custom source types.

columns.name: BASE_TXN_ACTION_ID
columns.comments: Inventory transaction action identifier. For Origin as INV, the value comes from lookup INV_TRANSACTION_ACTIONS and for Origin as CST the value is from lookup_type CST_BASE_TXN_ACTIONS.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_DATE
columns.comments: The date when this transaction happened.

columns.name: COST_DATE
columns.comments: Date to be used for transaction sequencing.

columns.name: USE_ITEM_COST_FLAG
columns.comments: Identifies receipt transactions that did not come with its own cost and are to use an existing item cost in the system (current perpetual average, a specific layer cost, or the current standard cost). Valid values are Y/N. Does not apply to transfer transactions.

columns.name: MATCHED_TO_COST_FLAG
columns.comments: Identifies transactions that have an associated cost in the CST_TRANSACTION_COSTS child table. Valid values are N/Y/X. Transactions for which this does not apply are marked with X. N means waiting for the incoming acquisition cost, transfer cost, or current item cost to be stamped in CTC.

columns.name: MATCHED_TO_ADDL_TAX_FLAG
columns.comments: The values in this column indicates if additional taxes are required and available for the transaction. X - Not expected, N - Expected but missing, Y - Expected and present.

columns.name: ITEM_COST_PROFILE_ID
columns.comments: Single column FK: Identifies the Item Cost Profile.

columns.name: COST_PROFILE_ID
columns.comments: Single column FK: Identifies Cost Profile associated with the transaction.

columns.name: EXPENSE_TRANSACTION_FLAG
columns.comments: Identifies whether a transaction is an asset or expense transaction.

columns.name: COST_METHOD_CODE
columns.comments: The cost method code like PERPETUAL AVERAGE, FIFO etc. Value comes from lookup_type CST_COST_METHODS.

columns.name: NEGATIVE_QTY_CODE
columns.comments: The negative quantity code defines the action of cost method processors when the inventory quantity becomes negative. Value comes from lookup_type CST_NEGATIVE_QUANTITY_CODES.

columns.name: QUANTITY_FLOW_CODE
columns.comments: Quantity flow code, FIFO or LIFO. Value comes from lookup_type CST_QUANTITY_FLOW_CODES.

columns.name: ENFORCE_TXN_DATE_ORDER_FLAG
columns.comments: Profile option to have cost dates in the same order as the transaction date. Possible values are (Y)es and (N)o.

columns.name: QUANTITY
columns.comments: Transaction quantity in costing unit of measure.

columns.name: UOM_CODE
columns.comments: Unit of measure code of the transaction quantity.

columns.name: UOM_CONVERSION_FACTOR
columns.comments: UOM Conversion factor from primary UOM to costing UOM (because the incoming cost is always in the primary UOM).

columns.name: PREPROCESSING_STATUS
columns.comments: Cost PreProcessing status of transaction.

columns.name: ERROR_CODE
columns.comments: Describes the transaction error code.

columns.name: POSTED_FLAG
columns.comments: Whether or not the transaction has been posted to quantity layers.

columns.name: REC_ONHAND_AVAIL_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates on hand availability for costing transaction.

columns.name: WO_LAYER_POSTED_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates whether the transaction has been created in the WIP layer table. N - layer not created Y - Layer created X - Excluded from layer creation.

columns.name: RUN_MODE
columns.comments: The mode in which this transaction is created, to specify whether it can be reprocessed.

columns.name: CST_INV_TRANSACTION_ID
columns.comments: The inventory transaction identifier that references costing's inventory transaction table.

columns.name: CST_INV_TRANSACTION_DTL_ID
columns.comments: The source inventory transaction detail identifier that references costing's inventory transaction details table.

columns.name: TRANSFER_COST_ORG_ID
columns.comments: Cost Organization identifier associated with Inventory organization of the other leg of transfer transaction.

columns.name: TRANSFER_BOOK_ID
columns.comments: Cost Book to be used for processing transfer transaction.

columns.name: OWNING_COST_ORG_ID
columns.comments: The cost organization that owns the transaction. Owning Cost Org is different from Cost Org for consignment transactions.

columns.name: TRANSFER_CST_INV_TXN_ID
columns.comments: Source inventory transaction identifying the other leg of transfer transaction.

columns.name: TRANSFER_VAL_UNIT_ID
columns.comments: Valuation unit identifier associated with the other leg of transfer transaction.

columns.name: TRANSFER_UOM_CONVERSION_FACTOR
columns.comments: Conversion factor between primary Unit of Measure code of the issue transaction and the primary unit of measure code of the receipt transaction.

columns.name: FOB_POINT
columns.comments: Indicates the 'Free on board' point and determines the point of transfer of liability/ownership. It is 1 for 'SHIPMENT' and 2 for 'RECEIPT.

columns.name: RCV_TRANSACTION_ID
columns.comments: Unique identifier for the transaction in receiving application.

columns.name: PO_DISTRIBUTION_ID
columns.comments: Identifies Purchase Order distribution for transaction.

columns.name: WSH_DELIVERY_DETAIL_ID
columns.comments: Identifies Shipping delivery details for the transaction.

columns.name: DOO_FULLFILL_LINE_ID
columns.comments: Distributed Order Orchestration (Sales Order) fulfillment line identifier.

columns.name: CODE_COMBINATION_ID
columns.comments: Code Combination identifier for the referenced account.

columns.name: TXN_SOURCE_DOC_TYPE
columns.comments: Transactions Source Document Type.

columns.name: TXN_SOURCE_DOC_NUMBER
columns.comments: Transactions Source Document Number.

columns.name: TXN_SOURCE_REF_DOC_TYPE
columns.comments: Transactions Source Documents Reference Document Type.

columns.name: TXN_SOURCE_REF_DOC_NUMBER
columns.comments: Transactions Source Documents Reference Document Number.

columns.name: CST_WORK_ORDER_ID
columns.comments: Single column FK indicating the work order associated with the transaction.

columns.name: CST_WORK_ORDER_OPERATION_ID
columns.comments: Single column FK indicating the work order operation associated with the transaction.

columns.name: SUPPLY_TYPE
columns.comments: Indicates the supply type on WIP transactions. The various supply types are Assembly Pull, Operation Pull, Push and Phantom.

columns.name: WORK_CENTER_ID
columns.comments: Surrogate ID identifying the work center where the operation is executed.

columns.name: CST_WO_OPERATION_TXN_ID
columns.comments: Surrogate ID identifying the work order operation transaction.

columns.name: WO_UPDATE_EVENT_TXN_ID
columns.comments: Surrogate ID identifying the work order close transaction. This reference is used to identify if a product transaction was available in the system during work order close. If this reference is missing and the work order is closed, a re-close of the work order is performed.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.comments: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.comments: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.comments: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: TRANSFER_PERCENTAGE
columns.comments: Percentage of value to attribute to transfer costs in an Inter organization transfer.

columns.name: PRICING_OPTION
columns.comments: Pricing Option identifier. It signifies whether the option is to use the PO price (1), transfer price (2) or the cost+markup (3) as the transfer cost.

columns.name: BUSINESS_UNIT_ID
columns.comments: Profit Center Business Unit Id of the Inventory Organization.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_FLOW_TYPE
columns.comments: Transaction Flow Identifier, 1 - Internal Drop Shipment, 2 - Global Procurement, 3 - Customer Drop Shipment, 4 - Intransit Interorg Transfer, 5 - Direct Interorg Transfer, 6 - Intraorg Transfer, 7 - Transfer Order Intransit Interorg Transfer, 8 - Transfer Order Direct Interorg Transfer, 9 - Transfer Order Intraorg Transfer, 10 - TIR/TIRR at ownership change in procuring org for consigned PO, 11 - TIRR of TO Return with Scrap or null for others.

columns.name: INTERNAL_PROFIT_TRACKING
columns.comments: This column is used by Costing and the values it can hold are 'Y' and 'N'. It indicates whether or not to track profit in inventory.

columns.name: VAL_UNIT_DETAIL_ID
columns.comments: Single column FK: Identifies the valuation unit detail line.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_QTY
columns.comments: Transaction quantity of the inventory transaction.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_UOM_CODE
columns.comments: The unit of measure code in which transaction quantity is specified.

columns.name: PROCESS_DATE
columns.comments: Date at which the average cost processor processed this transaction. It gives the sequence of transaction processing.

columns.name: COGS_POSTED_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates whether or not cogs has been recognized for the transaction or not yet.

columns.name: COSTED_QTY
columns.comments: Quantity that has been processed in costing.

columns.name: COSTING_UOM_CODE
columns.comments: Unit of measure for the costed quantity.

columns.name: COSTING_STATUS
columns.comments: Status of the transaction which denotes, whether a transaction has been pre-processed, processed by cost preprocessor, distributions have been created or processed by sub-ledger accounting.

columns.name: TRANSFER_CST_INV_TXN_DTL_ID
columns.comments: Source inventory transaction detail, such as lot or serial, identifying the other leg of transfer transaction. This is populated only if the item is lot or serial controlled in both source and destination organizations.

columns.name: STAGED_FOR_TXFR_COST_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates if the physical transfer transaction has the cost staged in the cst_transfer_txn_costs tables for transfer cost pre-processing.

columns.name: COST_STATUS
columns.comments: Current costing status of the transaction for display: N-Not Processed, P-Partially Processed, C-Fully Costed, E-Error, X-Excluded from Costing.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_STATUS
columns.comments: Current accounting status of the transaction for display: N-Not Processed, D-Draft Accounted, F-Final Accounted, E-Error, X-Excluded from Accounting.

columns.name: PROPAGATE_COST_ADJ_FLAG
columns.comments: The values can be Y or N (Default) and dictates whether or not cost adjustments will be propagated.

columns.name: RECEIPT_WITHOUT_COST_CODE
columns.comments: The values can be either of FIRST, LAST, CURRENT (Default) and dictates which receipt cost will be used for a receipt without any cost.

columns.name: REFERENCED_RMA_COST_CODE
columns.comments: What cost to be used for referenced RMA transactions. The default value is SO_COST.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_GROUP_ID
columns.comments: Used to group related transactions together.

columns.name: TRANSFER_TRANSACTION_GROUP_ID
columns.comments: The transaction group whose average cost is required to process this transaction.

columns.name: INTERCOMPANY_INVOICING_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates whether the transaction is eligible for intercompany invoicing or not.

columns.name: CONSIGNED_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates whether the transaction is consigned or owned.

columns.name: CONSIGNED_ACCT_DIST_BASIS
columns.comments: Indicates the Consigned Accounting Distribution basis for the cost profile.

columns.name: CREATE_ACCT_FOR_CONS_TXNS
columns.comments: Creating accounting for consigned transactions - Y or N.

columns.name: PROVISIONAL_COMPLETION_TYPE
columns.comments: Work order valuation option to for valuing work order partial completions into inventory. Following options will be available: - Value at standard cost (available for all cost methods) - Value at last actual cost (available for actual and perpetual average cost method) - Value at perpetual average cost ( available for perpetual average cost method).

columns.name: OPERATION_SCRAP_COST_TYPE
columns.comments: Work order valuation option for including scrap costs as a part of inventory or expensing out 'Operation Scrap' will have the following options available in a LOV choice list: - Include in Inventory - Expense Out.

columns.name: CST_TRANSFER_ORDER_LINE_ID
columns.comments: Transaction Transfer order line identifier.

columns.name: CST_TRANSFER_ORDER_DIST_ID
columns.comments: Transaction Transfer Order distribution identifier.

columns.name: PARTIAL_COMPLETION_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates if a product completion transaction is processed as partial completion. Valid values are NULL, N and Y.

columns.name: MANUAL_RECEIPT_REQD_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag to denote Manual receipt is created or not for transfer to expense destination.

columns.name: REFERENCE_DOO_FULLFILL_LINE_ID
columns.comments: Transaction Referenced fulfillment line identifier.

columns.name: REFERENCE_DELIVERY_ID
columns.comments: This column has the reference delivery identifier that points to delivery identifier of the forward flow.

columns.name: REFERENCED_RETURN_FLAG
columns.comments: Possible values Y/N/NULL. Mainly used in R13 for referenced RMA. May be used for more flows later. Y means return is a referenced return N means it is unreferenced NULL means that it is a pre-R13 return flow or this column is not applicable for the flow.

columns.name: SIMPLE_PROC_FLAG
columns.comments: Whether the Dropship Delivery is for Simple Procurement (Y) or for Global Procurement flow (N).

columns.name: PROJECT_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag for identifying if projects is enabled. Will be populated as Y for project enabled sales order issue transaction for now and later extended to all transactions types where projects is enabled.

columns.name: WO_COST_ALLOCATION_BASIS
columns.comments: The basis for cost allocation for output items in a process manufacturing work order. It can be either percentage or fixed value. Valid values exist in lookup ORA_WIS_COST_ALLOC_BASIS.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.comments: Period in which the inventory valuation will be calculated.

columns.name: PERIODIC_AVERAGE_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag to identify if the cost book is periodic average cost book.

columns.name: COST_CUTOFF_DATE
columns.comments: Identifies the cost cutoff date for the transaction's cost organization and book.

columns.name: SERVER_TZ_COST_CUTOFF_DATE
columns.comments: Cost cutoff date in server time zone.

columns.name: STD_OH_ABSORPTION_FLAG
columns.comments: This column indicates the decision derived by Cost processor whether to absorb or not absorb the overhead for a costing transaction. This is applicable only for standard cost method. Valid values are Y/N. 'Y' or null means absorb overheads, 'N' means do not absorb overheads.

columns.name: PAC_PROCESSED_FLAG
columns.comments: This column indicates if the transaction has been included for PAC calculation. Possible values are null/N - transaction is not eligible for PAC or is not yet included in PAC calculation, Y - transaction is included in PAC calculation.

columns.name: ASSEMBLY_ASSET_ID

columns.name: BASE_TXN_SOURCE_TYPE_ID
columns.comments: Inventory transaction source type identifier. For origin as INV the value comes from INV_TXN_SOURCE_TYPES_TL table, and for CST it comes from Lookup_type CST_BASE_TXN_SOURCE_TYPES

columns.name: LE_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates if the date for the transaction is expected to be in LE timezone.

columns.name: BASE_TXN_ACTION_ID
columns.comments: Inventory transaction action identifier. For Origin as INV, the value comes from lookup INV_TRANSACTION_ACTIONS and for Origin as CST the value is from lookup_type CST_BASE_TXN_ACTIONS.

columns.name: COST_TRANSACTION_TYPE
columns.comments: Costing transaction types are ISSUE, RECEIPT, RMA, COGS, ACCTGONLY

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_PROCESSING_CODE
columns.comments: Code specifying what kind of processing needs to be done. The value is defined in CST_INTERNAL_TXN_TYPE for the transaction type and is used by Cost Processors for additional processing.

columns.name: LOGICAL_FLAG
columns.comments: This indicates whether this transaction type is logical. Such transactions have no on-hand quantity impact and do not trigger re-averaging. These transaction show the financial flow.

columns.name: CHECK_QTY_SIGN_FLAG
columns.comments: For certain transactions like transfers, the sign of the transaction quantity denotes whether the transaction is an issue or receipt. This flag indicates if the sign of the quantity needs to be checked for that.

columns.name: INTRANSIT_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates whether this transaction is a intransit transaction

columns.name: CREATE_TXN_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates whether or not to create additional transaction

columns.name: CREATE_ISSUE_TXN_SOURCE_TYPE
columns.comments: BASE_TXN_SOURCE_TYPE_ID of the issue transaction that is created

columns.name: CREATE_ISSUE_TXN_ACTION
columns.comments: BASE_TXN_ACTION_ID of the issue transaction that is created

columns.name: CREATE_RECEIPT_TXN_SOURCE_TYPE
columns.comments: BASE_TXN_SOURCE_TYPE_ID of the receipt transaction that is created

columns.name: CREATE_RECEIPT_TXN_ACTION
columns.comments: BASE_TXN_ACTION_ID of the receipt transaction that is created

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.comments: Date that this transaction type will be activated

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.comments: Date that this transaction type will be disabled

columns.name: DIRECT_INTERFACE_COST_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates that this transaction can expect zero or more interface cost records in CST_I_INCOMING_TXN_COSTS directly tied to the external_system_ref_id in CST_I_INV_TRANSACTIONS.Valid values are 'N', 'Y' and 'C'. The column would be populated with 'C' for WIP Material Returns as the cost is computed by the cost processor using the Layering algorithm.

columns.name: MISC_INTERFACE_COST_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates that this transaction can expect zero or more interface cost records in CST_I_INCOMING_TXN_COSTS tied to the original_transaction_temp_id in CST_INV_TRANSACTIONS. This is the case for transaction costs entered through the Fusion Inventory miscellaneous transactions UI.

columns.name: PHYSICAL_ACQ_COST_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates that this transaction needs to be considered by the acquisition cost processor. Further restrictions apply (such as whether this is part of a global procurement flow).

columns.name: LOGICAL_ACQ_COST_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates that this transaction needs to be considered by the acquisition cost processor.

columns.name: ACQ_COST_PARENT_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates that this transaction is the level at which acquisition costs will be computed and persisted in CST_DELIVERY_ACQ_COST.

columns.name: COST_PREPROCESSING_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates that this transaction needs to set cost_preprocessing_status as 'UNPROCESSED' in CST_INV_TRANSACTIONS so this transaction is processed in pre-processors.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: GP_FWD_FLOW_RCV_PARENT
columns.comments: If not null, it specifies if the transaction is a part of Global Procurement Forward Flow. Its values are -1 when parent rcv_transaction_id needs to be -1 and 1 when parent rcv_transaction_id is a number other than -1.

columns.name: GP_FWD_FLOW_INV_ORG_TYPE
columns.comments: Possible values are 'INV' which means transfer transaction is the same inv org, 'XFER' which means that transfer transaction is from the transfer organization specified in ORIG_TRANSFER_INV_ORG & Null whcih means that it is not a Forward Flow Global Procurement (GP) transaction.

columns.name: GP_MAP_TO_XFER_GROUP
columns.comments: It specifies the GP_XFER_GROUP to which a global procurement transaction type maps to.

columns.name: GP_XFER_GROUP
columns.comments: It gives the transfer group for global procurement transactions. This grouping helps in deriving the transfer transaction id for GP txns.

columns.name: COGS_RECOGNITION_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag to indicate the transaction type that needs to be picked for COGS/RMA Recognition process

columns.name: SFO_EVENT_COST_INTERFACE_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates that this transaction should expect one or more cost records in CST_TRADE_EVENT_COSTS. Further restrictions apply (such as whether the event belongs to the supplier facing node in a global procurement flow).

columns.name: SFO_ACQ_COST_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates that this transaction needs to be considered by the acquisition cost processor. Further restrictions apply (such as whether the event belongs to the supplier facing node in a global procurement flow).

columns.name: EXTERNAL_TXN_TYPE
columns.comments: The column is used to map the transaction type as sent by the external system to costing transaction type with source_type and action.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_FLOW_TYPE
columns.comments: Transaction Flow Identifier, 1 - Internal Drop Shipment, 2 - Global Procurement, 3 - Customer Drop Shipment, 4 - Intransit Interorg Transfer, 5 - Direct Interorg Transfer, 6 - Intraorg Transfer, 7 - Transfer Order Intransit Interorg Transfer, 8 - Transfer Order Direct Interorg Transfer, 9 - Transfer Order Intraorg Transfer, 10 - TIR/TIRR at ownership change in procuring org for consigned PO, 11 - TIRR of TO Return with Scrap or null for others.

columns.name: CONSIGNED_TFR_TO_INV_INDICATOR
columns.comments: TFR_TO_REGULAR - Indicates the goods are being transferred from Consigned Inventory to Regular Inventory. TFR_TO_CONSIGNED - Indicates the goods are being transferred from Regular Inventory to Consigned Inventory. NONE - Indicates the transaction is not related to transfer of goods between Consigned Inventory and Regular Inventory.

columns.name: SINGLE_LEG_TRANSFER_SIGN
columns.comments: The sign of transaction qty (1 or -1) that specifies whether the issue (-1) or the receipt (1) leg is part of transfer flow for cost accounting.

columns.name: INACTIVE_FLAG
columns.comments: Marks the transaction types as inactive so that the preprocessors do not process such transaction types

columns.name: CHECK_WITH_SFO_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates if the transaction type needs to be sent to SFO to check if it has a trade agreement.

columns.name: WIP_COST_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates if the cost of this transaction would be derived by the work in process transaction processor. Possible values are NULL and Y.

columns.name: TRANSFER_SHIP_RCPT_COEVAL
columns.comments: Denotes whether both the shipping and receipt transactions of a transfer flow are created at the same time. Possible values are [Y]es, [N]o and NULL (not applicable)

columns.name: COMPARE_VU_STR_LEVEL
columns.comments: For transfers within a cost org, compare VU structure to ignore transaction from getting processed. Possible values are [C]ost Org, [I]nv Org and NULL (not applicable)

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.comments: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.comments: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.comments: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.

objects.name: CST_VARIANCE_COSTS
objects.description: Current Transactions and Overhead Costs

columns.name: VARIANCE_COST_ID
columns.comments: Single column surrogate key: Identifies the variance cost for a transaction

columns.name: TRANSACTION_ID
columns.comments: Single column FK: Identifies a transaction in costing

columns.name: REC_TRXN_ID
columns.comments: Single column FK: Identifies the Receipt Transaction for this transfer transaction

columns.name: DEP_TRXN_ID
columns.comments: Single column FK: Identifies the Deplete Transaction for this transfer transaction

columns.name: COST_ELEMENT_ID
columns.comments: Cost element corresponding to the cost of the transaction.

columns.name: EXPENSE_POOL_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the expense pool for which this cost is created. Indicates the following when negative value: -1: Freight Cost -2: Gain/loss on transfer price -3: Transfer Price -4: Expensed LCM cost element (capitalization flag deselected on mapping setup) -22: Used by internal logic to ignore cost for this node but transfer it to the next node for costing as gain/loss -5: Additional taxes for Brazil. Come on tops of TP.

columns.name: EFF_DATE
columns.comments: The effective date of the cost record. It is the date when the cost became in effect for the transaction. For new costs, the effective date is the date stamped on the transaction. For user adjustments, the effective date is the user entry date. For acquisition cost adjustments, the effective date is the system date at time of cost processing.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_COST_ID
columns.comments: Single column FK: Identifies the transactions cost

columns.name: COST_ORG_ID
columns.comments: Single column FK: Identifies the Cost Organization associated with the inventory organization.

columns.name: COST_BOOK_ID
columns.comments: Single column FK: Identifies the Cost Book assigned to the Cost Organization.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
columns.comments: Inventory Item Identifier for the transaction

columns.name: VAL_UNIT_ID
columns.comments: Single column FK: Identifies the Valuation unit for the transaction.

columns.name: COST_DATE
columns.comments: Date used for transaction sequencing

columns.name: BASE_TXN_TYPE_ID
columns.comments: Inventory transaction type identifier. For origin as INV the value comes from INV_TRANSACTION_TYPES_TL table.

columns.name: COST_SOURCE
columns.comments: Identifies the source of the cost, such as Purchase Order (PO) or Accounts Payable (AP). The LOOKUP_TYPE for these values is CST_COST_SOURCES.

columns.name: COST_REFERENCE
columns.comments: Identifies a specific business object or value that further refines the cost source information, such as the source cost organization identifier or an effective date.

columns.name: COST_TRANSACTION_TYPE
columns.comments: Cost Transaction Type is used by the costing engine to categorize group processing. Set to 'ADJUST' for adjustments, null otherwise.

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_PROCESSING_CODE
columns.comments: Additional Processing Code is an optional further definition of the Cost Transaction Type. It is used on adjustment transactions (Cost Transaction Type is set to 'ADJUST') and is set to 'USER' when the adjustment was done by the user; otherwise, it is set to null.

columns.name: ABSORPTION_TYPE
columns.comments: Absorption type: 1=Include in Inventory, 2=Expense

columns.name: QUANTITY

columns.name: DISABLE_DATE

columns.name: COMPONENT_QUANTITY

columns.name: ITEM_NUM

columns.name: QUANTITY_RELATED

columns.name: SO_BASIS

columns.name: MUTUALLY_EXCLUSIVE_OPTIONS

columns.name: HIGH_QUANTITY

columns.name: BOM_ITEM_TYPE

columns.name: OPTIONAL_ON_MODEL

columns.name: ACD_TYPE

columns.name: PRIMARY_UOM_CODE

columns.name: LE_EFFECTIVITY_DATE
columns.comments: Legal entity date at the beginning of the date range during which a given record will be available for transacting.

columns.name: LE_DISABLE_DATE
columns.comments: Legal entity date at the end of a date range during which a given record is available for transacting.

columns.name: FIND_NUMBER

columns.name: WIS_MATERIAL_SEQ_NUMBER

columns.name: OP_YIELD_FACTOR

columns.name: CONTRIBUTE_TO_YIELD_FLAG

objects.name: CST_WORK_DEFINITIONS

columns.name: CST_WORK_DEFINITION_ID

columns.name: WORK_DEFINITION_VERSION_ID

columns.name: WORK_DEFINITION_ID

columns.name: VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Indicates the work definition version number based on which the work definition snapshot is created.

columns.name: BILL_SEQUENCE_ID

columns.name: WD_EFFECTIVE_FROM_DATE
columns.comments: Indicates the date from which the work definition for which the snapshot is being created is effective.

columns.name: WD_EFFECTIVE_TO_DATE
columns.comments: Indicates the date till which the work definition for which the snapshot is being created is effective.

columns.name: COSTING_BATCH_OUTPUT_SIZE
columns.comments: Indicates the costing batch output size for work definition for which the snapshot is created.

columns.name: WORK_DEFINITION_TYPE
columns.comments: Indicates the type of work definition for which the snapshot is being created for.

columns.name: WORK_DEFINITION_NAME_ID
columns.comments: Indicates the name of the work definition for which the snapshot is being created for.

columns.name: PRODUCTION_PRIORITY
columns.comments: Indicates the production priority of the work definition snapshot.

columns.name: COSTING_PRIORITY
columns.comments: Indicates the costing priority of the work definition snapshot.

columns.name: ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.comments: Indicates the plant under which the work definition snapshot is created.

columns.name: WORK_METHOD_ID
columns.comments: Indicates the work method identifier of the work definition snapshot.

columns.name: WORK_METHOD_CODE

columns.name: OUTPUT_INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
columns.comments: Indicates the primary output item of the work definition snapshot.

columns.name: OUTPUT_INVENTORY_ORG_ID
columns.comments: Indicates the organization identifier of the primary output item of the work definition snapshot.

columns.name: CST_OPERATION_ID
columns.comments: Indicates the Fusion costing operation identifier and is used to model the BOM structure of all assemblies in the snapshot as it uniquely identifies an operation for every assembly structure.

columns.name: WD_OPERATION_ID
columns.comments: Indicates the Fusion manufacturing operation identifier as stored in WIS_WD_OPERATIONS_VL. For CTO snapshot data, this identifier can be shared across different assemblies and therefore should only be used to reference the data stored in WIS_WD_OPERATIONS_VL.

columns.name: OPERATION_SEQ_NUMBER
columns.comments: Indicates the sequence of the operation in the work definition snapshot.

columns.name: OPERATION_TYPE
columns.comments: Indicates the type of operation. Valid options are: (1) In-House (2) Supplier.

columns.name: OSP_ITEM_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the outside processing item reference associated with the operation.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the supplier reference of the outside processing operation.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_SITE_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the supplier site reference of the outside processing operation.

columns.name: WORK_CENTER_ID
columns.comments: Indicates the work center identifier for the resource under the work definition operation.

columns.name: WORK_CENTER_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates the work center code for the resource under the work definition operation.

columns.name: WORK_AREA_ID
columns.comments: Indicates the work area identifier for the resource under the work definition operation.

columns.name: WORK_AREA_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates the work area code for the resource under the work definition operation.

columns.name: OP_EFFECTIVE_FROM_DATE
columns.comments: Indicates the date from which the work definition operation is effective.

columns.name: OP_EFFECTIVE_TO_DATE
columns.comments: Indicates the date till which the work definition operation is effective.

columns.name: WD_OPERATION_RESOURCE_ID
columns.comments: Indicates the fusion manufacturing operation resource identifier based on which the operation resource snapshot is created for work definitions.

columns.name: RESOURCE_SEQ_NUMBER
columns.comments: Indicates the resource sequence for the resource under the work definition operation.

columns.name: RESOURCE_ASSIGNED_UNITS
columns.comments: Indicates the number of assigned units of the resource for the operation sequence.

columns.name: RESOURCE_USAGE_RATE
columns.comments: Indicates the resource usage rate for the resource under the work definition operation.

columns.name: RESOURCE_UOM_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates the unit of measure of the resource usage rate.

columns.name: RESOURCE_PRIMARY_UOM_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates the primary UOM of the resource.

columns.name: RESOURCE_UOM_CONVERSION_FACTOR
columns.comments: Indicates the conversion factor between the resource's usage UOM to its primary UOM.

columns.name: RESOURCE_BASIS_TYPE
columns.comments: Indicates the basis type for the resource usage rate. Fixed rate means that the resource is used once as per the resource usage rate for the entire batch. Variable rate means that for each item produced, the resource is used as per the resource usage rate specified.

columns.name: RESOURCE_ACTIVITY_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates the activity this resource is going to perform in this operation. Values are contained within the WIS_RESOURCE_ACTIVITY lookup.

columns.name: RESOURCE_ID
columns.comments: Indicates the resource used for the work definition operation.

columns.name: RESOURCE_COSTED_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates whether the resource is to be costed as part of the cost rollup process or not.

columns.name: RESOURCE_SCALED_USAGE_RATE
columns.comments: Indicates the resource usage rate scaled for the work definition based on costing output batch size and resource basis type.

columns.name: WD_OPERATION_MATERIAL_ID
columns.comments: Indicates the fusion manufacturing operation material identifier based on which the work definition operation material snapshot is created.

columns.name: MATERIAL_TYPE
columns.comments: Indicates the type of material, whether it is input or output.

columns.name: MATERIAL_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Indicates the quantity of material used for the work definition operation.

columns.name: MATERIAL_UOM_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates the unit of measure of the material used for the work definition operation.

columns.name: MATERIAL_PRIMARY_UOM_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates the primary UOM of the item.

columns.name: MATERIAL_UOM_CONVERSION_FACTOR
columns.comments: Indicates the conversion factor between the input component's usage UOM to its primary UOM.

columns.name: MATERIAL_BASIS_TYPE
columns.comments: Indicates whether the item quantity is fixed (e.g., quantity per lot produced) or variable (e.g., quantity per item produced).

columns.name: MATERIAL_YIELD_FACTOR
columns.comments: Indicates the percentage of material quantity incorporated into the finished good.

columns.name: MATERIAL_INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
columns.comments: Indicates the material identifier of the material used in the work definition operation.

columns.name: MATERIAL_INVENTORY_ORG_ID
columns.comments: Indicates the organization in which the material is defined.

columns.name: ORIG_MAT_INV_ORG_ID
columns.comments: Indicates original inventory organization defined for the material on the work definition.

columns.name: ALLOCATION_PERCENT
columns.comments: Percent of supply allocated to this source.

columns.name: SOURCE_TYPE
columns.comments: Indicates the source type: 1 - Transfer from, 2 - Make at, 3 - Buy from. Lookup type is MSC_SOURCING_SOURCE_TYPE.

columns.name: MATERIAL_SUPPLY_TYPE
columns.comments: Indicates the supply type of the item. Used for identifying an item as supplier sources or phantom.

columns.name: CST_MSC_SRC_RULE_ID
columns.comments: Costing identifier for sourcing rule.

columns.name: MATERIAL_SCALED_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Indicates the scaled quantity of the material for the work definition based on component yield factor, costing output batch size and material basis type.

columns.name: WD_CRITERION_DETAIL_ID
columns.comments: Indicates the criterion details from the scenario reference based on which the snapshot request is required.

columns.name: SCENARIO_EVENT_ID
columns.comments: Indicates the scenario event identifier based on which the request to create the snapshot for the item is created from.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates the status of the explosion / snapshot process for the work definition.

columns.name: SCENARIO_ROLLUP_HEADER_ID
columns.comments: Indicates the scenario rollup header identifier created using the costing work definition record for either material or resource.

columns.name: CREATED_BY

columns.name: OP_CUM_YIELD_FACTOR
columns.comments: Indicates the cumulative yield factor for the operation. Default value is 1 (100%).

columns.name: OP_REV_YIELD_FACTOR

columns.name: PROCESS_BATCH_TYPE

columns.name: PERCENT_BATCH

columns.name: OPERATION_OUT_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Indicates the quantity left at the end of the operation. Applicable for process manufacturing work definitions with support for intermediate quantities.

objects.name: CST_WORK_ORDERS
objects.description: This is the persistent table that stores work order information transferred from source manufacturing systems. This table will be source of truth for work order information within costing. Preprocessing program will generate a unique identifier for every external_system_reference + external_system_ref_id and the surrogate will be used to identify these work orders in downstream costing tables.

columns.name: CST_WORK_ORDER_ID
columns.comments: Surrogate identifying a work order uniquely in costing.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_SYSTEM_REFERENCE
columns.comments: Code identifying the external system owning this work order definition.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_SYSTEM_REF_ID
columns.comments: Surrogate ID identifying the work order in the source system. Manufacturing work order ID.

columns.name: WORK_ORDER_NUMBER
columns.comments: Work Order Number in manufacturing. The uniqueness of which will be controlled by user at the work method level or at the plant level.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.comments: Manufacturing Organization in which the work order is created.

columns.name: WORK_METHOD_ID
columns.comments: The work method that will be used to execute the work order. The Master table for which is WIS_WORK_METHODS_B/TL.

columns.name: WORK_ORDER_TYPE
columns.comments: Based on the Work Method, this attribute further classifies the Work Order to indicate whether it is meant for either Standard or Non Standard Production. The value for which comes from a lookup_type = 'WIE_WO_TYPE'. This lookup is system defined and not alterable by the user.

columns.name: WORK_ORDER_SUB_TYPE
columns.comments: For a specific Work Order Type, this attribute represents the specific nature of work being performed such as Standard Production, Prototyping, or Repair. The value for which comes from a lookup_type = 'WIE_WO_SUB_TYPE'. This is a user extensible lookup.

columns.name: RESEQUENCE_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag used to indicate if the operation can be re-sequenced while executing the operation. Valid values are Y or N.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
columns.comments: This refers to the primary product that needs to be manufactured, and can be any active item that has the "Build in WIP" flag checked at the Item Organization (Plant) level

columns.name: WORK_DEFINITION_ID
columns.comments: Surrogate ID identifying the work definition associated to the work order.

columns.name: WORK_DEFINITION_VERSION_ID
columns.comments: Surrogate ID identifying the work definition version.

columns.name: WORK_DEFINITION_AS_OF_DATE
columns.comments: The "As-Of-Date" is used to figure out the proper version of the work order when the Org + Product + "As-Of-Date" is provided as the filter criteria in narrowing down the work order.

columns.name: WORK_ORDER_STATUS_ID
columns.comments: Work Order Status Identifier. Statuses are defined in a flexible user defined table. The user defined statuses will have to be defined on top of some seeded system statuses. The user defined status table is 'WIE_WO_STATUSES_B/TL'. The system statuses are seeded in the lookup type = 'WIE_WO_SYSTEM_STATUS'.

columns.name: RELEASED_DATE
columns.comments: Date when the work order is released.

columns.name: CLOSED_DATE
columns.comments: Date when the work order is closed. This value is available only when the work order is currently in closed status. If a closed work order is reopened then this value would be updated accordingly.

columns.name: COMPLETION_DATE
columns.comments: Date when the work order is completed. This value is available only when the work order is currently in closed/completed status. If a closed work order is reopened this value is updated accordingly.

columns.name: CONTRACT_MFG_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates if this work order is meant for contract manufacturing.

columns.name: CONTRACT_MFG_PO_LINE_LOC_ID
columns.comments: The reference to the purchase order schedule that is created for the contract manufacturing flow.

columns.name: WORK_ORDER_LESS_FLAG
columns.comments: When products have well defined product definitions, they can be produced by means of something called work order less completions. Such completion transaction can trigger the creation of a work order and marks that with the ORDER_LESS_FLAG = "Y".

columns.name: INVENTORY_ASSET_FLAG
columns.comments: Internal column. Indicates whether the end item on the work order is asset or expense.

columns.name: MNT_COMPLETE_TO_INV_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating that the asset(s) involved in the work order will be completing to inventory upon completion of work.

columns.name: MNT_ALLOW_MULTIPLE_ASSETS_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating that multiple assets can be associated to this maintenance work order.

columns.name: QUANTITY
columns.comments: For Component: Quantity of the material either consumed in the operation or produced from the operation. This is usually the work order quantity times the QUANTITY_PER_ASSEMBLY when the basis type is VARIABLE. For Resource: Represents the total required usage for the resource based on the basis type, usage rate, and work order quantity. It is the usage per assembly unit (variable basis) or the usage per work order (fixed basis). For example, assuming usage rate = 1 hour and work order quantity = 10: If Basis = Variable, then required usage = 1 * 10 = 10 hours If Basis = Fixed, then required usage = 1 hour

objects.name: CMR_B_ALL_PERIOD_CLOSE_TXNS_V
objects.query:
SELECT transaction_id,
source_table,
bill_to_business_unit_id,
inventory_org_id,
item_organization_id,
transaction_type,
document_type_code,
transaction_number,
transaction_date,
transaction_line_number,
destination_type_code,
distribution_type,
inventory_item_id,
transaction_qty,
transaction_uom_code,
transaction_amt,
currency_code,
convert_to_letz,
CAST( DECODE(DOCUMENT_TYPE_CODE,'Interface Receipts', 'Unprocessed Interfaced Receipts',
'Interface Invoices','Unprocessed Interfaced Invoices',
'Interface Trade Events','Unprocessed Interfaced Trade Events',
DOCUMENT_TYPE_CODE) AS VARCHAR2(100)) error_code
/* CAST('Unimported/Unprocessed Interface' AS VARCHAR2(100)) error_code - added the above logic to give exact details to user */
FROM cmr_all_intf_txns_v
UNION ALL
SELECT transaction_id,
source_table,
bill_to_business_unit_id,
inventory_org_id,
item_organization_id,
transaction_type,
document_type_code,
transaction_number,
transaction_date,
transaction_line_number,
destination_type_code,
invoice_distribution_type distribution_type,
inventory_item_id,
transaction_qty,
transaction_uom_code,
transaction_amt,
CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(15)) currency_code,
convert_to_letz,
DECODE( source_table,
'CMR_TRANSACTIONS','Unprocessed Receipts',
'CST_TRADE_EVENTS','Unprocessed Trade Events',
'CMR_AP_INVOICE_DTLS', 'Unprocessed Invoices',
'CMR_ACCRUAL_CLR_AMTS','Unprocessed Accrual Clearing',
'CMR_RCV_EVENTS',DECODE(transaction_type, 'Period End Accrual','Unprocess Period End Accruals','Unprocessed Retro Price Adjustment' )
) error_code
FROM cmr_all_transactions_v
WHERE posted_flag in ('N','E') and NVL(RA_INVOICE_TRANSACTION_FLAG,'Y') = 'Y'
/* RA_INVOICE_TRANSACTION_FLAG = Y means Invoice variances are processed in CMR and other values are not processed as accounting txns. NULL means non-invoices data and it will be NULL */
UNION ALL
SELECT accounting_event_id transaction_id,
CAST('CMR_RCV_EVENTS_DIST' AS VARCHAR2(30)) source_table,
business_unit_id bill_to_business_unit_id,
inventory_org_id,
inventory_org_id item_organization_id,
transaction_type_code transaction_type, /* added correct txn type column in CRE instead of event_type_code - */

FROM
cst_acctd_attr_values_v av,

av.cost_org_id = ao.cost_org_id AND
av.cost_book_id = ao.cost_book_id AND

av.inventory_item_id = ao.inventory_item_id AND
av.inventory_org_id = ao.inventory_org_id AND

nvl(av.project_id, 0) = nvl(ao.project_id, 0) AND
nvl(av.task_id, 0) = nvl(ao.task_id, 0) AND
nvl(av.country_of_origin_code, '~') = nvl(ao.country_of_origin_code, '~')

CST_INTERNAL_TXN_TYPES_B.END_DATE,
CST_INTERNAL_TXN_TYPES_B.USER_DEFINED_FLAG USER_DEFINED_FLAG
FROM
CST_INTERNAL_TXN_TYPES_B ,
CST_INTERNAL_TXN_TYPES_TL,
CST_TXN_SOURCE_ACTIONS
WHERE
CST_INTERNAL_TXN_TYPES_B.BASE_TXN_TYPE_ID = CST_INTERNAL_TXN_TYPES_TL.BASE_TXN_TYPE_ID AND
CST_INTERNAL_TXN_TYPES_TL.LANGUAGE = USERENV('LANG') AND
CST_INTERNAL_TXN_TYPES_B.BASE_TXN_SOURCE_TYPE_ID = CST_TXN_SOURCE_ACTIONS.BASE_TXN_SOURCE_TYPE_ID AND
CST_INTERNAL_TXN_TYPES_B.BASE_TXN_ACTION_ID = CST_TXN_SOURCE_ACTIONS.BASE_TXN_ACTION_ID AND
CST_TXN_SOURCE_ACTIONS.BASE_TXN_SOURCE_TYPE_ID = 0
UNION
SELECT
INV_TRANSACTION_TYPES.TRANSACTION_TYPE_ID BASE_TXN_TYPE_ID,
INV_TRANSACTION_TYPES.TRANSACTION_TYPE_NAME BASE_TXN_TYPE_NAME,
INV_TRANSACTION_TYPES.DESCRIPTION DESCRIPTION,
CASE WHEN INV_TRANSACTION_TYPES.TRANSACTION_SOURCE_TYPE_ID>100 THEN 13
ELSE INV_TRANSACTION_TYPES.TRANSACTION_SOURCE_TYPE_ID
END BASE_TXN_SOURCE_TYPE_ID,
TO_NUMBER(INV_TRANSACTION_TYPES.TRANSACTION_ACTION_ID) BASE_TXN_ACTION_ID,
INV_TRANSACTION_TYPES.START_DATE START_DATE,
INV_TRANSACTION_TYPES.END_DATE END_DATE,
INV_TRANSACTION_TYPES.USER_DEFINED_FLAG USER_DEFINED_FLAG
FROM
INV_TRANSACTION_TYPES,
CST_TXN_SOURCE_ACTIONS
WHERE
CST_TXN_SOURCE_ACTIONS.BASE_TXN_SOURCE_TYPE_ID = CASE WHEN
INV_TRANSACTION_TYPES.TRANSACTION_SOURCE_TYPE_ID>100 THEN 13 ELSE
INV_TRANSACTION_TYPES.TRANSACTION_SOURCE_TYPE_ID END AND
INV_TRANSACTION_TYPES.TRANSACTION_ACTION_ID = CST_TXN_SOURCE_ACTIONS.BASE_TXN_ACTION_ID AND
CST_TXN_SOURCE_ACTIONS.BASE_TXN_SOURCE_TYPE_ID <> 0
