objects.name: CST_WO_OP_DEPENDENCIES_V
objects.query:
SELECT
cst_work_order_id,
from_cst_wo_operation_id,
to_cst_wo_operation_id,
act_transfer_percent transfer_percent,
dependency_type,
from_wo_operation_id,
to_wo_operation_id,
work_order_id,
from_operation_seq_number,
to_operation_seq_number,
work_method_code
FROM
(
SELECT
t.cst_work_order_id,
t.from_cst_wo_operation_id,
t.to_cst_wo_operation_id,
t.transfer_percent,
t.dependency_type,
t.from_wo_operation_id,
t.to_wo_operation_id,
t.work_order_id,
t.from_operation_seq_number,
t.to_operation_seq_number,
t.work_method_code,
CASE
WHEN t.work_method_code = 'PROCESS_MANUFACTURING' THEN
t.transfer_percent
ELSE
(
CASE
WHEN t.to_wo_operation_id IS NULL THEN
NULL
WHEN t.rk = t.cnt_of_op
AND t.cnt_of_op > 1 THEN
1 - round(1 / t.cnt_of_op, 20) * ( t.cnt_of_op - 1 )
WHEN t.cnt_of_op > 1 THEN
round(1 / t.cnt_of_op, 20)
ELSE
1
END
) * 100
END act_transfer_percent
FROM
(
SELECT
cwo.cst_work_order_id,
CASE
WHEN from_op.cst_work_order_operation_id IS NOT NULL THEN
from_op.cst_work_order_operation_id
WHEN op_dep.from_wo_operation_id IS NOT NULL THEN
- 1
ELSE
NULL
END AS from_cst_wo_operation_id,
CASE
WHEN to_op.cst_work_order_operation_id IS NOT NULL THEN
to_op.cst_work_order_operation_id
WHEN op_dep.to_wo_operation_id IS NOT NULL THEN
- 1
ELSE
NULL
END AS to_cst_wo_operation_id,
op_dep.transfer_percent,
CASE
WHEN wm.work_method_code = 'DISCRETE_MANUFACTURING' THEN
COUNT(1)
OVER(PARTITION BY cwo.cst_work_order_id, op_dep.work_order_id, op_dep.from_wo_operation_id)
ELSE
0
END cnt_of_op,
DENSE_RANK()
OVER(PARTITION BY cwo.cst_work_order_id, op_dep.work_order_id, op_dep.from_wo_operation_id
ORDER BY
op_dep.to_wo_operation_id
) rk,
op_dep.dependency_type,
op_dep.from_wo_operation_id,
op_dep.to_wo_operation_id,
op_dep.work_order_id,
from_op.operation_seq_number from_operation_seq_number,
to_op.operation_seq_number to_operation_seq_number,
wm.work_method_code
FROM
wie_wo_op_dependencies op_dep,
wis_work_methods_b wm,
cst_work_orders cwo,
cst_work_order_operations from_op,
cst_work_order_operations to_op
WHERE
cwo.external_system_reference || '' = 'FUSION'
AND cwo.enable_parallel_ops_flag = 'Y'
AND cwo.work_method_id = wm.work_method_id
AND TO_NUMBER(cwo.external_system_ref_id) = op_dep.work_order_id
AND cwo.cst_work_order_id = from_op.cst_work_order_id (+)
AND cwo.cst_work_order_id = to_op.cst_work_order_id (+)
AND op_dep.from_wo_operation_id = from_op.work_order_operation_id (+)
AND op_dep.dependency_type = 'ORA_FINISH_TO_START'
AND op_dep.to_wo_operation_id = to_op.work_order_operation_id (+)
) t
)

SELECT DISTINCT
ccd.distribution_id distribution_id,

ccb.cost_book_code cost_book_code,
esi.item_number item_number,
ct.quantity quantity,
iuom.unit_of_measure uom_code,
ct.transaction_date transaction_date,
cvu.val_unit_code val_unit_code,
nvl((SELECT MAX(CASE
WHEN cca.adjustment_transaction_id IS NULL THEN 'Transfer Price Adjustment'
WHEN ccas.trade_operation_id <> - 1 THEN 'Landed Cost Adjustment'
WHEN ccas.cmr_ap_invoice_dist_id <> - 1 THEN 'AP Invoice Adjustment'
WHEN ccas.cmr_po_distribution_id <> -1 THEN 'Retroactive Price Adjustment'
ELSE 'No Reference'
END) KEEP(DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY ctc.unit_cost DESC NULLS LAST)
FROM cst_transaction_costs ctc,
cst_acq_cost_adjustments cca,
cst_acq_cost_adj_sources ccas
WHERE cca.adjustment_transaction_id(+) = ctc.adjustment_transaction_id

AND ctc.transaction_id = ccd.transaction_id
AND ctc.eff_date = ccd.eff_date), 'No Reference') transaction_source,
'Reference' transaction_reference,
cwo.work_order_number work_order_number,
ct.txn_source_doc_number receipt_number,
ct.txn_source_ref_doc_number po_number
FROM
cst_cost_orgs_v cco,
cst_cost_books_b ccb,
cst_val_units_b cvu,
egp_system_items_vl esi,
cst_transactions ct,
cst_cost_org_parameters ccop,
cst_cost_distributions ccd,
inv_units_of_measure_vl iuom,
cst_work_orders cwo

ct.cost_org_id = cco.cost_org_id
AND ccop.cost_org_id = ct.cost_org_id
AND ct.cost_book_id = ccb.cost_book_id
AND ct.val_unit_id = cvu.val_unit_id
AND esi.inventory_item_id = ct.inventory_item_id
AND esi.organization_id = ccop.master_organization_id
AND ct.transaction_id = ccd.transaction_id
AND iuom.uom_code = ct.uom_code
AND ct.cst_work_order_id = cwo.cst_work_order_id (+)

cst_cost_org_parameters ccop,

objects.query:
SELECT
nvl(dfla.root_parent_fulfill_line_id,dfla.fulfill_line_id) billing_fulfill_line_id,
ct.transaction_id cogs_transaction_id
FROM cst_transactions ct,
cst_transfer_order_lines ctol,
doo_fulfill_lines_all dfla
WHERE ctol.external_system_reference (+) = 'FUSION'
AND ctol.cst_transfer_order_line_id (+) = ct.cst_transfer_order_line_id
AND dfla.fulfill_line_id(+) =ct.doo_fullfill_line_id
UNION ALL
select nvl(crl.root_parent_fulfill_line_id, crl.doo_fulfill_line_id) billing_fulfill_line_id,
cct.transaction_id cogs_transaction_id
from cst_cogs_transactions cct,
cst_revenue_lines crl
where
crl.revenue_line_id (+) = cct.revenue_line_id
and cct.revenue_line_id >0
union all
select
nvl(dfla.root_parent_fulfill_line_id,dfla.fulfill_line_id) billing_fulfill_line_id,
csrmd.cogs_transaction_id cogs_transaction_id
from
(select
case
when csrm.billing_fullfill_line_id='-1'
then cct.shipment_fullfill_line_id
else csrm.billing_fullfill_line_id
end ship_ref_fullfill_line_id,
cct.transaction_id cogs_transaction_id
from fusion.cst_cogs_transactions cct,
fusion.cst_shipment_revenue_map csrm
where cct.shipment_fullfill_line_id = csrm.shipment_fullfill_line_id
and csrm.bill_only_flag = 'N'
and cct.revenue_line_id ='-1'
and (csrm.delivery_id = to_char(cct.delivery_id)
or csrm.rma_transaction_id = to_char(cct.rma_transaction_id))
) csrmd,
doo_fulfill_lines_all dfla
where
dfla.fulfill_line_id = csrmd.ship_ref_fullfill_line_id

objects.name: CST_XLA_PURCHASE_ORDER_TXNS_V
objects.query:
SELECT DISTINCT
ccd.distribution_id distribution_id,
cco.cost_org_name cost_org_name ,
ccb.cost_book_code cost_book_code ,
iop.organization_code inv_org_code ,
esi.item_number item_number ,
cpod.po_number po_number ,
ct.quantity quantity ,
cit.txn_source_doc_number receipt_number ,
ct.transaction_date transaction_date ,
iuom.unit_of_measure uom_code ,
cvu.val_unit_code val_unit_code ,
cwo.work_order_number work_order_number
FROM cst_transactions ct ,
cst_inv_transactions cit ,
cst_cost_orgs_v cco ,
cst_cost_books_b ccb ,
cst_val_units_b cvu ,
egp_system_items_vl esi ,
inv_org_parameters iop ,
cmr_purchase_order_dtls cpod ,
poz_suppliers_v psv ,
hr_all_organization_units haous ,
hr_all_organization_units haoud ,
cst_cost_distributions ccd,
inv_units_of_measure_vl iuom,
cst_work_orders cwo
WHERE ct.cst_inv_transaction_id = cit.cst_inv_transaction_id
AND ct.cost_org_id = cco.cost_org_id
AND ct.cost_book_id = ccb.cost_book_id
AND ct.val_unit_id = cvu.val_unit_id
AND esi.inventory_item_id = ct.inventory_item_id
AND esi.organization_id = ct.inventory_org_id
AND iop.organization_id = ct.inventory_org_id
AND cpod.external_system_ref_id = to_char(cit.po_distribution_id)
AND cpod.external_system_reference = decode(cit.external_system_reference, 'RCV_INTERNAL', 'FUSION', cit.external_system_reference)
AND cpod.active_flag = 'Y'
AND psv.vendor_id (+) = cpod.vendor_id
AND haous.organization_id (+) = cpod.sold_to_business_unit_id
AND haoud.organization_id (+) = cpod.deliver_to_business_unit_id
AND ccd.transaction_id = ct.transaction_id
AND iuom.uom_code = ct.uom_code
AND ct.cst_work_order_id = cwo.cst_work_order_id(+)
AND ccd.event_type_code <> 'INVOICE_PRICE_CLEARING'
UNION ALL
SELECT DISTINCT
ccd.distribution_id distribution_id,
cco.cost_org_name cost_org_name,
ccb.cost_book_code cost_book_code,
iop.organization_code inv_org_code,
esi.item_number item_number,
cpod.po_number po_number,
cpod.quantity_ordered quantity,
cit.txn_source_doc_number receipt_number,
caot.txn_account_date transaction_date,
cpod.uom_code uom_code,
NULL val_unit_code,
NULL work_order_number
FROM
cst_acctg_only_txns caot,
cst_inv_transactions cit,
cst_cost_orgs_v cco,
cst_cost_books_b ccb,
egp_system_items_vl esi,
inv_org_parameters iop,
cmr_purchase_order_dtls cpod,
poz_suppliers_v psv,
hr_all_organization_units haous,
hr_all_organization_units haoud,
cst_cost_distributions ccd
WHERE
caot.cost_org_id = cco.cost_org_id
AND caot.cost_book_id = ccb.cost_book_id
AND esi.inventory_item_id = caot.inventory_item_id
AND esi.organization_id = caot.inventory_org_id
AND iop.organization_id = caot.inventory_org_id
AND cpod.external_system_ref_id = to_char(cit.po_distribution_id)
AND cpod.external_system_reference = decode(cit.external_system_reference, 'RCV_INTERNAL', 'FUSION', cit.external_system_reference)
AND cpod.active_flag = 'Y'
AND psv.vendor_id (+) = cpod.vendor_id
AND haous.organization_id (+) = cpod.sold_to_business_unit_id
AND haoud.organization_id (+) = cpod.deliver_to_business_unit_id
AND ccd.transaction_id = caot.acctg_only_txns_id
AND cpod.inventory_item_id = caot.inventory_item_id
AND cit.inventory_item_id = caot.inventory_item_id
AND cit.inventory_org_id = caot.inventory_org_id
AND ccd.cost_organization_id = caot.cost_org_id
AND ccd.cost_book_id = caot.cost_book_id
AND ccd.event_type_code = 'INVOICE_PRICE_CLEARING'
AND ccd.transaction_number = cpod.po_number

objects.name: CST_XLA_SALES_CREDITS_V
objects.query:
SELECT jrs.salesrep_number salesrep_number,
aral.rev_ccid salesrep_rev_ccid,
doo_sales_credit.cr_fulfill_line_id cr_fulfill_line_id,
jrs.resource_id cr_salesperson_id,
doo_sales_credit.cr_percent cr_percent
FROM hz_parties hp,
jtf_rs_salesreps jrs,
(SELECT ar.rev_ccid rev_ccid,ar.source_ref_account_id source_ref_account_id, ar.bu_id ar_bu_id FROM ar_ref_accounts_all ar WHERE ar.source_ref_table = 'RA_SALESREPS') aral,
(SELECT DISTINCT cr.fulfill_line_id cr_fulfill_line_id,
cr.salesperson_id cr_salesperson_id,
cr.percent cr_percent,
cr.creation_date
FROM doo_sales_credits cr
WHERE cr.fulfill_line_id IS NOT NULL
AND cr.percent IN
(SELECT /*+ NO_UNNEST PUSH_SUBQ */ MAX(crs.percent)
FROM doo_sales_credits crs
WHERE crs.fulfill_line_id=cr.fulfill_line_id
AND crs.fulfill_line_id IS NOT NULL
)
AND cr.salesperson_id IN
(SELECT /*+ NO_UNNEST PUSH_SUBQ */ MIN(crsss.salesperson_id)
FROM doo_sales_credits crsss
WHERE crsss.fulfill_line_id=cr.fulfill_line_id
AND crsss.sales_credit_id =cr.sales_credit_id
AND crsss.fulfill_line_id IS NOT NULL
)
AND cr.creation_date IN
(SELECT /*+ NO_UNNEST PUSH_SUBQ */ MIN(crss.creation_date)
FROM doo_sales_credits crss
WHERE crss.fulfill_line_id=cr.fulfill_line_id
AND crss.sales_credit_id =cr.sales_credit_id
AND crss.fulfill_line_id IS NOT NULL
)
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT line.fulfill_line_id cr_fulfill_line_id,
cr.salesperson_id cr_salesperson_id,
cr.percent cr_percent,
cr.creation_date
FROM doo_sales_credits cr,
doo_fulfill_lines_all line
WHERE line.header_id = cr.header_id
AND cr.fulfill_line_id IS NULL
AND NOT EXISTS
(SELECT /*+ NO_UNNEST PUSH_SUBQ */ 1
FROM doo_sales_credits cra
WHERE cra.header_id =cr.header_id
AND cra.fulfill_line_id =cr.fulfill_line_id
)
AND NOT EXISTS
(SELECT /*+ NO_UNNEST PUSH_SUBQ */ 1
FROM doo_sales_credits cra
WHERE cra.header_id =cr.header_id
AND cra.fulfill_line_id =line.fulfill_line_id
)
AND cr.percent IN
(SELECT /*+ NO_UNNEST PUSH_SUBQ */ MAX(crs.percent)
FROM doo_sales_credits crs
WHERE crs.header_id =cr.header_id
AND crs.fulfill_line_id IS NULL
)
AND cr.salesperson_id IN
(SELECT /*+ NO_UNNEST PUSH_SUBQ */ MIN(crsa.salesperson_id)
FROM doo_sales_credits crsa
WHERE crsa.header_id =cr.header_id
AND crsa.sales_credit_id =cr.sales_credit_id
AND crsa.fulfill_line_id IS NULL
)
AND cr.creation_date IN
(SELECT /*+ NO_UNNEST PUSH_SUBQ */ MIN(crss.creation_date)
FROM doo_sales_credits crss
WHERE crss.header_id =cr.header_id
AND crss.sales_credit_id =cr.sales_credit_id
AND crss.fulfill_line_id IS NULL
) ) doo_sales_credit,
doo_fulfill_lines_all doo_fulfill
WHERE
hp.party_id (+) = doo_sales_credit.cr_salesperson_id
AND hp.party_id(+) = jrs.resource_id
AND hp.status = 'A'
AND aral.source_ref_account_id (+) = jrs.resource_salesrep_id
AND jrs.status='A'
AND aral.ar_bu_id(+) = doo_fulfill.org_id
AND doo_fulfill.fulfill_line_id (+) = doo_sales_credit.cr_fulfill_line_id
AND jrs.SET_ID IN (0, FND_SetID_Utility.getSetID( 'HZ_SALES_PERSON', 'BU',doo_fulfill.org_id))
AND TRUNC(doo_fulfill.creation_date) BETWEEN TRUNC(jrs.START_DATE_ACTIVE) AND NVL(TRUNC(jrs.END_DATE_ACTIVE),TRUNC(sysdate))

objects.name: CST_XLA_SEED_DATA_V
objects.query:
SELECT DISTINCT te2.event_class_code,
te2.event_type_code event_type_code,
DECODE (A.accounting_definition_id, 5, 'EXPENSE', 7, 'EXPENSE', A.accounting_line_type) accounting_line_code
FROM cst_transaction_events te2,
cst_all_txn_types_v t,
(SELECT ad.accounting_definition_id,
ad.object_version_number,
te.event_class_code,
te.event_type_code event_type_code,
ad.event_type_code ad_event_type_code,
vt.code expense_transaction_flag,
DECODE (ad.source_table, 'cst_transfer_costs', inv.code, NULL) intercompany_invoice_flag,
NVL(ad.overhead_flag, ohd.code) overhead_flag,
tt.code transaction_type,
ad.line_no,
ad.accounting_line_type,
DECODE(ad.transaction_type, NULL, DECODE(tt.code, 'ISSUE', DECODE(ad.dr_cr_sign, 'DR', 'CR', 'DR'), ad.dr_cr_sign), ad.dr_cr_sign) dr_cr_sign,
ad.reverse_sign_flag,
ad.source_table,
ad.use_txn_curr_amount,
ad.use_txn_account,
ad.created_by,
ad.creation_date,
ad.last_updated_by,
ad.last_update_date,
ad.last_update_login
FROM cst_acct_definitions ad,
( SELECT 'EXPENSE' code_type, 'Y' code FROM dual
UNION
SELECT 'EXPENSE' code_type, 'N' code FROM dual
) vt,
( SELECT 'TRANS_TYPE' code_type, 'ISSUE' code FROM dual
UNION
SELECT 'TRANS_TYPE' code_type, 'RECEIPT' code FROM dual
) tt,
( SELECT 'INVOICE' code_type, 'Y' code FROM dual
UNION
SELECT 'INVOICE' code_type, 'N' code FROM dual
) inv,
( SELECT 'OVERHEAD' code_type, 'N' code FROM dual
UNION
SELECT 'OVERHEAD' code_type, 'P' code FROM dual
) ohd,
( SELECT DISTINCT event_class_code,
event_type_code
FROM cst_transaction_events
WHERE transaction_flow_type <> -99
) te
WHERE vt.code_type = 'EXPENSE'
AND NVL(ad.expense_transaction_flag, vt.code) = vt.code
AND tt.code_type = 'TRANS_TYPE'
AND NVL(ad.transaction_type, tt.code) = tt.code
AND inv.code_type = 'INVOICE'
AND DECODE (ad.source_table, 'cst_transfer_costs', NVL(ad.intercompany_invoice_flag, inv.code), 'N') = inv.code
AND ohd.code_type = 'OVERHEAD'
AND DECODE (ad.source_table, 'cst_transfer_costs', DECODE(ad.overhead_flag, NULL, ohd.code, 'N'), 'N')= ohd.code
AND NVL(ad.event_class_code, te.event_class_code) = te.event_class_code
AND NVL(ad.event_type_code, te.event_type_code) = te.event_type_code
AND NVL(ad.transaction_flow_type, -1) <> -99
) A
WHERE t.base_txn_source_type_id (+) = te2.transaction_source_type_id
AND t.base_txn_action_id (+) = te2.transaction_action_id
AND te2.event_class_code = A.event_class_code
AND te2.event_type_code = A.event_type_code
AND NVL(te2.default_cost_txn_type, A.transaction_type) = A.transaction_type
AND NVL(te2.cost_transaction_type, A.transaction_type) = A.transaction_type
AND NVL(te2.source_table, A.source_table) = A.source_table
AND te2.transaction_flow_type <> -99
AND ( NVL(transaction_source_type_id,0), NVL(transaction_action_id,3)) NOT IN
(SELECT base_txn_source_type_id,
base_txn_action_id
FROM cst_txn_source_actions
WHERE inactive_flag = 'Y'
)
AND NVL(t.user_defined_flag, 'N') = 'N'
AND NOT EXISTS
(SELECT 1
FROM cst_txn_source_actions sa
WHERE sa.intransit_flag = 'N'
AND sa.base_txn_action_id = te2.transaction_action_id
AND sa.base_txn_source_type_id = te2.transaction_source_type_id
AND A.source_table = 'cst_transfer_costs'
)
AND EXISTS
(SELECT 1
FROM cst_acct_definitions ad1
WHERE ad1.event_class_code = te2.event_class_code
AND NVL(ad1.event_type_code,te2.event_type_code) = te2.event_type_code
AND ad1.source_table = A.source_table
AND NVL(ad1.transaction_flow_type, -1) <> -99
AND DECODE (A.overhead_flag, 'Y', DECODE (A.source_table, 'cst_layer_costs', ad1.accounting_line_type, 'INVENTORY_VALUATION'), 'INVENTORY_VALUATION') = 'INVENTORY_VALUATION'
)
ORDER BY event_class_code, event_type_code, accounting_line_code

objects.name: XLA_CST_DISTRIBUTION_LINES_VL
objects.query:
SELECT
L.CODE_COMBINATION_ID,
HDR.AE_HEADER_ID,
L.AE_LINE_NUM,
HDR.GL_TRANSFER_DATE,
HDR.GL_TRANSFER_STATUS_CODE,
HDR.AE_HEADER_ID AS XLA_AE_HDR_ID,
B.NAME GL_BATCH_NAME,
B.DESCRIPTION GL_BATCH_DESC,
B.STATUS GL_BATCH_STATUS,
NVL(L.ACCOUNTED_DR, L.ACCOUNTED_CR) SLA_LEDGER_AMOUNT,
DECODE(L.ACCOUNTED_DR, NULL, 'CR', 'DR') SLA_DR_CR_SIGN
FROM
XLA_AE_LINES L,
XLA_AE_HEADERS HDR,
GL_IMPORT_REFERENCES IR,
GL_JE_BATCHES B,
GL_JE_HEADERS JH
WHERE
HDR.APPLICATION_ID = 707
AND L.AE_HEADER_ID = HDR.AE_HEADER_ID
AND L.GL_SL_LINK_ID = IR.GL_SL_LINK_ID (+)
AND L.GL_SL_LINK_TABLE = IR.GL_SL_LINK_TABLE (+)
AND IR.JE_BATCH_ID = B.JE_BATCH_ID (+)
AND NVL(B.PARENT_JE_BATCH_ID, 0) = 0
AND JH.JE_HEADER_ID = IR.JE_HEADER_ID
AND JH.LEDGER_ID = HDR.LEDGER_ID
AND HDR.ACCOUNTING_DATE >= NVL(to_date(SYS_CONTEXT('CST_CA_OTBI_PARAMS','p_gl_from_date'),'YYYY-MM-DD'), to_date('01/01/1900','mm/dd/yyyy'))
AND HDR.ACCOUNTING_DATE <= NVL(to_date(SYS_CONTEXT('CST_CA_OTBI_PARAMS','p_gl_to_date'),'YYYY-MM-DD'), to_date('12/31/4712','mm/dd/yyyy'))

columns.name: VERSION_LABEL

columns.name: CATEGORY_ID

columns.name: CONTENT_TYPE
columns.comments: Content type as specified during the uploading process. This string is an unparsed entity-header for the entity Content-Type.

columns.name: FILE_FORMAT
columns.comments: Indicates whether the uploaded file is in a binary or text format, helping to identify the file?s data structure.

columns.name: STATUS

objects.name: EDR_RECORDS
objects.description: This table stores e-record information for each ERES transaction and also caters to e-records only scenarios.

columns.name: RECORD_ID
columns.comments: This is the primary key and its value is an application generated unique id. It is used to uniquely identify the e-record for an ERES transaction.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.comments: Unique identifier of Organization and represents the org for which ERES transaction is done.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Identifies the EDR transaction type associated with this electronic record. Source: EDR_TRANSACTION_TYPES_B.TRANSACTION_TYPE_CODE. Values are controlled by EDR transaction type setup and are not free-form text.

columns.name: ROOT_TASK_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the root BPM human task associated with the electronic signature or approval workflow for this electronic record. This is a workflow support reference used to correlate the record with the overall signature task flow.

columns.name: IDENTIFICATION_KEY
columns.comments: User defined id for the task and the value should be unique across task Namespace and Name.

columns.name: TASK_OUTCOME
columns.comments: Stores the final workflow task outcome associated with the electronic record. Source: lookup type ORA_EDR_SIGNATURE_OUTCOME or mapped BPM workflow outcome values. Valid values are defined by ORA_EDR_SIGNATURE_OUTCOME or workflow mapping and represent the final approval, rejection, or other configured outcome captured for the record. This field is workflow outcome evidence and is distinct from the generated XML evidence stored in ERECORD_XML.

columns.name: PARENT_KEY
columns.comments: Identifies the parent transaction record key associated with this electronic record when the record participates in a related parent-child transaction flow.

columns.name: PARENT_TRANSACTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Identifies the parent EDR transaction type when this electronic record is created as part of a related parent-child transaction flow. Source: EDR transaction type setup. Values are controlled transaction type codes and are not free-form text.

columns.name: CHILD_SIGNATURE_TYPE
columns.comments: Identifies how approval or signature evidence is applied to a related child transaction. Source: lookup type ORA_EDR_CHILD_SIGNATURE_TYPE. Valid values are defined by ORA_EDR_CHILD_SIGNATURE_TYPE and control how child transaction signature behavior or approval stamping is handled in a parent-child related-event flow.

columns.name: HAS_RELATED_EVENTS
columns.comments: Indicates whether this electronic record participates in related parent-child transaction behavior for electronic record or electronic signature processing. Valid values: Y = the transaction has related events; N = the transaction does not have related events.

columns.name: FND_ATTACHMENT_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the FND attachment record associated with the rendered electronic record output or attached document. This field references attachment-based storage or presentation output and should be interpreted separately from the authoritative structured XML evidence stored in ERECORD_XML.

columns.name: ERECORD_XML
columns.comments: Stores the structured XML evidence payload generated for the electronic record. This is the system-generated XML representation of the electronic record evidence and is distinct from any rendered or attached document referenced through FND_ATTACHMENT_ID.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.comments: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.comments: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.comments: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: TASK_TITLE
columns.comments: Stores the BPM task title or display title for the transaction associated with this electronic record. Used for workflow display, reporting, and review context; this field is not the authoritative generated evidence payload.

columns.name: TASK_NUMBER
columns.comments: Stores the BPM task number associated with the electronic record workflow. Used to correlate the electronic record with the generated BPM task for review, approval, or signature processing.

columns.name: TASK_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.comments: Stores the BPM task definition name configured for the workflow task associated with this electronic record. Used to identify the workflow definition that supported review, approval, or signature processing.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: ARCHIVED_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates whether the electronic record has entered the archived lifecycle state. Valid values: Y = the electronic record is archived; N = the electronic record is not archived.

columns.name: ARCHIVED_BY
columns.comments: Identifies the user who performed or initiated the archive action for the electronic record. Used with ARCHIVED_DATE and ARCHIVED_FLAG to interpret the archive lifecycle state.

columns.name: ARCHIVED_DATE
columns.comments: Indicates the date and time when the e-record was archived.

objects.name: EDR_RECORD_ACTION_DETAILS
objects.description: This table stores the actions performed by an individual against an e-record, like download, print.

columns.name: ACTION_DETAIL_ID
columns.comments: This is the primary key and its value is an application generated unique id. It is used to uniquely identify the action details for an e-record.

columns.name: RECORD_ID
columns.comments: Represents foreign key to EDR_RECORDS table. It is used to uniquely identify the e-record for an ERES transaction.

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.comments: Identifies the controlled action performed on the electronic record output. Source: lookup type ORA_EDR_ACTION_TYPE_CODE. Valid values are defined by ORA_EDR_ACTION_TYPE_CODE; current examples include DOWNLOAD = downloaded record and PRINT = printed record.

columns.name: ACTION_COMPLETED_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates whether the requested electronic record action completed successfully. Valid values: Y = the action completed; N = the action did not complete or was not completed.

columns.name: FND_ATTACHMENT_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the FND attachment record for the output affected by the action. This may reference either a collated combined electronic record output or a single electronic record output, depending on the action execution context.

columns.name: ACTION_GROUP_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the action execution group used to associate multiple electronic records with the same print or download operation. Rows with the same action group represent records processed together in a single grouped action.

columns.name: RECORD_SEQUENCE_NUMBER
columns.comments: Indicates the sequence of the electronic record within an action group. Used to preserve ordering when multiple records are processed together as part of a collated or grouped print or download action.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.comments: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.comments: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.comments: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

objects.name: EDR_TRANSACTION_TYPES_VL
objects.query:
SELECT
B.TRANSACTION_TYPE_ID,
T.TRANSACTION_TYPE_MEANING,
T.TRANSACTION_TYPE_DESCRIPTION,
B.TRANSACTION_TYPE_CODE,
B.TRANSACTION_TYPE_SHORT_CODE,
B.BPM_TASK_NAMESPACE,
B.BPM_COMPOSITE_NAME,
B.BPM_RULE_FILE_NAME,
B.SIGNATURE_MODE,
B.BI_REPORT_PATH,
B.BI_TEMPLATE_NAME,
B.BI_OUTPUT_FORMAT,
B.ENABLED_FOR_ALL_ORGS_FLAG,
B.SUPPORTS_TXN_ATTACHMENTS_FLAG,
B.OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER,
B.CREATED_BY,
B.CREATION_DATE,
B.LAST_UPDATED_BY,
B.LAST_UPDATE_DATE,
B.LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN,
B.AUTO_APPR_DISABLED_FLAG,
T.IDENTIFIER
FROM
EDR_TRANSACTION_TYPES_TL T,
EDR_TRANSACTION_TYPES_B B
WHERE
T.TRANSACTION_TYPE_ID = B.TRANSACTION_TYPE_ID AND T.LANGUAGE = USERENV('LANG')

columns.name: BASIS
columns.comments: Defines the basis by which the charge amount is captured and allocated to Item Lines. FDC will pre-seed the following charge basis: ??? Aggregate: This indicates that the charge is entered at header level and needs to be allocated to individual Item lines. ??? Percentage of FD Item Value: This indicates that the charge amount is given in percentage and to be calculated by applying the percentage value to the Item price given at lines and consolidated in to the Amount Column. ??? Percentage of FD Item Value (Variable): Same as percentage of Item Price. However a user can select this charge basis if percentage is expected to be different for different items within a single Fiscal Document. Users will enter this information only when Item Lines are associated to the Fiscal Document (Allocation or save action can notify the user where percentages are missing). Applicable mainly for the Header taxes where rates can be different across the item lines Further, the Basis available for the charge will be influenced by the Charge Type. For the Charge type of ???Charges??? only Aggregate null of FD Item Value is available, for Charge type of ???Tax??? all of three are available.

columns.name: PERCENTAGE
columns.comments: Applicable only when the charge basis is ???Percentage of Item Price??? The %age to be applied to the all item lines in the given Fiscal Document

columns.name: CHARGE_AMOUNT
columns.comments: Amount as highlighted on the Fiscal Document received by Buyer

columns.name: ALLOCATION_BASIS
columns.comments: Applicable only if the charge basis is aggregate or Percentage of Item Amount. Defaulted from Charge Name Setup. Users have an option to override and call select any of the following allocation basis: 1) Equally 2) Quantity 3) Weight 4) Volume 5) Fiscal Document Item Value (Applicable for Brazil) 6) Item Value on the PO schedule 7) Manual Factor 8) Direct to Item Line (Applicable only if the Charge Derived basis is % of FD Item Value (variable))

columns.name: ALLOCATION_UOM
columns.comments: The base allocation UOM to be used. Applicable/enabled only when the allocation basis selected is Quantity, Weight and Volume. The base UOM value is defaulted from the charge name setup definition. Can be overridden by the user at any time (subject to business rules related to Fiscal Document status). The source for this look up will be the Inventory UOM table? This is required since FD Item lines to which a charge needs to be allocated can have different UOM???s.. There is a need to have a Base UOM in which all FD Item lines can be represented.

columns.name: CHARGE_LINE_STATUS
columns.comments: Indicates the state of the charge line -New -Not Allocated - Successfully Allocated - Error -Allocation Not Required -Needs Re-Allocation

columns.name: CHARGE_LINE_ID
columns.comments: Surrogate key that identifies the line.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_HEADER_ID
columns.comments: Indicates the Document Header of the line.

columns.name: LINE_NUMBER
columns.comments: Indicates sequence for each line Charge under each Fiscal Document header.

columns.name: CHARGE_ID
columns.comments: Indicates charge of Inbound charges.

columns.name: BASIS
columns.comments: Defines the basis by which the charge amount is captured and allocated to Item Lines. FDC will pre-seed the following charge basis: Aggregate: This indicates that the charge is entered at header level and needs to be allocated to individual Item lines. Percentage of FD Item Value: This indicates that the charge amount is given in percentage and to be calculated by applying the percentage value to the Item price given at lines and consolidated in to the Amount Column. Percentage of FD Item Value (Variable): Same as percentage of Item Price. However a user can select this charge basis if percentage is expected to be different for different items within a single Fiscal Document. Users will enter this information only when Item Lines are associated to the Fiscal Document (Allocation or save action can notify the user where percentages are missing). Applicable mainly for the Header taxes where rates can be different across the item lines Further, the Basis available for the charge will be influenced by the Charge Type. For the type Charges only Aggregate & Percentage of FD Item Value is available, for Charge type of Tax all of three are available.

columns.name: PERCENTAGE
columns.comments: Applicable only when the charge basis is Percentage of Item Price, the percentage to be applied to the all item lines in the given Fiscal Document.

columns.name: CHARGE_AMOUNT
columns.comments: Amount as highlighted on the Fiscal Document received by Buyer.

columns.name: ALLOCATION_BASIS
columns.comments: Applicable only if the charge basis is aggregate or Percentage of Item Amount. Defaulted from Charge Name Setup. Users have an option to override and call select any of the following allocation basis: 1) Equally 2) Quantity 3) Weight 4) Volume 5) Fiscal Document Item Value (Applicable for Brazil) 6) Item Value on the PO schedule 7) Manual Factor 8) Direct to Item Line (Applicable only if the Charge Derived basis is % of FD Item Value (variable)).

columns.name: ALLOCATION_UOM
columns.comments: The base allocation UOM to be used. Applicable/enabled only when the allocation basis selected is Quantity, Weight and Volume. The base UOM value is defaulted from the charge name setup definition. Can be overridden by the user at any time (subject to business rules related to Fiscal Document status). The source for this look up will be the Inventory UOM table. This is required since FD Item lines to which a charge needs to be allocated can have different UOM There is a need to have a Base UOM in which all FD Item lines can be represented.

columns.name: CHARGE_LINE_STATUS
columns.comments: Indicates the state of the charge line -New -Not Allocated - Successfully Allocated - Error -Allocation Not Required -Needs Re-Allocation.

objects.name: CMF_FISCAL_DOC_HEADERS
objects.description: This table will store Fiscal Document Header information.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_HEADER_ID
columns.comments: Surrogate key that identifies the Fiscal Document.

columns.name: INTERFACED_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag to determine the source of the Fiscal Document. Values: 'Y' - XML Interfaced FDs 'N' - Manually created FDs.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_NUMBER
columns.comments: Number for the Fiscal Document given on the Fiscal Document sent by the Supplier.

columns.name: ACCESS_KEY_NUMBER
columns.comments: Access Key number generated by issuer for each electronic fiscal document /electronic freight fiscal document.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_STATUS
columns.comments: The document status for the Fiscal Document Header. It can have following values: - New - Open - Cancelled - Closed.

columns.name: BILL_TO_BUSINESS_UNIT_ID
columns.comments: User will be able to choose the right Bill to BU based on the security access. This attribute is mandatory to be entered by the user when creating the FD.

columns.name: SOLD_TO_LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.comments: Sold to Legal Entity unique identifier. Indicates the party which is financially responsible for the purchases on a purchase order.

columns.name: FISCAL_DOC_ASSOCTNS_ID
columns.comments: Its association identifier which associates the Fiscal Document with a FD Process/Type.

columns.name: FISCAL_PROC_OPTIONS_ID
columns.comments: This is the reference with Process Option that defines the FD type and process.

columns.name: INVOICE_ID
columns.comments: Invoice identifier to uniquely identify the invoice.

columns.name: INVOICE_NUM
columns.comments: Invoice number generated by the fiscal document.

columns.name: ISSUER_TAX_ID
columns.comments: Taxpayer Id of the company which creates the FD. The issuer can be a Supplier or Customer (when outbound document) or Inventory Organization (when inbound document). Will be informed when creating FD (Manage Fiscal Documents) and ready only when editing FD.

columns.name: ISSUER_PARTY_ID
columns.comments: Identifier of the company which creates the FD.

columns.name: ISSUER_PARTY_SITE_ID
columns.comments: Identifier of the company site which creates the FD.

columns.name: ISSUER_LOCATION_ID
columns.comments: Identifier of the company site location which creates the FD.

columns.name: COUNTRY_CODE
columns.comments: This field is used to store issuer country code.

columns.name: RECEIVER_TAX_ID
columns.comments: Taxpayer Id of document receiver. For Operation Type = outbound the receiver is the legal entity (company name) which is receiving the FD. For Operation Type = inbound the receiver is the company that the issuer creates the FD on behalf. (TCA party name).

columns.name: RECEIVER_PARTY_ID
columns.comments: Identifier of the company which receives the FD.

columns.name: RECEIVER_PARTY_SITE_ID
columns.comments: Identifier of the company site which receives the FD.

columns.name: RECEIVER_LOCATION_ID
columns.comments: Identifier of the company site location which receives the FD.

columns.name: SHIPTO_TAX_ID
columns.comments: Stores the Ship-To Taxpayer identifier.

columns.name: SHIPTO_PARTY_ID
columns.comments: Identifier of the company which receives the material.

columns.name: SHIPTO_PARTY_SITE_ID
columns.comments: Identifier of the company site which receives the material.

columns.name: SHIPTO_LOCATION_ID
columns.comments: Identifier of the company site location which receives the FD.

columns.name: SHIPFROM_TAX_ID
columns.comments: Taxpayer Id of the third party where the goods are shipped from.

columns.name: SHIPFROM_PARTY_ID
columns.comments: Identifier of the company which ships the material.

columns.name: SHIPFROM_PARTY_SITE_ID
columns.comments: Identifier of the company site which ships the material.

columns.name: SHIPFROM_LOCATION_ID
columns.comments: Identifier of the company site location which ships the material.

columns.name: SHIPFROM_IBGE_CITY_CODE
columns.comments: Stores the value of city code which ships the material.

columns.name: SHIPFROM_IBGE_CITY_ID
columns.comments: Identifier of the city which ships the material.

columns.name: SHIPTO_IBGE_CITY_CODE
columns.comments: Stores the value of city code which receives the material.

columns.name: SHIPTO_IBGE_CITY_ID
columns.comments: Identifier of the city which receives the material.

columns.name: SOURCE_REF_DOC_HEADER_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the source document related to this fiscal document header. Example: shipment header indicating the ASN/ASNB for drop ship seller flow or consumption advice header for consigned flow.

columns.name: PARENT_DOCUMENT_HEADER_ID
columns.comments: Identifier of header of Parent Fiscal Document.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_UNIQUE_IDENTIFIER
columns.comments: A unique identifier for fiscal document imported from XML for sequencing.

columns.name: INTEREST_INDICATOR
columns.comments: Indicates whether interest applies to the fiscal document.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ISSUE_DATE
columns.comments: Issue Date of fiscal document. For manual entry will be informed when creating a fiscal document. When the document is launched from XML this attribute will be filled automatically and will be read only when editing FD. Issue Date cannot be greater than current date.

columns.name: ACKNOWLEDGED_DATE
columns.comments: Date on which the Fiscal Document is acknowledged into the System.

columns.name: MODEL
columns.comments: Model of fiscal document. Options are: 1-Fiscal document. 6-Electric power FD or bill. 7-Transport service FD. 8-Road bill of lading. 9-Waterway bill of lading. 10-Airway bill. 11-Rail bill of lading. 21-Communication service FD. 22-Telecommunications service FD. 26-Transport multimodal of cargo. 27-Rail service FD. 28-Piped gas FD. 29-Piped water FD. 55-Electronic fiscal document. 57-Electronic bill of lading.

columns.name: SERIES
columns.comments: Series of fiscal document. For manual entry will be given when editing a fiscal document. Use values for FD Process and FD Type to go to Process Options Table and get value for Electronic Models and Series Required column. If Series Required is NOT USED then the attribute is blocked from user access. As it is a mandatory attribute let us assume 0(zero) as default value for this case. If user enters a model that is one of the models of the Electronic Models list and Series Required is ELECTRONIC or ALL then series is mandatory. If user entered model is NOT in the list of Electronic Models and Series Required is ALL or NOT ELECTRONIC then series is mandatory.

columns.name: SUBSERIES
columns.comments: Number of the freight fiscal document sub-series.

columns.name: SOURCE_DOCUMENT_TYPE
columns.comments: The document type for which Fiscal Document is captured or created. The document type indicates the business flow for which a Fiscal Document is captured. The look up value for source document type will include: - Purchase Order - RMA - Internal Requisition - Consignment PO - Standard Fiscal Document (when complementary FD).

columns.name: DOCUMENT_TYPE
columns.comments: The type of Fiscal Document that is sent by supplier or party for capturing and processing indicating the business flow it covers. Logical Entity Fiscal Document Type will indicate the possible types of Fiscal Documents that can be received namely, - Standard Fiscal Document - Complementary FD - Freight FD - Remittance FD - Symbolic Remittance FD.

columns.name: CURRENCY
columns.comments: Currency of Fiscal Document. Options: BRL - Brazilian Real.

columns.name: CONVERSTION_TYPE
columns.comments: Type of conversion from GL. Only when currency different from functional currency. For XML launching it will be informed during the Import UI. For manual entry it will be informed manually when creating fiscal document. In case the functional currency of Set of Books and FD currency are the same this will be not required.

columns.name: CONVERSION_RATE
columns.comments: Rate of conversion to the currency of source document (PO, RMA, Internal Requisition).

columns.name: TOTAL_AMOUNT
columns.comments: Fiscal Document Header Amount for this Fiscal Document record.

columns.name: ITEM_LINE_AMOUNT
columns.comments: Total amount of goods or service (under incidence or taxed by ICMS) without accessory expenses. Sum of total line amount of goods or services under incidence or taxed by ICMS (quantity x unit price) For SPED reporting.

columns.name: OPERATION_TYPE
columns.comments: Type of fiscal document operation. For SPED Reporting and as base of entire FDC logic. Options are: 0-Inbound (when the BU issue the FD on behalf of TCA). 1-Outbound (when the TCA party issue an FD). Will be informed when creating FD (Manage Fiscal Documents) and ready only when editing FD.

columns.name: VALIDATION_STATUS
columns.comments: The validation status of Fiscal Document. It can have following values: - Never Validated - Pre-Validated - Validated - Needs Revalidation.

columns.name: REFERENCED_STATUS
columns.comments: The Referenced status for the Fiscal Document. It can have following values: - Not Required - Referenced - Not Referenced.

columns.name: CHARGE_ALLOCATION_STATUS
columns.comments: The Allocation status for the Fiscal Document. It can have following values: - Completed (Completed when all charge lines have been allocated to Item Lines) - Pending (At least one of the Charge lines is pending for allocation) - New (Not even one charge line is allocated).

columns.name: TAX_CALCULATION_STATUS
columns.comments: The Tax Calculation status for the Fiscal Document. It can have following values: - Completed (Tax computation is done for all the lines) - Pending (Tax computation is not done at-least for one charge line) - New (Tax Computation not yet started).

columns.name: REASON
columns.comments: Fiscal Document Status change reason.

columns.name: SCHEDULES_ALLOCATED_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates whether the fiscal document line amounts were allocated to the schedules level by received quantity. The allocated amounts are stored in table CMF_FISCAL_DOC_SCHED_ASSOC.

columns.name: CMR_INTERFACED_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates whether the fiscal document was interfaced to receipt accounting.

columns.name: INVOICE_INTERFACED_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates whether the fiscal document was interfaced to payables.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_SYSTEM_REFERENCE
columns.comments: Is used for backend processing based on the interface records.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_SYSTEM_REF_ID
columns.comments: Is used for backend processing based on the interface records.

columns.name: ISSUING_PURPOSE

columns.name: TYPE_OF_CREDIT

columns.comments: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: RELEASE_REASON_CODE

objects.name: CMF_AP_ELIGIBLE_FD_V
objects.query:
SELECT
elfdh.document_header_id
,elfdh.document_number
,elfdh.access_key_number
,elfdh.source_document_type
,elfdh.document_type
,elfdh.issuer_tax_id
,elfdh.receiver_tax_id
,elfdh.shipfrom_tax_id
FROM
cmf_fiscal_doc_headers elfdh
,cmf_fiscal_doc_ref_attributes elfdra
,cmf_fiscal_doc_headers elrfdh
WHERE
elfdh.document_status = 'VALIDATED'
AND NVL(elfdh.invoice_interfaced_flag,'N') = 'N'
AND elfdh.document_type != 'REMITTANCE_FD'
AND elfdra.document_header_id(+) = elfdh.document_header_id
AND elrfdh.document_header_id(+) = elfdra.ref_document_header_id
AND NVL(elrfdh.document_type,'X') != 'REMITTANCE_FD'
AND elfdh.schedules_allocated_flag = 'Y'
AND EXISTS
(SELECT 1
FROM cmf_fiscal_proc_options fpo
WHERE fpo.fiscal_proc_options_id = elfdh.fiscal_proc_options_id
AND fpo.iface_ap_flag = 'Y'
)
AND EXISTS
(SELECT 1
FROM cmf_fiscal_doc_lines_b elfdl
WHERE elfdl.document_header_id = elfdh.document_header_id
AND ( elfdl.fd_original_cfop IS NULL
OR EXISTS (
SELECT
'X'
FROM
cmf_fiscal_operation_types fot
WHERE
fot.fiscal_doc_assoctns_id = elfdh.fiscal_doc_assoctns_id
AND fot.fiscal_operation_code = elfdl.fd_original_cfop
AND fot.payment_flag = 'Y'
) )
)
AND NOT EXISTS
(SELECT 1
FROM cmf_fiscal_doc_lines_b elfdl
WHERE elfdl.document_header_id = elfdh.document_header_id
AND elfdl.line_status NOT IN ('VALIDTD_RECPT_CNFD','VALIDATED')
)

objects.query:
SELECT FDL.FD_HEADERS_INT_ID
,FDL.FD_LINES_INT_ID
,NULL SRC_INVENTORY_ORG_ID
,PLL.SHIP_TO_ORGANIZATION_ID DEST_INVENTORY_ORG_ID
,FDL.SOURCE_DOCUMENT_TYPE
FROM PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL PLL
,CMF_FD_LINES_INT FDL
WHERE PLL.LINE_LOCATION_ID(+) = FDL.SOURCE_DOC_SCHEDULE_ID
AND FDL.SOURCE_DOCUMENT_TYPE = 'PURCHASE_ORDER'
UNION
SELECT FDL.FD_HEADERS_INT_ID
,FDL.FD_LINES_INT_ID
,RSH.ORGANIZATION_ID SRC_INVENTORY_ORG_ID
,RSH.SHIP_TO_ORG_ID DEST_INVENTORY_ORG_ID
,FDL.SOURCE_DOCUMENT_TYPE
FROM RCV_SHIPMENT_HEADERS RSH
,CMF_FD_LINES_INT FDL
WHERE RSH.SHIPMENT_HEADER_ID(+) = FDL.SOURCE_DOC_HEADER_ID
AND FDL.SOURCE_DOCUMENT_TYPE = 'INTERNAL_REQUISITION'
UNION
SELECT FDL.FD_HEADERS_INT_ID
,FDL.FD_LINES_INT_ID
,NULL SRC_INVENTORY_ORG_ID
,DOFLV.FULFILL_ORG_ID DEST_INVENTORY_ORG_ID
,FDL.SOURCE_DOCUMENT_TYPE
FROM DOO_FULFILL_LINES_ALL_V DOFLV
,CMF_FD_LINES_INT FDL
WHERE DOFLV.FULFILL_LINE_ID(+) = FDL.SOURCE_DOC_SCHEDULE_ID
AND FDL.SOURCE_DOCUMENT_TYPE = 'RETURN_MATERIAL_AUTHORIZATION'
UNION
SELECT FDL.FD_HEADERS_INT_ID
,FDL.FD_LINES_INT_ID
,NULL SRC_INVENTORY_ORG_ID
,IOD.ORGANIZATION_ID DEST_INVENTORY_ORG_ID
,FDL.SOURCE_DOCUMENT_TYPE
FROM RCS_ORG_DEFINITIONS_LW_V IOD
,EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_VL EGP
,CMF_FD_LINES_INT FDL
WHERE IOD.ORGANIZATION_ID = IOD.MASTER_ORGANIZATION_ID
AND IOD.ORGANIZATION_ID = EGP.ORGANIZATION_ID
AND EGP.PURCHASING_ITEM_FLAG(+) = 'Y'
AND EGP.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID(+) = FDL.ITEM_ID
AND FDL.SOURCE_DOCUMENT_TYPE = 'NO_SOURCE'

objects.name: CMF_FD_OUT_ORIGIN_CFOPS_V
objects.query:
SELECT
ZXBC.CLASSIFICATION_CODE,
ZXBC.CLASSIFICATION_NAME
FROM
ZX_FC_BUSINESS_CATEGORIES_V ZXBC
WHERE
ZXBC.COUNTRY_CODE = 'BR'
AND ZXBC.EVENT_CLASS_CODE = 'SALES_TRANSACTION'
AND ZXBC.CONCAT_CLASSIF_CODE LIKE '%OPERATION_FISCAL_CODE%'
AND ZXBC.CLASSIFICATION_CODE_LEVEL = 3
AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) >= TRUNC(ZXBC.EFFECTIVE_FROM) AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) < TRUNC(NVL(ZXBC.EFFECTIVE_TO,SYSDATE+1))

,decode(fdp.ship_from_type,'SUPPLIER',shipfrom.party_site_id,'CUSTOMER',shipfrom.party_site_id,'LE',leshipfrom.establishment_id) shipfrom_party_site_id
,decode(fdp.ship_from_type,'SUPPLIER',shipfrom.party_site_name,'CUSTOMER',shipfrom.party_site_name,'LE',leshipfrom.establishment_name) shipfrom_party_site_name
,decode(fdp.ship_from_type,'SUPPLIER',shipfrom.location_id,'CUSTOMER',shipfrom.location_id,'LE',leshipfrom.location_id) shipfrom_location_id

select zpti.party_taxpayer_idntfs_id
,nvl(zpti.party_taxpayer_idntfs_id,-999) Formatted_Tax_id
,zpti.tax_payer_number taxpayer_id
,lpad(zpti.tax_payer_number,14,'0') formatted_taxpayer_number
,hp.party_id
,hp.party_name
,hps.party_site_id
,hps.party_site_name
,hl.location_id
,hl.address1
,hl.address2
,hl.address3
,hl.address4
,hl.city city
,hl.state state
,hl.country
,hl.postal_code
,replace(replace(hl.address1||', '||hl.address2||', '||hl.address3||', '||hl.address4||', '||hl.city||', '||hl.state||', '||hl.country||', '||hl.postal_code,',,',','),', ,',',') formatted_address
,zptp.supplier_flag
,zptp.customer_flag
from zx_party_taxpayer_idntfs zpti
,zx_party_tax_profile zptp
,hz_parties hp
,hz_party_sites hps
,hz_locations hl
where zpti.entity_id = zptp.party_tax_profile_id
and zptp.party_id = hps.party_site_id
and hps.party_id = hp.party_id
and hps.location_id = hl.location_id
and zpti.reporting_type_code in ('ORA_BR_CNPJ','ORA_BR_CPF','ORA_BR_OTHER')
and zptp.party_type_code = 'THIRD_PARTY_SITE'
and zptp.site_flag = 'Y'
and trunc(sysdate) between nvl(zpti.effective_from,trunc(sysdate)-1) and nvl(zpti.effective_to,trunc(sysdate+1))

|| hl.address3

|| hl.address4

objects.description: INV_ABC_ASSGN_GROUP_CLASSES stores information about the ABC Classes that are assigned to an ABC Group. An ABC Class can be assigned to 1 or more ABC Groups, but may be used only once in each ABC Group. . In addition to membership information, this table contains the priority number of the ABC Class in the ABC Group, and compile breakpoint specifications such as item sequence number from the compile, percent of items, and percent of value that goes into this ABC Class/ABC Group combination. . objects.name: INV_ABC_ASSIGNMENTS
objects.description: INV_ABC_ASSIGNMENTS holds assignments of inventory items to ABC Classes and ABC Groups. . An item can belong to 1 or more ABC Classes, but not more than once in each ABC Group. . An ABC Class can belong to 1 or more ABC Groups, but not more than once in each ABC Group. . The Assign ABC Items window allows the user to specify for a given ABC Group, the range of items to assign to every single ABC Class in the ABC Group. The range of items is indicated as an absolute sequence number or value; or as a percent of item, or value. Then, a concurrent program (INCAAA) looks at this assignment information and at the items compiled for that group, and assigns items to their corresponding classes. This information is stored in the INV_ABC_ASSIGNMENTS table. . Oracle Inventory uses this information to load the cycle count process.

objects.name: INV_ABC_COMPILE_HEADERS
objects.description: INV_ABC_COMPILE_HEADERS contains information that is used for, and that results from an ABC compile or ABC analysis. It holds user- specified information entered through the Define ABC Compiles window, such as the current compile option and cost code chosen, as well as the results of an ABC analysis, such as the number of items included in the compile, the cumulative item quantity and the cumulative item value. . Oracle Inventory uses this information during the ABC compilation process to determine the compile criterion and attributes used for the compilation; this information is also used for reporting purposes in the ABC Descending Value Report, and the ABC Assignments Report. . .

objects.name: INV_ATTR_UPDATE_HEADERS
objects.description: This table stores the inventory attribute update requests created in Oracle Fusion Inventory. The attribute update requests update the project and task attributes associated with the on-hand inventory for an item. These requests are created based on the project transfer recommendations created in Oracle Fusion Supply Chain Planning. These requests can also be initiated when project transfer requests are created using an Inventory Attribute Transaction Requests REST resource. These requests are triggered in Supply Chain Planning when there is a need to move inventory from one project and task to another or to move common inventory to another project and task based on the changes in the sales order or forecast demand.

columns.name: HEADER_ID
columns.comments: Inventory Attribute Update Request Header. Unique Identifier. Primary key.

columns.name: SOURCE_HEADER_ID
columns.comments: Source Header Identifier (Supply Order Header Id for project transfers initiated by Fusion SCO).

columns.name: HEADER_NUMBER
columns.comments: This is a sequence generated. Inventory Attribute Update Request number.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.comments: Description of the Inventory Attribute Update request.

columns.name: PRODUCT_CODE
columns.comments: Source from where this request was submitted. Example, Fusion SCO or an external non-fusion system.

columns.name: REQUESTED_DATE
columns.comments: Date when Inventory Attribute Update was requested.

columns.name: STATUS_LOOKUP
columns.comments: Indicates whether the request is OPEN/CLOSED/CANCELLED/IN PROCESS, etc.

columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

objects.name: INV_ATTR_UPDATE_LINES
objects.description: This table stores the details needed to execute the inventory attribute update requests in Oracle Fusion Inventory. Oracle Fusion Supply Chain Planning provides the REQUESTED_QUANTITY, PROJECT_ID, TASK_ID, TRANSFER_PROJECT_ID, and TRANSFER_TASK_ID. The requests are created in an Open status and processed in an Online processing mode when invoked from Supply Chain Planning. The requests can be created to process in Online, Concurrent, or Background processing modes using an Inventory Attribute Transaction Requests REST resource. Inventory determines the material to use to execute the project transfer and updates the TRANSFER_QUANTITY when the project transfer is executed. Inventory also determines the subinventory, locator, revision, lot numbers, and serial numbers based on the FIFO (First in, First Out) logic to execute the project transfer requests and populates the INV_TRANSACTIONS_INTERFACE, INV_TRANSACTION_LOTS_INTERFACE, and INV_SERIAL_NUMBERS_INTERFACE tables. The request moves to a Closed status when the project transfer is executed or when material to execute the project transfer isn't available.

objects.name: INV_CC_ENTRIES_HISTORY
objects.description: This table would store the details for recounts that have been done for the specific count sequence. Once the Count Sequence has been marked for recount the a row would be populated in this table which would push information from the count sequence row and then the count sequence row would be refreshed for the next count. objects.name: INV_CC_SCHEDULE_REQUESTS
objects.description: INV_CC_SCHEDULE_REQUESTS stores cycle count schedule requests. The SCHEDULE_STATUS column indicates whether the schedule request has been processed, completed, closed without count requests generated, or awaiting processing. . Cycle count schedule requests partially or fully specify the SKU (stock keeping unit) to cycle count. The cycle count generation process explodes each schedule request into count requests that fully specify the SKU against which count entries and adjustments are made. . Oracle Inventory uses this information to feed the count generation process and generate Cycle Count Requests that show up in the Count List Report.

objects.name: INV_CYCLE_COUNT_CLASSES
objects.description: INV_CYCLE_COUNT_CLASSES stores information about cycle count classes such as associated cycle count name, approval tolerance limits, and minimum counting frequency. . Oracle Inventory uses Cycle Count Classes as a unit for specifying and defaulting cycle count attributes. The cycle count scheduler uses counting frequency to determine if the class is eligible, and if so, how many and which items are eligible for scheduling. The count entry and approvals form uses tolerance limits to determine if an adjustment needs to be made. .

objects.name: INV_CYCLE_COUNT_ENTRIES
objects.description: INV_CYCLE_COUNT_ENTRIES stores the actual counts of a cycle count. A row in this table without a count is considered to be a count request. Oracle Inventory uses this information to determine and store cycle count adjustments, recounts, and approval requirements. . When a cycle count adjustment is approved, the count status is set to completed and the adjustment amount field is populated. The Cycle Count Approval form then calls a user exit to post an entry in the INV_MATERIAL_TXNS_TEMP, from which the Oracle Inventory Transaction Processor picks it up and does the accounting, costing, and history update. .

objects.description: INV_CYCLE_COUNT_HEADERS stores information about cycle count names. . Oracle Inventory uses this information to keep track of all cycle count names defined, to indicate tolerance/approval limits, cycle count calendar and exception set, ABC initialization information, scheduling options, and recount options. . objects.name: INV_INTERORG_PARAMETERS
objects.description: INV_INTERORG_PARAMETERS identifies the receiving organizations ("To" distribution organizations) linked to a particular organization ("From" distribution organizations). The TO_ORGANIZATION_ID identifies the organization that receives shipments from the organization identified by the FROM_ORGANIZATION_ID. . You must define the inter-organizational relationship here before you perform any inter-organization transfers in the transaction system. . INTRANSIT_TYPE indicates whether inter-organizational transfers between the two organizations will use direct or intransit transfer. . FOB_POINT indicates the 'Free on board' point and determines the point of transfer of liability/ownership. . Unit of measure, distance, transfer charge, and accounting information are also specified in this table.

objects.name: INV_INTERORG_PARAMETERS_
objects.description: INV_INTERORG_PARAMETERS identifies the receiving organizations ("To" distribution organizations) linked to a particular organization ("From" distribution organizations). The TO_ORGANIZATION_ID identifies the organization that receives shipments from the organization identified by the FROM_ORGANIZATION_ID. . You must define the inter-organizational relationship here before you perform any inter-organization transfers in the transaction system. . INTRANSIT_TYPE indicates whether inter-organizational transfers between the two organizations will use direct or intransit transfer. . FOB_POINT indicates the 'Free on board' point and determines the point of transfer of liability/ownership. . Unit of measure, distance, transfer charge, and accounting information are also specified in this table.

objects.name: INV_LOCATOR_MAINT_DETAILS
objects.description: This table is the detailed-level table that will outline the mass update/create actions taken for the Locator. So, if a locator update needs to happen for a specific attribute across multiple locators, then we will have one row denoting the action taken and the object on which the action is taken in the INV_SUBINV_MASS_MAINT_ACTION table, and it will have details of each locator. So, if 10 locators are being acted upon, then each locator being updated will have a row in this table with the corresponding detail. Also, when multiple locators are being created, then each locator being created will have one row in this table, and the INV_SUBINV_MASS_MAINT_ACTION will have one row with the CREATE ACTION.

objects.description: INV_LOT_NUMBERS_ stores the audit trail definition of the lot number master. When you create a lot, a new row is inserted in the lot master table INV_LOT_NUMBERS and it also inserts a row in the audit table INV_LOT_NUMBERS_. When a lot attribute is modified, a new row is inserted in INV_LOT_NUMBERS_ with the modified value of attributes.

objects.name: INV_LOT_UPDATE_DRAFT
objects.description: The table inv_lot_update_draft represents the updates made to an inventory lot and submitted for approval via Electronic Records and Electronic Signature framework. When a lot is submitted for approval, a new record is inserted into this table with a unique value for electronic record identifier, the lot number being updated, and the values for all the updateable attributes. On approval, the values are copied from this table to inv_lot_numbers and the draft row is deleted. On rejection, no change is propagated to inv_lot_numbers and the draft row is deleted.

objects.name: INV_MATERIAL_TXNS
objects.description: INV_MATERIAL_TXNS stores a record of every material transaction or cost update performed in Inventory. . . . Records are inserted into this table either through the transaction processor or by the standard cost update program. The columns TRANSACTION_TYPE_ID, TRANSACTION_ACTION_ID, TRANSACTION_SOURCE_TYPE_ID, TRANSACTION_SOURCE_ID and TRANSACTION_SOURCE_NAME describe what the transaction is and against what entity it was performed. . . . If the item is under lot control then the lot records are stored in INV_TRANSACTION_LOT_NUMBERS, joined by the column TRANSACTION_ID. If the item is under serial control then the serial records are stored in INV_UNIT_TRANSACTIONS, joined by the column TRANSACTION_ID. The Item revision and locator control are stored in the columns REVISION and LOCATOR_ID respectively. . . . Transfer transactions are represented as two single records in the table. They are related through the column TRANSFER_TRANSACTION_ID, which contains the TRANSACTION_ID of the other transaction in the transfer. . . . . . . . . The index INV_MATERIAL_TXNS_UPGD is used only during install and upgrade, and will be dropped during the course thereof, but is included here for completeness.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_ID
columns.comments: Primary key of the inventory transaction.

objects.name: INV_MATERIAL_TXNS_TEMP
objects.description: INV_MATERIAL_TXNS_TEMP is the gateway for all material transactions. . . . Records are processed from this table into Inventory through the transaction processor. All Inventory transaction forms write directly to this table. Outside applications must write transaction records to INV_TRANSACTIONS_INTERFACE to be processed through INV_MATERIAL_TXNS_TEMP and the transaction processor by the Transaction Worker concurrent program. . . . Lots and serial numbers for a INV_MATERIAL_TXNS_TEMP(MMTT) record are stored in the tables INV_TRANSACTION_LOTS_TEMP(MTLT) and INV_SERIAL_NUMBERS_TEMP(MSNT). If the item is under lot control, then MMTT.TRANSACTION_TEMP_ID joins to MTLT.TRANSACTION_TEMP_ID. If the item is also under serial number control, then MTLT.SERIAL_TRANSACTION_TEMP_ID joins to MSNT.TRANSACTION_TEMP_ID. If the item is only under serial number control, then MMTT.TRANSACTION_TEMP_ID joins to MSNT.TRANSACTION_TEMP_ID. . . . Transfer transactions are stored in this table as a single record. The transaction processor creates two transactions from the single record. . .

objects.name: INV_ONHAND_QUANTITIES_DETAIL
objects.description: INV_ONHAND_QUANTITIES_DETAIL stores quantity on hand information by control level and location. . . . INV_ONHAND_QUANTITIES_DETAIL is maintained as a stack of receipt records, which are consumed by issue transactions in FIFO order. The quantity on hand of an item at any particular control level and location can be found by summing TRANSACTION_QUANTITY for all records that match the criteria. Note that any transactions which are committed to the table INV_MATERIAL_TXNS_TEMP are considered to be played out as far as quantity on hand is concerned in Inventory transaction forms. All our Inquiry forms and ABC compile are only based on INV_ONHAND_QUANTITIES_DETAIL. . . . INV_ONHAND_QUANTITIES_DETAIL has two columns, CREATE_TRANSACTION_ID and UPDATE_TRANSACTION_IDs to join to INV_MATERIAL_TXNS.TRANSACTION_ID the transactions that created the row and the transaction that last updated a row. . . . . . . .

If the action is insert into INV_ONHAND_QUANTITIES_DETAIL, then INV_ONHAND_QUANTITIES_SUMMARY record is accordingly updated with the quantity if the record equivalent to the unique stock keeping unit already existed. If the record does not exist in the summary table then a new record is created.

objects.name: INV_ORG_PARAMETERS
objects.description: INV_ORG_PARAMETERS maintains a set of default options like locator, lot, and serial controls; item sourcing etc. for each organization defined in Oracle Inventory. Each organization's item master organization (MASTER_ORGANIZATION_ID) is maintained here. You specify which manufacturing calendar the organization will use (CALENDAR_CODE), as well as the set of exceptions to this calendar (CALENDAR_EXCEPTION_SET_ID). .NEGATIVE_INV_RECEIPT_CODE indicates whether this organization will allow negative balances in inventory. It is used in the transaction system to ensure, for example, that you do not over-issue a particular item (if you have indicated that negative balances are not allowed). For lot number and serial number auto-generation, you can specify whether you want the numbers generated from defaults defined at the organization level or the item level (LOT_NUMBER_GENERATION,SERIAL_NUMBER_GENERATION). You can also specify uniqueness constraints for lot numbers (LOT_NUMBER_UNIQUENESS) and serial numbers (SERIAL_NUMBER_TYPE).

columns.name: ALLOW_ITEM_SUBSTITUTIONS

columns.comments: Contains one of the following values: true or false. If true, then the plant is integrated to WMS for manufacturing or maintenance. If false, then the plant is not integrated. The default value is false.

columns.name: FILL_KILL_SALES_ORDER_FLAG
columns.comments: Contains one of the following values: true or false. If true, then automatically cancel the remaining quantities on sales order backorder lines during pick release, pick confirm, or ship confirm. If false, then don't cancel. The default value is false.

columns.name: KANBAN_CARD_PREFIX
columns.comments: The user supplied value to prefix each Kanban card number. The default value is the organization code followed by a dash, for example "VIND-".

columns.name: KANBAN_CARD_START_NUMBER

columns.name: MAINT_TECH_WB_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.comments: Contains one of the following values: true or false. If true, then the organization is enabled to be viewed in the maintenance technician workbench. If false, the organization is not visible in the workbench. The default value is false.

columns.name: EXPIRED_LOT_SUBINVENTORY
columns.comments: The user selected subinventory where expiring lots will be quarantined.

columns.name: EXPIRED_LOT_LOCATOR
columns.comments: The user selected locator in the subinventory where expiring lots will be quarantined.

columns.name: LOT_CONVERSION_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.comments: Contains one of the following values: true or false. If true, then the lot specific conversion is created or updated for the lot when a transaction modifies the secondary quantity for a given primary quantity, which indicates a change to the existing lot conversion value. If false, then the organization isn't enabled and lots will use existing UOM conversions. The default value is false.

columns.name: AUTOCRT_LOT_UOM_CONV_FLAG
columns.comments: Contains one of the following values: true or false. If true, then the organization is enabled automatically create lot specific conversion updates for items if transactional work modifies the secondary quantity to a value which does not use the existing lot conversion value. If false, then the user must explicitly update the existing UOM conversions for lots. The default value is false.

columns.name: ALLOW_OVERISSUE_WO_PICK
columns.comments: Contains one of the following values: true or false. If true, the manufacturing user will be allowed to specify component quantities on work orders which are greater than those in the work definition. If false, the existing behavior for pick quantities will continue. The default value is false.

columns.name: REQ_BARCODE_VALIDATION
columns.comments: Contains one of the following values: true or false. If true, barcode format validation is used on supplier part numbers or items without barcodes when the inventory user scans inventory transactions. If false, the barcode format isn't validated. The default value is false.

objects.name: INV_PICK_SLIP_NUMBERS
objects.description: Parallel pick release uses this table to store pick slip numbers. Pick slip number generation is based on grouping criteria specified in the pick slip grouping rule specified at the time of pick release. Every time a line is allocated with the same criteria as a previously allocated line, the same pick slip number is to be assigned. When pick release is run as a single process, pick slip number assignment is accomplished by caching pick slip numbers and the corresponding grouping criteria in memory. When multiple concurrent pick release processes run in parallel, this approach will not work since these processes do not have visibility of each others cached data structures. Hence a database table is needed to store pick slip numbers and the grouping criteria. Data in this table is deleted at the end of the pick release run.

columns.name: REPL_PARAM_ID
columns.comments: Column indicating the unique identifier for the replenish parameters.

columns.name: RUN_DATE
columns.comments: Column indicating the date and time when the replenishment run created the record. This value will be the same for all records in created in a particular run.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.comments: Column indicating the current status of the record. Valid values are ORA_P for published and ORA_N for new.

columns.name: DATA_SOURCE
columns.comments: Column Indicating whether the current record source is 'S' (system-calculated) or 'U' (user-uploaded).

columns.name: INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
columns.comments: Column indicating the unique identifier of the item.

columns.name: ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.comments: Column indicating the unique identifier of the organization.

columns.name: SUBINVENTORY_CODE
columns.comments: Column indicating the unique identifier of the subinventory code.

columns.name: LOCATOR_ID
columns.comments: Column indicating the unique identifier for locator.

columns.name: UOM_CODE
columns.comments: Column indicating the unit of measure code.

columns.name: PUBLISHED_DATE
columns.comments: Column indicating the published date.

columns.name: REPLENISH_TYPE
columns.comments: Column indicating whether the replenishment parameter is for Min-Max or PAR. A value of M indicates min-max and value of P indicates PAR.

columns.name: AVG_DAILY_DEMAND
columns.comments: Column indicating the average daily demand.

columns.name: SAFETY_STOCK
columns.comments: Column indicating the safe stock for an item.

columns.name: CUR_MIN_QTY
columns.comments: Column indicating the current minimum value for the item quantity.

columns.name: CUR_MAX_QTY
columns.comments: Column indicating the current maximum value for the item quantity.

columns.name: SUGT_MIN_QTY
columns.comments: Column indicating the minimum value calculated by min-max calculations for the item quantity.

columns.name: SUGT_MAX_QTY
columns.comments: Column indicating the maximum value calculated by min-max calculations for the item quantity.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_MIN_QTY
columns.comments: Column indicating the override value for minimum quantity for the item specified by the inventory user.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_MAX_QTY
columns.comments: Column indicating the override value for maximum quantity for the item by the inventory user.

columns.name: CUR_PAR_LEVEL
columns.comments: Column indicating the current minimum PAR quantity for the item.

columns.name: CUR_PAR_MAX_QTY
columns.comments: Column indicating the current maximum PAR quantity for the item.

columns.name: SUGT_PAR_LEVEL
columns.comments: Column indicating the suggested minimum PAR quantity for the item by planning.

columns.name: SUGT_PAR_MAX_QTY
columns.comments: Column indicating the suggested maximum PAR quantity for the item by planning.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_PAR_LEVEL
columns.comments: Column indicating the override value for minimum PAR quantity for the item by the inventory user.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_PAR_MAX_QTY
columns.comments: Column indicating the override value for maximum PAR quantity for the item by the inventory user.

columns.name: REPL_INT_ID
columns.comments: Column indicating the unique identifier for the replenish interfaced parameters.

objects.name: INV_REPLENISH_REQUEST
objects.description: This table stores the Replenishment Request details for PAR replenishment management

columns.name: REPLENISH_REQUEST_ID
columns.comments: This column stores the primary key of the Replenish Request.

columns.name: START_DATETIME
columns.comments: Indicates the timestamp when the task line associated to replenish request was started.

columns.name: END_DATETIME
columns.comments: Indicates the timestamp when the task line associated to replenish request was ended.

columns.name: DURATION
columns.comments: Indicates the actual duration for completing the task associated to replenish request.

columns.name: FLOW_SOURCE
columns.comments: Indicates the source of flow from which the replenish request is submitted.

columns.name: OFFLINE_MODE
columns.comments: This flag indicates whether the replenish request is in the offline mode.

columns.name: DI_REQUEST_ID
columns.comments: This column stores the unique identifier for upload from the Desktop integration.

columns.name: GROUP_ID
columns.comments: Group id of the replenish request

columns.name: ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.comments: This identifies the inventory organization.

columns.name: ORGANIZATION_CODE
columns.comments: Organization code of the replenishment request

columns.name: ORGANIZATION_NAME
columns.comments: Organization name of the replenishment request

columns.name: INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
columns.comments: This column stores Inventory item identifier

columns.name: ITEM_NUMBER
columns.comments: Item number of the replenishment request

columns.name: SUBINVENTORY
columns.comments: Subinventory of the replenishment request

columns.name: SUBINVENTORY_GROUP
columns.comments: Name of the Subinventory Group.

columns.name: LOCATOR_ID
columns.comments: Locator identifier of the replenishment request

columns.name: LOCATOR_NAME
columns.comments: Locator name of the replenishment request

columns.name: OWNING_TYPE_ID
columns.comments: This identifies the type of the owning entity 1 - Consigned Material 2 - Owned Material.

columns.name: OWNING_TYPE
columns.comments: The owning type indicates the type of the entity who owns this quantity, in the context of consignment; the lookup type INV_OWNING_TYPES has the valid values. The record is consigned only if OWNING_TYPE is populated.

columns.name: OWNING_ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.comments: This identifies the owning organization.

columns.name: OWNING_ORGANIZATION_CODE
columns.comments: Code of the owning Organization.

columns.name: PRC_BU_NAME
columns.comments: Procuring business unit for the replenishment request record when the replenishment request has consigned quantity.

columns.name: PARENT_REPLENISH_REQUEST_ID
columns.comments: Identifies the group of replenishment requests that are logically grouped together based on the same SKU.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_REPLENISH_COUNT_TYPE
columns.comments: Indicates the override replenishment count type. Values include Order PAR, On-Hand Quantity, and Order Quantity. If this field is not specified, the Replenishment Count Type specified for the item or the subinventory will be used.

columns.name: QUANTITY
columns.comments: Requested quantity of the replenishment request

columns.name: UOM_CODE
columns.comments: Unit of measure code of the replenishment request

columns.name: UNIT_OF_MEASURE
columns.comments: Unit of measure of the replenishment request

columns.name: PAR_UOM_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Requested quantity in PAR Unit of Measure.

columns.name: NOT_PLANNED_RECORDS
columns.comments: Number of not planned records in the replenishment request

columns.name: PROCESSING_STATUS
columns.comments: This column stores the processing status.

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE_CODE
columns.comments: Error message code of the replenishment request

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE_TEXT
columns.comments: Error message text of the replenishment request

objects.description: INV_SECONDARY_INVENTORIES is the definition table for the subinventory. A subinventory is a section of inventory, i.e., raw material, finished goods, etc. Subinventories are assigned to items (in a many to one relationship), indicating a list of valid places where this item will physically exist in inventory. . Other attributes include general ledger accounts, demand picking order, locator type, availability type, and reservable type. . objects.description: INV_SERIAL_NUMBERS_ stores the audit trail definition of the serial number master. When you create a serial, a new row is inserted in the serial master table INV_SERIAL_NUMBERS and it also inserts a row in the audit table INV_SERIAL_NUMBERS_. When a serial attribute is modified, a new row is inserted in INV_SERIAL_NUMBERS_ with the modified value of attributes.

objects.name: INV_SERIAL_NUMBERS_TEMP
objects.description: INV_SERIAL_NUMBERS_TEMP holds temporary serial number transaction records for a parent record in INV_MATERIAL_TXNS_TEMP. Data in this table will eventually reside in INV_UNIT_TRANSACTIONS after processing by the transaction processor. TRANSACTION_TEMP_ID joins to TRANSACTION_TEMP_ID in INV_MATERIAL_TXNS_TEMP when under serial control. If also under lot control it joins to INV_TRANSACTION_LOTS_TEMP.SERIAL_TRANSACTION_TEMP_ID. . . . It is possible to have child records in this table without a parent record due to the autocommit feature of the Serial Number Entry form. Periodic deletion of irrelevant data from this table is desired.

objects.name: INV_SERIAL_UPDATE_DRAFT
objects.description: The table inv_serial_update_draft represents the updates made to an inventory serial number and submitted for approval via Electronic Records and Electronic Signature framework. When a serial number is submitted for approval, a new record is inserted into this table with a unique value for electronic record identifier, the serial number being updated, and the values for all the updateable attributes. On approval, the values are copied from this table to inv_serial_numbers and the draft row is deleted. On rejection, no change is propagated to inv_serial_numbers and the draft row is deleted.
