objects.name: MNT_WORK_REQUIREMENTS_B
objects.description: This table stores the detailed work requirements specifiec to the maintenance program business object. Maintenance program is a preventive maintenance plan that is to be executed at a regular periodic schdeuld or based on the usage of the asset or when a condition of the asset is detected for one or more maintainable assets. Work requirement details the assets to be used in the realization of the forecast based on schedules, usages, or conditions.

columns.name: REQUIREMENT_ID
columns.comments: The unique system generated identifier for the work requirement.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.comments: The organization identifier. This is the maintenance organization in which the maintenance program is authored.

columns.name: PROGRAM_ID
columns.comments: Foreign key to the maintenance program identifier.

columns.name: REQUIREMENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: This requirement is done at the asset level or at the item level is designated by this value. The valid values are 'Asset' or 'Item'.

columns.name: ITEM_ID
columns.comments: Foreign key to the inventory item.

columns.name: ASSET_ID
columns.comments: Foreign key reference to the Asset business object.

columns.name: ROUTE_HIERARCHY_ID
columns.comments: Foreign key reference to the Asset Route Business Object. This is defined as a special type of Asset Logical Hierarchy.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.comments: The status of the maintenance work requirements. The valid statuses are Draft and Active.

columns.name: FORECAST_USING_CYCLE_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating whether the requirement is to be forecasted using a cycle of patterns either for the schedule or meter based requirement.

columns.name: INTERVALS_IN_THE_CYCLE
columns.comments: Intervals in the cycle of patterns. How many intervals are to be considered in the cycle. And varying work definitions can be specified to be picked up in the nth interval.

columns.name: CALENDAR_BASED_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating whether this requirement is going to be used for a periodic calendar based forecasting.

columns.name: METER_BASED_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating whether this requirement is going to be used for a usage based forecasting. Usage is drawn from the readings on the meter tied to the asset.

columns.name: CONDITION_BASED_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating whether this requirement is going to be used for a condition based work order creation. A condition of the asset will be used in driving the work definition to be picked up for the creation of the adhoc work.

columns.name: DAY_BASED_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates the method to forecast is a Day Interval.

columns.name: NUMBER_OF_DAYS
columns.comments: Indicates the number of days between cycle intervals in the forecast. This is used in the day based forecast.

columns.name: NEXT_FORECAST_DUE_BY_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates if next due uses the Base Interval or the Last Service of a work order.

columns.name: ASSET_HISTORY_SERVICE_DATE
columns.comments: Used for Asset based work requirements to indicate the last date in which the work was accomplished from an external system. This is just captured one time at the setting up of the program for the first time for this asset.

columns.name: ASSET_HISTORY_SERVICE_INTERVAL
columns.comments: Used for Asset based work requirements to indicate the last interval in a cycle which the work was accomplished from an external system.

columns.name: ASSET_INCLUSION_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates if the Assets are Implicitly or Explicitly covered by the work requirement. Values are Automatically or Manually.

columns.name: SCHEDULE_PATTERN_ID
columns.comments: The foreign key reference to the schedule pattern.

columns.name: ACTIVE_START_DATE
columns.comments: The effectivity start date of the work requirement.

columns.name: ACTIVE_END_DATE
columns.comments: The effectivity end date of the work requirement.

columns.name: SUPPRESS_MERGE_CODE
columns.comments: The attribute indicates whether the work definitions are suppressed or merged when forecasts are generated on the same scheduled date.

columns.name: SUPPRESS_MERGE_OVERRIDE_FLAG
columns.comments: This flag indicates whether the program level concurrent requirements are overriden at the work requirement level.

columns.name: LAST_FORECAST_DATE
columns.comments: The date when the forecast was run last for this work requirement.

columns.name: LAST_FORECAST_GEN_REQUEST_ID
columns.comments: The enterprise scheduler request identifier for the last forecast generation program run.

columns.name: LAST_WO_GEN_REQUEST_ID
columns.comments: The enterprise scheduler request identifier for the last work order generation program run.

columns.name: IN_PROCESS_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating wheter the forecasting process is currently working on this work requirement or not.

columns.name: MODIFIED_FLAG
columns.comments: The flag indicating whether the Maintenance Program has become dirty after a forecast generation was already run.

columns.name: NEXT_WORK_ORDER_ONLY_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating that the work order generation program only generates the very next work order to the already forecasted and completed work order in the work order creation horizon. The other occurances of forecasts that are to be converted as work orders will be ignored.

columns.name: REQUIREMENT_REFERENCE
columns.comments: A reference captured from another third party application.

columns.name: REQUIREMENT_REFERENCE_ID
columns.comments: A reference identifier captured from another third party application.

columns.name: FORECAST_WINDOW_IN_DAYS
columns.comments: The number of days to be considered for the forecast window.

columns.name: WORK_ORDER_WINDOW_IN_DAYS
columns.comments: The number of days to be considered for the work order window.

columns.name: CREATE_WORK_ORDER_OPTION_CODE
columns.comments: The mode in which the work order is created from the forecast. Is it automatically or via a manual process.

columns.name: WORK_ORDER_STATUS_ID
columns.comments: Represents the internal identifier of the user-defined status of the work order.

columns.name: WORK_ORDER_PRIORITY
columns.comments: The priority of the work order that is to be created from this requirement.

columns.name: FIRM_PLANNED_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag to allow or prevent Planning from suggesting rescheduling and re-planning recommendations with respect to the Work Order. When the flag is on, this work order will not be considered by MRP to reschedule or re-plan.

columns.name: FORECAST_EXIST_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating whether there is atleast one forecast that is created from this work requirement. This drives a series of validations in the requirement.

columns.name: WORK_ORDER_EXIST_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating whether there is atleast one work order that is created from this work requirement. This drives a series of validations in the requirement.

columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.comments: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.comments: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.comments: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

objects.query:
SELECT work_req.requirement_id requirement_id,
work_req.object_version_number object_version_number,
work_req_tl.requirement_name requirement_name,
work_req.organization_id organization_id,
work_req.program_id program_id,
work_req.requirement_type_code requirement_type_code,
work_req.item_id item_id,
nvl(work_req.asset_id, assets.asset_id) asset_id,
work_req.route_hierarchy_id route_hierarchy_id,
work_req.status_code status_code,
work_req.forecast_using_cycle_flag forecast_using_cycle_flag,
work_req.intervals_in_the_cycle intervals_in_the_cycle,
work_req.calendar_based_flag calendar_based_flag,
work_req.meter_based_flag meter_based_flag,
work_req.condition_based_flag condition_based_flag,
work_req.schedule_pattern_id schedule_pattern_id,
work_req.active_start_date active_start_date,
work_req.active_end_date active_end_date,
work_req.last_forecast_date last_forecast_date,
work_req.suppress_merge_code suppress_merge_code,
work_req.suppress_merge_override_flag suppress_merge_override_flag,
work_req.modified_flag modified_flag,
work_req.next_work_order_only_flag next_work_order_only_flag,
work_req.created_by created_by,
work_req.creation_date creation_date,
work_req.last_updated_by last_updated_by,
work_req.last_update_date last_update_date,
work_req.last_update_login last_update_login,
work_req.request_id request_id,
work_req.job_definition_name job_definition_name,
work_req.job_definition_package job_definition_package,
nvl(assets.asset_id, work_req.asset_id) asset_id_final,
work_req.Day_Based_Flag Day_Based_Flag,
work_req.Number_Of_Days Number_Of_Days,
work_req.Next_Forecast_Due_By_Code Next_Forecast_Due_By_Code,
work_req.Asset_History_Service_Date Asset_History_Service_Date,
work_req.Asset_History_Service_Interval Asset_History_Service_Interval,
work_req.Asset_Inclusion_Type_Code Asset_Inclusion_Type_Code,
work_req.Requirement_Reference Requirement_Reference,
work_req.Forecast_Window_In_Days Forecast_Window_In_Days,
work_req.Work_Order_Window_In_Days Work_Order_Window_In_Days,
work_req.Create_Work_Order_Option_Code Create_Work_Order_Option_Code,
work_req.Work_Order_Status_Id Work_Order_Status_Id,
work_req.Work_Order_Priority Work_Order_Priority,
work_req.Firm_Planned_Flag Firm_Planned_Flag,
wo_statuses_tl.wo_status_id Wo_Status_id,
wo_statuses_tl.wo_status_name Wo_Status_Name,
wo_statuses_tl.language language
FROM mnt_work_requirements_b work_req
LEFT OUTER JOIN mnt_work_requirements_tl work_req_tl
ON work_req_tl.requirement_id = work_req.requirement_id
AND work_req_tl.language = USERENV('LANG')
LEFT OUTER JOIN CSE_ASSETS_B assets
ON work_req.ITEM_ID = assets.ITEM_ID
AND assets.ITEM_ORGANIZATION_ID IN
(
SELECT prog.organization_id FROM mnt_programs_b prog
WHERE prog.program_id = work_req.program_id
AND NVL(prog.global_assets_flag, 'N') = 'N'
UNION ALL
SELECT inv1.organization_id FROM inv_org_parameters inv1, inv_org_parameters inv2, mnt_programs_b prog
WHERE inv1.master_organization_id = inv2.master_organization_id
AND inv2.organization_id = prog.organization_id
AND prog.program_id = work_req.program_id
AND NVL(prog.global_assets_flag, 'N') = 'Y'
)
AND work_req.REQUIREMENT_TYPE_CODE = 'ORA_ITEM'
AND assets.MAINTAINABLE_FLAG = 'Y'
AND assets.NEW_WO_ALLOWED_FLAG = 'Y'
AND (assets.active_end_date is null OR assets.active_end_date > sysdate)
AND
(
(NVL(work_req.asset_inclusion_type_code,'ORA_AUTOMATIC') = 'ORA_AUTOMATIC'
AND assets.asset_id NOT IN (
SELECT excluded_assets.asset_id
FROM mnt_wr_excluded_assets excluded_assets
WHERE work_req.requirement_id=excluded_assets.requirement_id))
OR
(work_req.asset_inclusion_type_code = 'ORA_MANUAL'
AND assets.asset_id IN (
SELECT included_assets.asset_id
FROM mnt_wr_included_assets included_assets
WHERE work_req.requirement_id=included_assets.requirement_id))
)
LEFT OUTER JOIN egp_system_items_bv items
on items.inventory_item_id = work_req.item_id
and items.organization_id = work_req.organization_id
and items.allow_maintenance_asset_flag = 'Y'
LEFT OUTER JOIN wie_wo_statuses_tl wo_statuses_tl
ON work_req.work_order_status_Id = wo_statuses_tl.wo_status_Id
AND wo_statuses_tl.language = USERENV('LANG')

MWRB.ASSET_HISTORY_SERVICE_INTERVAL ASSET_HISTORY_SERVICE_INTERVAL,
MWRB.ASSET_INCLUSION_TYPE_CODE ASSET_INCLUSION_TYPE_CODE,

MWRB.LAST_FORECAST_DATE LAST_FORECAST_DATE,

MWRB.LAST_FORECAST_GEN_REQUEST_ID LAST_FORECAST_GEN_REQUEST_ID,

objects.name: MNT_WO_DISPATCH_LISTS_V
objects.query:
SELECT wo.work_order_id WORK_ORDER_ID,
wo.work_definition_id WORK_DEFINITION_ID,
wo.object_version_number WO_OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER,
wo.work_order_number WORK_ORDER_NUMBER,
wo.work_order_description WORK_ORDER_DESCRIPTION,
wo.work_order_priority WORK_ORDER_PRIORITY,
wo.released_date RELEASED_DATE,
wo.organization_id ORGANIZATION_ID,
wo.created_by CREATED_BY,
wo.creation_date CREATION_DATE,
wo.last_updated_by LAST_UPDATED_BY,
wo.last_update_date LAST_UPDATE_DATE,
wo.last_update_login LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN,
uoms.unit_of_measure UOM,
wo.uom_code UOM_CODE,
wo.planned_start_quantity PLANNED_START_QUANTITY,
esi.item_number ITEM_NUMBER,
esi.inventory_item_id INVENTORY_ITEM_ID,
esi.description ITEM_DESCRIPTION,
CASE
WHEN esi.serial_number_control_code IN (2,5,6)
THEN 'Y'
ELSE 'N'
END SERIAL_CONTROLLED_ITEM_FLAG,
CASE
WHEN esi.lot_control_code = 2
THEN 'Y'
ELSE 'N'
END LOT_CONTROLLED_ITEM_FLAG,
wo.pjc_context_category pjc_context_category,
wo.pjc_project_id pjc_project_id,
wo.pjc_project_number pjc_project_number,
wo.pjc_task_id pjc_task_id,
wo.pjc_task_number pjc_task_number,
wo.pjc_expenditure_type_id pjc_expenditure_type_id,
wo.pjc_expenditure_item_date pjc_expenditure_item_date,
wo.pjc_organization_id pjc_organization_id,
wo.pjc_billable_flag pjc_billable_flag,
wo.pjc_capitalizable_flag pjc_capitalizable_flag,
wo.pjc_work_type_id pjc_work_type_id,
wo.pjc_contract_id pjc_contract_id,
wo.pjc_contract_line_id pjc_contract_line_id,
wo.pjc_funding_allocation_id pjc_funding_allocation_id,
wc.work_center_name WORK_CENTER_NAME,
wc.work_center_id WORK_CENTER_ID,
wc.work_area_id WORK_AREA_ID,
woop.wo_operation_id WO_OPERATION_ID,
woop.operation_name WO_OPERATION_NAME,
woop.operation_seq_number OPERATION_SEQ_NUMBER,
woop.execution_sequence EXECUTION_SEQUENCE,
woop.resequence_flag RESEQUENCE_FLAG,
woop.completed_quantity COMPLETED_QUANTITY,
woop.ready_quantity READY_QUANTITY,
woop.in_process_quantity IN_PROCESS_QUANTITY,
woop.operation_type OPERATION_TYPE,
woop.osp_item_id OSP_ITEM_ID,
ospi.item_number OSP_ITEM_NUMBER,
fl.meaning DISPATCH_STATE,
fl.lookup_code DISPATCH_LOOKUP_CODE,
CASE
WHEN fl.lookup_code = 'READY'
THEN NVL(woop.ready_quantity,0)
WHEN fl.lookup_code = 'COMPLETE'
THEN woop.completed_quantity
WHEN fl.lookup_code IN ('OPTIONAL', 'IN_PROCESS')
THEN NULL
END QUANTITY,
woop.previous_cp_op_seq_num PREVIOUS_CP_OP_SEQ_NUM,
woop.next_cp_op_seq_num NEXT_CP_OP_SEQ_NUM,
woop.tollgate_op_seq_num TOLL_GATE_OP_SEQ_NUM,
woop.planned_start_date OPERATION_START_DATE,
woop.planned_completion_date OPERATION_COMPLETION_DATE,
wo.cm_po_header_id PO_HEADER_ID,
wo.cm_po_line_id PO_LINE_ID,
poh.segment1 PO_HEADER_NUMBER,
pol.line_num PO_LINE_NUMBER,
cab.asset_id ASSET_ID,
cab.asset_number ASSET_NUMBER,
cab.SERIAL_NUMBER,
cab.description ASSET_DESCRIPTION,
DECODE(woop.operation_type, 'SUPPLIER',
CASE DECODE(
(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT supplier_id)
FROM wie_wo_osp_action_details
WHERE document_type = 'PO'
AND status ='APPROVED'
AND wo_operation_id = woop.wo_operation_id) ,0,'DEFAULT',1,'SINGLE','MULTIPLE')
WHEN 'DEFAULT' THEN
NULL
WHEN 'SINGLE' THEN
(SELECT DISTINCT osp.supplier_id
FROM wie_wo_osp_action_details osp,
poz_suppliers supplier,
hz_parties parties
WHERE osp.wo_operation_id = woop.wo_operation_id
AND osp.document_type = 'PO'
AND osp.status ='APPROVED'
AND supplier.vendor_id = osp.supplier_id
AND parties.party_id = supplier.party_id
AND ROWNUM = 1
)
ELSE
NULL
END,
NULL
) AS SUPPLIER_ID,
DECODE(woop.operation_type, 'SUPPLIER',
CASE DECODE(
(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT supplier_id)
FROM wie_wo_osp_action_details
WHERE document_type = 'PO'
AND status ='APPROVED'
AND wo_operation_id = woop.wo_operation_id) ,0,'DEFAULT',1,'SINGLE','MULTIPLE')
WHEN 'DEFAULT' THEN
NULL
WHEN 'SINGLE' THEN
(SELECT parties.party_name
FROM wie_wo_osp_action_details osp,
poz_suppliers supplier,
hz_parties parties
WHERE osp.wo_operation_id = woop.wo_operation_id
AND osp.document_type = 'PO'
AND osp.status ='APPROVED'
AND supplier.vendor_id = osp.supplier_id
AND parties.party_id = supplier.party_id
AND ROWNUM = 1
)
ELSE
'MULTIPLE'
END,
NULL
) AS SUPPLIER_NAME,
DECODE(woop.operation_type, 'SUPPLIER',
CASE DECODE(
(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT supplier_site_id)
FROM wie_wo_osp_action_details
WHERE document_type = 'PO'
AND status = 'APPROVED'
AND wo_operation_id = woop.wo_operation_id
) ,0, 'DEFAULT', 1, ' SINGLE', 'MULTIPLE')
WHEN 'DEFAULT'
THEN NULL
WHEN 'SINGLE'
THEN
(SELECT site.vendor_site_code
FROM wie_wo_osp_action_details osp,
poz_supplier_sites_all_m site
WHERE osp.wo_operation_id = woop.wo_operation_id
AND osp.document_type = 'PO'
AND osp.status ='APPROVED'
AND site.vendor_site_id = osp.supplier_site_id
AND ROWNUM = 1
)
WHEN 'MULTIPLE'
THEN 'MULTIPLE'
END,
NULL
) AS SUPPLIER_SITE,
DECODE(woop.operation_type, 'SUPPLIER',
CASE DECODE(
(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT supplier_site_id)
FROM wie_wo_osp_action_details
WHERE document_type = 'PO'
AND status ='APPROVED'
AND wo_operation_id = woop.wo_operation_id
) ,0,'DEFAULT',1,'SINGLE','MULTIPLE')
WHEN 'DEFAULT' THEN NULL
WHEN 'SINGLE' THEN
(SELECT DISTINCT osp.supplier_site_id
FROM wie_wo_osp_action_details osp
WHERE osp.wo_operation_id = woop.wo_operation_id
AND osp.document_type = 'PO'
AND osp.status ='APPROVED'
AND ROWNUM = 1
)
WHEN 'MULTIPLE'
THEN NULL
END,
NULL
) AS SUPPLIER_SITE_ID,
NVL(
(SELECT SUM(DECODE(SIGN(NVL(issued_quantity,0)-quantity),-1,1,0))
FROM WIE_WO_OPERATION_MATERIALS OPMAT
WHERE OPMAT.WO_OPERATION_ID= WOOP.WO_OPERATION_ID
AND opmat.work_order_id = woop.work_order_id
AND SUPPLY_TYPE ='1'
) ,-1) MATERIAL_REPORTING_INDICATOR,
NVL(
(SELECT SUM(DECODE(SIGN(NVL(ACTUAL_RESOURCE_USAGE,0)-REQUIRED_USAGE),-1,1,0))
FROM wie_wo_operation_resources OPRESOURCE
WHERE OPRESOURCE.WO_OPERATION_ID=WOOP.WO_OPERATION_ID
AND OPRESOURCE.CHARGE_TYPE ='MANUAL'
) ,-1)RESOURCE_REPORTING_INDICATOR,
wo.work_order_type WORK_ORDER_TYPE,
wo.work_order_sub_type WORK_ORDER_SUB_TYPE,
wo.item_revision ITEM_REVISION,
woop.count_point_operation_flag COUNT_POINT_OPERATION_FLAG
FROM wie_wo_operations_vl woop,
WIE_WORK_ORDERS_VL wo,
wis_work_centers_vl wc,
egp_system_items_vl esi,
egp_system_items_vl ospi,
fnd_lookups fl,
inv_units_of_measure_vl uoms,
po_headers_all poh,
po_lines_all pol,
wie_wo_assets wwa,
cse_assets_vl cab
WHERE wo.work_order_id = woop.work_order_id
AND woop.osp_item_id = ospi.inventory_item_id(+)
AND woop.organization_id = ospi.organization_id(+)
AND woop.work_center_id = wc.work_center_id
AND uoms.uom_code = wo.uom_code
AND wo.cm_po_header_id = pol.po_header_id(+)
AND wo.cm_po_line_id = pol.po_line_id(+)
AND wo.cm_po_header_id = poh.po_header_id (+)
AND fl.lookup_type = 'ORA_WIE_DISPATCH_STATE'
AND nvl(wwa.route_asset_flag,'N') = 'N'
AND EXISTS
(SELECT 1
FROM wie_wo_statuses_b wost
WHERE wost.wo_status_id = wo.work_order_status_id
AND wost.wo_system_status_code IN ('RELEASED', 'COMPLETED')
)
AND wwa.work_order_id = wo.work_order_id
AND cab.asset_id = wwa.asset_id
AND esi.inventory_item_id = cab.item_id
AND esi.organization_id = cab.item_organization_id
AND NVL(woop.auto_transact_flag,'N') = 'N'
AND ((fl.lookup_code = 'READY'
AND (woop.ready_quantity > 0
OR (woop.resequence_flag='Y' AND NVL(woop.ready_quantity,0) = 0 AND NVL(woop.completed_quantity,0) = 0
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wie_wo_operations_b WHERE work_order_id = woop.work_order_id
AND ready_quantity > 0
AND NVL(completed_quantity,0) = 0
AND tollgate_op_seq_num=woop.tollgate_op_seq_num))))
OR(woop.completed_quantity > 0
AND fl.lookup_code = 'COMPLETE')
OR(NVL(WOOP.COUNT_POINT_OPERATION_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'
AND fl.lookup_code = 'OPTIONAL')
OR (woop.operation_type = 'SUPPLIER'
AND (woop.in_process_quantity > 0
OR (NVL(woop.in_process_quantity, 0) = 0
AND NVL(woop.ready_quantity, 0) = 0
AND NVL(woop.completed_quantity, 0) = 0))
AND fl.lookup_code = 'IN_PROCESS')
)

objects.name: MNT_WO_EXCEPTIONS_V
objects.query:
SELECT A.Issue_id,
B.supported_entity_id,
B.exception_component_id,
B.exception_component_name,
B.exception_component_org_id,
B.resource_id,
B.resource_name,
B.work_area_id,
B.work_area_name,
B.work_center_id,
B.work_center_name,
B.resource_instance_id,
B.Exception_On_Object_Name,
A.organization_id, '1002' as SUPPORTED_ENTITY_ID_Dummy
FROM enq_issues_b A
LEFT OUTER JOIN
(SELECT eaov.object_id AS issue_id,
eaov.supported_entity_id,
esiv.inventory_item_id AS exception_component_id,
esiv.item_number As exception_component_name,
esiv.organization_id AS exception_component_org_id,
NULL AS resource_id,
NULL AS resource_name,
NULL AS work_area_id,
NULL AS work_area_name,
NULL AS work_center_id,
NULL AS work_center_name,
NULL AS resource_instance_id,
esiv.item_number as Exception_On_Object_Name
FROM enq_affected_objects_b eaov,
egp_system_items_vl esiv
WHERE eaov.supported_entity_id = 1004
AND eaov.pk1_value = esiv.inventory_item_id (+)
AND eaov.pk2_value = esiv.organization_id (+)
UNION ALL
SELECT eaov.object_id AS issue_id,
eaov.supported_entity_id,
NULL AS exception_component_id,
NULL AS exception_component_name,
NULL AS exception_component_org_id,
wrv.resource_id AS resource_id,
wrv.resource_name AS resource_name,
NULL AS work_area_id,
NULL AS work_area_name,
NULL AS work_center_id,
NULL AS work_center_name,
eaov.pk3_value AS resource_instance_id,
wrv.resource_name as Exception_On_Object_Name
FROM enq_affected_objects_b eaov,
wis_resources_vl wrv
WHERE eaov.supported_entity_id = 1003
AND eaov.pk1_value = wrv.resource_id (+)
UNION ALL
SELECT eaov.object_id AS issue_id,
eaov.supported_entity_id,
NULL AS exception_component_id,
NULL AS exception_component_name,
NULL AS exception_component_org_id,
NULL AS resource_id,
NULL AS resource_name,
wwav.work_area_id AS work_area_id,
wwav.work_area_name AS work_area_name,
NULL AS work_center_id,
NULL AS work_center_name,
NULL AS resource_instance_id,
wwav.work_area_name as Exception_On_Object_Name
FROM enq_affected_objects_b eaov,
wis_work_areas_vl wwav
WHERE eaov.supported_entity_id = 1005
AND eaov.pk1_value = wwav.work_area_id (+)
UNION ALL
SELECT eaov.object_id AS issue_id,
eaov.supported_entity_id,
NULL AS exception_component_id,
NULL AS exception_component_name,
NULL AS exception_component_org_id,
NULL AS resource_id,
NULL AS resource_name,
NULL AS work_area_id,
NULL AS work_area_name,
wwcv.work_center_id AS work_center_id,
wwcv.work_center_name AS work_center_name,
NULL AS resource_instance_id,
wwcv.work_center_name as Exception_On_Object_Name
FROM enq_affected_objects_b eaov,
wis_work_centers_vl wwcv
WHERE eaov.supported_entity_id = 1006
AND eaov.pk1_value = wwcv.work_center_id (+)) B ON A.issue_id = B.issue_id
WHERE A.source='ORA_MAINTENANCE'
AND A.quality_type_id IN (SELECT quality_type_id FROM enq_quality_types_b WHERE source = 'ORA_MAINTENANCE')

objects.name: MNT_WR_AFFECTED_ASSETS_V
objects.query:
SELECT WorkRequirementEO.REQUIREMENT_ID,
AssetEO.ASSET_ID,
AssetEO.ITEM_ID,
WorkRequirementEO.ORGANIZATION_ID,
WorkRequirementIncludedAssetEO.HISTORY_SERVICE_DATE,
WorkRequirementIncludedAssetEO.HISTORY_SERVICE_INTERVAL,
WorkRequirementIncludedAssetEO.REQUIREMENT_START_DATE,
NVL(WorkRequirementIncludedAssetEO.STATUS_CODE,'ORA_ACTIVE') FORECAST_OPTION_CODE,
CASE WHEN WorkRequirementIncludedAssetEO.HISTORY_SERVICE_DATE IS NOT NULL
THEN 'ORA_HISTORY_DATE'
WHEN WorkRequirementIncludedAssetEO.REQUIREMENT_START_DATE IS NOT NULL
THEN 'ORA_START_DATE'
ELSE NULL
END INTIALIZE_OPTION_CODE,
case when WorkRequirementEO.Requirement_type_code = 'ORA_ITEM' and WorkRequirementEO.ASSET_INCLUSION_TYPE_CODE = 'ORA_MANUAL'
and exists (select 'X' from MNT_WR_INCLUDED_ASSETS IA where WorkRequirementEO.REQUIREMENT_ID = IA.REQUIREMENT_ID and AssetEO.ASSET_ID = IA.ASSET_ID) then 'ORA_INCLUDE'
when WorkRequirementEO.Requirement_type_code = 'ORA_ITEM' and (WorkRequirementEO.ASSET_INCLUSION_TYPE_CODE = 'ORA_AUTOMATIC' or WorkRequirementEO.ASSET_INCLUSION_TYPE_CODE is null)
and not exists (select 'X' from MNT_WR_EXCLUDED_ASSETS EA where WorkRequirementEO.REQUIREMENT_ID = EA.REQUIREMENT_ID and AssetEO.ASSET_ID = EA.ASSET_ID) then 'ORA_INCLUDE'
else 'ORA_EXCLUDE' end STATUS_CODE,
AssetEO.ASSET_NUMBER,
AssetEO.DESCRIPTION,
AssetEO.NEW_WO_ALLOWED_FLAG,
AssetEO.SERIAL_NUMBER,
DECODE(WorkRequirementEO.work_order_exist_flag,'Y',
NVL(
( select 'Y' from mnt_forecast_lines flines
where flines.requirement_id = WorkRequirementEO.requirement_id
and flines.asset_id = AssetEO.asset_id
and EXISTS
(
SELECT 1 FROM mnt_forecasts forecast
WHERE forecast.forecast_id = flines.forecast_id
and forecast.work_order_id is not null
) AND ROWNUM = 1
),'N'),'N') WORK_ORDER_CREATED_FLAG,
NVL(WorkRequirementIncludedAssetEO.CREATE_WORK_ORDER_OPTION_CODE, NVL(WorkRequirementEO.CREATE_WORK_ORDER_OPTION_CODE,'ORA_AUTOMATIC')) CREATE_WORK_ORDER_OPTION_CODE,
AssetOperatingOrgPEO.organization_id OPERATING_ORGANIZATION_ID,
CAST (decode(nvl(AssetOperatingOrgPEO.eam_enabled_flag,'N'), 'Y', AssetOperatingOrgPEO.organization_id,
NVL((select iop.organization_id
from inv_org_parameters iop, cse_org_relationships cor
where iop.organization_id = cor.organization_id
and cor.relationship_type_code = 'ORA_SUPPORTS_AS_PRIMARY'
and cor.related_organization_id = AssetEO.item_organization_id),
WorkRequirementEO.organization_id)) AS NUMBER(18)) MAINTENANCE_ORGANIZATION_ID
FROM CSE_ASSETS_VL AssetEO, MNT_WORK_REQUIREMENTS_VL WorkRequirementEO
,MNT_WR_INCLUDED_ASSETS WorkRequirementIncludedAssetEO
,INV_ORGANIZATION_DEFINITIONS_V AssetOperatingOrgPEO
,MNT_PROGRAMS_VL MaintenanceProgramEO
WHERE WorkRequirementEO.item_id = AssetEO.item_id
AND WorkrequirementEO.REQUIREMENT_TYPE_CODE = 'ORA_ITEM'
AND AssetEO.MAINTAINABLE_FLAG = 'Y'
AND NVL(AssetEO.ACTIVE_END_DATE,SYSDATE+1) > SYSDATE
AND WorkRequirementIncludedAssetEO.REQUIREMENT_ID(+) = WorkRequirementEO.REQUIREMENT_ID
AND WorkRequirementIncludedAssetEO.ORGANIZATION_ID(+)= WorkRequirementEO.ORGANIZATION_ID
AND WorkRequirementIncludedAssetEO.ITEM_ID(+) = WorkRequirementEO.ITEM_ID
AND WorkRequirementIncludedAssetEO.ASSET_ID(+)= AssetEO.ASSET_ID
AND WorkRequirementIncludedAssetEO.ITEM_ID(+) = AssetEO.ITEM_ID
AND AssetEO.ITEM_ORGANIZATION_ID = AssetOperatingOrgPEO.ORGANIZATION_ID
AND WorkRequirementEO.program_id = MaintenanceProgramEO.program_id
AND
(
(
NVL(MaintenanceProgramEO.global_assets_flag, 'N') = 'N'
AND MaintenanceProgramEO.organization_id = AssetEO.item_organization_id
)
OR
(
NVL(MaintenanceProgramEO.global_assets_flag, 'N') = 'Y'
AND AssetEO.item_organization_id IN
(
SELECT inv1.organization_id FROM inv_org_parameters inv1, inv_org_parameters inv2
WHERE inv1.master_organization_id = inv2.master_organization_id
AND inv2.organization_id = MaintenanceProgramEO.organization_id
)
)
)
UNION
SELECT WorkRequirementEO.REQUIREMENT_ID,
AssetEO.ASSET_ID,
AssetEO.ITEM_ID,
WorkRequirementEO.ORGANIZATION_ID,
WorkRequirementIncludedAssetEO.HISTORY_SERVICE_DATE HISTORY_SERVICE_DATE,
WorkRequirementIncludedAssetEO.HISTORY_SERVICE_INTERVAL HISTORY_SERVICE_INTERVAL,
WorkRequirementIncludedAssetEO.REQUIREMENT_START_DATE REQUIREMENT_START_DATE,
NVL(WorkRequirementIncludedAssetEO.STATUS_CODE,'ORA_ACTIVE') FORECAST_OPTION_CODE,
CASE WHEN WorkRequirementIncludedAssetEO.HISTORY_SERVICE_DATE IS NOT NULL
THEN 'ORA_HISTORY_DATE'
WHEN WorkRequirementIncludedAssetEO.REQUIREMENT_START_DATE IS NOT NULL
THEN 'ORA_START_DATE'
ELSE NULL
END INTIALIZE_OPTION_CODE,
'ORA_INCLUDE' STATUS_CODE,
AssetEO.ASSET_NUMBER,
AssetEO.DESCRIPTION,
AssetEO.NEW_WO_ALLOWED_FLAG,
AssetEO.SERIAL_NUMBER,
DECODE(WorkRequirementEO.work_order_exist_flag,'Y',
NVL(
( select 'Y' from mnt_forecast_lines flines
where flines.requirement_id = WorkRequirementEO.requirement_id
and flines.asset_id = AssetEO.asset_id
and EXISTS
(
SELECT 1 FROM mnt_forecasts forecast
WHERE forecast.forecast_id = flines.forecast_id
and forecast.work_order_id is not null
) AND ROWNUM = 1
),'N'),'N') WORK_ORDER_CREATED_FLAG,
NVL(WorkRequirementIncludedAssetEO.CREATE_WORK_ORDER_OPTION_CODE, NVL(WorkRequirementEO.CREATE_WORK_ORDER_OPTION_CODE,'ORA_AUTOMATIC')) CREATE_WORK_ORDER_OPTION_CODE,
AssetOperatingOrgPEO.organization_id OPERATING_ORGANIZATION_ID,
CAST (decode(nvl(AssetOperatingOrgPEO.eam_enabled_flag,'N'), 'Y', AssetOperatingOrgPEO.organization_id,
NVL((select iop.organization_id
from inv_org_parameters iop, cse_org_relationships cor
where iop.organization_id = cor.organization_id
and cor.relationship_type_code = 'ORA_SUPPORTS_AS_PRIMARY'
and cor.related_organization_id = AssetEO.item_organization_id),
WorkRequirementEO.organization_id)) AS NUMBER(18)) MAINTENANCE_ORGANIZATION_ID
FROM CSE_ASSETS_VL AssetEO,
MNT_WORK_REQUIREMENTS_VL WorkRequirementEO,
MNT_WR_INCLUDED_ASSETS WorkRequirementIncludedAssetEO,
INV_ORGANIZATION_DEFINITIONS_V AssetOperatingOrgPEO,
MNT_PROGRAMS_VL MaintenanceProgramEO
WHERE WorkRequirementEO.REQUIREMENT_ID = WorkRequirementIncludedAssetEO.REQUIREMENT_ID
AND WorkrequirementEO.REQUIREMENT_TYPE_CODE = 'ORA_MIXED_ASSETS'
AND WorkRequirementIncludedAssetEO.ORGANIZATION_ID = WorkRequirementEO.ORGANIZATION_ID
AND WorkRequirementIncludedAssetEO.ASSET_ID = AssetEO.ASSET_ID
AND AssetEO.MAINTAINABLE_FLAG = 'Y'
AND NVL(AssetEO.ACTIVE_END_DATE,SYSDATE+1) > SYSDATE
AND AssetEO.ITEM_ORGANIZATION_ID = AssetOperatingOrgPEO.ORGANIZATION_ID
AND WorkRequirementEO.program_id = MaintenanceProgramEO.program_id
AND
(
(
NVL(MaintenanceProgramEO.global_assets_flag, 'N') = 'N'
AND MaintenanceProgramEO.organization_id = AssetEO.item_organization_id
)
OR
(
NVL(MaintenanceProgramEO.global_assets_flag, 'N') = 'Y'
AND AssetEO.item_organization_id IN
(
SELECT inv1.organization_id FROM inv_org_parameters inv1, inv_org_parameters inv2
WHERE inv1.master_organization_id = inv2.master_organization_id
AND inv2.organization_id = MaintenanceProgramEO.organization_id
)
)
)
UNION
SELECT WorkRequirementEO.REQUIREMENT_ID,
AssetEO.ASSET_ID,
AssetEO.ITEM_ID,
WorkRequirementEO.ORGANIZATION_ID,
WorkRequirementEO.ASSET_HISTORY_SERVICE_DATE HISTORY_SERVICE_DATE,
WorkRequirementEO.ASSET_HISTORY_SERVICE_INTERVAL HISTORY_SERVICE_INTERVAL,
WorkRequirementEO.active_start_date REQUIREMENT_START_DATE,
WorkRequirementEO.STATUS_CODE FORECAST_OPTION_CODE,
CASE WHEN WorkRequirementEO.ASSET_HISTORY_SERVICE_DATE IS NOT NULL
THEN 'ORA_HISTORY_DATE'
ELSE NULL
END INTIALIZE_OPTION_CODE,
'ORA_INCLUDE' STATUS_CODE,
AssetEO.ASSET_NUMBER,
AssetEO.DESCRIPTION,
AssetEO.NEW_WO_ALLOWED_FLAG,
AssetEO.SERIAL_NUMBER,
DECODE(WorkRequirementEO.work_order_exist_flag,'Y','Y','N') WORK_ORDER_CREATED_FLAG,
NVL(WorkRequirementEO.CREATE_WORK_ORDER_OPTION_CODE,'ORA_AUTOMATIC') CREATE_WORK_ORDER_OPTION_CODE,
AssetOperatingOrgPEO.organization_id OPERATING_ORGANIZATION_ID,
CAST (decode(nvl(AssetOperatingOrgPEO.eam_enabled_flag,'N'), 'Y', AssetOperatingOrgPEO.organization_id,
NVL((select iop.organization_id
from inv_org_parameters iop, cse_org_relationships cor
where iop.organization_id = cor.organization_id
and cor.relationship_type_code = 'ORA_SUPPORTS_AS_PRIMARY'
and cor.related_organization_id = AssetEO.item_organization_id),
WorkRequirementEO.organization_id)) AS NUMBER(18)) MAINTENANCE_ORGANIZATION_ID
FROM CSE_ASSETS_VL AssetEO,
MNT_WORK_REQUIREMENTS_VL WorkRequirementEO,
INV_ORGANIZATION_DEFINITIONS_V AssetOperatingOrgPEO,
MNT_PROGRAMS_VL MaintenanceProgramEO
WHERE WorkRequirementEO.asset_id = AssetEO.asset_id
AND WorkrequirementEO.REQUIREMENT_TYPE_CODE IN ('ORA_ASSET','ORA_ROUTE')
AND AssetEO.MAINTAINABLE_FLAG = 'Y'
AND NVL(AssetEO.ACTIVE_END_DATE,SYSDATE+1) > SYSDATE
AND AssetEO.ITEM_ORGANIZATION_ID = AssetOperatingOrgPEO.ORGANIZATION_ID
AND WorkRequirementEO.program_id = MaintenanceProgramEO.program_id
AND DECODE (WorkRequirementEO.requirement_type_code,'ORA_ROUTE',
(SELECT 'Y' FROM cse_hierarchies_b chb
WHERE chb.hierarchy_id = WorkRequirementEO.route_hierarchy_id
AND chb.route_asset_id = WorkRequirementEO.asset_id
AND chb.route_flag = 'Y' FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY),'Y') = 'Y'
AND
(
(
NVL(MaintenanceProgramEO.global_assets_flag, 'N') = 'N'
AND MaintenanceProgramEO.organization_id = AssetEO.item_organization_id
)
OR
(
NVL(MaintenanceProgramEO.global_assets_flag, 'N') = 'Y'
AND AssetEO.item_organization_id IN
(
SELECT inv1.organization_id FROM inv_org_parameters inv1, inv_org_parameters inv2
WHERE inv1.master_organization_id = inv2.master_organization_id
AND inv2.organization_id = MaintenanceProgramEO.organization_id
)
)
)

objects.name: MNT_WR_METERS_FACT_V
objects.query:
SELECT mrm.requirement_meter_id requirement_meter_id,
mrm.object_version_number object_version_number,
mrm.requirement_id requirement_id,
req.requirement_type_code requirement_type_code,
req.item_id item_id,
req.asset_id asset_id,
mrm.organization_id organization_id,
mrm.meter_definition_id meter_definition_id,
nvl(mrm.meter_id, meters.meter_id) meter_id,
mrm.base_interval base_interval,
mrm.next_forecast_due_by_code next_forecast_due_by_code,
mrm.disabled_flag disabled_flag,
mrm.created_by created_by,
mrm.creation_date creation_date,
mrm.last_updated_by last_updated_by,
mrm.last_update_date last_update_date,
mrm.last_update_login last_update_login,
mrm.request_id request_id,
mrm.job_definition_name job_definition_name,
mrm.job_definition_package job_definition_package
FROM mnt_wr_meters mrm,
(SELECT mr.requirement_id,
mr.requirement_type_code,
mr.item_id,
nvl(mr.asset_id, assets.asset_id) asset_id
FROM mnt_work_requirements_b mr
LEFT OUTER JOIN cse_assets_b assets
ON mr.item_id = assets.item_id
AND mr.requirement_type_code = 'ORA_ITEM'
AND assets.maintainable_flag = 'Y'
AND
(
(NVL(mr.asset_inclusion_type_code,'ORA_AUTOMATIC') = 'ORA_AUTOMATIC'
AND assets.asset_id NOT IN (
SELECT excluded_assets.asset_id
FROM mnt_wr_excluded_assets excluded_assets
WHERE mr.requirement_id=excluded_assets.requirement_id))
OR
(mr.asset_inclusion_type_code = 'ORA_MANUAL'
AND assets.asset_id IN (
SELECT included_assets.asset_id
FROM mnt_wr_included_assets included_assets
WHERE mr.requirement_id=included_assets.requirement_id))
)) req,
cse_meters meters
WHERE req.requirement_id = mrm.requirement_id
AND meters.meter_usage_code = 'ORA_ASSET'
AND meters.meter_object_id = req.asset_id
AND meters.meter_definition_id = mrm.meter_definition_id

columns.name: CHARGE_DEFINITION
columns.comments: A charge definition is a combination of Price Type, Charge Type, Charge Sub Type.

columns.name: CHARGE_DEFINITION_CODE
columns.comments: Code of the charge definition entity. A charge definition defines the price type, charge type, and charge subtype, which are denormalized onto this entity.

columns.name: CHARGE_SUBTYPE
columns.comments: Subtype of a given charge type. Examples are, within Shipping Related Charges: Freight Charge, Shipping Insurance, within Special Charges: Suspend Charge, Resumption Charge

columns.name: CHARGE_SUBTYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Code of the subtype of a given charge. Defined for this configuration for aggregation of totals.

columns.name: PRICE_TYPE
columns.comments: Price type of a given charge. Examples are One-time, Recurring, Usage, etc.

columns.name: PRICE_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Code of the price type of a given charge. One-time, Recurring.

columns.name: PRICED_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Quantity for which pricing was done.

columns.name: PRICED_QUANTITY_UOM
columns.comments: Meaning of the unit of measure code in which the priced quantity is expressed.

columns.name: PRICED_QUANTITY_UOM_CODE
columns.comments: Unit of measure code in which the priced quantity is expressed.

columns.name: PRIMARY_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates whether this charge is the primary charge.

columns.name: APPLY_TO
columns.comments: Indicates whether a charge is applied to Product, Shipping, or Return.

columns.name: ROLLUP_FLAG
columns.comments: Marks a charge as a rollup or aggregate charge.

columns.name: CHARGE_TYPE
columns.comments: Defines the type of charge. Examples are Goods Sale, Service Sale, Financing, Shipping-related Charges, Restocking Penalties, Special Charges, etc.

columns.name: CHARGE_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Code of a given charge type. Charge types could include goods sale, service sale, financing or lease, shipping-related charges, restocking penalties, or special charges.

columns.name: CHARGE_CURRENCY_NAME
columns.comments: Name of the currency that was used for the charge. E.g., US Dollar.

columns.name: CHARGE_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.comments: Code of the currency that was used for the charge. E.g., USD.

columns.name: SEQUENCE_NUMBER
columns.comments: Indicates the sequence number of the charge.

columns.name: PRICE_PERIODICITY_CODE
columns.comments: Code of the periodicity for both recurring price type and recurring usage price type. Month, Year, Quarter.

columns.name: AVERAGE_UNIT_SELLING_PRICE
columns.comments: Average unit selling price for an item.

columns.name: CHARGE_CURRENCY_CODE

columns.name: HEADER_CURRENCY_NAME
columns.comments: Name of the header currency. E.g., US Dollar.

columns.name: HEADER_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.comments: Code of the order header currency. E.g., USD.

columns.name: HEADER_CURRENCY_EXT_AMOUNT
columns.comments: Extended amount in the header currency.

columns.name: PRICE_ELEMENT
columns.comments: Meaning of the price element code from the price element setup.

columns.name: PRICE_ELEMENT_CODE
columns.comments: Code of the elements used in the price elements setup, for example, LISTPRICE and NETPRICE.

columns.name: SEQUENCE_NUMBER
columns.comments: Sequence number of the charge component.

columns.name: PRICE_ELEMENT_USAGE
columns.comments: Meaning of the price element usage code which indicates how the charge component will be used.

columns.name: PRICE_ELEMENT_USAGE_CODE
columns.comments: Used by consuming applications to indicate how the charge component will be used. Values of this attribute come from an Oracle Fusion Pricing lookup. By default, the values include List Price and Net Price.

columns.name: CHARGE_CURRENCY_UNIT_PRICE
columns.comments: Price or adjustment per unit in the charge currency for the line unit of measure.

columns.name: HEADER_CURRENCY_UNIT_PRICE
columns.comments: Price or adjustment for a unit in the header currency for the line unit of measure.

columns.name: ROLLUP_FLAG
columns.comments: Marks a charge component as a rollup or aggregate value for the charge component price element code.

columns.name: PARENT_CHARGE_COMPONENT_IF_KEY
columns.comments: Charge Component Id of the contributing charge as assigned by the system that captured the transaction. Only populated for charge components where the parent charge is a rollup charge

columns.name: CHARGE_CURRENCY_EXT_AMOUNT
columns.comments: Extended amount in charge currency. Extended amount equals the unit price multiplied by the line requested quantity for simple products and equals the unit price multiplied by the line extended quantity for configurations.

columns.name: EXPLANATION
columns.comments: Message for display in a price breakdown user interface.

columns.name: PERCENT_OF_COMPARISON_ELEMENT
columns.comments: The percentage that this unit price is of the basis charge component unit price. By default the basis is the List Price. This attribute captures the Margin %, the % the Net Price is of the List Price etc.

columns.name: PRICING_SOURCE_ID
columns.comments: Id of the lowest level pricing source. E.g. priceListLineId, Tier Rule Id, CP Rule Id, Formula Id, AP Id, shipping line id, etc.

columns.name: EXPLANATION_MESSAGE_NAME
columns.comments: Message name of the explanation for the price break down UI.

columns.name: TAX_INCLUDED_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates whether tax is included in the price for a given charge component.

columns.comments: This is the final destination location for the purchases made by the customer.

columns.name: PROD_FC_CATEG_ID
columns.comments: This is a classification of the product(s) by tax authority for tax purposes.

columns.name: PRODUCT_TYPE
columns.comments: The Product Type is another product related classification in Fusion Tax. The value of product type specifies whether the transaction line is for a good, or a service, or it is a memo line.

columns.name: PRODUCT_CATEGORY
columns.comments: The Product Category is used to classify products for tax purposes. It is used where Oracle Inventory is not installed, or is installed but not used for classifying products for tax purposes.

columns.name: TRX_BUSINESS_CATEGORY
columns.comments: The Transaction Business Category is a classification or categorization of a transaction for tax purposes as required by a tax authority.

columns.name: ASSESSABLE_VALUE
columns.comments: Assessable value is the deemed price at which a product is valued, by a tax authority for a given tax.

columns.name: USER_DEFINED_FISC_CLASS
columns.comments: User Defined Fiscal Classification is an additional classification of the transaction into different categories for tax purposes.

columns.name: INTENDED_USE_CLASSIF_ID
columns.comments: The classification id for intended use for tax calculation purposes.

columns.name: DESTINATION_LOCATION_ID
columns.comments: Destination Location to which the product is Shipped

columns.name: DESTINATION_ORG_ID
columns.comments: Destination Org to which the product is Shipped

columns.name: QUANTITY_PER_MODEL
columns.comments: Component quantity for a single model

columns.name: CONFIG_INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
columns.comments: Inventory item of shippable ATO configuration

columns.name: PURCHASING_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates whether the item on the fulfillment line may be included on a Purchase Order for fulfilling the underlying source order line

columns.name: CUSTOMER_PO_SCHEDULE_NUMBER
columns.comments: Contains Customers Purchase Order Shipment Schedule number , if specified while submitting an order.

columns.name: SUPPLY_STATUS_CODE
columns.comments: Status of the supply for the fulfillment line.

columns.name: SHIP_TO_CONTACT_POINT_ID
columns.comments: Identifier of a ship-to contact point

columns.name: PREF_OVERRIDDEN_BITSET
columns.comments: Bitset that helps identify the overridden attributes on the line.

columns.name: APPLIED_PRICE_LIST_ID
columns.comments: Id of the price list that has been applied

columns.name: PRICED_ON
columns.comments: The date when the line is priced. This attribute will be populated with the system date at the beginning of a pricing process

columns.name: REQUIRED_FULFILLMENT_DATE
columns.comments: The date used for planning and re-planning purpose

columns.name: COMPONENT_ID_PATH
columns.comments: Inventory ID path to the parent of this Line. Path format is ">" separated inventory item id.

columns.name: VALID_CONFIGURATION_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates the valid status of the configuration. This is populated only for the Root line.

columns.name: CONFIGURATOR_PATH
columns.comments: Runtime representation of the Inventory Item Id path to the component. Path format is "." Separated inventory item id. For multi-instantiable components instances are denoted by [<instance number>].

columns.name: CONFIG_HEADER_ID
columns.comments: Header Id of the configuration.

columns.name: CONFIG_REVISION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Revision number of the configuration.

columns.name: SHOW_IN_SALES
columns.comments: Indicates whether to show the Line Item in Sales Summary page including Configurator summary page. This is an Item component attribute defined in PIM during structure creation. This attribute only controls the display and does not filter Line Items from configurator output results. This column can have one of three values: 1: Yes - Item is always shown (default), 2: Hide Self - Item is hidden, child items will be moved up in the summary display, 3: Hide Self and Descendants - Item and its hierarchy will be hidden in summary display.

columns.name: CHANGE_ELIGIBLE_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates whether the Line as a whole is eligible for modification by the user.

columns.name: MODIFIED_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates that the row has been modified in the version currently submitted

columns.name: UNREFERENCED_RETURN_FLAG
columns.comments: Identify return that does not include a reference order.

columns.name: BILL_TO_CONTACT_POINT_ID
columns.comments: Identifier of a bill-to contact point.

columns.name: UNIT_QUANTITY
columns.comments: For a configuration this is the requested component quantity of a child option for one unit of parent item component.

columns.name: CONFIG_CREATION_DATE
columns.comments: The date when configuration is created. This attribute will be populated with the system date when a configuration is first created.

columns.name: CONTRACT_START_DATE
columns.comments: The start date of the contract, if the order line is associated with a contract.

columns.name: CONTRACT_END_DATE
columns.comments: The end date of the contract, if the transaction line is associated with a contract.

columns.name: TOTAL_CONTRACT_QUANTITY
columns.comments: It reflects the total quantity for the entire contract duration. It takes into acccount the number of periods in the case of recurring billing.

columns.name: TOTAL_CONTRACT_AMOUNT
columns.comments: It reflects the total amount for the entire contract duration based on the total contract quantity.

columns.name: PROCESS_INSTANCE_ID
columns.comments: Identifier of the orchestration process instance that attached to the fulfill line.

columns.name: PROCESS_NUMBER
columns.comments: Process number used for display in the runtime UI

columns.name: CREDIT_CHK_AUTH_NUM
columns.comments: The unique identifier for the approved credit authorization created in credit management system on the requested authorized amount for the customer account specified. This is only applicable for credit check of type `Authorization' and `Re-Authorization'.

columns.name: CREDIT_CHK_AUTH_EXP_DATE
columns.comments: The date on which the approved credit authorization will expire.

columns.name: TRADE_COMPLIANCE_RESULT_CODE
columns.comments: Roll-up result of the trade compliance screening across all applicable compliance types

columns.name: TRADE_COMPLIANCE_DATE
columns.comments: Date on which the line was last screened for trade compliance

columns.name: TRANSPORTATION_PLANNED_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates that a transportation planning system plans the fulfillment line.

columns.name: CREATED_IN_RELEASE
columns.comments: Stores the release version when fulfill line was created.

columns.name: CONFIG_TRADE_COMPL_RESULT_CODE
columns.comments: Roll-up result of trade compliance screening for configuration

columns.name: BILLING_TRX_TYPE_ID
columns.comments: Billing Transaction type identifier

columns.name: SERVICE_DURATION
columns.comments: Captures duration for the coverage or subscription product on the fulfillment line.

columns.name: SERVICE_DURATION_PERIOD_CODE
columns.comments: Identifies duration unit of measure for the coverage or subscription product on the fulfillment line.

columns.name: SALES_PRODUCT_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Identifies sales product type of product on the fulfillment line.

columns.name: ACTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Abbreviation that identifies the Type of action for subscription or coverage: Add, Terminate, or Amend. The ORA_QP_ACTION_TYPES lookup type contains the values that you can use for this attribute.

columns.name: ASSET_TRACKED_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag to indicate whether the fulfill line is eligible to be interfaced to Asset Management for tracking of customer assets that are created from the order processing.

columns.name: ASSET_GROUP_NUMBER
columns.comments: Asset Group Number. Used for grouping customer assets together.

columns.name: PROCESS_SET
columns.comments: Captures Process Name to group all Fullfillment lines in a single process as provided.

columns.name: SALESPERSON_ID
columns.comments: Primary Sales person identifier.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.comments: Unique identifier of the batch that was used for importing the order.

columns.name: PROCESS_ID
columns.comments: Unique identifier of the orchestration process assigned.

columns.name: PRJ_REC_INDICATOR
columns.comments: Project's record indicator, used in interfarcing to Shipping Task Layer. A value of 'Y' indicates a project record exists for this line, 'N' implies no project record.

columns.name: CREATION_MODE
columns.comments: Identifies the interface using which the line was captured.

columns.name: MDO_FLAG
columns.comments: Determines the mode of orchestration e.g., 'Y' is MDO , 'N' is classic.

columns.name: FULFILLMENT_GROUP_ID
columns.comments: Unique identifier of the fulfillment group to which the fulfillment line belongs. All lines that belong to the same ship set or model are in the same fulfillment group.

columns.name: SELLING_PROFIT_CENTER_BU_ID
columns.comments: Reference to Unique Identifier of Profit Center Business Unit.

columns.name: USER_UPDATE_INDICATOR_BITSET
columns.comments: Identifies if User has Modified any specific attribute. Internally this number is converted as bits to identify user updated attribute

columns.name: SUBSCRIPTION_PROFILE_ID
columns.comments: Value that uniquely identifies the subscription profile.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_PRICE_BOOK_NAME
columns.comments: Price book or price list name in the external pricing application.

columns.name: END_REASON_CODE
columns.comments: Abbreviation that identifies the Reason to end or amend the subscription or coverage. The ORA_OSS_CLOSE_REASONS lookup type contains the values that you can use for this attribute.

columns.name: END_CREDIT_METHOD_CODE
columns.comments: Abbreviation that identifies the credit method for ending or amending the subscription or coverage. The ORA_OSS_CLOSE_CREDIT_METHOD lookup type contains the values that you can use for this attribute.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.comments: Date when the subscription or coverage is ended.

columns.name: INVENTORY_INTERFACED_FLAG
columns.comments: Contains Y, N, or empty. Y: Order management successfully interfaced the fulfillment line to inventory management. N or empty: Order management hasn't interfaced the fulfillment line. Order management updates this attribute when it directly reduces inventory to fulfill the order line.

columns.name: INVENTORY_TRANSACTION_FLAG
columns.comments: Contains Y, N, or empty. Y: Order management sends a request to inventory management to do an inventory transaction when fulfilling the order line instead of using the pick wave, pick, pack, and ship flow. N or empty: Order management uses the pick wave, pick, pack, and ship flow to fulfill the order line. The Order Entry Specialist sets the value for this attribute in the Order Management work area, or order management sets it during order import.

columns.name: SECONDARY_UOM
columns.comments: Secondary unit of measure for the ordered quantity on the fulfillment line. For example, length, time, heat, value, and so on. This attribute applies when you use more than one unit of measure to measure and track the item.

columns.name: SECONDARY_ORDERED_QTY
columns.comments: Ordered quantity on the fulfillment line for the item or service in the secondary unit of measure. This attribute applies when you use more than one unit of measure to measure and track the item.

columns.name: SECONDARY_SHIPPED_QTY
columns.comments: Shipped quantity on the fulfillment line for the item or service in the secondary unit of measure. This attribute applies when you use more than one unit of measure to measure and track the item.

columns.name: SECONDARY_RMA_DELIVERED_QTY
columns.comments: Delivered quantity on the fulfillment line for the returned item or service in the secondary unit of measure. This attribute applies when you use more than one unit of measure to measure and track the item.

columns.name: PRICE_USING_SEC_UOM_FLAG
columns.comments: Contains Y, N, or empty. Y: Order management uses secondary ordered quantity and secondary unit of measure to price the order line. N or empty: Order management uses ordered quantity and ordered unit of measure to price the order line.

columns.name: SECONDARY_FULFILLED_QTY
columns.comments: Fulfilled quantity on the fulfillment line for the item or service in the secondary unit of measure. This attribute applies when you use more than one unit of measure to measure and track the item.

columns.name: RATE_PLAN_DOCUMENT_ID
columns.comments: Value that uniquely identifies the JSON document for a rate plan in Oracle Fusion Pricing Cloud.

columns.name: RATE_PLAN_ID
columns.comments: Value that uniquely identifies a rate plan in Oracle Fusion Pricing Cloud.

columns.name: INTEGRATE_SUBSCRIPTION_FLAG
columns.comments: Contains one of the following values: Y or N. Y means Order Management will send the fulfillment line to Oracle Fusion Subscription Management. N means it won't. The default value is N.

columns.name: FULFILL_UPDATE_PARENT_REF_ID
columns.comments: Unique Identifier of the parent fulfillment line id which resulted the split after partial fulfillment.

columns.name: ADDED_BY_EXTENSION_FLAG
columns.comments: Contains Y or N. Y means an order management extension added the fulfillment line.

columns.name: DEMAND_SOURCE_LINE_REFERENCE
columns.comments: Value that uniquely identifies demand, such as the line in a shopping cart on a web store or in an ecommerce application. You create a sales order in a web store, the web store sends a request to Global Order Promising to schedule it, Global Order Promising schedules the demand and sends a reply to the web store, the web store sends the sales order to Order Management, then Order Management manages the order through fulfillment.

columns.name: DEMAND_SOURCE_SCHEDULED_FLAG
columns.comments: This attribute applies for a transaction that starts in a web store or ecommerce store. It contains Y or N. Y: Order Management created a sales order, sent the DEMAND_SOURCE_LINE_ID to Global Order Promising, Promising successfully scheduled the demand, Order Management received a response from Promising, and then set DEMAND_SOURCE_SCHEDULED_FLAG to Y. It does this during the first scheduling interaction that it has with Promising. You can't modify the value for DEMAND_SOURCE_SCHEDULED_FLAG after it contains Y. N: Promising hasn't successfully scheduled this demand, or the line doesn't contain DEMAND_SOURCE_LINE_ID.

columns.name: REQUESTED_RATE_PLAN_ID
columns.comments: Value that uniquely identifies the rate plan requested by the user. Oracle Fusion Pricing Cloud automatically creates the value for this attribute.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_ID_F
columns.comments: This will hold the fusion value for Supplier on whom Purchase Order is created.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_SITE_ID_F
columns.comments: This will hold the fusion value for Supplier Site on whom Purchase Order is created.

columns.name: CARRIER_ID_F
columns.comments: Reference to the unique fusion value identifier for the carrier.

columns.name: SHIP_MODE_OF_TRANSPORT_F
columns.comments: Fusion value for the type of transportation used to ship the product, such as truck, air or boat.

columns.name: SHIP_CLASS_OF_SERVICE_F
columns.comments: Fusion value for the Priority of transportation that affects how quickly goods are transported

columns.name: SHIPMENT_PRIORITY_CODE_F
columns.comments: Fusion value that Indicates the priority of the fulfillment lines to be shipped.

columns.name: FREIGHT_TERMS_CODE_F
columns.comments: Fusion value for the Freight Terms, specifying the responsibility for Freight charges

columns.name: FOB_POINT_CODE_F
columns.comments: Fusion value for the Code that indicates freight on board

columns.name: DEMAND_CLASS_CODE_F
columns.comments: Fusion value for the Demand Class used by the promise engine to consume target allocation amounts.

columns.name: PAYMENT_TERM_ID_F
columns.comments: Refers to the unique fusion value identifier for the payment term.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_RULE_ID_F
columns.comments: Reference to the unique fusion value identifier for the accounting rule which determines the revenue recognition schedule for the invoice line.

columns.name: INVOICING_RULE_ID_F
columns.comments: Fusion value for the Invoicing rule used by Billing for generating Invoice

columns.name: TAX_CLASSIFICATION_CODE_F
columns.comments: Fusion value for a group of taxes for reporting and processing purposes.

columns.name: RETURN_REASON_CODE_F
columns.comments: Fusion value for justification to return a specific product. Many companies have standard reasons that are assigned to returns to be used to analyze the quantity and types of returns.

columns.name: TAX_EXEMPTION_REASON_CODE_F
columns.comments: Fusion value for the reason a tax exemption was granted and taken.

columns.name: CANCEL_BACKORDERS_FLAG
columns.comments: Contains Y or N. Y: Allow user to cancel sales orders or order lines that have items that are on back order. N: Don't allow.

columns.name: ENFORCE_SINGLE_SHIPMENT_FLAG
columns.comments: Contains Y or N. Y: Allow user to cancel the part of the order line's quantity that they can't ship in one shipment. N: Don't allow.

columns.name: CANCEL_REASON_CODE_F
columns.comments: Fusion value for the cancel reason.

columns.name: REVISION_REASON_CODE
columns.comments: Abbreviation that identifies the reason why the user revised the fulfillment line.

columns.name: REVISION_COMMENTS
columns.comments: Comments that the user can enter on the fulfillment line when revising the line.

columns.name: ONE_TIME_CONFIG_FLAG
columns.comments: Contains Y or N. Y: Fulfill the item as a one-time configuration. N: Don't fulfill it as a one-time configuration. A one-time configuration is an assembled-to-order, configured item that's unique on the order line. Order Management keeps that item's number even if you reconfigure the item and modify its structure.

columns.name: CONFIG_ITEM_VERSION
columns.comments: Number that identifies the version of a one-time configured item.

columns.name: DRAFT_SCHEDULED_FLAG
columns.comments: Contains one of the following values : Y or N. If Y, the fulfillment line is manually scheduled by the user, using schedule action through UI. If N, the fulfillment line isn't scheduled manually. Default value is N.

columns.name: PROMOTION_ITEM_FLAG
columns.comments: This indicates that the line is a promotion item line added automatically by Oracle Fusion Pricing. Default Value is N.

columns.name: SORT_SEQUENCE_NUMBER
columns.comments: Indicates the position of the item within the order and is used to sort items accordingly.

columns.name: BILLING_SET_NAME
columns.comments: Name for a group of order lines that you invoice together.

columns.name: BILLING_SET_ID
columns.comments: Number that uniquely identifies the billing set.

columns.name: INVOICE_INTERFACE_STATUS
columns.comments: Status that indicates whether order management interfaced the order line to receivables.

columns.name: ATTACH_TO_SUBSCRIPTION
columns.comments: Number that identifies the subscription or coverage to which you will add this subscription or coverage line.

columns.name: MRSL_SHIP_DAYS
columns.comments: Minimum remaining shelf life days with reference to scheduled ship date of the sales order line.

columns.name: MRSL_DAYS
columns.comments: Minimum remaining shelf life days of the sales order line demand.

columns.name: MRSL_ANCHOR_TYPE
columns.comments: Minimum remaining shelf life anchor type. This can be Arrival (1) or Ship (2).

A processing constraint controls whether you can do an Update operation on the sales order entity, and it determines this attribute's value each time you revise the order. This attribute doesn't apply when you import an order.

columns.name: LINE_ADD_ALLOWED_FLAG
columns.comments: Contains Y or N. Y: you can use redesigned pages in the Order Management work area to add an order line to a sales order. N: you can't do this add. columns.comments: Unique identifier of the transaction in the system that captured the transaction.

columns.comments: Reference that represents the covered item in the system that captured the transaction. Order Management uses this attribute for cancelling coverage item without a reference order.

columns.name: AGREEMENT_NUMBER
columns.comments: Number that uniquely identifies the sales agreement on the order line.

columns.comments: Value that uniquely identifies the inventory item that the coverage item covers. Order Management uses this attribute to cancel the coverage item without a reference order.

columns.name: COVERED_CUSTOMER_PRODUCT_NUM
columns.comments: Number that identifies the customer item that the coverage item covers. This value applies only when the sales order or the return order includes the customer. Order Management uses this attribute to cancel the coverage item without a reference order.

columns.name: COVERED_CUSTOMER_PRODUCT_DESC
columns.comments: Description of the customer item that the coverage item covers. This value applies only when the sales order or the return order includes the customer. Order Management uses this attribute to cancel the coverage item without a reference order.

columns.name: SERVICE_CANCEL_DATE
columns.comments: Date when the cancellation of the service item becomes effective. Order Management uses this attribute to cancel the service item without a reference order.

columns.name: COVERED_PRODUCT_NUMBER
columns.comments: Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) of the inventory item that the coverage item covers. Order Management uses this attribute to cancel the coverage item without a reference order.

columns.name: COVERED_PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION
columns.comments: Description of the inventory item that the coverage item covers. Order Management uses this attribute to cancel the coverage item without a reference order.

columns.name: COVERED_CUSTOMER_PRODUCT_ID
columns.comments: Value that uniquely identifies the customer item that the coverage item covers. This value applies only when the sales order or the return order includes the customer. Order Management uses this attribute to cancel the coverage item without a reference order.

columns.name: AGREEMENT_HEADER_ID
columns.comments: Value that uniquely identifies the sales agreement on the order line.

columns.name: CREDIT_CHK_AUTH_NUM
columns.comments: The unique identifier for the approved credit authorization created in credit management system on the requested authorized amount for the customer account specified. This is only applicable for credit check of type `Authorization' and `Re-Authorization'.

columns.name: CREDIT_CHK_AUTH_EXP_DATE
columns.comments: The date on which the approved credit authorization will expire.

columns.name: SOURCE_TRANSACTION_SYSTEM
columns.comments: System or application that submitted the order request.

columns.name: SOURCE_TRANSACTION_LINE_ID
columns.comments: Unique identifier of the transaction line from the system that captured the transaction.

columns.name: SOURCE_TRANSACTION_SCHEDULE_ID
columns.comments: Unique identifier of a schedule, shipment, or subline, as assigned by the system that captured the transaction.

columns.name: SOURCE_TRANSACTION_SCHEDULE_NO
columns.comments: Number of a schedule, shipment, or subline, as assigned by the system that captured the transaction.

columns.name: SOURCE_TRANSACTION_LINE_NO
columns.comments: Number of the transaction line from the system that captured the transaction.

columns.name: PRODUCT_ID
columns.comments: Unique identifier of the inventory item.

columns.name: PRODUCT_NUMBER
columns.comments: SKU of product that is being fulfilled.

columns.name: PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION
columns.comments: Display Name of the product that is being fulfilled.

columns.name: ORDERED_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Quantity of an ordered good or service.

columns.name: ORDERED_UOM_CODE
columns.comments: Unit of measure for the quantity ordered. A predetermined amount, quantity, or quality that is adopted as a standard of measurement. Examples: length, time, heat, value.

columns.name: ORDERED_UOM
columns.comments: Name of the unit of measure for the quantity ordered. A predetermined amount, quantity, or quality that is adopted as a standard of measurement. Examples: length, time, heat, value.

columns.name: REQUESTED_FULFILLMENT_ORG_ID
columns.comments: Unique identifier of the fulfillment organization.

columns.name: REQUESTED_FULFILLMENT_ORG_CODE
columns.comments: Code that represents the organization from which the product was shipped.

columns.name: REQUESTED_FULFILLMENT_ORG_NAME
columns.comments: Name that represents the organization from which the product was shipped.

columns.name: BUSINESS_UNIT_ID
columns.comments: Unique identifier of the business unit that is associated with the row.

columns.name: BUSINESS_UNIT_NAME
columns.comments: Internal organization that is fulfilling the order.

columns.name: REQUESTING_BUSINESS_UNIT_ID
columns.comments: Unique identifier of the organization that is associated with the source order.

columns.name: REQUESTING_BUSINESS_UNIT_NAME
columns.comments: Internal organization that initiated this transaction.

columns.name: CANCEL_REASON_CODE
columns.comments: Code that represents the reason the line was canceled.

columns.name: CANCEL_REASON
columns.comments: Reason the line was canceled.

columns.name: SUBSTITUTION_ALLOWED_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates that items on the fulfillment line can be substituted for various reasons like shortage of material, or as a goodwill gesture to the customer.

columns.name: SUBSTITUTION_REASON_CODE
columns.comments: Code that describes why an item was substituted on a fulfillment line.

columns.name: SUBSTITUTION_REASON
columns.comments: Reason why an item was substituted on a fulfillment line.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_PO_NUMBER
columns.comments: Commercial document that is used to request that a seller supply a product or service in return for payment.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_PO_LINE_NUMBER
columns.comments: Unique identifier of the line record of a transaction. The purchase order line describes an item or service, with a price and quantity ordered.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_PO_SCHEDULE_NUMBER
columns.comments: Contains the customer's purchase order shipment schedule number, if specified, while submitting an order.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_PRODUCT_ID
columns.comments: Unique identifier of the customer item.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_PRODUCT_NUMBER
columns.comments: Product number on the customer item table, if a customer item number was used for ordering.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION
columns.comments: Product description on the customer item table, if a customer item description was used for ordering.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_LINE_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Defines the system behavior for the order line transaction, in terms of values required, defaulted, and displayed.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_LINE_TYPE
columns.comments: Type of line or action in the channel system. Some example values are Buy, Replace With, Return For Credit, and Upgrade.

columns.name: PARENT_LINE_REFERENCE
columns.comments: Alphanumeric reference of the line that is the immediate parent of this line in a configurable product hierarchy or in any other situation with parent-child relationships.

columns.name: ROOT_PARENT_LINE_REFERENCE
columns.comments: Alphanumeric reference of the line at the root of the configurable product hierarchy that the line is a component of.

columns.name: SHIPPING_INSTRUCTIONS
columns.comments: Message on a document that provides details about cargo and any requirements for its physical movement.

columns.name: PACKING_INSTRUCTIONS
columns.comments: Document that contains information concerning the packing of an item.

columns.name: INVOICING_RULE_CODE
columns.comments: Code that represents invoicing rules that determine when to recognize a receivable for invoices.

columns.name: INVOICING_RULE
columns.comments: Invoicing rule that determine when to recognize a receivable for invoices.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_RULE_CODE
columns.comments: Code that represents an accounting rule that determines the accounting period or periods in which the revenue distributions for an invoice line are recorded.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_RULE
columns.comments: Accounting rule that determines the accounting period or periods in which the revenue distributions for an invoice line are recorded.

columns.name: REQUESTED_SHIP_DATE
columns.comments: Original date the customer requested the item to ship.

columns.name: REQUESTED_ARRIVAL_DATE
columns.comments: Original date the customer requested the to item arrive.

columns.name: SCHEDULE_SHIP_DATE
columns.comments: Date when goods are expected to be shipped.

columns.name: SCHEDULE_ARRIVAL_DATE
columns.comments: Date the shipment is scheduled to arrive.

columns.name: DEMAND_CLASS_CODE
columns.comments: Demand class used by the order promising engine to consume target allocation amounts.

columns.name: DEMAND_CLASS
columns.comments: Grouping of customers. Demand classes can represent different sources of demand, such as retail, mail order, and wholesale.

columns.name: SHIPPING_CARRIER_CODE
columns.comments: Code that represents the shipping carrier that delivered the goods.

columns.name: SHIPPING_CARRIER
columns.comments: Shipping carrier that delivered the goods.

columns.name: PAYMENT_TERM_CODE
columns.comments: Code that represents payment terms to apply to collect this payment.

columns.name: PAYMENT_TERM
columns.comments: Payment terms to apply to collect this payment.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_CATEGORY_CODE
columns.comments: Code used to group and process journal entries with similar characteristics, such as adjustments, accruals, or reclassifications.

columns.name: RETURN_REASON_CODE
columns.comments: Code that represents the justification for a return of a specific product. Many companies have standard reasons that are assigned to returns to be used to analyze the quantity and types of returns.

columns.name: RETURN_REASON
columns.comments: Reason expressed by customer for wanting to return the product.

columns.name: SHIPPING_SERVICE_LEVEL_CODE
columns.comments: Code that represents the priority of transportation that affects how quickly goods are transported.

columns.name: SHIPPING_SERVICE_LEVEL
columns.comments: Level of service to be used for delivery of the shipment.

columns.name: SHIPPING_MODE_CODE
columns.comments: Code that represents the type of transportation used to ship the product, such as truck, air, or boat.

columns.name: SHIPPING_MODE
columns.comments: Shipping mode that was actually used to deliver the goods.

columns.name: SHIPMENT_PRIORITY_CODE
columns.comments: Code that represents the priority of the fulfillment lines to be shipped.

columns.name: SHIPMENT_PRIORITY
columns.comments: Priority categorization that can be used to group shipments by urgency.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.comments: Unique identifier of the inventory organization.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ORGANIZATION_CODE
columns.comments: Code of the inventory organization that the product belongs to.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ORGANIZATION_NAME
columns.comments: Name of the inventory organization that the product belongs to.

columns.name: FREIGHT_TERMS_CODE
columns.comments: Code that represents the terms specifying the responsibility for freight charges.

columns.name: FREIGHT_TERMS
columns.comments: Terms specifying the responsibility for freight charges, such as paid by shipper, collect, or prepaid.

columns.name: REQUEST_CANCEL_DATE
columns.comments: Date that the customer canceled the line.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_PRODUCT_ID
columns.comments: Unique identifier of the original inventory item that was populated on the fulfillment line before the item was substituted.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_PRODUCT_NUMBER
columns.comments: Number of the original inventory item that was populated on the fulfillment line before the item was substituted.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION
columns.comments: Description of the original inventory item that was populated on the fulfillment line before the item was substituted.

columns.name: PARTIAL_SHIP_ALLOWED_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates that the items on the order can be shipped in multiple shipments, rather than as one shipment.

columns.name: FULFILLMENT_LINE_ID
columns.comments: Unique identifier of a fulfillment line.

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.comments: Comments for the line.

columns.name: UNIT_LIST_PRICE
columns.comments: Base selling price before applying discounts. It typically defaults from the item definition.

columns.name: UNIT_SELLING_PRICE
columns.comments: Price per unit that a buyer paid for an item.

columns.name: EXTENDED_AMOUNT
columns.comments: Monetary amount of the order line quantity.

columns.name: EARLIEST_ACCEPTABLE_SHIP_DATE
columns.comments: Earliest date that the customer is willing to receive a shipment.

columns.name: LATEST_ACCEPTABLE_SHIP_DATE
columns.comments: Latest date that the customer is willing to have a warehouse ship a product.

columns.name: EARLIEST_ACCEPTABLE_ARR_DATE
columns.comments: Earliest date the customer can accept arrival.

columns.name: LATEST_ACCEPTABLE_ARRIVAL_DATE
columns.comments: Latest date that the customer is willing to receive a product.

columns.name: PROMISE_SHIP_DATE

columns.name: PROMISE_ARRIVAL_DATE
columns.comments: Date that was promised to the customer that the item would arrive.

columns.name: SUBINVENTORY_CODE
columns.comments: Code that represents the physical or logical location of the item.

columns.name: SUBINVENTORY
columns.comments: Physical or logical location of the item.

columns.name: SHIP_SET_NAME
columns.comments: Group of order lines within an order that need to ship together from their common origin to a common destination and which have the same scheduled ship date.

columns.name: TAX_EXEMPT_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates that a quote or fulfillment line is exempt from taxes.

columns.name: TAX_CLASSIFICATION_CODE
columns.comments: Code that represents a grouping of taxes for reporting and processing purposes.

columns.name: TAX_CLASSIFICATION
columns.comments: Grouping of taxes for reporting and processing purposes.

columns.name: TAX_EXEMPTION_CERTIFICATE_NO

columns.name: TAX_EXEMPT_REASON
columns.comments: Reason that a tax exemption was granted and taken.

columns.name: DEFAULT_TAXATION_COUNTRY

columns.name: DEFAULT_TAX_COUNTRY_SHORT_NAME
columns.comments: Specifies the taxation country for tax calculation purposes.

columns.name: FIRST_PARTY_TAX_REG_NUMBER

columns.name: THIRD_PARTY_TAX_REG_NUMBER

columns.name: DOCUMENT_SUBTYPE_NAME

columns.name: PRODUCT_FISCAL_CATEGORY_NAME

columns.name: ASSESSABLE_VALUE

columns.name: USER_DEFINED_FISCAL_CLASS

columns.name: USER_DEFINED_FISC_CLASS_NAME
columns.comments: Classification of the transaction into different categories for tax purposes.

columns.name: INTENDED_USE_CLASS_NAME
