columns.name: FULFILL_LINE_ID
columns.comments: Unique identifier for the sales order line. This is an internal column.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.comments: Id of the batch as part of which this line will be processed

columns.name: PROCESS_ID
columns.comments: Id of the assigned process for order. This column is not used currently.

columns.name: PROCESS_NAME
columns.comments: This column will accept valid/active value from DOO_PROCESS_DEFINITION table's PROCESS_NAME attribute. This value will be used to select the orchestration process to process that order line. To find the valid value for this column, please use Orchestration Process Maintenance user interface. This value will be accepted as part of import only for new lines; for both CREATE and UPDATE flows. Update of Process Name is not possible for lines which are already submitted in UPDATE flow. For UPDATE flow, make sure you provide Process Name for all new lines; if you have provided Process Name value for lines in CREATE flow.

columns.name: PROCESS_DISPLAY_NAME
columns.comments: Display name of the assigned process. This column is not used currently.

columns.name: VALIDATION_BITSET
columns.comments: Oracle internal use only. This is used to identify attributes that failed validation.

columns.name: SELLING_PROFIT_CENTER_BU_ID
columns.comments: Reference to Unique Identifier of Profit Center Business Unit.

columns.name: INVENTORY_TRANSACTION_FLAG
columns.comments: Contains Y, N, or empty. Y: Order management sends a request to inventory management to do an inventory transaction when fulfilling the order line instead of using the pick wave, pick, pack, and ship flow. N or empty: Order management uses the pick wave, pick, pack, and ship flow to fulfill the order line. The Order Entry Specialist sets the value for this attribute in the Order Management work area, or order management sets it during order import.

columns.name: SUBSCRIPTION_PROFILE_ID
columns.comments: Value that uniquely identifies the subscription profile.

columns.name: SUBSCRIPTION_PROFILE_NAME
columns.comments: Value that identifies with the name of the subscription profile.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_PRICE_BOOK_NAME
columns.comments: Price book or price list name in the external pricing application.

columns.name: ACTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Abbreviation that identifies the Type of action for subscription or coverage: Add, Terminate, or Amend. The ORA_QP_ACTION_TYPES lookup type contains the values that you can use for this attribute.

columns.name: ACTION_TYPE
columns.comments: Value that identifies the name of the type of the action with respect to the Subscription or the Coverage product.

columns.name: END_REASON_CODE
columns.comments: Abbreviation that identifies the Reason to end or amend the subscription or coverage. The ORA_OSS_CLOSE_REASONS lookup type contains the values that you can use for this attribute.

columns.name: END_REASON
columns.comments: Value that identifies the name of the Reason for ending or amending the subscription or coverage.

columns.name: END_CREDIT_METHOD_CODE
columns.comments: Abbreviation that identifies the credit method for ending or amending the subscription or coverage. The ORA_OSS_CLOSE_CREDIT_METHOD lookup type contains the values that you can use for this attribute.

columns.name: END_CREDIT_METHOD
columns.comments: Value that identifies the name of the credit method used for ending or amending a subscription or coverage.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.comments: Date when the subscription or coverage is ended.

columns.name: DEMAND_SOURCE_LINE_REFERENCE
columns.comments: Value that uniquely identifies demand, such as the line in a shopping cart on a web store or in an ecommerce application. You create a sales order in a web store, the web store sends a request to Global Order Promising to schedule it, Global Order Promising schedules the demand and sends a reply to the web store, the web store sends the sales order to Order Management, then Order Management manages the order through fulfillment.

columns.name: REQUESTED_RATE_PLAN_ID
columns.comments: Value that uniquely identifies the rate plan requested by the user. The rate plan is maintained in Oracle Fusion Cloud Pricing. This is available for use with the Integrate Order Management with Subscription Management to Process Subscriptions and Rate Usage With Events features.

columns.name: REQUESTED_RATE_PLAN_NUMBER
columns.comments: Number that identifies the rate plan requested by the user. The rate plan is maintained in Oracle Fusion Cloud Pricing. This is available for use with the Integrate Order Management with Subscription Management to Process Subscriptions and Rate Usage With Events features.

columns.name: CANCEL_BACKORDERS_FLAG
columns.comments: Contains Y or N. Y: Allow user to cancel sales orders or order lines that have items that are on back order. N: Don't allow.

columns.name: ENFORCE_SINGLE_SHIPMENT_FLAG
columns.comments: Contains Y or N. Y: Allow user to cancel the part of the order line's quantity that they can't ship in one shipment. N: Don't allow.

columns.name: AGREEMENT_LINE_ID
columns.comments: Value that uniquely identifies the sales agreement line on the order line.

columns.name: AGREEMENT_LINE_NUMBER
columns.comments: Number that uniquely identifies the sales agreement line on the order line.

columns.name: BILLING_SET_NAME
columns.comments: Name for a group of order lines that you invoice together.

columns.name: ATTACH_TO_SUBSCRIPTION
columns.comments: Number that identifies the subscription or coverage to which you will add this subscription or coverage line.

columns.comments: Unique identifier of the import request.

columns.name: CC_TOKEN_NUMBER
columns.comments: Token number issued by the tokenization service provider corresponding to a credit card number.

columns.name: CC_EXPIRATION_DATE
columns.comments: Date when the credit card is no longer valid. Use the YYYY/MM/DD format.

columns.name: CC_FIRST_NAME
columns.comments: First name of the credit card holder.

columns.name: CC_LAST_NAME
columns.comments: Last name of the credit card holder.

columns.name: CC_ISSUER_CODE
columns.comments: Abbreviation that uniquely identifies the organization that issued the credit card. For example, VISA or MASTERCARD.

columns.name: CC_MASKED_NUMBER
columns.comments: Masked format that displays only the last four digits of a credit card number, and replaces all other digits with X. This attribute is used for security purposes. The length of the masked card number should match the actual length of the number provided by the card issuer. For example, the masked card number for a Visa card number is XXXXXXXXXXXX2345.

columns.name: CC_AUTH_REQUEST_ID
columns.comments: Authorization request identifier received from the tokenization service provider to authorize the credit card number. If you want to import a credit card authorization other than the Credit Card Token Number, then you must provide either the Credit Card Authorization Request Identifier or the Credit Card Voice Authorization Code. If both are provided, then the Credit Card Authorization Request Identifier takes precedence.

columns.name: CC_VOICE_AUTH_CODE
columns.comments: Voice authorization code received from the tokenization service provider to authorize the credit card number. If you want to import a credit card authorization other than the Credit Card Token Number, then you must provide either the Credit Card Authorization Request Identifier or the Credit Card Voice Authorization Code. If both are provided, then the Credit Card Authorization Request Identifier takes precedence.

columns.name: PAYMENT_SERVER_ORDER_NUM
columns.comments: Number that identifies the credit card payment that was authorized by Oracle Payment Server.

columns.name: AUTHORIZED_AMOUNT
columns.comments: Authorized amount received from the tokenization service provider to authorize the transaction. The authorized amount must be provided if the authorization request identifier is sent in the payload.

columns.name: CHECK_NUMBER

STATUS: Provides overall request status WAIT: These records are meant for the wait service SPLIT: These records are meant for the split manager LINESTATUS: This is the line level return data which will have a RecordNumber to point to the corresponding input record. objects.name: DOO_ACCRUAL_CHARGE_COMP_V
objects.query:
select FLINES.FULFILL_LINE_ID
,FLINES.SOURCE_ORG_ID
,FLINE_DETAILS.BILLING_TRANSACTION_NUMBER
,FLINE_DETAILS.BILLING_TRANSACTION_DATE
,FLINE_DETAILS.CUSTOMER_TRX_LINE_ID
,(case when (FLINES.shipped_qty > 0 ) then (select WAYBILL_NUMBER from DOO_FULFILL_LINE_DETAILS where TASK_TYPE = 'Shipment' and fulfill_line_id=FLINES.fulfill_line_id)
else null
end ) WAYBILL_NUMBER
,(case when (FLINES.shipped_qty > 0 ) then (select BILL_OF_LADING_NUMBER from DOO_FULFILL_LINE_DETAILS where TASK_TYPE = 'Shipment' and fulfill_line_id=FLINES.fulfill_line_id)
else null
end ) BILL_OF_LADING_NUMBER
,(case when (FLINES.shipped_qty > 0 ) then (select TRACKING_NUMBER from DOO_FULFILL_LINE_DETAILS where TASK_TYPE = 'Shipment' and fulfill_line_id=FLINES.fulfill_line_id)
else null
end ) TRACKING_NUMBER
,(case when (FLINES.shipped_qty > 0 ) then (select DELIVERY_NAME from DOO_FULFILL_LINE_DETAILS where TASK_TYPE = 'Shipment' and fulfill_line_id=FLINES.fulfill_line_id)
else null
end ) DELIVERY_NAME
,decode((SELECT count(*) FROM DOO_BILLING_PLANS WHERE FULFILL_LINE_ID=FLINES.FULFILL_LINE_ID),0,'N','Y') BILLING_PLANS_EXIST
, (case when (FLINES.rma_delivered_qty > 0 ) then (select rma_receipt_date from DOO_FULFILL_LINE_DETAILS where TASK_TYPE = 'Return' and fulfill_line_id=FLINES.fulfill_line_id)
else null
end ) RMA_RECEIPT_DATE
,COMPONENTS.PRICING_SOURCE_ID
,COMPONENTS.PRICING_SOURCE_TYPE_CODE
,COMPONENTS.PRICE_ELEMENT_CODE
,COMPONENTS.CHARGE_CURRENCY_CODE
,COMPONENTS.CHARGE_CURRENCY_EXT_AMOUNT
,COMPONENTS.CHARGE_CURRENCY_UNIT_PRICE
,COMPONENTS.HEADER_CURRENCY_CODE
,COMPONENTS.HEADER_CURRENCY_EXT_AMOUNT
,COMPONENTS.HEADER_CURRENCY_UNIT_PRICE
,COMPONENTS.PERCENT_OF_COMPARISON_ELEMENT
,COMPONENTS.PRICE_ELEMENT_USAGE_CODE
,CHARGES.ORDER_CHARGE_ID
,CHARGES.CHARGE_DEFINITION_CODE
,CHARGES.PRICE_PERIODICITY_CODE
,FLINES.HEADER_ID
,FLINES.BILL_TO_CUSTOMER_ID
,FLINES.BILL_TO_SITE_USE_ID
,FLINES.SHIP_TO_PARTY_SITE_ID
,FLINES.SHIP_TO_PARTY_ID
,FLINES.ACTUAL_SHIP_DATE
,FLINES.FULFILLED_QTY
,FLINES.SHIPPED_QTY
,FLINES.ORDERED_QTY
,FLINES.ORDERED_UOM
,FLINES.UNIT_LIST_PRICE
,FLINES.UNIT_SELLING_PRICE
,FLINES.STATUS_CODE

columns.name: PLAN_ID

columns.comments: Quantity of the item being produced

columns.comments: Type of the item consumed. Valid values are ???Item??? and ???Resource???.

columns.name: CONSUMED_ITEM_ID
columns.comments: Consumed Item Identifier

columns.comments: Quantity of the item being consumed. Not null if the CONSUMED_ITEM_TYPE is 'ITEM'

columns.comments: Consumed Resource Identifier. Not null, if COMPONENT_ITEM_TYPE is 'RESOURCE???. If COMPONENT_ITEM_TYPE is 'ITEM' then the value will be -23453

columns.comments: Quantity of the resource being consumed. Not null if the CONSUMED_ITEM_TYPE is ???RESOURCE???

columns.comments: Effective start date of the for the component item or resource

columns.name: DISABLE_DATE
columns.comments: Effective end date for the component item or resource

columns.name: NEW_PLAN_ID
columns.comments: Plan id of the copied plan

columns.comments: the plan ids in format of "id1, id2, id3, etc" from all copied plans

columns.name: SIMULATION_SET_ID
columns.comments: Simulation set Identifier

columns.name: APPLIED
columns.comments: Flag to indicate whether this row contains changed row

columns.name: REFRESH_NUMBER
columns.comments: REFRESH_NUMBER

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: UNIQUE_ORDER_NUMBER
columns.comments: A string that indicates the unique order identifier for the request.

columns.name: OPTION_RANK
columns.comments: A number that represents the unique identifier for the fulfillment line availability option

columns.name: OPTION_SUMMARY
columns.comments: A string that that indicates how the current set availability option is different from the default availability option

columns.name: INSTANCE_NUMBER
columns.comments: A string identifier for the source system from which the order promising service request originated.

columns.name: INTERNAL_SUPPLY_IDENTIFIER
columns.comments: Response attribute that indicates the source document number for the internal order fulfillment line request

columns.name: INTERNAL_ORDER_TYPE
columns.comments: Contains one of the following TO, ISO and SO. Response attribute that indicates the type of internal order.

columns.name: FULFILLMENT_LINE_ID
columns.comments: A string that represents the unique identifier for the fulfillment line

columns.name: PARENT_FULFILL_IDENTIFIER
columns.comments: A string that indicates the immediate parent of the fulfillment line. This is applicable only for configured to order items

columns.name: SALES_ORDER_NUMBER
columns.comments: A string unique identifier for the sales order for which the fulfillment line is created

columns.name: SPLIT_LINE_IDENTIFIER
columns.comments: A string that uniquely identifies the fulfillment line split. A unique number is generated in case of split.

columns.name: PARENT_SPLIT_LINE_IDENTIFIER
columns.comments: Response attribute that indicates the immediate parent of the fulfillment line. This is applicable only for configured to order items

columns.name: SET_NAME
columns.comments: This column indicates the Set Name of the fulfillment lines.

columns.name: CONFIG_ITEM
columns.comments: A string that identifies the unique configuration item corresponding the configuration sent for promising. This is applicable only in the case of assemble to order demands only.

columns.name: REQUESTED_DATE
columns.comments: The date on which the material is requested to be available. Depending on the request type this represents the requested ship date or request arrival date

columns.name: REQUESTED_ITEM
columns.comments: Unique identifier for the item that is being requested.

columns.name: REQUESTED_QUANTITY
columns.comments: The quantity of the item requested on the fulfillment line

columns.name: UNIT_PRICE
columns.comments: This represents the per unit price that needs to be considered by order promising to calculate the margin information

columns.name: REQUESTED_ORG_IDENTIFIER
columns.comments: Indicates the desired organization from which the material needs to be shipped to the customer ship-to site

columns.name: REQUESTED_TYPE
columns.comments: Indicates whether the request is of arrival date or ship date type. Depending on the request type, the requested date represents the requested ship date and requested arrival date respectively.

columns.name: LATEST_ACCEPTABLE_DATE
columns.comments: A date beyond which the fulfillment line must not be promised

columns.name: EARLIEST_ACCEPTABLE_DATE
columns.comments: A date attribute that indicates the date before which the fulfillment line must not be promised

columns.name: SPLIT_ALLOWED
columns.comments: An attribute that determines whether splits of the fulfillment line are allowed or not

columns.name: SUBSTITUTION_ALLOWED
columns.comments: An attribute that indicates whether the fulfillment line can be split based on supply availability dates in the case of order delays.

columns.name: PARTY
columns.comments: The value of the party identifier representing the customer name

columns.name: PARTY_SITE
columns.comments: The value of the party site identifier corresponding to the customer ship-to site.

columns.name: REGION
columns.comments: Unique identifier for the region from which material is to be shipped to the customer ship-to site.

columns.name: DESTINATION_ORG
columns.comments: Code for the organization that represents the destination of supply, for transfer of supply

columns.name: DROPSHIP_SUPPLIER
columns.comments: Unique identifier for the drop supplier from which material is to be shipped to the customer ship-to site

columns.name: DROPSHIP_SUPPLIER_SITE
columns.comments: Unique identifier for the drop supplier site from which material is to be shipped to the customer ship-to site. This indicates the drop ship supplier location from where material is shipped to the customer ship-to site.

columns.name: PROMISING_STATUS
columns.comments: Whether it meets the request completely (by the requested arrival date) or not.

columns.name: PROMISING_TYPE
columns.comments: A string that indicates the type of promise. This can be either ship date or arrival date based promising

columns.name: PRIORITY
columns.comments: A number that indicates the relative priority of the fulfillment line when multiple fulfillment lines are sent for promising.

columns.name: DEMAND_CLASS
columns.comments: A string that represents the identifier of the demand class that the order is associated with.

columns.name: IGNORE_RESERVATION_FLAG
columns.comments: Attribute that indicates whether the existing reservations can be ignored or not during rescheduling

columns.name: IGNORE_DATE_RESERVATION_FLAG
columns.comments: Attribute that indicates whether the reserved supply dates can be rescheduled or not. This attribute is applicable only for drop ship requests

columns.name: NUMBER_OF_ALT_OPTIONS
columns.comments: A number that indicates the total number of availability options generated for the fulfillment line service request.

columns.name: TOTAL_PRICE
columns.comments: A number that indicates the total price for the fulfillment line availability option

columns.name: PRICE
columns.comments: A number that indicates the per unit price associated with the availability option

columns.name: TOTAL_PROFIT
columns.comments: A number that indicates the total profit for the fulfillment line availability option

columns.name: PROFIT
columns.comments: The projected profit generated by this split line item

columns.name: TOTAL_MARGIN
columns.comments: A number that indicates the total margin for the fulfillment line availability option

columns.name: TOTAL_VALUE
columns.comments: A number that indicates the total value for the fulfillment line availability option

columns.name: VALUE
columns.comments: A number that indicates the value associated with the fulfillment line availability response

columns.name: NUMBER_OF_SPLITS
columns.comments: A number to indicate the number of split lines generated for the fulfillment line

columns.name: NUMBER_OF_SUBSTITUTIONS
columns.comments: A number to indicate the number of end item substitutions generated for the fulfillment line

columns.name: FILL_RATE
columns.comments: Fill rate represents the percentage of quantity that can be promised on the requested date

columns.name: NUMBER_OF_ATP_ITEMS
columns.comments: A number to indicate the number of items for which available to promise inventory was used in the availability option

columns.name: NUMBER_OF_CTP_ITEMS
columns.comments: A number to indicate the number of items for which capable to promise supplies was used in the availability option

columns.name: SOURCING_RULE
columns.comments: A string unique identifier for the sourcing rule used

columns.name: EXPECTED_GROUP_SHIP_DATE
columns.comments: A date attribute that indicates the date on which the set of fulfillment lines are expected to be shipped together from the shipping organization

columns.name: EXPECTED_GROUP_ARRIVAL_DATE
columns.comments: A date attribute that indicates the date on which the set of fulfillment lines are expected to arrive at the customer ship-to site

columns.name: EXPECTED_SET_SHIP_DATE
columns.comments: A date attribute that indicates the date on which the set of fulfillment lines are expected to be shipped together from the shipping organization.

columns.name: EXPECTED_SET_ARRIVAL_DATE
columns.comments: A date attribute that indicates the date on which the set of fulfillment lines are expected to arrive at the customer ship-to site.

columns.name: DAYS_OF_DELAY
columns.comments: This column indicates the days of delay in promising the order.

columns.name: SOURCE_ORDER_LINE
columns.comments: This column indicates the line id of the sales order line generated in doo_fulfill_lines_all.

columns.name: SOURCE_DOCUMENT_TYPE
columns.comments: This column indicates whether demand is from Sales order or Internal Material Transfer.

columns.name: ITEM_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: This column indicates Item type like model/option class/standard item etc.

columns.name: ITEM_SUB_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: This column indicates sub group for ITEM_TYPE_CODE like ATO, PTOSMC, PTONONSMC.

columns.name: EXPECTED_SHIP_FROM_ORG_NAME
columns.comments: This column stores ship from warehouse name.

columns.name: SHIP_METHOD
columns.comments: This column stores the shipping method used to move the material.

columns.name: DESTINATION_ORG_NAME
columns.comments: This column stores ship to warehouse name.

columns.name: SOURCE_TIMEZONE_CODE
columns.comments: This column stores the timezone code of shipping partner.

columns.name: DESTINATION_TIMEZONE_CODE
columns.comments: This column stores the timezone code of receiving partner.

columns.name: ORGANIZATION_TIMEZONE_CODE
columns.comments: This column stores the timezone code of warehouse.

columns.name: ITEM_DESCRIPTION
columns.comments: This column stores the description of the requested inventory item.

columns.name: ORGANIZATION_NAME
columns.comments: This column stores the requested ship-from organization's name.

columns.name: BACK_TO_BACK_FLAG
columns.comments: This column indicates whether the item is a back-to-back item.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CONVERSION_RATE
columns.comments: This column stores the rate to use for conversion.

columns.name: REQUESTED_ORG_CODE
columns.comments: This column stores the requested organization's code.

columns.name: REQUESTED_ITEM_ID
columns.comments: This column stores the unique identifier for the requested item.

columns.name: EXPECTED_ARRIVAL_DATE
columns.comments: The date on which the fulfillment line is expected to be available at the customer ship-to site

columns.name: EXPECTED_SHIP_DATE
columns.comments: The date on which the requested item line is expected to be shipped from the ship-from organization to the customer ship-to site

columns.name: EXPECTED_PICK_DATE
columns.comments: The date on which the shipment is expected to be picked at the pickup organization by the customer

columns.name: EXPECTED_AVAILABLE_ITEM
columns.comments: A string identifier for the item that is expected to be used for satisfying the customer demand. This can be either the requested item or substitute of the requested item

columns.name: EXPECTED_AVAIL_ON_REQ_DATE
columns.comments: A number that indicates the available to promise inventory quantity on the requested date

columns.name: EXPECTED_AVAILABLE_QUANTITY
columns.comments: A number that indicates the quantity of the material that can be promised on the expected shipment date. In the case of splits, this quantity can be less than the requested quantity

columns.name: EXPECTED_AVAILABLE_QTY_UOM
columns.comments: A string that indicates the identifier of the unit of measure used to represent the available quantity.

columns.name: EXPECTED_SUPPLIER_SOURCE
columns.comments: A string identifier to the source system to which the drop ship supplier and supplier belong to

columns.name: EXPECTED_DROPSHIP_SUPPLIER
columns.comments: A string identifier for the suggested drop supplier

columns.name: EXPECTED_DROPSHIP_SUPLIER_SITE
columns.comments: A string identifier for the suggested drop supplier site. This indicates the drop ship supplier location from where material is shipped to the customer ship-to site

columns.name: EXPECTED_MODE
columns.comments: A string that identifies the suggested transport mode from the source inventory organization to destination inventory organization.

columns.name: EXPECTED_SERVICE
columns.comments: A string that represents the expected service level used for shipping from the ship-from organization to the customer ship-to site for the fulfillment line availability option.

columns.name: EXPECTED_CARRIER
columns.comments: A string that represents the identifier of the suggested carrier from the ship-from organization to the customer ship-to site

columns.name: EXPECTED_MARGIN
columns.comments: A number that indicates the expected margin for the fulfillment line availability option. Margin is calculated as the difference between the revenue and fulfillment cost associated with the availability option.

columns.name: EXPECTED_DEMAND_CLASS
columns.comments: A string that represents the identifier of the demand class that the order is associated with.

columns.name: EXPECTED_TOTAL_FULFILMENT_COST
columns.comments: A number that represents the total expected cost associated with the fulfillment line availability option

columns.name: EXPECTED_SHIPPING_COST
columns.comments: A number that represents the expected shipping cost associated with the fulfillment line availability option

columns.name: LINE_FILL_RATE
columns.comments: A number that represents the percentage of quantity that can be promised by the requested date

columns.name: EXPECTED_SHIP_FROM_ORG
columns.comments: A string that represents the expected shipping organization to the customer ship-to site for the fulfillment line availability option

columns.name: CARRIER_CALENDAR
columns.comments: A string that indicates the suggested carrier calendar from the ship-from organization to the customer ship-to site

columns.name: DESTINATION_RECEIVING_CALENDAR
columns.comments: A string that represents the receiving calendar for the customer or destination organization in case in internal order

columns.name: CUSTOMER_CLASS

columns.comments: Contains one of the following values: Yes or No. If Yes, then the pegging information needs to be sent by Oracle Global Order Promising Cloud as a response to the request. If No, then pegging information doesn't need to be sent by Oracle Global Order Promising Cloud in addition to the promise information, which is always sent. The default value is No.

If both MinPromiseQuantity and MinPromisePercentage are specified, calculate minimum promise quantity based on both criteria; the higher value becomes the constraint.If FillKillFlag=true, this is the min quantity that needs to be available on the RequestedDate. columns.name: COLLINEARITYUSERIDGE
columns.comments: COLLINEARITY_USE_RIDGE: Feature - Colinearity. A flag controlling use of Ridge regression or QR/SVD decomposition in cases of collinearity. If set to 0 - Ridge Service is not used. 1(default) - use Ridge for cases of collinearity. 2 - use QR instead SVD for cases of collinearity and NonNegRegr.

columns.name: COLLINEARITYTOLERANCE
columns.comments: COLLINEARITY_TOLERANCE: Feature - Colinearity. Parameter controlling sensitivity of collinearity detection. Default value of 1 detects very strong cases. Large values such as 1000 would detect weaker cases. Can be set between 1 and 100,000

columns.name: COLLINEARITYMAXRATIO
columns.comments: COLLINEARITY_MAX_RATIO: Feature - Colinearity. Maximum ratio allowed between base or lift elements and total demand. Can be set to any integer greater than one.

columns.name: POPULATIONFILTER
columns.comments: POPULATION_FILTER: Feature - Population Filter. 'Applies a filter on a batch profile. Default- No filter. Example: MDP_MATRIX .PREDICTION_STATUS=1. Syntax must include the tables for the from clause. Example: ITEMS.ITEM_ID=MDP_MATRIX.ITEM_ID AND ITEMS.ITEM_ID<100.'.

columns.name: INTERMITTENCYOUTPUTTYPE

columns.name: TRAININGPERCENT

columns.name: OUTOFSAMPLETESTSETS
columns.comments: OUT_OF_SAMPLE_TEST_SETS: Specifies the number of valid historical test sets for out of sample error calculation. Use 0 to disable the out of sample data set. Use 2-N to determine the number of data sets. When choosing 1, engine will use 2 instead.

columns.name: ACCURACYTHRESHOLD
columns.comments: ACCURACY_THRESHOLD : Specifies the minimum acceptable forecast accuracy required for cross-product machine learning forecasting methods. The values should be between 0.4 and 0.9.

columns.name: ACCURACYSTRATIFICATIONLEVEL
columns.comments: ACCURACY_STRATIFICATION_LEVEL : Specifies the product dimension level to use for forecast accuracy calculation by cross-product machine learning forecasting methods.

columns.name: PLANADVISORNOTIFLAYOUTID

columns.name: ENABLENODALTUNING
columns.comments: Specifies whether to use nodal forecast parameter values during a forecast run. If hypertuning is turned on then nodal tuning should also be turned on. Parameter values may be 0 or 1. 0 for not using nodal tuning,1 for using nodal tuning

columns.name: HYPERTUNESAMPLEPERCENT
columns.comments: Specifies the percentage of the plan population for which hyperparameter tuning is done during the forecast generation. Parameter values may be 0, n, 100. 0 for no hyperparameter tuning, N for random sample of population for hyperparameter tuning, 100 for hyperparameter tuning for all of the plan population.

columns.name: HYPERTUNEOUTPUTMODE
columns.comments: Specifies whether to save the results of hyperparameter tuning in the output measures. Parameter values may be 0, 1, 2. 0 for no saving, 1 for saving optimal settings, MAPE metrics and optimal forecast in profile output measure, 2 for saving the optimal settings, MAPE metrics and optimal forecast in separate hypertuning forecast measure.

columns.name: HYPERTUNEADVISOR
columns.comments: Specifies whether to provide notifications through the Planning Advisor when better forecasting results are available because of hyperparameter tuning. Parameter values may be 0, 1. 0 for no notifications through the Planning Advisor, 1 for providing notifications through the Planning Advisor.

columns.name: HYPERTUNEHOLDBACK
columns.comments: Specifies the number of days before the plan start date to use for holdback validation (out-of-sample testing) of the results of hyperparameter tuning.

columns.name: HYPERTUNEHOLDBACKPERCENT
columns.comments: Specifies the maximum percentage of history to use for holdback validation (out-of-sample testing) for each combination during hyperparameter tuning. Holdback period will never be greater than this percent of history if specified.

columns.name: HYPERTUNEMAPETHRESHOLD
columns.comments: Specifies the minimum percentage of change required between the default mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) and the MAPE after hyperparameter tuning for a combination for the optimization to be successful. If the percentage of change is below the threshold, the optimization is ignored.

columns.name: HYPERTUNEHALFLIFE
columns.comments: Specifies the number of days that the output of hyperparameter tuning is considered as fresh. After this time period the hypertuning feature will retune any nodes where their hypertuning output is older than this.

columns.name: SETNODALTUNINGSOURCE
columns.comments: Specifies which measure to use to get the nodal forecast parameter values for forecast runs. Parameter values may be 0, or a selected user-defined measure. The 0 value denotes that the predefined hypertuning measure for that profile will be used, other values mean that the other user-specified measure will be used as the source for the forecast parameter values. This parameter will only be used if EnableNodalTuning is set to 1.

columns.name: HYPERTUNEPARAMSET
columns.comments: Specifies a default set of parameter values to be used for hyperparameter tuning if it's enabled but no values have been entered in the Hyperparameter Tuning Values column on the Forecasting Parameters tab on the Manage Forecasting Profiles page. This default set of parameter values shouldn't be edited.

columns.name: HYPERTUNEADVISORPAGELAYOUT
columns.comments: Specifies the name of the page layout that is opened from the link in the Planning Advisor notification when the hyperparameter tuning improved the forecast for one or more nodes during the plan run and the HypertuneAdvisor forecasting parameter is set to 1. The default value of the HypertuneAdvisorPageLayout forecasting parameter is null.

columns.name: HYPERTUNEMAXPERMUTATIONS
columns.comments: Specifies the maximum number of permutations to be evaluated during hyperparameter tuning. If 0 or 1, then all permutations are evaluated. If greater than 1, then this value is the maximum number of permutations evaluated for each node with a random walk method.

columns.name: HYPERTUNEDISABLESLOWMETHODS
columns.comments: Specifies whether to disable forecasting methods that slows down the performance during hyperparameter tuning. Disabling these forecasting methods can significantly reduce tuning time, but they are still used during forecasting. Specify the forecasting methods by their letters. When the value is null, no forecasting method is disabled.

objects.name: MSC_FS_WD_OP_MATERIALS
objects.description: This table stores all the Flow Schedule Component demands taken into account for planning.

columns.name: PLAN_ID
columns.comments: This value indicates the plan identifier for the record.

columns.name: FS_WD_HEADER_ID
columns.comments: The unique identifier of the record which represents the combination of work definition, item, and flow schedule completion date. Its value is an application generated unique id.

columns.name: FS_WD_OP_MATERIAL_ID
columns.comments: The unique identifier for the exploded materials of a work definition. Its value is an application generated unique id.

columns.name: ASSEMBLY_ITEM_ID
columns.comments: Assembly item identifier (item generating the demand for dependent demands).

columns.name: ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.comments: The organization identifier that represents the manufacturing plant to which this operation material belongs.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
columns.comments: The item identifier of the operation material.

columns.name: QUANTITY_PER_PRODUCT
columns.comments: Represents the quantity per assembly. This is the material quantity from the work definition operation material.

columns.name: UOM_CODE
columns.comments: Represents the unit of measure code of the specified quantity.

columns.name: BASIS_TYPE
columns.comments: Indicates whether the material quantity is fixed (i.e. quantity per lot produced) or variable (i.e. quantity per item produced). Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = EGP_BOM_BASIS_TYPE.

columns.name: YIELD_FACTOR
columns.comments: This is the percentage of material quantity actually incorporated into the finished good.

columns.name: SUPPLY_TYPE
columns.comments: Reference of the supply type used for the work order operation material. Valid values exist in the lookup with lookup type = EGP_WIP_SUP_TYPE + lookup_type = ORA_WIE_WO_SUPPLY_TYPE.

columns.name: ROUTING_SEQUENCE_ID
columns.comments: Source application operational routing sequence identifier.

columns.name: OPERATION_SEQ_NUMBER
columns.comments: Indicates the execution sequence of the operation.

columns.name: OPERATION_SEQUENCE_ID
columns.comments: Unique Reference to the operation to which this routing is assigned.

columns.name: PRODUCTION_LINE_ID
columns.comments: The unique identifier of a production line. Its value is an application generated unique id.

columns.name: REFRESH_NUMBER
columns.comments: Refresh identifier populated by the collection program.

columns.name: PART_KEY1
columns.comments: Source application instance identifier.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

objects.description: This table represents the pegging from supply to demands.

columns.name: PEGGING_ID
columns.comments: Id of the pegging row, part of the unique key

columns.name: SUPPLY_TYPE
columns.comments: Type of order from which the material originates

columns.name: INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
columns.comments: Item Id of the material pegged from this supply to the demand

columns.name: ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.comments: Organization Id of the material pegged from this supply to this demand

columns.name: PLAN_ID
columns.comments: Plan in which the pegging takes place

columns.name: PREV_PEGGING_ID
columns.comments: Reference to previous level's pegging identifier

columns.name: END_PEGGING_ID
columns.comments: Reference to end pegging node identifier

columns.name: TRANSACTION_ID
columns.comments: Id of the supply order from which the material originates

columns.name: DISPOSITION_ID
columns.comments: Disposition Id of the supply assembly order receiving the material

columns.name: DEMAND_ID
columns.comments: Id of the demand receiving the material

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: DEST_TRANSACTION_ID
columns.comments: Transaction Id of the supply assembly order receiving the material, ie. transaction id of prev_pegging_id pegging.

columns.name: ALLOCATED_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Quantity of material from this supply allocated to this demand

columns.name: SUPPLY_DATE
columns.comments: Date of the supply when the material is available

columns.name: DEMAND_DATE
columns.comments: Date of the demand when the material is due

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: PEGGING_TYPE
columns.comments: lookup msc_reservation_type 1 Reservation 2 Recommendation

columns.name: DEMAND_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Quantity of the demand denormalized in this table. Historically demand_id: -1 is excess demand (i.e. where the engine pegs excess) -3 is negative on-hand

columns.name: NET_SEQ_NUM
columns.comments: netting sequence number for pegging supplies.

columns.name: LATEST_START_DATE_PEG_SUP
columns.comments: Latest Start Date for Pegged Supply=Downstream supply's Need_by_date - current supply's lead time

columns.name: SLACK_DAYS
columns.comments: Slack days = Earliest start date - Latest start date pegged supply, will only populate when it is greater than 0

columns.name: MOST_CRITICAL_PATH
columns.comments: A boolean flag to the pegging entries to indicate if it's on the most critical path (largest slack), 1 -yes 2 -no

columns.name: ITEM_STRUCTURE_LEVEL
columns.comments: Number of supplies between current supply to the end item supply. (For end pegging the value is zero)

columns.name: RELEASE_STATUS
columns.comments: Release status for the pegged supply. Only applicable for On Hand supplies.

columns.name: MRSL_PEG_SUGG_SHIP_DATE
columns.comments: Demand's pegging level suggested ship date related to demand's due date if Supply is on or earlier to demand due date.

columns.name: MRSL_PEG_PLANNED_ARRIVAL_DATE
columns.comments: Demand's pegging level planned arrival date related to demand's planned arrival date if supply is on or earlier to demand due date.

columns.name: MRSL_PEG_REM_SHELF_LIFE_DATE
columns.comments: Pegging Suggested Ship Date or Pegging Planned Arrival Date based on the sum of Minimum Remaining Shelf Life Days demand anchor date and Minimum Remaining Shelf Life Days.

columns.name: CAPACITY_SLACK_DAYS
columns.comments: Days between latest start date of the pegged supply and constrained earliest start date.

columns.name: ZOMBIE_LOCK_LIFESPAN
columns.comments: If a thread process terminates unexpectedly and if it has already acquired some locks then these locks will be left without an owner. As a result there is no other thread/process that can release these locks. If these leftover locks remain set for a duration longer than the Zombie Lock Lifespan than they get considered as zombie locks and will be cleaned up automatically at first opportunity when the engine try to acquire locks for the same inventory key

columns.name: LAST_SUPDEM_TARGET_COLL
columns.comments: Indicates when last target collection ran for supplies and demands. This column is populated by collection flow. If this date is later than the latest update time of specific value from MSC_HVGOP_IAP table then specific_value cache is stale and needs to be recomputed. Null value indicates that cache needs to be recomputed.

columns.name: LAST_ATP_RULE_UPDATE
columns.comments: Indicates the time when last update was made to ATP rule definition or ATP rule assignments. This column is populated by collection flow and user interface. If this date is later than the latest update time of ATP Rules from MSC_HVGOP_IAP.LATEST_ATP_RULE_UPDATE then ATP Rule cache is stale and needs recomputation. Null value indicates that cache needs to be recomputed

columns.name: LAST_DEPENDENCY_UPDATE
columns.comments: Indicates the time when last update was made to (1) Sourcing rule definition or (2) Sourcing rule assignments or (3) Bill of Resources. This column is populated by collection flow and user interface. If this date is later than the latest update time of Sourcing Rules or Bill of Resource from MSC_HVGOP_IAP.LATEST_DEPENDENCY_UPDATE then dependency cache is stale and needs recomputation. Null value indicates that cache needs to be recomputed

columns.name: LAST_SUP_TARGET_COLL
columns.comments: Indicates when last target collection ran for supplies. This column is populated by collection flow. If this date is later than the latest update time of specific value from MSC_HVGOP_IAP table then specific_value cache is stale and needs recomputation. Null value indicates that cache needs to be recomputed.

columns.name: LAST_DEM_TARGET_COLL
columns.comments: Indicates when last target collection ran for demands. This column is populated by collection flow. If this date is later than the latest update time of specific value from MSC_HVGOP_IAP table then specific_value cache is stale and needs recomputation. Null value indicates that cache needs to be recomputed.

columns.comments: This column indicates synchronization interval in minutes which will be used for sync to trigger.

columns.comments: Identifies the ATP rule to which inventory key belongs

columns.comments: Identifies the assignment type for atp rule

columns.name: LAST_SUPDEM_NETCHANGE_COLL
columns.comments: Indicates when last net change collection modified supply/demand for respective item/org. This column is populated by collection flow and is used to determine whether aggregated supply and demand cache is stale or not. Null value indicates that cache needs to be recomputed.

columns.name: LATEST_ATP_RULE_UPDATE
columns.comments: Indicates the time when order promising solver cached atp rule for respective item/org. This column is populated during order promising flow and is used to determine whether ATP rule cache is stale or not. Null value indicates that record was never cached.

columns.name: LATEST_DEPENDENCY_UPDATE
columns.comments: Indicates the time when order promising solver cached dependency for respective item/org. This column is populated during order promising flow and is used to determine whether dependency cache is stale or not. Null value indicates that record was never cached.

columns.name: SOURCING_RULE_ID
columns.comments: Sourcing rule that is applicable for given inventory key from the hierarchy 6 - Item-Instance-Organization,12 - Item,5 - Category-Instance-Organization,11 - Category,4 - Instance-Org,10 - Global

columns.name: SOURCING_ASSIGNMENT_TYPE
columns.comments: Identifies the local sourcing assignment type

columns.name: BOR_ID
columns.comments: Bill of Resource that is assigned for given inventory key.

columns.name: LAST_SUP_NETCHANGE_COLL
columns.comments: Indicates when last net change collection modified supply for respective item/org. This column is populated by collection flow and is used to determine whether aggregated supply and demand cache is stale or not. Null value indicates that cache needs to be recomputed.

columns.name: LAST_DEM_NETCHANGE_COLL
columns.comments: Indicates when last net change collection modified demand for respective item/org. This column is populated by collection flow and is used to determine whether aggregated supply and demand cache is stale or not. Null value indicates that cache needs to be recomputed.

columns.name: LAST_SUPCAP_SUP_NETCHANGE_COLL
columns.comments: Last date for supplier capacity net change collection will be considered as supply , this column will be used for rebaseline calculation.

columns.name: LAST_SUPCAP_DEM_NETCHANGE_COLL
columns.comments: Last date for PO/PR net change collection will be considered as demand , this column will be used for rebaseline calculation.

columns.name: LATEST_BOR_DEPENDENCY_UPDATE
columns.comments: Indicates the time when order promising solver cached BOR dependency for respective item/org.This column is populated during order promising flow and is used to determine whether BOR dependency cache is stale or not.Null value indicates that record was never cached.

columns.name: LAST_RES_SUP_NETCHANGE_COLL
columns.comments: Indicates when last net change collection modified resource availability for respective resource. This column is populated by collection flow and is used to determine whether aggregated resource supply is stale or not. Null value indicates that cache needs to be recomputed.

columns.name: LAST_RES_DEM_NETCHANGE_COLL
columns.comments: Indicates when last net change collection modified resource requirement for respective resource. This column is populated by collection flow and is used to determine whether aggregated resource demand is stale or not. Null value indicates that cache needs to be recomputed.

columns.name: LAST_ALLOC_QTY_UPDATE
columns.comments: Indicates when last manual allocation quantity changed for respective item/org. This column is populated by HVGOP flow and is used to determine whether Manual allocation quantity is stale or not. Null value indicates that cache needs to be recomputed.

columns.name: SALES_ORDER_COLL_START
columns.comments: Indicates the time when last sales order collection started. This column is populated by collection flow. If current order promising request time is between SALES_ORDER_COLL_START and SALES_ORDER_COLL_END then order promising will write these requests to MSC_HVGOP_LATEST_DEMANDS table. Null value indicates no need to store demands separately.

columns.name: SALES_ORDER_COLL_END
columns.comments: Indicates the time when last sales order collection ended. This column is populated by collection flow. If current order promising request time is between SALES_ORDER_COLL_START and SALES_ORDER_COLL_END then order promising will write these requests to MSC_HVGOP_LATEST_DEMANDS table. If SALES_ORDER_COLL_START is Not Null and SALES_ORDER_COLL_END is Null it means the Collection has started but it's not finished yet, which means the processed demands still need to be stored in MSC_HVGOP_LATEST_DEMANDS

objects.description: This table holds the items which are not supported by HVGOP. All the requests for these items should be promised by C++ Engine GOP flow.

columns.name: SR_ITEM_ID
columns.comments: This column holds the fusion side generated inventory_item_id. During orchestration, this column is used for fusion Order Management requests.

columns.name: ITEM_ID
columns.comments: This column holds the planning side generated inventory_item_id. During orchestration, this column is used for Manage Order Promising Demands UI requests.

columns.name: ITEM_NAME
columns.comments: This column holds the item name. During orchestration, this column is used for public web service calls.

columns.name: CALLING_INSTANCE
columns.comments: This column holds the value of Source system Id.

columns.name: BACK_TO_BACK_FLAG
columns.comments: This column will hold value as 1 in case the item is back to back enabled in any organization.

columns.name: ALLOCATION_FLAG
columns.comments: This column will hold value as 1 if the allocation rule is assigned for this item in any organization.

columns.name: MAKE_SOURCING_FLAG
columns.comments: This column will hold value as 1 in case item (which is not a Model/Optional Class/Config Item) having 'search_components_code enabled' or 'planning_make_buy_code as MAKE and MAKE Sourcing Rule defined' in any organization.

columns.name: COMPONENT_FLAG
columns.comments: This column will hold value as 1 in case item is a component of Assembly (Assembly is not a Model/Optional Class/Config Item) and Assembly is also part of MSC_HVGOP_UNSUPPORTED_ITEMS table.

columns.name: COMPONENT_SUBS_FLAG
columns.comments: This column will hold value as 1 in case item is substitute for a component of Assembly (Assembly is not a Model/Opt.Class/Config) and Assembly is also part of MSC_HVGOP_UNSUPPORTED_ITEMS table.

columns.name: PTP_FLAG
columns.comments: This column will hold value as 1 in case the item having ATP rule with PROFITABLE_TO_PROMISE_CODE enabled in any organization.

columns.name: ATF_FLAG
columns.comments: This column will hold value as 1 in case the item having ATP rule with ATP_TIME_FENCE defined in any organization.

columns.name: WD_RES_FLAG
columns.comments: This column will hold value as 1 in case Model/Optional Class/Config Item having work definition with resources enabled for GOP in any organization.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_CAPACITY_FLAG
columns.comments: This column will hold value as 1 in case item is having supplier capacity defined and having supply_chain_search_code enabled at ATP Rule level in any organization.

columns.name: HAVING_MANDATORY_COMP_FLAG
columns.comments: This column will hold value as 1 in case Model, Option Class or Config Item is having Mandatory component and mandatory component is having search_components_code enabled at ATP Rule level in any organization.

columns.name: PLAN_INTEGRATION_FLAG
columns.comments: This column will hold value as 1 in case the user is using plan integration. In such cases, all items of having supply/demands from Plan Outputs will have this flag enabled.

columns.name: PROMISED_BY_CPP_GOP_FLAG
columns.comments: This column will hold value as 1 whenever C++ engine promises for this item(belong to any org).

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.comments: We will use this column to find the items which are eligible to get deleted from this table. Eg: To start with say an item is back_to_back enabled (rest all other columns hold value as null). So we will have an entry in this table with BACK_TO_BACK_FLAG as 1. Now say there is a change in set up of this item (belong to any org) and is not a back_to_back enabled, then we need to delete data from this table. So, this column will be first updated to '1' and then as on we trace through all queries, we will flip this value to 2 if found. At the end of the process, we will delete the items that are in this table with deleted_flag as '1'and PROMISED_BY_CPP_GOP_FLAG is null.

Null value indicates no need to store demands separately.

If SALES_ORDER_COLL_START is Not Null and SALES_ORDER_COLL_END is Null it means the Collection has started but it's not finished yet, which means the processed demands still need to be stored in MSC_HVGOP_LATEST_DEMANDS.

columns.name: REPL_THRESHOLD_COMPARISON
columns.comments: Threshold Percentage for Policy Comparison for replenishment plans. Holds Integer value between 0 to 100

columns.name: REPL_INCR_PLANNING_FLAG
columns.comments: Enables incremental planning for replenishment plans 0 = No, 1 = Yes

columns.name: REPL_TIME_HORIZON
columns.comments: Time Horizon used for replenishment plans calculation of measure Demand within Lead Time. valid values are 0 = 'None' and 1 = 'Total Lead Time'

columns.name: REPL_LEAD_TIME_MULTIPLIER
columns.comments: Lead time Multiplier for replenishment plans calculation of measure Demand within Lead Time. Holds integer value between 1 and 5

columns.name: LAST_PLAN_RUN_START_DATE
columns.comments: For Replenishment Planning, indicates the start date of the last successful plan run. Used in net change plan run to determine number of days to be rolled for the plan horizon.

columns.name: REPL_RETAIN_POLICY_OVERRIDES
columns.comments: For Replenishment Planning when policy comparison is enabled, this flag indicates if policy measure user overrides should be retained during plan runs. null = Do not retain overrides, 1 = retain overrides, 2 = Do not retain overrides.

columns.name: CONSUMPTION_CALENDAR
columns.comments: Gregorian or Manufacturing Calendar for Forecast Consumption

columns.name: CONSUMPTION_BUCKET_TYPE
columns.comments: Bucket Type for Forecast Consumption, e.g. 1 (Day)

columns.name: BACKWARD_CONSUMPTION_BUCKET
columns.comments: Number of Buckets for Backward Consumption.

columns.name: FORWARD_CONSUMPTION_BUCKET
columns.comments: Number of Buckets for Forward Consumption

columns.name: PAST_DUE_DEMAND_BUCKET
columns.comments: Past Due Demand Bucket. The value may be either 1 (Supply Network Model) or 2 (Plan Option Values)

columns.name: PAST_DUE_DEMAND_CALENDAR
columns.comments: Gregorian or Manufacturing Calendar for Past Due Demand

columns.name: PAST_DUE_DEMAND_BUCKET_TYPE
columns.comments: Bucket Type for Past Due Demand, e.g. 1 (Day)

columns.name: PAST_DUE_OPEN_SO_BUCKET
columns.comments: Number of Buckets for Past Due Open Sales Order

columns.name: PAST_DUE_SHIPPED_SO_BUCKET
columns.comments: Number of Buckets for Past Due Shipped Sales Order

columns.name: PAST_DUE_FORECAST_BUCKET
columns.comments: Number of Buckets for Past Due Forecast

columns.name: ATTR_BASED_NETTING_RULE
columns.comments: Attribute Based Netting Rules will be available in Supply tab of Plan options

columns.name: TIME_WINDOWS_FOR_NET_SEQ
columns.comments: Stores time window in days for netting sequence. It is a positive non-zero integer

columns.name: DEFAULT_TASK_ATTR_VALUE_FLAG
columns.comments: Default task attribute value flag. 1 - yes, 2 or null - no

columns.name: INCLUDE_PROD_MONITORING_ALRTS
columns.comments: This column stores the flag:Include Production Monitoring Alerts. Values are Yes(1) or No(2).

columns.name: SUPPLY_PARAMETER_OVERRIDES
columns.comments: Store the internal option used by the Supply plan and ISD plan.

columns.name: SOP_LOAD_FROM_DEMAND_PLAN
columns.comments: Load measure from demand plan to shipments forecast.

columns.name: SOP_DEMAND_PLAN_LOADED
columns.comments: SOP Load plan id, for load measure from demand plan to shipments forecast.

columns.name: SOP_DEMAND_MEASURE_LOADED
columns.comments: SOP Load demand measure id, for load measure from demand plan to shipments forecast.

columns.name: SOP_MANUFACTURE_OFFSET
columns.comments: This column shows the value of the flag: Manufacture Offset. Values are Yes(1) or No(2).

columns.name: REPL_SUPPLY_CUTOFF_DAYS
columns.comments: For Replenishment Planning, Snapshot supplies with due date up to plan cutoff date + supply cutoff days.

columns.name: DEMAND_WINDOW_TO_CAL_PEGGING
columns.comments: This column stores the demand window to calculate pegging.

columns.name: SHOW_ANOMALIES
columns.comments: This column indicates if Anomalies to be shown or not. Values are Yes(1) or No(2).

columns.name: REPL_AGGR_PLANNED_ORDERS
columns.comments: For Replenishment Planning, the flexibility to consolidate orders in aggregate planning buckets. 1=Yes, 2 or null =No

columns.name: ENFORCE_ORDER_MODIFIERS
columns.comments: Plan Option to Enforce order modifiers in aggregate buckets.

columns.name: MAXIMUM_PLANNED_ORDERS
columns.comments: Maximum Planned Orders per Item per Time Bucket-Day, Week, and Period

columns.name: PLAN_EX_MANUFACTURER_SUPPLIES
columns.comments: If this check box in plan option is unchecked, then the CM organization will not be further planned even if org level parameter is checked. Enabled value 1 and disabled value 2

columns.name: CONSUMPTION_DTLS_CUTOFF_DAYS
columns.comments: Number of days after plan start date to stop the writing of consumption details

columns.name: MEASURE_CONTEXT_ID
columns.comments: An ID of MEASURE_CONTEXT entity (in measure_context_b) which this plan is attached to

columns.name: INCLUDE_ITEMS_WITH_SSTOCK
columns.comments: With Planned Items Plan Option for Including Items with Safety Stock in Supply Planning customers will be able to plan supplies for safety stock without planning for any other type of demands.

columns.name: MEASURE_CATALOG_BICC
columns.comments: This is the Measure catalog for Extract.

columns.name: DIMENSION_CATALOG_BICC
columns.comments: This is the Dimension Catalog for Extract.

columns.name: EXTRACT_TIME_HIERARCHY
columns.comments: Extract time hierarchy selected in the advanced options.

columns.name: EXTRACT_TIME_LEVEL
columns.comments: Extract time level either week or month selected.

columns.name: SCHEDULE_BY
columns.comments: This is a plan option to provide different scheduling options to user. This plan option will have two values, Schedule Ship Date ( 1) and Request Ship Date (3). Default value is 1.

columns.name: ENABLE_EXTRACT_PLAN_DATA
columns.comments: Plan Option checkbox to enable extract plan data.

columns.name: REPL_INV_REBALANCE_FLAG
columns.comments: Replenishment plan type flag for if inventory rebalancing feature is used, 1 = Yes, 2 = No.

columns.name: REPL_INV_REB_PARTIALS
columns.comments: Replenishment plan flag for inventory rebalancing to reduce partial recommendations, 1 = Yes, 2 = No.

columns.name: REPL_INV_REB_MOVE_EXCESS
columns.comments: Replenishment plan flag for inventory rebalancing to move excess to sweep locations, 1 = Yes, 2 = No.

columns.name: REPL_INV_REB_INCLD_SS
columns.comments: Replenishment plan flag for inventory rebalancing to include safety stock in shortage calculation, 1 = Yes, 2 = No.

columns.name: APPLY_SEGMENT_SS_PARAM
columns.comments: This parameter indicates whether safety stock parameters defined at the segment level should apply in a Supply Plan. If they apply, the policy assignment sets referred to by sp_policy_assignment_set_id will get used. 1=Yes, 2=No

columns.name: SP_POLICY_ASSIGNMENT_SET_ID
columns.comments: In Supply Plans, this column indicates which set of segment level parameters should be used. This contains for example safety stock service levels at the segment level.

columns.name: CURRENCY_FOR_REVENUE
columns.comments: Consider currency conversion rates for planning revenue, 1 = Yes, 2 = No.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CONV_TYPE
columns.comments: Represents the currency conversion type for Revenue Parameters.

columns.name: PIVOT_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.comments: Currency associated with amounts for Revenue Parameters.

columns.name: SOP_DEMAND_TARGET_MEASURE
columns.comments: Target measure for copying from DM plan.

columns.name: SOP_REPORT_RES_REQ
columns.comments: Report resource requirements by assembly, 1 = Yes, 2 = No.

columns.name: ALLOW_ATTRIBUTE_TRANSFER
columns.comments: Column to denote whether Attribute Transfer is allowed or not. 1=Yes, 2 or null = No.

columns.name: SOP_DEM_PC_MULTIPLIER
columns.comments: This column holds the SOP Demand Backordering Penalty Cost Multiplier to tune penalty cost of demand backordering

columns.name: SOP_WC_CAP_PC_MULTIPLIER
columns.comments: This column holds the SOP Suppler Capacity Overloading Penalty Cost Multiplier to tune penalty cost of supplier category capacity

columns.name: SOP_SUP_CAT_CAP_PC_MULTIPLIER
columns.comments: This column holds the SOP Resource Capacity Overloading Penalty Cost Multiplier to tune penalty cost of resource capacity

columns.name: SOP_SRC_ALLOC_PCT_MULTIPLIER
columns.comments: This column holds the SOP Sourcing Capacity Overloading Penalty Cost Multiplier to tune penalty cost of sourcing split

columns.name: SOP_DECLINING_STORAGE_COST
columns.comments: This column holds the SOP check box value to use declining storage costs to avoid prebuilding inventory. Values are checked(1) or unchecked(2)

columns.name: NET_MULTIPLE_LOCAL_ORG
columns.comments: This column holds the value for net multiple local organization. Values are checked(1) or unchecked(2)

columns.name: EIS_RULE
columns.comments: This column holds the numeric value for end item substitution decision rule. Values are Do not use related items supplies (1 or null), Maximize use of related items supplies to minimize new replenishment (2), Use related items supplies only when necessary to avoid stockouts (3). Default value is 1.

columns.name: EXCESS_LT_MULTIPLIER
columns.comments: This column holds value of lead time multiplier for excess window.

columns.name: INCLUDE_ITEMS_WITH_SUPPLY
columns.comments: This column indicates whether items with existing supplies, but no demand, to be considered in Supply Planning.

columns.name: UNFIRM_IN_TRANSIT_SUPPLY
columns.comments: This column indicates whether in-transit and shipments in receiving supply to be considered as not firm.

columns.name: ENFORCE_LT_INTRANSIT
columns.comments: This column indicates whether lead time should be enforced for In-Transit Supply and Shipments in Receiving when they are not firmed. This option applies to constrained supply plans. A value of 1 indicates that the lead time should be respected. Compression may happen when the lead time is respected.

columns.name: REFERENCE_PLAN_FOR_EXECUTION
columns.comments: Indicates whether the current plan is used as a reference plan for execution systems.

columns.name: FORECAST_CUTOFF_DAYS
columns.comments: Represents the number of days after the Forecast Demand Date which the forecast can be satisfied.The planning engine will not plan for forecasts, if the supply date is later than these many working days. This field is applicable for constrained planning engine only.

columns.name: APPLY_CUTOFF_TO_ORDER_TYPE
columns.comments: Allows the user to override the Latest Acceptable Date on Sales Orders, Manual Demand and Forecast to NULL. This field is applicable for constrained planning engine only.

columns.name: ECC_ENFORCE_RES_CAP
columns.comments: Allows the user to enforce honoring of resource capacity constraints in the constrained planning engine. Values Yes(1) or No(2).

columns.name: ECC_ENFORCE_SUP_CAP
columns.comments: Allows the user to enforce honoring of supplier capacity constraints in the constrained planning engine. Values Yes(1) or No(2).

columns.name: INCLUDE_LEAD_TIME_ALERTS
columns.comments: This column holds the value for the flag : Include Alerts from Lead Time Insights. values are Yes(1) or No(0)

columns.name: USE_MODEL_SPEC_PLAN_PERCENT
columns.comments: This column indicates whether the plan honors model-specific planning percentages for options in an option class to calculate dependent demand. This flag is shown as 'Use model-specific planning percentages for options' on the 'Forecast Allocation and Consumption' subtab of the Supply tab on Plan Options. 1 indicates yes, model-specific planning percentages for options, null or 2 indicates not honor.

columns.name: MULTIECHELON_FLAG
columns.comments: Replenishment plan type flag for if multi-echelon feature is used, 1 = Yes, 2 = No

columns.name: CRITICAL_RES_SUPPLIER_CONSTR
columns.comments: This column indicates if the plan enforces capacity constraints only for critical resources or critical suppliers.

columns.name: SOP_ADD_PAST_DUE_SO
columns.comments: Indicates if past due sales orders should be added to net demand in the first time bucket. 1 means Yes and 2 or null means No.

columns.name: SOP_PLAN_ANCHOR_DATE
columns.comments: Indicates the anchored plan start date which is between the first day of first time bucket and system date. It is null if anchor date is not activated.

columns.name: SOP_INTRANSIT_EXTRACTION_LOC
columns.comments: This column indicates if in-transit measure is to be extracted at source or destination organization. 1 means from destination organization. Otherwise from source organization.

columns.name: SOP_DECL_RAC_MULTIPLIER
columns.comments: This column specifies a multiplier value on declining risk-adjusted cost in manufacturing network.

columns.name: SUPPLY_SCHEDULE_FLAG
columns.comments: Plan parameter which indicates whether the replenishment plan considers supply schedules. Valid values as 1 (Yes) and 2 (No). Null indicates No.

columns.name: RESP_RES_ASSIGN_FLAG
columns.comments: This column holds value for the flag:Respect resource assigned units in work definition. Valid values are 1 (Yes) and 2 (No).

columns.name: ECC_CONSTRAINTS_CUTOFF_DAYS
columns.comments: ECC plans will enforce capacity constraints within the specified days. After that, the capacity will be unconstrained. Null value indicates the capacity constraints are enforced throughout the planning horizon.

columns.name: SOP_MAX_SOURCING_RULE_RANK
columns.comments: This column specifies the highest rank to be considered in a Sales and Operations plan. Null value would mean 1 and maximum value is 99.

columns.name: GLOBAL_FCST_CALENDAR
columns.comments: This column specifies the global forecasting calendar.

columns.name: GLOBAL_FCST_DISTR_SET_ID
columns.comments: This column specifies the assignment set identifier for global forecast distribution.

columns.name: ELASTIC_DATA_READY
columns.comments: Determines if there is data in Elastic.1 = Yes, 2 or null = No.

columns.name: USE_ALTERNATE_UOM
columns.comments: Determines if plan considers alternate unit of measure. Values are Yes(1) or No(2). Null value indicates No(2)

columns.name: FULFILLMENT_LEAD_TIME
columns.comments: Fulfillment lead time used in the safety stock at the plan level.

columns.name: INVENTORY_BUDGET
columns.comments: Inventory budget used in the safety stock at the plan level.

columns.name: INVENTORY_BUDGET_CURRENCY
columns.comments: Inventory budget currency used in the safety stock at the plan level.

columns.name: INCLUDE_EXISTING_SUPPLIES
columns.comments: In the plan option scope, user can select the 'Include existing supplies' checkbox to include the existing supplies such onhand and scheduled receipts.

columns.name: USE_FIRM_SUP_BEFORE_NEW_PLO
columns.comments: This option instructs the planning to use firm supplies available in future buckets before creating new planned orders.

columns.name: FIRM_SUP_ALLOC_WINDOW_DAYS
columns.comments: The firm supplies are used within this window starting from plan start date, before creating new planned orders.

columns.name: CONSUME_DEM_SCHED_IN_ORDER
columns.comments: If same item, organization is present in more than one demand schedule and if this column is selected, then sales order will consume the forecast in sequence as entered in the plan options. If this column is not selected, then sales order will consume the forecast from all the demand schedules independently.

columns.name: PRD_FAM_PLAN_PCNT_HIST_DAYS
columns.comments: This column holds the value for Product Family Planning Percentage History Days.

columns.name: PRD_FAM_PLAN_PCNT_CAL_LVL
columns.comments: This column shows the Product Family Planning Percentage Calculation Level. A value of 1 specifies calculation at the Item and Organization level. A value of 2 specifies calculation at the Item level. A value of 3 specifies calculation at the Item, Organization and Demand class levels.

columns.name: PRD_FAM_PLAN_PCNT_HIST_CAL_MES
columns.comments: This column stores the Product Family Planning Percentage History Calculation Measure.

columns.name: PRD_FAM_PLAN_PCNT_HIERARCHY
columns.comments: This column specifies the hierarchy at which the product family planning percentage is calculated.

columns.name: PRD_FAM_PLAN_PCNT_HIERAR_LVL
columns.comments: This column specifies the hierarchy level at which the product family planning percentage is calculated.

columns.name: CALCULATE_PRD_FAM_PLAN_PCNT
columns.comments: This column contains the flag indicating whether the calculation of Product Family Planning Percentage is enabled. A value of 1 means the calculation is enabled, while a value of 2 or null means it is disabled.

columns.name: ENABLE_SPARSE_MEASURES
columns.comments: Indicates whether measures are computed using sparse or dense processing. Valid values are: 1 (sparse), 2 or null (dense).

columns.name: ENABLE_ABP_SOURCING
columns.comments: Indicates weather attributes based sourcing is enabled or not. Valid values are: 1 (Enabled), 2 or null (Not Enabled).

columns.name: ENFORCE_AGGR_SVC_LEVEL_PCT
columns.comments: This column holds the value of the flag: Enforce service level percentage at the aggregate level. Values are Yes(1) or No(2).

columns.comments: A hash value is calculated for the existing forecast tree of the demand forecast profile and used to detect if the forecast tree was modified by the user since the last run, in which case the full run will be forced instead of a net change run which is the default.

columns.comments: Last History date for the forecasting profile by plan.

columns.name: FORECAST_START_DATE
columns.comments: First Forecast date for the forecasting profile by plan.

columns.name: HYPERTUNING_SETTING
columns.comments: A dynamic Column under demand tab in edit plan options, which opens the Settings for Hyperparameter Tuning dialog box. In addition, it holds the corresponding plan's population percent value to be used in the Hyperparameters Tuning calculation in the selected forecasting profile. Percent value corresponds to the Percentage of Nodes to Tune field in the same dialog box. By default, percent value is taken from the HypertuneSamplePercent forecasting parameter. Values can be any percent between O and 100. 0% means no tuning. 100% means tuning on all plan’s population. Any percent between means hyperparameters tuning on part of the plan’s population.

columns.name: IS_AUTOMATIC_TUNING_ENABLED
columns.comments: Holds the corresponding value selected in the Settings for Hyperparameter Tuning dialog box in the Enable hyperparameter tuning check box field. Dialog box can be opened from the Hyperparameters Settings Column’s in the Plan Options Page. Not checked is saved as 0, checked is saved as 1.

columns.name: OUTPUT_OPTIONS
columns.comments: Holds the corresponding value which was added in the Output Options field in the Settings for Hyperparameter Tuning dialog box. Dialog box can be opened from the Hyperparameters Settings Column's in the Plan Options Page. The user can select 'Tune and Use' or 'Tune and Compare' the Hyperparameters Tuning results for the specific forecasting profile inside a specific plan. 'Tune and Use' is stored as 1 in the database and 'Tune and Compare' as 2.

columns.name: PLANNING_ADVISOR_NOTIFY
columns.comments: Holds the corresponding value which was selected in the Planning Advisor Notification field in the Settings for Hyperparameter Tuning dialog box. Dialog box can be opened from the Hyperparameters Settings Column’s in the Plan Options Page. Notification to Planning Advisor about Hyperparameter Tuning on the specific forecasting profile and plan can be disabled or enabled.

columns.comments: Feature - Colinearity. A flag controlling use of Ridge regression or QR/SVD decomposition in cases of collinearity. If set to 0 - Ridge Service is not used. 1(default) - use Ridge for cases of collinearity. 2 - use QR instead SVD for cases of collinearity and NonNegRegr.

columns.name: COLLINEARITYTOLERANCE
columns.comments: Feature - Colinearity. Parameter controlling sensitivity of collinearity detection. Default value of 1 detects very strong cases. Large values such as 1000 would detect weaker cases. Can be set between 1 and 100,000

columns.name: COLLINEARITYMAXRATIO
columns.comments: Feature - Colinearity. Maximum ratio allowed between base or lift elements and total demand. Can be set to any integer greater than one.

columns.name: POPULATIONFILTER
columns.comments: Feature - Population Filter. 'Applies a filter on a batch profile. Default- No filter. Example: MDP_MATRIX .PREDICTION_STATUS=1. Syntax must include the tables for the from clause. Example: ITEMS.ITEM_ID=MDP_MATRIX.ITEM_ID AND ITEMS.ITEM_ID<100.'

columns.comments: Specifies the type of order: planned order, purchase order, etc.

columns.comments: This value indicates the Supplier identifier of the pegged supply or the overloaded supplier capacity

columns.name: SUPPLIER_SITE_ID
columns.comments: This value indicates the Supplier site identifier of the pegged supply or the overloaded supplier capacity.

columns.name: SUGGESTED_DUE_DATE
columns.comments: The end date of the supply (completion date of first unit). This value is from new_schedule_date of the pegged supply in msc_supplies

columns.name: EXPEDITE_DATE
columns.comments: When the recommendation is for the demand at risk due to insufficient lead time, this date is new_schedule_date of the pegged supply. For late supply pegged to forecast and late supply pegged to sales order, this is need_by_date of the pegged supply

columns.name: EXPEDITE_DAYS
columns.comments: The number of days the order is recommended to be pulled forward. Expedite days is based on the earliest date that would satisfy all end demands to which the supply is pegged. This is also the maximum lateness of all Late Supply... exceptions for this supply order. When there is a pegged demand with a Demand at risk due to insufficient lead time exception, meaning the order is already in the past, the value is 0.

columns.name: ORDER_QUANTITY
columns.comments: This value is new_order_quantity of the pegged supply.

columns.name: ORDER_VALUE
columns.comments: The order value of the pegged supply, default to 0.

columns.name: BOM
columns.comments: The bill of material of the pegged supply.

columns.name: ROUTING
columns.comments: The work definition of the pegged supply.

columns.name: PLAN_ID
columns.comments: This value indicates the plan identifier for the record.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_ID
columns.comments: Transaction identifier of the pegged supply.

columns.name: RECOMMENDATION_TYPE
columns.comments: The value indicates the recommendation type, 1-Expedite Buy Order, 2-Expedite Transfer Order, 3-Expedite Make Order, 4-Resource Capacity, 5-Supplier Capacity, 6-Resource Capacity Constraints, 7-Supplier Capacity Constraints, 8-Late Maturity Supply.

columns.name: DEMAND_NAME
columns.comments: The name of the at risk demand.

columns.name: RESOURCE_ID
columns.comments: The resource identifier of the resource for the overloaded resource capacity.

columns.name: DEPARTMENT_ID
columns.comments: The department identifier associated with the resource for the overloaded resource capacity.

columns.name: AVAILABLE_RESOURCE_CAPACITY
columns.comments: Resource Capacity available between Start Constraint Date & End Constraint Date.

columns.name: TOTAL_RESOURCE_CAPACITY
columns.comments: Resource Capacity required between Start Constraint Date & End Constraint Date, Requested Capacity - Available Capacity.

columns.name: REQUESTED_DATE
columns.comments: The requested date of the pegged supply.

columns.name: REQUESTED_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Supplier Capacity required between From Date & To Date, Requested Capacity - Available Capacity.

columns.name: AVAILABLE_CAPACITY
columns.comments: Supplier Capacity available between From Date & To Date.

columns.name: SHORTAGE_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Requested Capacity - Available Capacity.

columns.name: SHORTAGE_PERCENTAGE
columns.comments: Loaded Supplier Capacity, as a percent of the cumulative available supplier capacity.

columns.name: EARLIEST_AVAILABLE_DATE
columns.comments: The earliest available date of the pegged supply.

columns.name: RECOMMENDATIONS_ID
columns.comments: The recommendation identifier. For recommendation of type Expedite Buy Order, Expedite Make Order, Expedite Transfer Order, Late Maturity Supply, this is populated with the value of transaction_id, for recommendation of type Resource Capacity, Supplier Capacity, Resource Capacity Constraints, Supplier Capacity Constraints, this is populated with the value of exception_detail_id*-1.

columns.name: EXCEPTION_DETAIL_ID
columns.comments: This is the id of the exception in msc_exception_details for the problem that makes this end demand at risk and is solved by this recommendation. This is populated only for recommendation of type Resource Capacity, Supplier Capacity, Resource Capacity Constraints, Supplier Capacity Constraints.

objects.name: MSC_RESERVATIONS
objects.description: MSC_RESERVATIONS stores information regarding material reservations from the inventory system. Each row represents a portion of inventory that is reserved for a demand. A reservation may be against an inventory. If the reservation is against a nonnettable subinventory, the NONNET_QUANTITY_RESERVED column holds the quantity. If the reservation is against a nettable subinventory or no subinventory is specified, the reservation quantity is stored in RESERVED_QUANTITY. Note that the sum of RESERVED_QUANTITY cannot exceed the nettable subinventories for a part. This could happen if the planner manually sets subinventories to be non-reserved during the planning process. The NONNET_QUANTITY_RESERVED will then store the quantity in excess of the sum of the nettable reserved quantities. MSC_RESERVATIONS is populated during the Snapshot and used by the Planner. It is derived from MTL_DEMAND from source application instances.

columns.comments: Replenishment plan type flag for if inventory rebalancing feature is used, 1 = Yes, 2 = No.

columns.comments: Initial excess quantity available for inventory rebalancing.

columns.name: INIT_SHORTAGE_AT_DEST
columns.comments: Initial shortage quantity for inventory rebalancing.

columns.comments: This column stores the hold date of on-hand inventory lot. Engine will consider lot as available from HOLD_DATE if populated.
