WD.STATUS_CODE,
WD.WORK_METHOD_ID,
WD.ORGANIZATION_ID ASSEMBLY_ORGANIZATION_ID,
WD.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID ASSEMBLY_ITEM_ID,
WDO.LINE_OP_SEQ_NUMBER,
NULL contribute_to_yield
FROM
WIS_WORK_DEFINITIONS WD,
WIS_WORK_METHODS_B WM,
WIS_WD_OPERATIONS_B WDO,
WIS_WD_OPERATION_MATERIALS MTL,
MSC_PLANNED_EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS ITEM
WHERE
NVL(WD.SYSTEM_GENERATED_FLAG,'N')='N'
AND MTL.ADHOC_FLAG='Y'
AND WD.WORK_METHOD_ID = WM.WORK_METHOD_ID
AND (WM.work_method_code IN ('DISCRETE_MANUFACTURING','PROCESS_MANUFACTURING','MAINTENANCE') OR (WM.work_method_code = 'FLOW_MANUFACTURING' and nvl(WDO.auto_transact_flag,'N') != 'Y'))
AND WD.WORK_DEFINITION_ID=WDO.WORK_DEFINITION_ID
AND WDO.WD_OPERATION_ID=MTL.WD_OPERATION_ID
AND WD.ORGANIZATION_ID=MTL.ORGANIZATION_ID
AND MTL.COMPONENT_SEQUENCE_ID IS NULL
AND MTL.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = ITEM.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
AND MTL.ORGANIZATION_ID = ITEM.ORGANIZATION_ID
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL ROW_ID,
NULL AS WD_OPERATION_MATERIAL_ID,
COMP.ITEM_NUM AS MATERIAL_SEQ_NUMBER,
MATERIAL_TYPE_LOOKUP.LOOKUP_CODE AS MATERIAL_TYPE,
'N' AS ADHOC_FLAG,
COMP.COMPONENT_SEQUENCE_ID,
NULL AS COMPONENT_SEQUENCE_ID_PATH,
WDO.WD_OPERATION_ID,
WD.WORK_DEFINITION_ID,
ITEM.organization_id,
ITEM.inventory_item_id,
COMP.COMPONENT_YIELD_FACTOR YIELD_FACTOR,
TO_CHAR(COMP.BASIS_TYPE) BASIS_TYPE,
COMP.PRIMARY_UOM_CODE UOM_CODE,
TO_CHAR(COALESCE(COMP.WIP_SUPPLY_TYPE,ITEM.WIP_SUPPLY_TYPE,1)) SUPPLY_TYPE,
COMP.COMPONENT_QUANTITY MATERIAL_QUANTITY,
TO_NUMBER(DECODE(COMP.COMPONENT_QUANTITY,0,0,(DECODE(INSTR(TO_CHAR(ROUND(1/COMP.COMPONENT_QUANTITY,PRECISION_VAL.PROFILE_OPTION_VALUE)), '.'),1,'0'
||TO_CHAR(ROUND(1/COMP.COMPONENT_QUANTITY,PRECISION_VAL.PROFILE_OPTION_VALUE)),TO_CHAR(ROUND(1/COMP.COMPONENT_QUANTITY,PRECISION_VAL.PROFILE_OPTION_VALUE)))))) AS INVERSE_MATERIAL_QUANTITY,
COMP.SUPPLY_SUBINVENTORY AS SUPPLY_SUBINVENTORY_NAME,
COMP.SUPPLY_LOCATOR_ID,
COMP.OPTIONAL,
COMP.PLANNING_FACTOR,
COMP.ENFORCE_INT_REQUIREMENTS,
COMP.CHECK_ATP,
COMP.EFFECTIVITY_DATE,
COMP.DISABLE_DATE,
COMP.COMPONENT_QUANTITY,
COMP.ITEM_NUM,
COMP.QUANTITY_RELATED,
COMP.SO_BASIS,
COMP.MUTUALLY_EXCLUSIVE_OPTIONS,
COMP.LOW_QUANTITY,
COMP.HIGH_QUANTITY,
COMP.BOM_ITEM_TYPE,
COMP.OPTIONAL_ON_MODEL,
COMP.ACD_TYPE,
COMP.OPERATION_SEQ_NUM FIND_NUMBER,
ITEM.ITEM_NUMBER COMPONENT_NAME,
ITEM.UOM_CODE COMP_UOM_CODE,
WDO.OPERATION_SEQ_NUMBER,
WDO.EFFECTIVE_FROM_DATE,
WDO.EFFECTIVE_TO_DATE,
WD.WORK_DEFINITION_NAME_ID,
WD.BILL_SEQUENCE_ID,
WD.STATUS_CODE,
WD.WORK_METHOD_ID,
WD.ORGANIZATION_ID ASSEMBLY_ORGANIZATION_ID,
WD.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID ASSEMBLY_ITEM_ID,
WDO.LINE_OP_SEQ_NUMBER,
DECODE(COMP.contribute_to_yield, 'Y', 1, 'N', 2) contribute_to_yield
FROM
WIS_WORK_DEFINITIONS WD,
WIS_WORK_METHODS_B WM,
WIS_WD_OPERATIONS_B WDO,
MSC_PLANNED_EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS ITEM,
EGP_COMPONENTS_B COMP,
EGP_STRUCTURES_B STRT,
(SELECT NVL(PROFILE_OPTION_VALUE,5) PROFILE_OPTION_VALUE FROM FND_PROFILE_OPTION_VALUES VAL, FND_PROFILE_OPTIONS_vl PF
WHERE PF.PROFILE_OPTION_ID =VAL.PROFILE_OPTION_ID AND PF.PROFILE_OPTION_NAME ='INV_QUANTITY_DECIMAL_PRECISION' AND VAL.LEVEL_NAME ='SITE' AND PF.APPLICATION_ID = VAL.APPLICATION_ID AND VAL.LEVEL_VALUE = 'SITE') PRECISION_VAL
, (SELECT LOOKUP_CODE FROM FND_LOOKUPS WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE= 'ORA_WIS_WD_INPUT_MATERIAL') MATERIAL_TYPE_LOOKUP
WHERE
NVL(WD.SYSTEM_GENERATED_FLAG,'N')='Y'
AND WD.WORK_METHOD_ID = WM.WORK_METHOD_ID
AND (WM.work_method_code IN ('DISCRETE_MANUFACTURING','PROCESS_MANUFACTURING','MAINTENANCE') OR (WM.work_method_code = 'FLOW_MANUFACTURING' and nvl(WDO.auto_transact_flag,'N') != 'Y'))
AND WD.WORK_DEFINITION_ID=WDO.WORK_DEFINITION_ID
AND STRT.COMMON_BILL_SEQUENCE_ID=COMP.BILL_SEQUENCE_ID
AND WD.BILL_SEQUENCE_ID= STRT.BILL_SEQUENCE_ID
AND COMP.PK1_VALUE = ITEM.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
AND COMP.PK2_VALUE = ITEM.ORGANIZATION_ID
AND COMP.IMPLEMENTATION_DATE IS NOT NULL

columns.name: ALGM_ID
columns.comments: Algorithm unique Identifer of this table

columns.comments: Unique Identifier generated for the algorithm

columns.name: NAME
columns.comments: Algorithm name, which is unique across the enterprise.

columns.name: PUBLIC_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates if this algorithm can be viewed publicly from other applications.

columns.name: CONFLICT_ID
columns.comments: Disconnected Mobile: this value is used to guarantee the uniqueness of the row when duplicates are created in different databases (i.e. mobile databases or the server).

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.comments: Detailed description of this algorithm

columns.name: OWNER_APPLICATION
columns.comments: Each algorithm belongs to an owner application, and can only be edited under the owner application.

columns.name: MODULE_ID
columns.comments: Seed Data Framework: indicates the module that owns the row. A module is an entry in Application Taxonomy such as a Logical Business Area. When the MODULE_ID column exists and the owner of the row is not specified, then the Seed Data Framework will not extract the row as seed data.

columns.comments: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

objects.name: QP_CHARGE_GUIDELINES
objects.description: QP_CHARGE_GUIDELINES is to store Charge Types Guidelines

columns.name: CHARGE_GUIDELINE_ID
columns.comments: Primary Key of the table, Mandatory

columns.name: PRICING_GUIDELINE_ID
columns.comments: Foreign Key to parent Pricing Guideline table

columns.name: LINE_NUMBER
columns.comments: LineNumber is unique number starting with 1 within a given parent (e.g. Pricing Guideline). Combination of Pricing Guideline Id and LineNumber is unique.

columns.name: CHARGE_GUIDELINE_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Values will be: Item Charge, Coverage Association Charge and Component Item Charge

columns.name: ITEM_LEVEL_CODE
columns.comments: Contains values: All Items, Item Category, Product Group, and Item Based on lookup type QP_ITEM_LEVELS.

columns.name: ITEM_ID
columns.comments: Items will be choicelist lookup to PIM Item table Item Name. Stores the covered product when Coverage Guideline Flag = Y. Stores the Goods or Coverage Service product when the Coverage Guideline Flag = N

columns.name: PRICING_UOM_CODE
columns.comments: LOV for item???s UOM. Based on PIM entities. The value ???ALL??? should also be available and merged list of values. The value ???ALL??? should appear first in the list.

columns.name: PRICE_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Any, One Time, Recurring, or Usage ??? dependent on what is defined in PIM for the item, only those values defined will be available. The value ???Any??? should also be available and merged with the FND Lookup. The value ???Any??? should appear first in the list.

columns.name: CHARGE_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Contains all Active and Setup Enabled Charge Types. The value ???Any??? should also be available and merged with the Choicelist Lookup. The value ???Any??? should appear first in the list.

columns.name: CHARGE_SUBTYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Contains all Active and Setup Enabled Charge Subtypes for a given Charge Type. The value ???Any??? should also be available and merged with the Choicelist Lookup. The value ???Any??? should appear first in the list.

columns.name: USAGE_UOM_CODE
columns.comments: If price type = Usage, a LOV for the UOM from those defined in PIM for the item. The value ???Any??? should also be available and merged with the FND Lookup. The value ???Any??? should appear first in the list.

columns.name: PRICE_PERIODICITY_CODE
columns.comments: For a recurring or usage price type, a LOV for the UOM from those defined in PIM for the item. The value ???Any??? should also be available and merged with the FND Lookup. The value ???Any??? should appear first in the list.

columns.name: LINE_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: LOV from QOC, contains (Buy, Upgrade, etc, Any). The value ???Any??? should also be available and merged with the FND Lookup. The value ???Any??? should appear first in the list.

columns.name: SERVICE_DURATION
columns.comments: Mutually exclusive with attribute All Coverage Durations Flag. The length of time for an item with a property ???Service Enabled??? in PIM such as a Warranty

columns.name: ALL_SERVICE_DURATIONS_FLAG
columns.comments: Mutually exclusive with attribute Coverage Duration. Values contain Y, N. Based on lookup type YES_NO

columns.name: SERVICE_DURATION_PERIOD_CODE
columns.comments: UOM for the Duration, e.g. Month, Year. Obtained from PIM. The value ???Any??? should also be available and merged with the FND Lookup. The value ???Any??? should appear first in the list.

columns.name: GUIDELINE_RULE_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Based on lookup type QP_GUIDE_RULE_TYPES. Indicates if rule is Simple or Complex (using Guideline Matrix)

columns.name: GUIDELINE_MATRIX_ID
columns.comments: Stores FK to the Pricing Matrix record

columns.name: GUIDELINE_APPLY_TO_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Type of party to whom guideline applies e.g. Role, Employee, Partner Org, etc. Based on lookup type QP_GUIDE_PARTY_TYPES

columns.name: GUIDELINE_APPLY_TO_ID
columns.comments: Id of party to whom guideline applies

columns.name: CONSTRAINING_VALUE
columns.comments: The value the Pricing Guideline constrains to.

columns.name: SUGGESTED_VALUE
columns.comments: Suggested Value of Pricing Guideline

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.comments: User requested effective start date.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.comments: User requested effective end date.

columns.name: GUIDELINE_VIOLATION_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Exception Type of the Charge Guideline. Based on lookup type QP_GUIDE_EXCEPTION_TYPES. At run time, this value overrides parent???s (Pricing Guideline???s) value if defined. If null, parent???s value prevails.

columns.name: ALLOW_PRICE_LIST_OVERRIDE_FLAG
columns.comments: This flag is used by the calling application to allow (if checked) or disallow (if unchecked) the user from overriding the Price List returned from the Strategy on the Quote/Order. If the flag is Y, then another price list from the Strategy may be specified instead of the default one that the pricing engine would have used from the current strategy. If the flag is N, the price list cannot be changed from the default one that pricing engine would have used from the current strategy.

columns.name: ALLOW_CURRENCY_OVERRIDE_FLAG
columns.comments: This flag is used by the calling application to allow (if checked) or disallow (if unchecked) the user from overriding the currency on the Quote/Order. By default, the currency on the order is the currency of the price list on the order. If override currency is allowed, then the list of valid currencies will be limited to the currencies of the price lists on the current strategy.

objects.description: Base table for storing pricing terms for parent entities such as Sales Agreements, Promotions or Discount Lists.

columns.name: PRICING_TERM_ID
columns.comments: Id of the Pricing Term created.System Generated Unique ID.

columns.name: PARENT_ENTITY_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Type of Entity to which this pricing term is related e.g. Promotion,Contract etc. Based on look Up Type ORA_QP_TERMS_PARENT_ENTITIES.

columns.name: PARENT_ENTITY_KEY_COLUMN1
columns.comments: Primary Key of parent entity to which this pricing term is related e.g. Promotion Id, Contract Id,etc.If a key is a composite then more than one column may be used.

columns.name: PARENT_ENTITY_KEY_COLUMN2
columns.comments: Column 2 of the parent entity primary Key.

columns.name: PARENT_ENTITY_KEY_COLUMN3
columns.comments: Column 3 of the parent entity primary Key.

columns.name: PARENT_ENTITY_KEY_COLUMN4
columns.comments: Column 4 of the parent entity primary Key.

columns.name: PARENT_ENTITY_KEY_COLUMN5
columns.comments: Column 5 of the parent entity primary Key.

columns.name: ITEM_LEVEL_CODE
columns.comments: Can be item, Item Category and Product Category.

columns.name: ITEM_ID
columns.comments: Id of the product of type Target Product Type.

columns.name: BENEFIT_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Based on the Look up Type:ORA_QP_PRIC_TERM_BENEFIT_TYPES.

columns.name: PRICE_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates if the price adjustment is of price types one time,recurring,usuage or ALL. Based on the lookup type ORA_QP_PRICE_TYPES.

columns.name: CHARGE_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates the charge type the Pricing term is for. Not applicable for benefit types Price List and Accrual.

columns.name: CHARGE_SUBTYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates the charge subtype the Pricing term is for. Not applicable for benefit types Price List and Accrual.

columns.name: PRICING_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates the pricing currency code for the pricing term

columns.name: ACCRUAL_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.comments: Relevant when Benefit Type is Accrual e.g. Airmiles

columns.name: ACCRUAL_BASIS_ID
columns.comments: Based on named pricing basis of type accrual basis. The Pricing Basis of type Accrual Basis will have one or more combinations of price element, price type, charge type and charge subtype associated.

columns.name: PRICING_QUANTITY
columns.comments: Quantity of a good or service. When this value is used for promotions it signifies the quantity of a promotional item that is to be added to the order.

columns.name: PRICING_UOM_CODE
columns.comments: UOM in which the price/adjustment for the item is setup. Derived from PIM.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_ELEMENT_CODE
columns.comments: Adjustment Element to which the Pricing Term belongs. This is to position the adjustment on the waterfall display. Optionally this field is defaulted with a value that is setup in the QP: Default Adjustment Group application-level Pricing Parameter.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_LEVEL_CODE
columns.comments: Based on lookup type ORA_QP_ADJUSTMENT_LEVELS. Contracts will always use a level of LINE.Can be HEADER or LINE (or SHIPMENT when Benefit Type is Shipping Price Adjustment).

columns.name: PRICING_RULE_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates if the adjustment is SIMPLE or based on tiered Pricing,Attribute base Pricing,Cp pricing, or Formula Pricing.Based on lookup type ORA_QP_PRICING_RULE_TYPES

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: e.g. %Discount, %Markup, etc. Based on a lookup type as described below: If (Benefit Type is Accrual) then List of values based on lookup type ORA_QP_ACCRUAL_CALC_TYPES Else if Benefit Type other than Price List List of values based on lookup type ORA_QP_LINE_ADJ_TYPES End if This field is not relevant for Benefit Type is Price List.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_AMOUNT
columns.comments: Adjustment numeric value associated with the Adjustment Type.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_BASIS_ID
columns.comments: Indicates the basis for calculating a % based adjustment.When adjustment is at line level, Benefit Type is Coverage Price Adjustment, Price Adjustment or Price List Based Adjustment and Adjustment Type is Discount % or Markup %, the list of values for this field are Pricing Basis (setup separately as named entities) of type Adjustment Basis. The Pricing Basis of type Adjustment Basis will only have a single price element associated. Price Type, Charge Type, Subtype for calculation purposes are to be same as price type, charge type, subtype to which the term is applied.When adjustment is at line level, Benefit Type is Coverage Price Adjustment and Adjustment Type is Covered Product Percent Price (applicable only when the item on the pricing term is a coverage/warranty item) then the list of values are Pricing Basis of type Coverage Basis. The Pricing Basis of type Coverage Basis will have one or more combinations of price element, price type, charge type and charge subtype associated.

columns.name: PRICE_LIST_ID
columns.comments: FK. Price List id of the Price List

columns.name: TIERED_PRICING_HEADER_ID
columns.comments: Id of the Tiered Pricing Scheme/header attached to the price or adjustment. Note: a)If Adjustment Level is LINE And Price Type is One Time or Recurring then the Tiered Pricing Basis can be Item Quantity or Item Amount. b)If Adjustment Level is LINE and Price Type is Usage then the Tiered Pricing Basis can be Item Quantity, Item Amount, Usage Quantity or Usage Amount. c)If Adjustment Level is HEADER and Price Type is One Time or Recurring then the Tiered Pricing Basis can be Order Amount or other named Order Totals defined in the Totals Administration that are eligible for use in common components

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_PRICING_MATRIX_ID
columns.comments: Id of the Attribute Based Pricing Model attached to the price or adjustment. For line level shipping price adjustments or shipping policy based adjustments that are dependent on Item Weight, attribute model may be used to setup charges where Item Weight is a condition dimension.

columns.name: USAGE_UOM_CODE
columns.comments: Relevant when price type is Usage. Mutually exclusive with Recurring UOM.

columns.name: PRICE_PERIODICITY_CODE
columns.comments: Relevant when price type is Recurring. Mutually exclusive with Usage UOM. E.g. Possible values are Monthly (MONTHLY), Weekly (WEEKLY), yearly (YEARLY), etc.

columns.name: ALLOW_PRICE_LIST_OVERRIDE_FLAG

columns.comments: Indicates the group identifier for a pricing term when created as a part of the benefit creation process. For example, when user multi-selects items while creating a benefit, a pricing term is created corresponding to each of the item. This term group identifier is used to collectively group all those pricing terms.

objects.name: QP_PRICING_TERMS_INT
objects.description: This table represents the Interface for Pricing Terms.

columns.name: PRICING_TERM_INT_ID
columns.comments: Value that uniquely identifies the pricing term in the interface table.

columns.name: OPERATION_CODE
columns.comments: Value that identifies the operation to perform on the pricing term.

columns.name: SOURCE_ROOT_PARENT_ID
columns.comments: Value that uniquely identifies the parent entity in the source system. For discount list, it will be the source discount list ID.

columns.name: SOURCE_PARENT_ID
columns.comments: Value that uniquely identifies the parent for this pricing term in the source system. For discount list, it will be the source discount list item ID.

columns.name: SOURCE_TERM_ID
columns.comments: Value that uniquely identifies the pricing term. For discount list, it is the source ID of either simple rule, tiered rule or attribute rule.

columns.name: NAME
columns.comments: Name of the pricing term. For discount list, it is the name of either simple rule, tiered rule or attribute rule.

columns.name: PRICING_RULE_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Abbreviation that indicates the type of the discount rule such as simple, tiered, attribute rule. The value as based on lookup type ORA_QP_PRICING_RULE_TYPES.

columns.name: PRICE_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Abbreviation that indicates if the price types such as one time, recurring, etc. The values are based on the lookup type ORA_QP_PRICE_TYPES.

columns.name: CHARGE_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Abbreviation that indicates the charge type of the Pricing term. The values are based on the lookup type. Not applicable for benefit types Price List and Accrual. The values are based on the lookup type ORA_QP_CHARGE_TYPES.

columns.name: CHARGE_SUBTYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Abbreviation that indicates the charge subtype of the Pricing term. The valeus are based on the lookup type Not applicable for benefit types Price List and Accrual.The values are based on the lookup type ORA_QP_CHARGE_SUBTYPES.

columns.name: PRICE_PERIODICITY
columns.comments: Periodicity unit of measure for a recurring charge or recurring usage charge.

columns.name: PRICE_PERIODICITY_CODE
columns.comments: Abbreviation that indicates the Periodicity unit of measure code for a recurring charge or recurring usage charge.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Abbreviation that indicates the Adjustment type for the pricing term. The values are based on the lookup type ORA_QP_LINE_ADJ_TYPES.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_AMOUNT
columns.comments: Adjustment amount for the pricing term.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_BASIS
columns.comments: Name of the Adjustment basis. Applicable for percentage based adjustments.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_BASIS_ID
columns.comments: Value that uniquely identifies the Adjustment basis. Applicable for percentage based adjustments.

columns.name: APPLY_TO_ROLLUP_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates if the Adjustment is applicable to the coverage/model item alone or the rollup (applicable when item on term is a coverage or model item).

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.comments: Start date of the pricing term.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.comments: End date of the pricing term.

columns.name: PRICING_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates the pricing currency code for the pricing term.

columns.name: PRICING_TERM_ID
columns.comments: Value that uniquely identifies the pricing term. The application updates this value after it successfully creates the pricing term.

columns.name: CHARGE_DEFINITION_ID
columns.comments: Number that uniquely identifies the charge definition for the given price type, charge type and charge sub type. Used internally to validate price periodicity for recurring charges.

columns.name: PARENT_ID
columns.comments: Number that uniquely identifies the parent. The application updates this value based on Source Parent ID and is used internally.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_PRICING_MATRIX_ID
columns.comments: Number that uniquely identifies the matrix. The application updates this value based on Source Matrix Id and is used internally.

columns.name: INTERFACE_STATUS
columns.comments: Status of a record, such as New, Error, Validated and Imported.

columns.name: WEIGHT
columns.comments: Internally calculated attribute based on the predefined importance of the child records in a pricing batch. This attribute is used to determine weight of the item and helps batching the items so that the weight is distributed equally.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.comments: Value that identifies the pricing batch to process.

columns.name: CHILD_BATCH_NAME
columns.comments: Name of the child pricing batch to be processed.

columns.name: BATCH_JOB_ID
columns.comments: Value that identifies the records in the batch that belong to the current run.This is the request id of the parent ESS job.

columns.comments: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: IS_TEMPLATE_FLAG

columns.name: NEGOTIATED_FLAG

This feature supports common common Rounding Rules such as "Round to precision", "Round to Nearest" and "Round to value", but is also extensible to support more complex Rounding Rules including cultural appearance rules.

columns.name: ROUNDING_RULE_TYPE_CODE

columns.name: ROUND_VALUE

columns.name: INCREMENT_VALUE

columns.name: SETUP_ENABLED_FLAG

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG

objects.name: QP_SEARCH_ATTRIBUTE_VALUES
objects.description: This table stores the values for the common attributes the users will search for the pricing entities like promotions, discount lists, etc. When the users perform the searches on the pricing entities, these attribute values in this table will be searched to return the results.

columns.name: SEARCH_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE_ID
columns.comments: This is the identifier for the search attribute value. This is system generated and is also the primary key for this table.

columns.name: ENTITY_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Abbreviation that uniquely identifies the type of pricing entity for which the search attribute value is stored. For example, PROMOTION, DISCOUNT_LIST, etc.

columns.name: ENTITY_SUB_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Abbreviation that uniquely identifies the subtype of pricing entity for which the search attribute value is stored. For example, HEADER, LINE, BENEFITS, CONDITIONS, etc.

columns.name: ENTITY_ID1
columns.comments: Value that uniquely identifies the pricing entity for the search attribute value. For example, PROMOTION_ID.

columns.name: ENTITY_ID2
columns.comments: Value that uniquely identifies the pricing entity for the search attribute value. For example, PROMOTION_LINE_ID.

columns.name: ENTITY_ID3
columns.comments: Value that uniquely identifies the pricing entity for the search attribute value. For example, PROMOTION_RULE_ID.

columns.name: ENTITY_ID4
columns.comments: Value that uniquely identifies the pricing entity for the search attribute value.

columns.name: ENTITY_ID5
columns.comments: Value that uniquely identifies the pricing entity for the search attribute value.

columns.name: ENTITY_ID6
columns.comments: Value that uniquely identifies the pricing entity for the search attribute value.

columns.name: ATTR_KEY_NAME
columns.comments: The name of the attribute for which the search value is stored. For example, Item Id or Currency Code.

columns.name: ATTR_KEY_VALUE_STRING
columns.comments: Attribute Value for an attribute with string data type. For example, for the attribute Currency Code which is a String data type, this column will store the Currency Code USD.

columns.name: ATTR_KEY_VALUE_NUMBER
columns.comments: Attribute Value for an attribute with number data type. For example, for the attribute Item ID which is a Number data type, this column will store the inventory item id.

objects.name: QP_SHIPPING_CHARGES
objects.description: Table that stores shipping charges

columns.name: SHIPPING_CHARGE_ID
columns.comments: Primary Key of the table and it???s a system generated unique number.

columns.name: SHIPPING_DETAIL_ID
columns.comments: Foreign Key of the parent table and it???s a system generated unique number.

columns.name: SHIPPING_CHARGE_LIST_ID
columns.comments: Foreign Key of the grandparent table and it???s a system generated unique number.

columns.name: CHARGE_LINE_NUMBER
columns.comments: Line number for charges. Defaults to 1 and increments by 1 for each additional charge. Part of functional key for the entity.

columns.name: CHARGE_DEFINITION_ID
columns.comments: ID of the charge definition from Pricing Charge Definition. Only those Pricing Charge definitions with Active Flag = ???Y???, Setup Enabled Flag = ???Y??? and Applies To = ???SHIPPING??? will be displayed in the choice list.

columns.name: CHARGE_LEVEL_CODE
columns.comments: Based on lookup type QP_SHIPPING_CHARGE_LEVELS. Possible values are ORDER, LINE, or SHIPMENT. Indicates the level at which the Shipping Charge is applied.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.comments: Effective Start Date of this record. It is mandatory attribute.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.comments: Effective End Date of this record. It is optional attribute.

columns.name: CAN_ADJUST_FLAG
columns.comments: Flag indicating if the Shipping Charge may be manually discounted at runtime. Based on lookup type ???YES_NO??? and defaults to ???NO???

columns.name: CALCULATION_METHOD_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates how the shipping charge will be calculated. Supported values will be Price, Cost (shipping cost-based). Based on lookup type QP_CALCULATION_METHODS.

columns.name: CALCULATION_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates the calculation type when the Calculation Method is Cost. Based on lookup type QP_COST_CALC_TYPES. Conditionally Required when Calculation Method is ???Cost???. Possible values are Discount Amount, Discount Percent, Markup Percent, and Markup Amount.

columns.name: COST_CALCULATION_AMOUNT
columns.comments: Indicates the markup value /discount value for the calculation type specified. Conditionally Required when Calculation Type is not null.

columns.name: BASE_PRICE
columns.comments: Base price for the shipping charge. Conditionally required when Calculation Method is ???Price???.

columns.name: TIERED_PRICING_HEADER_ID
columns.comments: Id (FK) of the Tiered Pricing Header associated with the shipping charge.

columns.name: SHIPPING_CHARGE_MATRIX_ID
columns.comments: Id of the dynamic matrix associated with the shipping charge. Will be Based on new Matrix Type SHIPPING_CHARGE and new Dynamic Matrix Class ???Shipping Charge???.

columns.comments: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

objects.name: QP_TIER_HEADERS
objects.description: This table Stores the attributes of Tier Header.

columns.name: TIERED_PRICING_HEADER_ID
columns.comments: Primary Key that Identifies a row in this table

columns.name: ACCRUAL_BASIS_ID
columns.comments: This points to the Pricing_Basis_Id in QP_PRICING_BASIS_VL where usage = Accrual Basis This is applied when Benefit Type is Accrual and Adjustment Type is percent based.Contains a list of pricing totals when level is header otherwise list of pricing elements when level is line

columns.name: PARENT_ENTITY_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Type of Parent Entity to which this Tiered Pricing is related. It may be PRICE_LIST_CHARGE or PRICING_TERM.

columns.name: PARENT_ENTITY_ID
columns.comments: Id of the Entity to which the Tiered Pricing is related.It can be PRICE_LIST_LINE_ID or PRICING_TERM_ID

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: BENEFIT_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Denormalized from the parent. Mandatory for Pricing Term. When called from Price List Line,then the Benefit Type=Price Adjustment.When called from shipping line,then the Benefit Type will be Ship Adjustment,when called from Pricing Term,then the Benefit Type will be Accrual.

columns.name: BENEFIT_SUBTYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Denormalized from the parent.When Benefit Type is Shipping Adjustment, Subtype may be one of Duty,Freight Handling or Insurance. Based on Lookup_type : QP_SHIPPING_CHARGE_TYPE

columns.name: ITEM_LEVEL_CODE
columns.comments: Denormalized from Parent entity. The values are PRODUCT GROUP , ITEM CATEGORY or ITEM

columns.name: ITEM_ID
columns.comments: Denormalized from parent Entity. This will be used to generate Tiered Pricing Name.

columns.name: PRICING_UOM_CODE
columns.comments: Denormalized from the parent entity. Line UOM code.

columns.name: LEVEL_CODE
columns.comments: Denormalized from the parent entity. Indicates Header or Line level.Price List will pass in LINE.Pricing term will pass in LINE/HEADER

columns.name: AGGREGATION_METHOD_CODE
columns.comments: Accumulation will evaluate the volume for Tiers. When LEVEL is LINE, values include On Line,On Document,Over Time Duration of Agreement,Over Time Specific Duration,or Over Time Recurring Interval,when LEVEL is ORDER Values include On Document,Over Time Duration of Agreement,Over Time Specific Duration or Over Time Recurring Interval. The LOOKUP_TYPE IS : QP_AGGREGATION_METHOD_CODE .

columns.name: TIER_BASIS_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: It is the Volume Attribute of the Transaction for tier evaluation. This value will be used in the PDP for conditional steps in the Tiered Pricing Step. The LOOKUP_TYPE IS : QP_TIER_BASIS.

columns.name: TIER_BASIS_ID
columns.comments: This points to the Pricing_Basis_Id in QP_PRICING_BASIS_VL where usage = Tier Basis or Accumulation Basis. Indicates across what charge or set of charges the tier basis will be evaluated against when the Tier Basis Type is Amount. Indicates across what charge or set of charges the basis will be used for accumulating the values across orders.

columns.name: GRADUATED_CODE
columns.comments: Graduated Flag Checked -> Graduated - Range Pricing , Unchecked - Simple Tiered Pricing

columns.name: APPLICATION_METHOD_CODE
columns.comments: Applicable when Tier Basis Type is Product Quantity Application Method Code - Values are Per Unit , Per Block This determines how the pricing is calculated. The LOOKUP_TYPE IS : QP_APPLICATION_METHOD_CODE

columns.name: PERIOD_FROM_DATE_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Orders to be taken for Tier evaluation based on Peroid From Date Type Code. The LOOKUP_TYPE IS : QP_PERIOD_FROM_DATE_TYPE_CODE .

columns.name: PERIOD_FROM_DATE
columns.comments: Period From Date is either Start Date or Pricing Date depending on the value of the Period_Date_Type_Code

columns.name: AGGREGATION_DURATION
columns.comments: The number of units indicates the duration for the tier evaluation.

columns.name: AGGR_DURATION_UOM_CODE
columns.comments: This indicates the duration unit - for example Day , Month or Year. The LOOKUP_TYPE IS : QP_DURATION_UOM_CODE .

columns.name: INCL_VALUE_ON_CURR_DOC_FLAG
columns.comments: Applicable when aggregation method is Over time options.If checked -> To include the current order amount or quantity in the PDP

columns.name: EXPLANATION_MESSAGE_ID
columns.comments: WATERFALL_MESSAGE_NAME for the Waterfall to indicate if Tiered Pricing apply to Lines. This Points to PRICING_MESSAGE_ID in QP_PRICING_MESSAGES_B

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates the type of Adjustment that is applied to the selling price- The LOOKUP_TYPE IS : QP_ADJUSTMENT_TYPE_CODE .

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_BASIS_ID
columns.comments: This points to the Pricing_Basis_Id in QP_PRICING_BASIS_VL where usage = Adjustment Basis If the value is entered, the value will be defaulted to the Adjustment Basis in Tiered Pricing Lines. This is only applicable when adjustment type is percent based adjustment.

columns.name: PARTIAL_BLOCK_ACTION_CODE
columns.comments: Applicable when Application Method is PER BLOCK.It indicates which block to be considered if increment value is entered.

columns.name: AGGREGATION_PERIOD_CODE
columns.comments: This indicates the accumulation period . For example Daily , Weekly, etc .The LOOKUP_TYPE IS : QP_AGGREGATION_INTERVAL_CODE

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.comments: This indicates the currency when the adjustment type code is Price Override/markup amount/discount amount.

columns.name: ENFORCE_ADJ_CALCULATION_FLAG
columns.comments: This flag controls whether certain attributes on the TP line are editable or not.

columns.name: ACCRUAL_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates the accrual currency when Benefit Type is Accrual and Adjustment Type is Fix Amount. This is based on Lookup_Type : QP_ACCRUAL_CURRENCIES.

columns.name: TIER_CONTEXT_CODE
columns.comments: This attribute will include the following values passed from the parent entity: Item,Coverage,Accrual. The value of this attribute will be used to determine the list of values to be displayed for the adjustment type.

objects.name: QP_TOTAL_DEFINITIONS_B

columns.name: ALGORITHM_NAME
columns.comments: It is the Process name that is defined in the STS Algorithm. The algorithm name that is referenced here is linked with manage pricing total guideline via the total definition Code atatched to this guideline.

columns.name: PRICING_GUIDELINE_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates whether the pricing total definition can be referenced in pricing guideline definitions. Valid values are ???Y??? and ???N???. Defaults to ???N???. ) Only when the Pricing Guideline Enabled Flag is set to ???Y???, can the pricing total definition be referenced in pricing guidelines definitions. The value of this flag will not be evaluated in the Calculate Pricing Totals service.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_ENABLED_FLAG

SELECT dynamic_matrix_id,

max(case when DIMENSION_NO='Condition1' then ATTRIBUTE_NAME when DIMENSION_NO='Result10' then ATTRIBUTE_NAME ELSE NULL END) ATTRIBUTE_1,
max(case when DIMENSION_NO='Condition1' then COLUMN_VALUE when DIMENSION_NO='Result10' then COLUMN_VALUE ELSE NULL END) ATTRIBUTE_VALUE_1,
max(case when DIMENSION_NO='Condition2' then ATTRIBUTE_NAME when DIMENSION_NO='Result9' then ATTRIBUTE_NAME ELSE NULL END) ATTRIBUTE_2,
max(case when DIMENSION_NO='Condition2' then COLUMN_VALUE when DIMENSION_NO='Result9' then COLUMN_VALUE ELSE NULL END) ATTRIBUTE_VALUE_2,
max(case when DIMENSION_NO='Condition3' then ATTRIBUTE_NAME when DIMENSION_NO='Result8' then ATTRIBUTE_NAME ELSE NULL END) ATTRIBUTE_3,
max(case when DIMENSION_NO='Condition3' then COLUMN_VALUE when DIMENSION_NO='Result8' then COLUMN_VALUE ELSE NULL END) ATTRIBUTE_VALUE_3,
max(case when DIMENSION_NO='Condition4' then ATTRIBUTE_NAME when DIMENSION_NO='Result7' then ATTRIBUTE_NAME ELSE NULL END) ATTRIBUTE_4,
max(case when DIMENSION_NO='Condition4' then COLUMN_VALUE when DIMENSION_NO='Result7' then COLUMN_VALUE ELSE NULL END) ATTRIBUTE_VALUE_4,
max(case when DIMENSION_NO='Condition5' then ATTRIBUTE_NAME when DIMENSION_NO='Result6' then ATTRIBUTE_NAME ELSE NULL END) ATTRIBUTE_5,
max(case when DIMENSION_NO='Condition5' then COLUMN_VALUE when DIMENSION_NO='Result6' then COLUMN_VALUE ELSE NULL END) ATTRIBUTE_VALUE_5,
max(case when DIMENSION_NO='Condition6' then ATTRIBUTE_NAME when DIMENSION_NO='Result5' then ATTRIBUTE_NAME ELSE NULL END) ATTRIBUTE_6,
max(case when DIMENSION_NO='Condition6' then COLUMN_VALUE when DIMENSION_NO='Result5' then COLUMN_VALUE ELSE NULL END) ATTRIBUTE_VALUE_6,
max(case when DIMENSION_NO='Condition7' then ATTRIBUTE_NAME when DIMENSION_NO='Result4' then ATTRIBUTE_NAME ELSE NULL END) ATTRIBUTE_7,
max(case when DIMENSION_NO='Condition7' then COLUMN_VALUE when DIMENSION_NO='Result4' then COLUMN_VALUE ELSE NULL END) ATTRIBUTE_VALUE_7,
max(case when DIMENSION_NO='Condition8' then ATTRIBUTE_NAME when DIMENSION_NO='Result1' then ATTRIBUTE_NAME ELSE NULL END) ATTRIBUTE_8,
max(case when DIMENSION_NO='Condition8' then COLUMN_VALUE when DIMENSION_NO='Result1' then COLUMN_VALUE ELSE NULL END) ATTRIBUTE_VALUE_8,
max(case when DIMENSION_NO='Condition9' then ATTRIBUTE_NAME when DIMENSION_NO='Result2' then ATTRIBUTE_NAME ELSE NULL END) ATTRIBUTE_9,
max(case when DIMENSION_NO='Condition9' then COLUMN_VALUE when DIMENSION_NO='Result2' then COLUMN_VALUE ELSE NULL END) ATTRIBUTE_VALUE_9,
max(case when DIMENSION_NO='Condition10' then ATTRIBUTE_NAME when DIMENSION_NO='Result3' then ATTRIBUTE_NAME ELSE NULL END) ATTRIBUTE_10,
max(case when DIMENSION_NO='Condition10' then COLUMN_VALUE when DIMENSION_NO='Result3' then COLUMN_VALUE ELSE NULL END) ATTRIBUTE_VALUE_10
from
(select source_code_name as attribute_name,attribute_type,column_value,b.dynamic_matrix_rule_id,a.dynamic_matrix_id,a.dynamic_matrix_class_id,
dimension_type||(row_number() over (partition by a.DYNAMIC_MATRIX_ID,b.dynamic_matrix_rule_id,dimension_type order by DISPLAY_SEQUENCE_NUM)) as DIMENSION_NO
from (
select b.source_code_name,'VALUE_'||b.DATA_TYPE_CODE||id1.MAP_TO_RULE_COL_NUM As attribute_type,dimension_type,b.DISPLAY_SEQUENCE_NUM as DISPLAY_SEQUENCE_NUM,id1.dynamic_matrix_id,b.dynamic_matrix_class_id
from fusion.qp_matrix_dimensions_b b, qp_matrix_inherited_dimensions id1
where b.dynamic_matrix_dimension_id = id1.dynamic_matrix_dimension_id
) a, (
select COLUMN_NAME,COLUMN_VALUE,dynamic_matrix_rule_id,dynamic_matrix_id
from
(
select
NVL(TO_CHAR(VALUE_NUMBER1),' ') VALUE_NUMBER1,NVL(TO_CHAR(VALUE_NUMBER2),' ') VALUE_NUMBER2,NVL(TO_CHAR(VALUE_NUMBER3),' ') VALUE_NUMBER3,NVL(TO_CHAR(VALUE_NUMBER4),' ') VALUE_NUMBER4,
NVL(TO_CHAR(VALUE_NUMBER5),' ') VALUE_NUMBER5,NVL(TO_CHAR(VALUE_NUMBER6),' ') VALUE_NUMBER6,NVL(TO_CHAR(VALUE_NUMBER7),' ') VALUE_NUMBER7,NVL(TO_CHAR(VALUE_NUMBER8),' ') VALUE_NUMBER8,
NVL(TO_CHAR(VALUE_NUMBER9),' ') VALUE_NUMBER9,NVL(TO_CHAR(VALUE_NUMBER10),' ') VALUE_NUMBER10,
NVL(VALUE_STRING1,' ') VALUE_STRING1,NVL(VALUE_STRING2,' ') VALUE_STRING2,NVL(VALUE_STRING3,' ') VALUE_STRING3,NVL(VALUE_STRING4,' ') VALUE_STRING4,NVL(VALUE_STRING5,' ') VALUE_STRING5,
NVL(VALUE_STRING6,' ') VALUE_STRING6,NVL(VALUE_STRING7,' ') VALUE_STRING7,NVL(VALUE_STRING8,' ') VALUE_STRING8,NVL(VALUE_STRING9,' ') VALUE_STRING9,NVL(VALUE_STRING10,' ') VALUE_STRING10,
NVL(TO_CHAR(VALUE_DATE1,'YYYY-MM-DD'),' ') VALUE_DATE1,NVL(TO_CHAR(VALUE_DATE2,'YYYY-MM-DD'),' ') VALUE_DATE2,NVL(TO_CHAR(VALUE_DATE3,'YYYY-MM-DD'),' ') VALUE_DATE3,NVL(TO_CHAR(VALUE_DATE4,'YYYY-MM-DD'),' ') VALUE_DATE4,
NVL(TO_CHAR(VALUE_DATE5,'YYYY-MM-DD'),' ') VALUE_DATE5,NVL(TO_CHAR(VALUE_DATE6,'YYYY-MM-DD'),' ') VALUE_DATE6,NVL(TO_CHAR(VALUE_DATE7,'YYYY-MM-DD'),' ') VALUE_DATE7,NVL(TO_CHAR(VALUE_DATE8,'YYYY-MM-DD'),' ') VALUE_DATE8,
NVL(TO_CHAR(VALUE_DATE9,'YYYY-MM-DD'),' ') VALUE_DATE9,NVL(TO_CHAR(VALUE_DATE10,'YYYY-MM-DD'),' ') VALUE_DATE10,
NVL(TO_CHAR(VALUE_TIMESTAMP1,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),' ') VALUE_TIMESTAMP1,NVL(TO_CHAR(VALUE_TIMESTAMP2,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),' ') VALUE_TIMESTAMP2,NVL(TO_CHAR(VALUE_TIMESTAMP3,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),' ') VALUE_TIMESTAMP3,
NVL(TO_CHAR(VALUE_TIMESTAMP4,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),' ') VALUE_TIMESTAMP4,NVL(TO_CHAR(VALUE_TIMESTAMP5,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),' ') VALUE_TIMESTAMP5,NVL(TO_CHAR(VALUE_TIMESTAMP6,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),' ') VALUE_TIMESTAMP6,
NVL(TO_CHAR(VALUE_TIMESTAMP7,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),' ') VALUE_TIMESTAMP7,NVL(TO_CHAR(VALUE_TIMESTAMP8,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),' ') VALUE_TIMESTAMP8,NVL(TO_CHAR(VALUE_TIMESTAMP9,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),' ') VALUE_TIMESTAMP9,
NVL(TO_CHAR(VALUE_TIMESTAMP10,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),' ') VALUE_TIMESTAMP10,
dynamic_matrix_id,dynamic_matrix_rule_id
from qp_matrix_rules)
UNPIVOT(
COLUMN_VALUE FOR (COLUMN_NAME)
IN(VALUE_NUMBER1,VALUE_NUMBER2,VALUE_NUMBER3,VALUE_NUMBER4,VALUE_NUMBER5,
VALUE_NUMBER6,VALUE_NUMBER7,VALUE_NUMBER8,VALUE_NUMBER9,VALUE_NUMBER10, VALUE_STRING1,VALUE_STRING2,VALUE_STRING3,VALUE_STRING4,VALUE_STRING5,VALUE_STRING6,VALUE_STRING7,VALUE_STRING8,VALUE_STRING9,VALUE_STRING10,VALUE_DATE1,VALUE_DATE2,VALUE_DATE3,VALUE_DATE4,VALUE_DATE5,VALUE_DATE6,VALUE_DATE7,VALUE_DATE8,VALUE_DATE9,VALUE_DATE10,VALUE_TIMESTAMP1,VALUE_TIMESTAMP2,VALUE_TIMESTAMP3,VALUE_TIMESTAMP4,VALUE_TIMESTAMP5,VALUE_TIMESTAMP6,VALUE_TIMESTAMP7,VALUE_TIMESTAMP8,VALUE_TIMESTAMP9,VALUE_TIMESTAMP10)
)
) b where a.attribute_type = b.COLUMN_NAME and a.dynamic_matrix_id = b.dynamic_matrix_id) group by dynamic_matrix_id,dynamic_matrix_rule_id

objects.description: Contains information about component elements of a concept. A Component is a placeholder for future item, like e.g. "Engine"

columns.name: COMPONENT_ID
columns.comments: System-wide unique component id. The same component is stored as a separate record if it's baselined and therefore has a different COMPONENT_ID.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: TOP_CONCEPT_ID
columns.comments: Contains the concept id this (sub-) component belongs to

columns.name: COMPONENT_SIZE
columns.comments: Size attribute value for this component.

columns.name: MATERIAL
columns.comments: Material attribute value for this component.

columns.name: SUPPLIER
columns.comments: Supplier attribute value for this component.

columns.name: TARGET_TYPE
columns.comments: Describes the target type for this component Item Model (Variant Management) Option Class (Variant Management)

columns.name: TYPE
columns.comments: Column for Class Management Type.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

objects.name: ACD_COMPONENT_TL

columns.name: COMPONENT_ID
columns.comments: Foreign Key. Points to COMPONENT_ID in ACD_COMPONENT_B

columns.name: LANGUAGE
columns.comments: Indicates the code of the language into which the contents of the translatable columns are translated.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SOURCE_LANG
columns.comments: Indicates the code of the language in which the contents of the translatable columns were originally created.

columns.name: NAME
columns.comments: Name value attribute for the Product Component

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.comments: Description of Product Component

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

objects.name: ACD_CONCEPT_B
objects.description: Contains detailed information about Product Concept.

columns.name: CONCEPT_ID
columns.comments: unique concept ID. Each version of a concept is stored as a separate concept with its own ID.

columns.name: CORP_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.comments: Column that stores the corporate currency code.

columns.name: CURCY_CONV_RATE_TYPE
columns.comments: Column that stores the conversion rate type for the corporate currency.

columns.name: LONG_DESCRIPTION
columns.comments: This represents the long description of the concept.

columns.name: TYPE
columns.comments: Column for Class Management Type.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: MASTER_ID
columns.comments: A reference number which identifies a particular concept independent from its versions. All versions of a concept must have the same MASTER_ID value.

columns.name: CONCEPT_NUMBER
columns.comments: Concept number is an Id which will be Number Generator based depending on the CLASS_TYPE.

columns.name: IS_CURRENT
columns.comments: Determines whether the record is the latest and should be treated as the current version in work. Only one version of a particular object may be current. This must be assured on the business objects layer level. Possible values y = the record is active n = this concept version is the current one

columns.name: VERSION
columns.comments: This is the field that shows the Version value of this Concept data record.

columns.name: DUE_DATE
columns.comments: Indication by when the Product Concept is due

columns.name: LIFECYCLE_PHASE
columns.comments: This is actually used to store the workflow status of the concept i.e. approved, submitted or converted, draft etc.

columns.name: POWER_UNIT
columns.comments: This is a Lookup about the Power unit of measure used for concept.

columns.name: COMPLIANCE
columns.comments: Indicates whether a Concept is compliant or not. Possible Values. Yes, No, N/A

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.comments: Column that stores the currency code.

columns.name: VOLUME
columns.comments: approximate future production/purchasing volume

columns.name: ALLOW_ACCESSTO_EVERYONE
columns.comments: This holds either "Y" to allow acess to everyone or "N" to restrict access to Team

columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

objects.name: ACD_CONCEPT_B_INT
objects.description: Product Concept interface table for Bulk Import.

columns.name: CONCEPT_ID
columns.comments: Unique concept ID. Each version of a concept is stored as a separate concept with its own ID.

columns.name: TYPE
columns.comments: Column for Class Management Type.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: MASTER_ID
columns.comments: A reference number which identifies a particular concept independant from its versions. All versions of a concept must have the same MASTER_ID value.

columns.name: CONCEPT_NUMBER
columns.comments: Concept number is an Id which will be Number Generator based depending on the CLASS_TYPE.

columns.name: IS_CURRENT
columns.comments: Determines whether the record is the latest and should be treated as the current version in work. Only one version of a particular object may be current. This must be assured on the business objects layer level. Possibles values y = the record is active n = this concept version is the current one

columns.name: VERSION
columns.comments: Version attribute for the concept interface base table.

columns.name: DUE_DATE
columns.comments: Indication by when the Product Concept is due

columns.name: LIFECYCLE_PHASE
columns.comments: Lifecycle of concept attribute for the concept interface base table.

columns.name: POWER_UNIT
columns.comments: Lookup: Power unit of measure attribute for the concept interface base table.

columns.name: COMPLIANCE
columns.comments: List of Values. Yes, No, N/A for compliance attribute for the concept interface base table.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.comments: Currency attribute for the concept interface base table.

columns.name: VOLUME
columns.comments: Approximate future production/purchasing volume

columns.name: ALLOW_ACCESSTO_EVERYONE
columns.comments: This holds either "Y" to allow acess to everyone or "N" to restrict access to Team

columns.name: SEQ_NO
columns.comments: For every batch of data that will be inserted into the interface table a new SEQ_ID will be populated.

columns.name: SRC_LANG_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates the code of the language into which the contents of the translatable columns are translated.

columns.name: LANG_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates the code of the language in which the contents of the translatable columns were originally created.

columns.name: SOURCE_LANG_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates the code of the language in which the contents of the translatable columns were originally created.

columns.name: NAME
columns.comments: Name attribute for the concept interface base table.

columns.name: PROPOSAL_ID
columns.comments: Proposal Id attribute for the concept interface base table.

columns.name: BUSINESS_DETAILS_ID
columns.comments: Business detail id attribute for the concept interface base table.

columns.name: EXISTING_CONCEPT_ID
columns.comments: Existing concept id attribute for the concept interface base table.

columns.name: EXISTING_MASTER_ID
columns.comments: Existing master id attribute for the concept interface base table.

columns.name: EXISTING_VERSION
columns.comments: Existing version attribute for the concept interface base table.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: ID
columns.comments: This is the primary key of the table.

columns.name: RECORD_NUMBER
columns.comments: Extensibility column that stores the number of the reference entity record.

columns.name: CONCEPT_ID
columns.comments: unique concept ID. Each version of a concept is stored as a separate concept with its own ID.

columns.name: RECORD_NAME
columns.comments: Extensibility column that stores the name of the reference entity record.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY
columns.comments: Descriptive Flexfield: structure definition of the user descriptive flexfield.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CONFLICT_ID
columns.comments: Disconnected Mobile: this value is used to guarantee the uniqueness of the row when duplicates are created in different databases (i.e. mobile databases or the server).

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.comments: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).

columns.name: REQUEST_ID

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.comments: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.comments: A reference number which identifies a particular concept independant from its versions. All versions of a concept must have the same MASTER_ID value.

columns.name: CONCEPT_NUMBER
columns.comments: Concept number is an Id which will be Number Generator based depending on the CLASS_TYPE.

columns.name: IS_CURRENT
columns.comments: Determines whether the record is the latest and should be treated as the current version in work. Only one version of a particular object may be current. columns.comments: Parent component attribute for the concept interface table.

columns.comments: Structure id attribute for the concept interface table.

columns.name: INTERNAL_ACTION_CODE
columns.comments: This column is created for internal use and will be populated and used by bulk import logic.

columns.name: IMPORT_STATUS_CODE
columns.comments: IMPORT_STATUS_CODE tells status of a row in the interface table.

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.comments: ACTION_CODE in interface table allows source system to specify a particular operation (insert, update, etc) for a row.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.comments: When Data file uploaded and click on submit that time the load request Id generated.

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.comments: INTERFACE_ROW_ID is the unique identifier for the record with in a batch.

columns.name: PARENT_LEVEL
columns.comments: Parent level attribute for the concept interface table.

columns.name: CONCEPT_ID
columns.comments: Unique concept ID. Each version of a concept is stored as a separate concept with its own ID.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

objects.name: ACD_CONCEPT_STRUCTURE
objects.description: Contains Product Concept Structure entries. A Product Concept Structure could be a heterogeneous multi-level structure with line-items of different types. It contains following structure relations: Product Concept -> Concept Component, Product Concept -> AU Item (PD Items, A9 Items, e6 Items), Product Component -> Product Component, Product Component -> AU Item (PD Items, A9 Items, e6 Items), Product Concept -> Product Sub-Concept, Product Component -> Product Sub-Concept

columns.name: CONCEPT_STRUCTURE_ID
columns.comments: Primary Key which will be system generated Application Unique Id.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.comments: Column that stores the currency code.

columns.name: CORP_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.comments: Column that stores the corporate currency code.

columns.name: CURCY_CONV_RATE_TYPE
columns.comments: Column that stores the conversion rate type for the corporate currency.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: TOP_CONCEPT_ID
columns.comments: Unique concept ID. Each version of a @ concept is stored as a separate concept with its own ID.

columns.name: ANALYTICS_DIRTY_FLAG
columns.comments: 'y' - analytics data, like cost, weight etc.; must be recalculated 'n' - analytics data is up to date

columns.name: FROM_STR_ID
columns.comments: Refers to the parent structure entry identified by CONCEPT_STRUCTURE_ID.

columns.name: FROM_TYPE
columns.comments: Describes the parent object type. Possible values are: Concept Component, Item (AU Integration ID), Product Concept

columns.name: FROM_ID
columns.comments: This is the ID of parent object of this structure line item pointing to different tables based on from_type.

columns.name: TO_TYPE
columns.comments: Describes the child object type. Possible values are: Concept Component, Item (AU Integration ID), Sub-Concept, Sub-Item

columns.name: TO_ID
columns.comments: Refers to the child structure entry identified by CONCEPT_STRUCTURE_ID

columns.name: TO_ITEM_ID
columns.comments: Refers to the child ID identified by the specific AU Item ID (for PD, A9, e6)

columns.name: TO_ITEM_STR_ID
columns.comments: Refers to the child structure ID identified by the specific AU Item ID (for PD, A9, e6)

columns.name: POS_NO
columns.comments: Position number for concept structure entry

columns.name: QUANTITY
columns.comments: Quantity of this object used for the concept structure

columns.name: COST_INCOMPLETE
columns.comments: Defines whether cost data for this node is complete. That means, all its childern have complete data calculated. y=yes n=no

columns.name: WEIGHT_INCOMPLETE
columns.comments: Defines whether weight data for this node is complete. That means, all its childern have complete data calculated. y=yes n=no

columns.name: POWER_INCOMPLETE
columns.comments: Defines whether power data for this node is complete. That means, all its childern have complete data calculated. y=yes n=no

columns.name: REQ_COUNT_TOTAL
columns.comments: Total count of requirements assigned to this structure line item

columns.name: REQ_COUNT_FULFILLED
columns.comments: Count of fulfilled requirements assigned to this structure line item

columns.name: PLACEHOLDER
columns.comments: Identifies a Placeholder component y=yes n=no

columns.name: STATUS
columns.comments: Item status list of values, like e.g. "released", "approved" etc

columns.name: SCORE
columns.comments: This is a Scoring value that is set by rolling up the concept structure.

columns.name: NUMBER_MANUFACTURERS
columns.comments: This is the number of item manufacturers of this concept structure line item.

columns.name: PREFERRED_STATUS
columns.comments: AU mapped attribute: preferred status

columns.name: ITEM_NUMBER_MANIFACTURERS
columns.comments: AU mapped attribute; number of manufacturers

columns.name: REFERENCE_DESIGNATOR
columns.comments: Field that can help unambiguously identify a component in an electrical schematic or on a printed circuit board for example.

columns.name: ACTUAL_COST
columns.comments: Actual component (structure line item) cost

columns.name: TARGET_COST
columns.comments: This is the budgeted line item Cost of this concept structure line item.

columns.name: MATERIAL_COST
columns.comments: This is the Actual material cost of this concept structure line item.

columns.name: NON_MATERIAL_COST
columns.comments: This is the Actual Non Material Cost of this concept structure line item.

columns.name: FIXED_COST
columns.comments: This is the Actual Fixed Cost of this concept structure line item.

columns.name: LAST_COST_UPDATE
columns.comments: This is the Date of Last Cost Update done on this concept structure line item.

columns.name: LEAD_TIME
columns.comments: This is the Lead Time (days) of this concept structure line item.

columns.comments: Structure Entry ID for the each row in the concept structure interface table.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: TOP_CONCEPT_ID
columns.comments: Unique concept ID. Each version of a concept is stored as a separate concept with its own ID.

columns.name: ANALYTICS_DIRTY_FLAG
columns.comments: 'y' - analytics data, like cost, weight etc.; must be recalculated 'n' - analytics data is up to date

columns.name: FROM_STR_ID
columns.comments: Refers to the parent structure entry identified by CONCEPT_STRUCTURE_ID.

columns.name: FROM_TYPE
columns.comments: Describes the parent object type. Possible values are: Concept Component, Item (AU Integration ID), Product Concept.

columns.name: FROM_ID
columns.comments: ID of parent object for the concept structure interface table.

columns.name: TO_TYPE
columns.comments: "Describes the child object type. Possible values are: Concept Component, Item (AU Integration ID), Sub-Concept, Sub-Item

columns.name: TO_ID
columns.comments: Refers to the child structure entry identified by CONCEPT_STRUCTURE_ID

columns.name: TO_ITEM_ID
columns.comments: Structure entry child item ID for the concept structure interface table.

columns.name: TO_ITEM_STR_ID
columns.comments: Structure entry Child Str ID for the concept structure interface table.

columns.name: POS_NO
columns.comments: Position number for concept structure entry

columns.name: QUANTITY
columns.comments: Quantity of this object used for the concept structure

columns.name: COST_INCOMPLETE
columns.comments: Defines whether cost data for this node is complete. That means, all its childern have complete data calculated. y=yes n=no

columns.name: WEIGHT_INCOMPLETE
columns.comments: Defines whether weight data for this node is complete. That means, all its childern have complete data calculated. y=yes n=no

columns.name: POWER_INCOMPLETE
columns.comments: Defines whether power data for this node is complete. That means, all its childern have complete data calculated. y=yes n=no

columns.name: REQ_COUNT_TOTAL
columns.comments: Total count of requirements assigned to this structure line item

columns.name: REQ_COUNT_FULFILLED
columns.comments: Count of fulfilled requirements assigned to this structure line item

columns.name: PLACEHOLDER
columns.comments: Identifies a Placeholder component y=yes n=no

columns.name: STATUS
columns.comments: Item status list of values, like e.g. "released", "approved" etc

columns.name: SCORE
columns.comments: Scoring value, e.g. item score for the concept structure interface table.

columns.name: NUMBER_MANUFACTURERS
columns.comments: Number of item manifacturers for the concept structure interface table.

columns.name: PREFERRED_STATUS
columns.comments: AU mapped attribute: preferred status

columns.name: ITEM_NUMBER_MANIFACTURERS
columns.comments: AU mapped attribute; number of manufacturers

columns.name: REFERENCE_DESIGNATOR
columns.comments: Reference Designator for the concept structure interface table.

columns.name: ACTUAL_COST
columns.comments: Actual component (structure line item) cost

columns.name: TARGET_COST
columns.comments: Budgeted line item Cost for the concept structure interface table.

columns.name: MATERIAL_COST
columns.comments: Actual material cost for the concept structure interface table.

columns.name: NON_MATERIAL_COST
columns.comments: Actual Non Material Cost for the concept structure interface table.

columns.name: FIXED_COST
columns.comments: Actual Fixed Cost for the concept structure interface table.

columns.name: LAST_COST_UPDATE
columns.comments: Date of Last Cost Update for the concept structure interface table.

columns.name: LEAD_TIME
columns.comments: Item Lead Time (days) for the concept structure interface table.

columns.name: RISK
columns.comments: LOOKUP: Level of risk associated

columns.name: PRICE
columns.comments: Estimated or calculated price per unit

columns.name: VOLUME
columns.comments: approx future production/purchasing volume

columns.name: COMPLIANCE
columns.comments: LOOKUP for Compliance : yes, no, partly, N/A

columns.name: AVAILABILITY
columns.comments: External Availability of Component

columns.name: LOCATION
columns.comments: LOOKUP: Manufacturing Location for the concept structure interface table.

columns.name: ACTUAL_WEIGHT
columns.comments: Estimated, calculated or weighed weight

columns.name: TARGET_WEIGHT
columns.comments: Target line item weight for the concept structure interface table.

columns.name: WEIGHT_UNIT
columns.comments: LOOKUP: Weight Unit, e.g. Kg, g, Pound, ton, ....

columns.name: WEIGHT_QUALITY
columns.comments: LOOKUP: Quality of weight information e.g. Estimated, Calculated, Weighed

columns.name: ACTUAL_POWER_CONSUMPTION
columns.comments: Actual power consumption of the component

columns.name: TARGET_POWER_CONSUMPTION
columns.comments: Planned power consumption of a line item

columns.name: COST_VARIANCE
columns.comments: Variance between planned and actual cost

columns.name: WEIGHT_VARIANCE
columns.comments: Variance between planned and actual line item weight

columns.name: POWER_CONSUMPTION_VARIANCE
columns.comments: Variance between planned and actual line item power consumption

columns.name: POWER_UNIT
columns.comments: Lookup: Wattage etc. for the concept structure interface table.

columns.name: UNIT_SIZE
columns.comments: Size/Volume of component for the concept structure interface table.

columns.name: MATERIAL
columns.comments: Component Material for the concept structure interface table.

columns.name: ALTERNATE
columns.comments: 'y' - current structure line item is available only for selected solution alternatives. Otherwise 'n'

columns.comments: Notes to/about Vendor for the concept structure interface table.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN

columns.name: MORPHED_ID
columns.comments: The Concept Structure Id of the line item that this line item got morphed into.

columns.name: CONCEPT_ID
columns.comments: Foreign Key. Points to CONCEPT_ID in ACD_CONCEPT_B

columns.comments: Indicates the code of the language into which the contents of the translatable columns are translated.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SOURCE_LANG
columns.comments: Indicates the code of the language in which the contents of the translatable columns were originally created.

columns.name: NAME
columns.comments: Name attribute for the product concept object.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.comments: Description attribute for the product concept object.

columns.name: CREATED_BY

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

objects.name: ACD_COSTS
objects.description: Contains Cost Details for the Product Proposal.

columns.name: COST_ID
columns.comments: Primary Key which will be system generated Application Unique Id.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.comments: Column that stores the currency code.

columns.name: CORP_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.comments: Column that stores the corporate currency code.

columns.name: CURCY_CONV_RATE_TYPE
columns.comments: Column that stores the conversion rate type for the corporate currency.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: PRODUCT_PROPOSAL_ID
columns.comments: Refers to Product Proposal Id from ACD_PRODUCT_PROPOSAL table as Foreign key

columns.name: COST_CATEGORY
columns.comments: Indicates the category of cost for Product Concept (Development, Production + Custom) The supported types are defined in the Lookup type with the name ACD_COST_CATEGORY and the look up codes are DEVELOPMENT, PRODUCTION, custom values.

columns.name: COST_TYPE
columns.comments: Indicates the type of cost for Product Concept (Fixed,Labor,Variable,Material) The supported types are defined in the Lookup type with the name ACD_COST_TYPES and the look up codes are FIXED,LABOR,VARIABLE,MATERIAL values

columns.name: COST_STATUS
columns.comments: Indicates the status of cost for Product Concept (Budgeted,Estimated,Actual) The supported types are defined in the Lookup type with the name ACD_COST_STATUS and the look up codes are BUDGETED,ESTIMATED,ACTUAL values

columns.name: COST_AMOUNT
columns.comments: Total amount spent during the time-period between start and end dates

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.comments: Start date of a time-period e.g. 04/01/201

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.comments: End date of a time-period e.g. 08/01/2011

columns.name: COST_TREND
columns.comments: Indicates the trend of cost for Product Concept (Point, Uniformly Distributed, Front Loaded, Back Loaded) The supported types are defined in the Lookup type with the name ACD_TREND and the look up codes are POINT,UNIFORMLY_DISTRIBUTED,FRONT_LOADED,BACK_LOADED values

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SOURCE
columns.comments: Source of the cost row. The supported values are defined in lookup type ORA_ACD_RESOURCE_SOURCE

objects.name: ACD_COSTS_B_INT
objects.description: Product Proposal Cost interface table for Bulk Import.

columns.name: COST_ID
columns.comments: Primary Key which will be system generated Application Unique Id.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: PRODUCT_PROPOSAL_ID
columns.comments: Refers to Product Proposal Id from ACD_PRODUCT_PROPOSAL table as Foreign key

columns.name: COST_CATEGORY
columns.comments: Indicates the category of cost for Product Concept (Development, Production + Custom) The supported types are defined in the Lookup type with the name ACD_COST_CATEGORY and the look up codes are DEVELOPMENT, PRODUCTION, custom values

columns.name: COST_TYPE
columns.comments: Indicates the type of cost for Product Concept (Fixed,Labor,Variable,Material) The supported types are defined in the Lookup type with the name ACD_COST_TYPES and the look up codes are FIXED,LABOR,VARIABLE,MATERIAL values

columns.name: COST_STATUS
columns.comments: Indicates the status of cost for Product Concept (Budgeted,Estimated,Actual) The supported types are defined in the Lookup type with the name ACD_COST_STATUS and the look up codes are BUDGETED,ESTIMATED,ACTUAL values

columns.name: COST_AMOUNT
columns.comments: Total amount spent during the time-period between start and end dates

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.comments: Start date of a time-period e.g. 04/01/201

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.comments: End date of a time-period e.g. 08/01/2011

columns.name: COST_TREND
columns.comments: Indicates the trend of cost for Product Concept (Point, Uniformly Distributed, Front Loaded, Back Loaded) The supported types are defined in the Lookup type with the name ACD_TREND and the look up codes are POINT,UNIFORMLY_DISTRIBUTED,FRONT_LOADED,BACK_LOADED values

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: NAME
columns.comments: Name value of the Product Proposal object for the cost row.

columns.name: LANG_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates the code of the language into which the contents of the translatable columns are translated.

columns.name: SRC_LANG_CODE
columns.comments: Indicates the code of the language in which the contents of the translatable columns were originally created.

columns.name: SOURCE_LANG_FLAG
columns.comments: Indicates the code of the language in which the contents of the translatable columns were originally created.

columns.name: IMPORT_STATUS_CODE
columns.comments: IMPORT_STATUS_CODE tells status of a row in the interface table.

columns.name: INTERNAL_ACTION_CODE
columns.comments: This column is created for internal use and will be populated and used by bulk import logic.

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.comments: ACTION_CODE in interface table allows source system to specify a particular operation (insert, update, etc) for a row.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.comments: When Data file uploaded and click on submit that time the load request Id generated.

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.comments: INTERFACE_ROW_ID is the unique identifier for the record with in a batch.

objects.name: ACD_PRODUCT_PROPOSAL_INT
objects.description: Product Proposal interface table for Bulk Import.

columns.name: PRODUCT_PROPOSAL_ID
columns.comments: Primary Key which will be system generated Application Unique Id.

columns.name: THREAD_ID
columns.comments: Thread id column for requirement staging table.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.comments: This represents the description of the product concept.

columns.name: PUBLISHED_FROM_PORTFOLIO
columns.comments: Shows that the proposal is published from portfolio or not.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: IS_CLONED
columns.comments: Specifies if theProduct Proposal is a cloned copy. Y - Cloned;N-Not Cloned. Default N

columns.name: CONCEPT_MASTER_ID
columns.comments: MASTER_ID from CONCEPT_B table as Foreign Key

columns.name: PROPOSAL_STATUS
columns.comments: Indicates the Proposal Status value for the Product Concept (Draft, Submitted, and Approved). The supported types are defined in the Lookup type with the name ACD_PROPOSAL_STATUS and the look up codes are DRAFT_STATUS, SUBMITTED_STATUS, and APPROVED_STATUS. Default Value is DRAFT_STATUS

columns.name: VERSION
columns.comments: This is the version number for this proposal.

columns.name: IS_LATEST
columns.comments: Flag which indicates whether the proposal is latest or not. 'Y' stands for latest version and 'N' stands for old version.

columns.name: LAST_CONCEPT_VERSION
columns.comments: Indicates last concept version with which proposal is associated.

columns.name: SRC_PRODUCT_PROPOSAL_ID
columns.comments: Product Proposal Id of the source Product Proposal for a cloned copy

columns.name: PROPOSAL_TYPE
columns.comments: Indicates the proposal type for the Product COncept (New Technology, New Concept, New Product, Sustaining Product, End of Life). The supported types are defined in the Lookup type with the name ACD_PROPOSAL_TYPE and the look up codes are NEW_TECHNOLOGY, NEW_CONCEPT,SUSTAINING_PRODUCT,END_OF_LIFE.

columns.name: ALLOW_ACCESSTO_EVERYONE
columns.comments: This holds either "Y" to allow acess to everyone or "N" to restrict access to Team

columns.name: LAST_PROJ_RES_REFRESH_TIME
columns.comments: Stores last refresh time of resources updated from projects

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.comments: Refers to the lookup code in Fnd Lookups with LookupType as ACD_PROPOSAL_PORTFOLIOS

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comments: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.comments: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
